/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0. -/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanMinimalFusion
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanMixedStopLoss

/-!
# Actual fusion: exact moving-mean integral and threshold transport

Treehood, order, edge counts, integrability and the one-unit count gap are
discharged for the same actual source/fused pair. Positivity of the integral
at the actual mean is necessary and sufficient for strict energy decrease.
A reserve above 2/n at threshold two is a sufficient alternative.
Source: unified manuscript, revised 22 September 2026, Sections 2 and 9.
-/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ActualFusionIntegral
open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

def delta (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum (source C u p q)) t -
    stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum (fused C u p q)) t

def normalizedIntegral (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0,
    MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source C u p q) (fused C u p q) t y)

omit [DecidableEq V] in
theorem source_fused_card (p q : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) =
      Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) := by
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

theorem logarithm_integrable (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source C u p q) (fused C u p q) t)
      (Ioi 0) :=
  MixedGraphIntegral.integrable _ _ (source_fused_card (V := V) p q) t

omit [DecidableEq V] in
theorem source_fused_edges (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    (source C u p q).edgeFinset.card = (fused C u p q).edgeFinset.card := by
  have hs := hT.card_edgeFinset
  have hf := (FusionDescent.fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hT hd).1.card_edgeFinset
  have hc := source_fused_card (V := V) p q
  omega

theorem integral_eq_delta (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) (t : ℝ) :
    normalizedIntegral C u p q t = delta C u p q t :=
  MixedStopLoss.integral_eq _ _ (source_fused_card (V := V) p q)
    (source_fused_edges C u p q hT hd) t

theorem count_gap (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    |aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum (source C u p q)) t -
      aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum (fused C u p q)) t| ≤ 1 := by
  have hm := RewireIso.base_missing_edges C u p q
  exact MixedStopLoss.rewire_count_gap_iso (RewireIso.base C u p q)
    (.inl u) (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p))) (.inr (.inr 0))
    (by simp) (by simp) hm.1 hm.2
    { toEquiv := Equiv.refl _, map_rel_iff' := by intro a b; rfl }
    (RewireIso.fusedIso C u p q) t

theorem delta_lipschitz (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) (s t : ℝ) :
    |delta C u p q s - delta C u p q t| ≤ |s - t| := by
  have hm := RewireIso.base_missing_edges C u p q
  exact MixedStopLoss.rewire_stopLoss_transport_iso (RewireIso.base C u p q)
    (.inl u) (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p))) (.inr (.inr 0))
    (by simp) (by simp) hm.1 hm.2
    { toEquiv := Equiv.refl _, map_rel_iff' := by intro a b; rfl }
    (RewireIso.fusedIso C u p q) s t

theorem mean_transport (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    delta C u p q 2 - 2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) ≤
      delta C u p q (2 - 2 /
        (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
  have h := delta_lipschitz C u p q (2 - 2 /
    (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) 2
  have he : |(2 - 2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) - 2| =
      2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) := by
    rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [he, abs_le] at h
  linarith [h.1]

theorem integral_lipschitz (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) (s t : ℝ) :
    |normalizedIntegral C u p q s - normalizedIntegral C u p q t| ≤ |s - t| := by
  rw [integral_eq_delta C u p q hT hd, integral_eq_delta C u p q hT hd]
  exact delta_lipschitz C u p q s t

/-- Exact transport from a certificate's threshold, with the same physical graph pair. -/
theorem anchor_transport (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q a : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    normalizedIntegral C u p q (2 - 2 / (a : ℝ)) -
      |2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) - 2 / (a : ℝ)| ≤
    normalizedIntegral C u p q (2 - 2 /
      (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
  have h := integral_lipschitz C u p q hT hd (2 - 2 / (a : ℝ))
    (2 - 2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ))
  rw [show (2 - 2 / (a : ℝ)) -
      (2 - 2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) =
      2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) - 2 / (a : ℝ) by ring,
    abs_le] at h
  linarith [h.2]

theorem energy_difference (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) - laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) =
      2 * normalizedIntegral C u p q (2 - 2 /
        (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
  have hf := (FusionDescent.fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hT hd).1
  rw [integral_eq_delta C u p q hT hd]
  unfold delta
  rw [tree_energy_identity _ hT, tree_energy_identity _ hf,
    ← source_fused_card (V := V) p q]
  ring

theorem strict_iff_mean_integral_pos (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) ↔
      0 < normalizedIntegral C u p q (2 - 2 /
        (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ)) := by
  have h := energy_difference C u p q hT hd
  constructor <;> intro hp <;> linarith

theorem strict_of_reserve (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hr : 2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) <
      normalizedIntegral C u p q 2) :
    laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) := by
  apply (strict_iff_mean_integral_pos C u p q hT hd).mpr
  rw [integral_eq_delta C u p q hT hd]
  rw [integral_eq_delta C u p q hT hd] at hr
  have h := mean_transport C u p q
  linarith

/-- Certificate validity (including any order bound n <= a) must be proved by its producer. -/
theorem strict_of_anchor (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q a : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hr : |2 / (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) - 2 / (a : ℝ)| <
      normalizedIntegral C u p q (2 - 2 / (a : ℝ))) :
    laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) := by
  apply (strict_iff_mean_integral_pos C u p q hT hd).mpr
  have h := anchor_transport C u p q a hT hd
  linarith

#check @strict_iff_mean_integral_pos
#check @strict_of_reserve
#print axioms source_fused_card
#print axioms logarithm_integrable
#print axioms source_fused_edges
#print axioms integral_eq_delta
#print axioms count_gap
#print axioms delta_lipschitz
#print axioms mean_transport
#print axioms integral_lipschitz
#print axioms anchor_transport
#print axioms energy_difference
#print axioms strict_iff_mean_integral_pos
#print axioms strict_of_reserve
#print axioms strict_of_anchor
attribute [instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ActualFusionIntegral

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFiniteSpectrumIntegralRemainders
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanActualFusionIntegral

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ActualMeanOrigin

open Finset Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

theorem spectrum_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : V) :
    0 ≤ laplacianSpectrum G i := by
  exact (SimpleGraph.posSemidef_lapMatrix ℝ G).eigenvalues_nonneg i

theorem spectrum_upper (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : V) :
    laplacianSpectrum G i ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have hd := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  push_cast at hd
  calc
    laplacianSpectrum G i ≤ ∑ j, laplacianSpectrum G j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => spectrum_nonneg G j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    _ = (2 * G.edgeFinset.card : ℝ) := spectrum_sum G
    _ = ∑ j, (G.degree j : ℝ) := hd.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : V, (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      exact_mod_cast (G.degree_lt_card_verts j).le
    _ = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2 := by simp [pow_two]

theorem shifted_spectrum_bound (G : SimpleGraph V) (n : ℕ)
    (hN : Fintype.card V ≤ n) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 2) (i : V) :
    |laplacianSpectrum G i - t| ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 := by
  have hc : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card V by positivity) hc 2
  have hn := spectrum_nonneg G i
  have hu := spectrum_upper G i
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1,ht.2,sq_nonneg (n : ℝ)]

theorem mixed_origin_lower {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (hc : Fintype.card V = Fintype.card W)
    (n : ℕ) (hN : Fintype.card V ≤ n) (t ε : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 2) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (n : ℝ) * ε * (Real.log ε - Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3) - 1) ≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..ε, MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm G H t y := by
  let e : V ≃ W := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hc
  let H' : SimpleGraph V := H.comap e
  let f : H' ≃g H := { toEquiv := e, map_rel_iff' := by intro a b; rfl }
  have he : MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm G H t = GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm G H' t := by
    funext y
    unfold MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm
    rw [MixedGraphIntegral.shifted_det_eq f]
  rw [he, GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm_eq G H' t]
  simp_rw [Coulson.matrixLogarithm_eq _ _ (G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ)
    (H'.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ) t]
  have hbound (i : V) : |(H'.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ).eigenvalues i - t| ≤
      (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 := shifted_spectrum_bound H' n hN t ht i
  have hspec := FiniteSpectrumIntegralRemainders.spectral_origin_integral_lower
    (G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ).eigenvalues (H'.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ).eigenvalues
    t ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2) ε hε hε1 hbound
  rw [show ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2) + 1 = (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3 by ring] at hspec
  have hlogε : Real.log ε ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hε.le hε1
  have hlogB : 0 ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (n : ℝ)])
  have hneg : ε * (Real.log ε - Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3) - 1) ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hε.le (by linarith)
  have hcoef := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right
    (show (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ n by exact_mod_cast hN) hneg
  have hcoef' : (n : ℝ) * ε * (Real.log ε - Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3) - 1) ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ε * (Real.log ε - Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3) - 1) := by
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hcoef
  exact hcoef'.trans hspec

/-- The order bound refers to the same actual source/fused Laplace matrices. -/
theorem actual_origin_lower (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q n : ℕ)
    (hN : Fintype.card V + p + q + 2 ≤ n) (t ε : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 2) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (n : ℝ) * ε * (Real.log ε - Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3) - 1) ≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..ε,
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source C u p q)
          (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) t y := by
  apply mixed_origin_lower _ _ (ActualFusionIntegral.source_fused_card (V := V) p q)
    n ?_ t ε ht hε hε1
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

#print axioms spectrum_nonneg
#print axioms spectrum_upper
#print axioms shifted_spectrum_bound
#print axioms mixed_origin_lower
#print axioms actual_origin_lower

attribute [instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ActualMeanOrigin

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Connection of the real invariant interval with actual path resolvents.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPathResolvent
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPathEnclosure

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathEnclosure

open Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence
noncomputable section

def rho (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := y + arm y n / y

theorem rho_pos (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) : 0 < rho y n := by
  have h := arm_nonneg y n
  unfold rho
  positivity

theorem rho_succ (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) :
    rho y (n + 1) = y + 1 / rho y n := by
  have ha := arm_nonneg y n
  have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
  change y + (y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 + arm y n)) / y = y + 1 / (y + arm y n / y)
  field_simp

theorem tau_step (z h : ℂ) (hn : z - 1 - z * h ≠ 0) :
    z * (1 - (1 - h) / (z - 1 - z * h)) - 1 =
      z - 2 - 1 / (z * (1 - h) - 1) := by
  have he : z * (1 - h) - 1 = z - 1 - z * h := by ring
  rw [he]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- The complex path endpoint resolvent equals the real continued fraction. -/
theorem path_resolvent_real (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) :
    let z : ℂ := 2 + Complex.I * y
    z * (1 - resolventQuotient z (n + 1)) - 1 = Complex.I * (rho y n : ℂ) := by
  let z : ℂ := 2 + Complex.I * y
  have hz : z.im ≠ 0 := by simpa [z] using hy.ne'
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hz; simp [h]
  change z * (1 - resolventQuotient z (n + 1)) - 1 = Complex.I * (rho y n : ℂ)
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [resolventQuotient, num_succ, den_succ, num_zero, den_zero,
      rho, arm]
    simp
    field_simp
    dsimp [z]
    ring
  | succ n ih =>
    have hr : (rho y n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (rho_pos y hy n).ne'
    have hd : z - 1 - z * resolventQuotient z (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      have he : z - 1 - z * resolventQuotient z (n + 1) = Complex.I * (rho y n : ℂ) := by
        linear_combination ih
      rw [he]
      exact mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hr
    rw [resolventQuotient_succ z (n + 1) (den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz n),
      tau_step z _ hd, ih, rho_succ y hy n]
    push_cast
    have hzz : z - 2 = Complex.I * (y : ℂ) := by dsimp [z]; ring
    rw [hzz]
    field_simp
    simp only [Complex.I_sq]
    ring

/-- All long actual path resolvents satisfy the manuscript's invariant interval. -/
theorem all_long_path_resolvents (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) :
    let z : ℂ := 2 + Complex.I * y
    let h := (pathMatrix z (n + 5))⁻¹ 0 0
    ∃ a : ℝ, lower y ≤ a ∧ a ≤ upper y ∧
      z * (1 - h) - 1 = Complex.I * ((y + a / y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨arm y (n + 4), (all_long_arms y hy n).1, (all_long_arms y hy n).2, ?_⟩
  rw [pathMatrix_inv_endpoint]
  exact path_resolvent_real y hy (n + 4)

#print axioms path_resolvent_real
#print axioms all_long_path_resolvents

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathEnclosure

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Exhaustive five-class parameterization of all positive arm lengths.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, five-class recurrence enclosure.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanArmBridge
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFocus

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ArmClasses
open PathEnclosure Set
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The recurrence index is one less than the physical arm length. -/
def classify (n : ℕ) : Fin 5 := ⟨min n 4, by omega⟩

def parameter (y : ℝ) (c : Fin 5) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if c.val < 4 then rho y c.val
  else y + (lower y + t * (upper y - lower y)) / y

theorem long_width_pos (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : 0 < upper y - lower y := by
  rw [interval_width y hy]
  positivity

theorem actual_parameter (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, rho y n = parameter y (classify n) t := by
  by_cases hn : n < 4
  · refine ⟨0, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    simp only [parameter, classify, Fin.val_mk, Nat.min_eq_left hn.le, hn, ↓reduceIte]
  · have hn4 : 4 ≤ n := by omega
    have hlong := all_long_arms y hy (n - 4)
    have he : n - 4 + 4 = n := by omega
    rw [he] at hlong
    have hw := long_width_pos y hy
    let t := (arm y n - lower y) / (upper y - lower y)
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlong.1) hw.le
      · apply (div_le_one hw).mpr
        linarith [hlong.2]
    · simp only [parameter, classify, Fin.val_mk, Nat.min_eq_right hn4,
        show ¬ (4 : ℕ) < 4 by omega, ↓reduceIte, rho]
      congr 2
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp
      ring

def unordered : Finset (Fin 5 × Fin 5) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun c => c.1 ≤ c.2)

theorem unordered_card : unordered.card = 15 := by decide +kernel

/-- This is an exhaustive reduction, not a count of sampled lengths. -/
theorem all_pairs (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (R : ℝ → ℝ → Prop)
    (hsym : ∀ P Q, R P Q → R Q P)
    (hclasses : ∀ c ∈ unordered, ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      R (parameter y c.1 s) (parameter y c.2 t)) (p q : ℕ) :
    R (rho y p) (rho y q) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hp⟩ := actual_parameter y hy p
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hq⟩ := actual_parameter y hy q
  rw [hp, hq]
  by_cases h : classify p ≤ classify q
  · exact hclasses (classify p, classify q) (by simp [unordered, h]) s hs t ht
  · apply hsym
    exact hclasses (classify q, classify p) (by simp [unordered, le_of_not_ge h]) t ht s hs

theorem quotient_swap (y P Q : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) :
    Focus.quotient y P Q ζ = Focus.quotient y Q P ζ := by
  unfold Focus.quotient Focus.A Focus.N₀ Focus.B Focus.D₀
  rw [mul_comm P Q, add_comm P Q]

#print axioms actual_parameter
#print axioms unordered_card
#print axioms all_pairs
#print axioms quotient_swap
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ArmClasses

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0. -/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanForkResidual

/-!
# Label the actual nonroot vertices of a pendant path

The arm labels enumerate the tail of the given walk. In an acyclic graph its
walk subgraph is the graph induced on its vertices. A positive simple path
therefore gives an induced path embedding whose zero label is its first neighbor.
Source: the actual-fork checkpoint b546e3edbad3e45182649bc798182bf30a7457fe,
and Mathlib's `Walk.IsPath.pathGraphIsoToSubgraph`.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ArmEmbedding

open SimpleGraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}

theorem walk_subgraph_induced (hA : G.IsAcyclic) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    p.toSubgraph.coe = G.induce p.toSubgraph.verts := by
  have hle : p.toSubgraph.coe ≤ G.induce p.toSubgraph.verts := by
    intro x y h
    exact p.toSubgraph.coe_adj_sub x y h
  have hc : p.toSubgraph.coe.Connected := p.toSubgraph_connected
  have hT : (G.induce p.toSubgraph.verts).IsTree :=
    ⟨hc.mono hle, hA.induce _⟩
  exact le_antisymm hle
    ((isTree_iff_minimal_connected.mp hT).2 hc hle)

theorem mem_tail_iff {u v x : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hpos : 0 < p.length) : x ∈ p.tail.support ↔ x ∈ p.support ∧ x ≠ u := by
  have hn : ¬p.Nil := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr hpos
  have hnd : (u :: p.tail.support).Nodup := by
    rw [Walk.cons_support_tail hn]
    exact hp.support_nodup
  have hu : u ∉ p.tail.support := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Walk.cons_support_tail hn]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem u hx
    · intro he
      exact hu (he ▸ hx)
  · rintro ⟨hx, hxu⟩
    rw [← Walk.cons_support_tail hn, List.mem_cons] at hx
    exact hx.resolve_left hxu

/-- The labels enumerate this walk's tail, in order from the attachment point. -/
def armVertex {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (i : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) : V :=
  (p.tail.pathGraphHomToSubgraph i).val

theorem armVertex_mem_tail {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (i : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) :
    armVertex p i ∈ p.tail.support :=
  p.tail.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp (p.tail.pathGraphHomToSubgraph i).property

theorem armVertex_mem {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hpos : 0 < p.length) (i : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) : armVertex p i ∈ p.support :=
  ((mem_tail_iff p hp hpos).mp (armVertex_mem_tail p i)).1

theorem armVertex_ne_root {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hpos : 0 < p.length) (i : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) : armVertex p i ≠ u :=
  ((mem_tail_iff p hp hpos).mp (armVertex_mem_tail p i)).2

theorem armVertex_zero {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) : armVertex p 0 = p.snd := by
  simp [armVertex, Walk.pathGraphHomToSubgraph]

theorem armVertex_injective {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath) :
    Function.Injective (armVertex p) := by
  intro i j hij
  exact hp.tail.pathGraphIsoToSubgraph.injective (Subtype.ext hij)

theorem armVertex_range {u v x : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hpos : 0 < p.length) (hx : x ∈ p.support) (hxu : x ≠ u) :
    ∃ i, armVertex p i = x := by
  have ht := (mem_tail_iff p hp hpos).mpr ⟨hx, hxu⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp.tail.pathGraphIsoToSubgraph.surjective
    ⟨x, p.tail.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mpr ht⟩
  exact ⟨i, congrArg Subtype.val hi⟩

theorem armVertex_adj_iff (hA : G.IsAcyclic) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (i j : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) :
    G.Adj (armVertex p i) (armVertex p j) ↔ (pathGraph (p.tail.length + 1)).Adj i j := by
  let f := hp.tail.pathGraphIsoToSubgraph
  have hle : G.induce p.tail.toSubgraph.verts ≤ p.tail.toSubgraph.coe :=
    (walk_subgraph_induced hA p.tail).symm.le
  change G.Adj ((f i).val) ((f j).val) ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact f.map_rel_iff.mp (hle h)
  · intro h
    exact p.tail.toSubgraph.coe_adj_sub _ _ (f.map_rel_iff.mpr h)

theorem root_arm_adj_iff (hA : G.IsAcyclic) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hpos : 0 < p.length) (i : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) :
    G.Adj u (armVertex p i) ↔ i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := hA.eq_snd_of_adj_start hp h (armVertex_mem p hp hpos i)
    apply armVertex_injective p hp
    exact he.trans (armVertex_zero p).symm
  · rintro rfl
    rw [armVertex_zero]
    exact p.adj_snd (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr hpos)

#print axioms walk_subgraph_induced
#print axioms mem_tail_iff
#print axioms armVertex_mem_tail
#print axioms armVertex_mem
#print axioms armVertex_ne_root
#print axioms armVertex_zero
#print axioms armVertex_injective
#print axioms armVertex_range
#print axioms armVertex_adj_iff
#print axioms root_arm_adj_iff

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ArmEmbedding

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanArmClasses
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ArmRationalForm
open ArmClasses PathEnclosure
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

def denominator (c : Fin 5) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if c.val=0 then 1 else if c.val=1 then y else if c.val=2 then y^2+1
  else if c.val=3 then y^3+2*y
  else y*(y^4+3*y^2+1)*(y^4+4*y^2+3)

def numerator (c : Fin 5) (y t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if c.val=0 then y else if c.val=1 then y^2+1 else if c.val=2 then y^3+2*y
  else if c.val=3 then y^4+3*y^2+1
  else y^2*(y^4+3*y^2+1)*(y^4+4*y^2+3)+(y^4+2*y^2)*(y^4+4*y^2+3)+t

theorem denominator_positive (c : Fin 5) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < denominator c y := by
  fin_cases c
  all_goals norm_num [denominator]
  all_goals positivity

/-- Exact rational forms for the same five physical arm classes. -/
theorem parameter_identity (c : Fin 5) (y t : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    parameter y c t=numerator c y t/denominator c y := by
  have hy2 : 0 < y^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
  fin_cases c
  all_goals norm_num [parameter,rho,arm,numerator,denominator,lower,upper]
  all_goals field_simp
  all_goals ring

theorem parameter_enclosure (c : Fin 5) (y t : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, parameter y c t=y+a/y := by
  by_cases hc : c.val < 4
  · refine ⟨arm y c.val,⟨arm_nonneg y c.val,arm_le_one y hy c.val⟩,?_⟩
    simp only [parameter,if_pos hc,rho]
  · let a := lower y+t*(upper y-lower y)
    have hl : 0 ≤ lower y := by unfold lower; positivity
    have hw : 0 ≤ upper y-lower y := (long_width_pos y hy).le
    have hu : upper y ≤ 1 := by
      unfold upper
      apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := add_nonneg hl (mul_nonneg ht.1 hw)
    have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2 hw
      dsimp [a]
      linarith
    exact ⟨a,⟨ha0,ha1⟩,by simp only [parameter,if_neg hc,a]⟩

#print axioms denominator_positive
#print axioms parameter_identity
#print axioms parameter_enclosure
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ArmRationalForm

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Sound coefficient inequalities in a common tensor Bernstein basis.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Lemma 4.2. This module does not assert acceptance or
exhaustive coverage of the manuscript's concrete certificates.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanMobiusDisk
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Bernstein

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.Bernstein

open Finset
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def basis (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n j).eval x

theorem basis_nonneg (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    0 ≤ basis n j x := by
  unfold basis bernsteinPolynomial
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_natCast, Polynomial.eval_pow,
    Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_one]
  have hx0 := hx.1
  have hx1 : 0 ≤ 1 - x := sub_nonneg.mpr hx.2
  positivity

theorem basis_sum (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), basis n j x = 1 := by
  have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval x) (bernsteinPolynomial.sum ℝ n)
  unfold basis
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ => (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ n j).eval x) (n + 1)]
  simpa only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_one, basis] using h

variable {K : Type*} [Fintype K]

def tensor (n : K → ℕ) (j : ∀ i, Fin (n i + 1)) (x : K → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, basis (n i) (j i) (x i)

theorem tensor_nonneg (n : K → ℕ) (j : ∀ i, Fin (n i + 1)) (x : K → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) : 0 ≤ tensor n j x := by
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => basis_nonneg _ _ _ (hx i))

theorem tensor_sum (n : K → ℕ) (x : K → ℝ) :
    ∑ j : ∀ i, Fin (n i + 1), tensor n j x = 1 := by
  have h := Fintype.prod_sum (fun i (j : Fin (n i + 1)) => basis (n i) j (x i))
  simp only [basis_sum, Finset.prod_const_one] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- A common nonnegative basis preserves every coefficientwise lower inequality. -/
theorem weighted_ratio {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (w p q : J → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hq : 0 < ∑ j, q j * w j)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j, L * q j ≤ p j) :
    L ≤ (∑ j, p j * w j) / (∑ j, q j * w j) := by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hq).mpr
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hcoeff j)) (hw j)]

theorem tensor_denominator_pos (n : K → ℕ) (q : (∀ i, Fin (n i + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : K → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) :
    0 < ∑ j, q j * tensor n j x := by
  have hs := tensor_sum n x
  have hw := tensor_nonneg n
  have hex : ∃ j, 0 < tensor n j x := by
    by_contra! h
    have hz : ∑ j, tensor n j x ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun j _ => h j)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hex
  apply (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ =>
    mul_nonneg (hq j).le (hw j x hx))).mpr
  exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_pos (hq j) hj⟩

theorem tensor_ratio (n : K → ℕ) (p q : (∀ i, Fin (n i + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : K → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (L : ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) (hcoeff : ∀ j, L * q j ≤ p j) :
    L ≤ (∑ j, p j * tensor n j x) / (∑ j, q j * tensor n j x) :=
  weighted_ratio _ _ _ L (fun j => tensor_nonneg n j x hx)
    (tensor_denominator_pos n q x hx hq) hcoeff

/-- The positive rational Young parameter gives the manuscript's common denominator. -/
theorem young_denominator (u v c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (u + v) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + c) * u ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / c) * v ^ 2 := by
  have h := sq_nonneg (c * u - v)
  have hp := mul_pos hc hc
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hc).mp
  field_simp
  nlinarith

/-- Coefficient acceptance implies the squared norm bound once the exact common
polynomial representation has been supplied. -/
theorem mobius_certificate (a b c d η : ℂ)
    (hE : 0 < Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c)
    (hN : 0 < Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a) (hη : ‖η‖ ≤ 1)
    (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hL : L * ((1 + s) * ‖b * star d - a * star c‖ ^ 2 +
      (1 + 1 / s) * ‖a * d - b * c‖ ^ 2) ≤
        (Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a) ^ 2) :
    L ≤ ‖(a * η + b) / (c * η + d)‖ ^ 2 := by
  let N := Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a
  let U := ‖b * star d - a * star c‖
  let V := ‖a * d - b * c‖
  let f := ‖(a * η + b) / (c * η + d)‖
  let D := (1 + s) * U ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / s) * V ^ 2
  have hid : U ^ 2 - V ^ 2 = (Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c) * N :=
    MobiusDisk.center_distance_identity a b c d
  have hsep : V < U := by
    have hp := mul_pos hE hN
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (b * star d - a * star c), norm_nonneg (a * d - b * c)]
  have hsum : 0 < U + V := by
    have hv : 0 ≤ V := norm_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hden : (U + V) ^ 2 ≤ D := young_denominator U V s hs
  have hf : N / (U + V) ≤ f := MobiusDisk.rationalized_lower_bound a b c d η hE hN hη
  have hfN : N ≤ f * (U + V) := (div_le_iff₀ hsum).mp hf
  have hsq : N ^ 2 ≤ f ^ 2 * (U + V) ^ 2 := by
    have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hN.le hfN 2
    simpa only [mul_pow] using this
  have hfden : f ^ 2 * (U + V) ^ 2 ≤ f ^ 2 * D :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hden (sq_nonneg _)
  have hD : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le (sq_pos_of_pos hsum) hden
  have hh : L * D ≤ f ^ 2 * D := le_trans hL (le_trans hsq hfden)
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hD).mp hh

#print axioms tensor_ratio
#print axioms mobius_certificate

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.Bernstein

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Kernel-checkable rational sign and degree certificates for complete root boxes.
Coefficients are listed in increasing order. Repeated factors are handled
separately; this checker certifies a factor with distinct real roots.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRootIsolation

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.CheckedRoots
open Polynomial Set Finset

def eval : List ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
  | [], _ => 0
  | c :: cs, x => c + x * eval cs x

noncomputable def polynomial : List ℚ → ℝ[X]
  | [] => 0
  | c :: cs => C (c : ℝ) + X * polynomial cs

theorem eval_cast (cs : List ℚ) (x : ℚ) :
    (eval cs x : ℝ) = (polynomial cs).eval (x : ℝ) := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [eval, polynomial]
  | cons c cs ih => simp [eval, polynomial, ih]

theorem degree_bound (cs : List ℚ) : (polynomial cs).natDegree ≤ cs.length - 1 := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [polynomial]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    cases cs with
    | nil => simp [polynomial]
    | cons d ds =>
      have hm := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (p := (X : ℝ[X])) (q := polynomial (d :: ds))
      have ha := Polynomial.natDegree_add_le (C (c : ℝ)) (X * polynomial (d :: ds))
      simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_X, Polynomial.natDegree_C, max_eq_right (Nat.zero_le _)] at ha hm
      change (C (c : ℝ) + X * polynomial (d :: ds)).natDegree ≤ (c :: d :: ds).length - 1
      simp only [List.length_cons] at ih ⊢
      omega

def accepts (cs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n → ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (0 < n ∧ cs.length ≤ n + 1 ∧ ∀ i,
    a i < b i ∧ eval cs (a i) * eval cs (b i) < 0 ∧
      ∀ j, i < j → b i ≤ a j)

private theorem conditions (cs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hc : accepts cs n a b = true) :
    polynomial cs ≠ 0 ∧ (polynomial cs).natDegree ≤ n ∧
      (∀ i, (a i : ℝ) < b i) ∧
      (∀ i, (polynomial cs).eval (a i : ℝ) * (polynomial cs).eval (b i : ℝ) < 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, i < j → (b i : ℝ) ≤ a j) := by
  obtain ⟨hn, hlen, hrows⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have hs (i : Fin n) :
      (polynomial cs).eval (a i : ℝ) * (polynomial cs).eval (b i : ℝ) < 0 := by
    rw [← eval_cast, ← eval_cast]
    exact_mod_cast (hrows i).2.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hs, ?_⟩
  · intro hp
    have h := hs ⟨0, hn⟩
    simp [hp] at h
  · have hd := degree_bound cs
    omega
  · intro i
    exact_mod_cast (hrows i).1
  · intro i j hij
    exact_mod_cast (hrows i).2.2 j hij

theorem complete (cs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hc : accepts cs n a b = true) :
    ∃ r : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, r i ∈ Ioo (a i : ℝ) (b i : ℝ)) ∧
      (polynomial cs).roots = Multiset.map r (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hn, hab, hs, ho⟩ := conditions cs n a b hc
  exact RootIsolation.complete_roots _ hp n hn _ _ hab hs ho

theorem stop_loss_bounds (cs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hc : accepts cs n a b = true) (α : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, max ((a i : ℝ) - α) 0) ≤
      ((polynomial cs).roots.map (fun x => max (x - α) 0)).sum ∧
    ((polynomial cs).roots.map (fun x => max (x - α) 0)).sum ≤
      ∑ i, max ((b i : ℝ) - α) 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hn, hab, hs, ho⟩ := conditions cs n a b hc
  exact RootIsolation.stop_loss_bounds _ hp n hn _ _ hab hs ho α

def cubic : List ℚ := [-7, 19, -9, 1]
def cubicLower : Fin 3 → ℚ := ![46/100, 248/100, 605/100]
def cubicUpper : Fin 3 → ℚ := ![47/100, 249/100, 606/100]

theorem cubic_accepts : accepts cubic 3 cubicLower cubicUpper = true := by decide +kernel

theorem cubic_stop_loss_upper :
    ((polynomial cubic).roots.map (fun x => max (x - (12/7 : ℝ)) 0)).sum ≤ 717/140 := by
  have h := (stop_loss_bounds cubic 3 cubicLower cubicUpper cubic_accepts (12/7)).2
  norm_num [cubicUpper, Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h ⊢
  exact h

#print axioms degree_bound
#print axioms complete
#print axioms stop_loss_bounds
#print axioms cubic_accepts
#print axioms cubic_stop_loss_upper
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.CheckedRoots

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanScaledQuotient
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalLog

/-! Exact cell certificates for the remaining fixed arm classes. Coefficient
acceptance, the representation of the three actual squared norms and the
logarithm payment are separate obligations. This module proves their sound
composition; the concrete cell partitions and integral ledgers remain required. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassCellCertificates
open Focus
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def accepts {J : Type} [Fintype J] (cu cv cj : J → ℚ) (s L : ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (0<s ∧ ∀ j, L*((1+s)*cu j+(1+1/s)*cv j)≤cj j)

theorem coefficient_sound {J : Type} [Fintype J] (cu cv cj : J → ℚ) (s L : ℚ)
    (hc : accepts cu cv cj s L=true) (w : J → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0≤w j)
    (U V W : ℝ) (hu : U=∑ j, (cu j : ℝ)*w j)
    (hv : V=∑ j, (cv j : ℝ)*w j) (hj : W=∑ j, (cj j : ℝ)*w j) :
    (L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*U+(1+1/(s : ℝ))*V)≤W := by
  have hcoeff : ∀ j, (L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*(cu j : ℝ)+
      (1+1/(s : ℝ))*(cv j : ℝ))≤(cj j : ℝ) := by
    intro j
    exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc).2 j
  calc
    _ = (L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*(∑ j, (cu j : ℝ)*w j)+
        (1+1/(s : ℝ))*(∑ j, (cv j : ℝ)*w j)) := by rw [hu,hv]
    _ = ∑ j, ((L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*(cu j : ℝ)+
        (1+1/(s : ℝ))*(cv j : ℝ)))*w j := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (cj j : ℝ)*w j :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff j) (hw j))
    _ = W := hj.symm

theorem log_lower_of_square (L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hc : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) (z : ℂ) (hL : (L : ℝ)≤‖z‖^2) :
    (R : ℝ)≤Real.log ‖z‖ := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ)<L := by exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc).1
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpos hL
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  norm_num at hlog
  have hR := RationalLog.sound L R k n hc
  linarith

theorem cell_log_lower {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (cu cv cj : J → ℚ) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hc : accepts cu cv cj s L=true) (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true)
    (w : J → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0≤w j)
    (d y P Q : ℝ) (hd : 0<d) (hy : 0<y) (hP : y≤P) (hQ : y≤Q)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ-g d y‖≤r d y)
    (hu : ‖b d y P Q*star (e d y P Q)-a d P Q*star (c d y P Q)‖^2=
      ∑ j, (cu j : ℝ)*w j)
    (hv : ‖a d P Q*e d y P Q-b d y P Q*c d y P Q‖^2=
      ∑ j, (cv j : ℝ)*w j)
    (hj : (Complex.normSq (b d y P Q)-Complex.normSq (a d P Q))^2=
      ∑ j, (cj j : ℝ)*w j) :
    (R : ℝ)≤Real.log ‖quotient y P Q ζ‖ := by
  have hs : (0 : ℝ)<s := by exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc).1
  have hcoeff := coefficient_sound cu cv cj s L hc w hw _ _ _ hu hv hj
  exact log_lower_of_square L R k n hl _
    (concrete_certificate d y P Q hd hy hP hQ ζ hζ s L hs hcoeff)

theorem coefficient_control : accepts (fun _ : Unit => 1) (fun _ => 1)
    (fun _ => 4) 1 1=true := by decide +kernel
theorem rejects_false_coefficient : accepts (fun _ : Unit => 1) (fun _ => 1)
    (fun _ => 3) 1 1=false := by decide +kernel

#print axioms coefficient_sound
#print axioms log_lower_of_square
#print axioms cell_log_lower
#print axioms coefficient_control
#print axioms rejects_false_coefficient
end

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanActualFusionIntegral
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanConcreteGraphQuotient

/-!
# Fifteen-class bounds for the same actual source/fused integral

One fixed unordered class pair is selected by the two physical arm lengths.
Its own lower function is integrated. No pointwise minimum across distinct
class payments is substituted. The sign certificates remain explicit inputs.
-/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassEnvelope
open CoreQuotient ArmClasses Focus Set MeasureTheory ActualFusionIntegral
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

def pair (p q : ℕ) : Fin 5 × Fin 5 :=
  if classify p ≤ classify q then (classify p, classify q) else (classify q, classify p)

theorem pair_mem (p q : ℕ) : pair p q ∈ unordered := by
  by_cases h : classify p ≤ classify q
  · simp [pair, h, unordered]
  · simp [pair, h, unordered, le_of_not_ge h]

def Bounds (d : ℕ) (B : (Fin 5 × Fin 5) → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ c ∈ unordered, ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
    ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ζ : ℂ,
      ‖ζ - g d y‖ ≤ r d y →
        B c y ≤ Real.log ‖quotient y (parameter y c.1 s) (parameter y c.2 t) ζ‖

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

theorem graph_lower (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q d : ℕ)
    (hd : C.degree u = d) (B : (Fin 5 × Fin 5) → ℝ → ℝ) (hB : Bounds d B)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    B (pair p q) y ≤
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source C u p q) (fused C u p q) 2 y := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hp⟩ := actual_parameter y hy p
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hq⟩ := actual_parameter y hy q
  have hζ := (schur_in_disk C u y hy).1
  rw [hd] at hζ
  change B (pair p q) y ≤ Real.log ‖(shifted (z y) (source C u p q)).det /
    (shifted (z y) (fused C u p q)).det‖
  rw [concrete_graph_quotient C u y hy p q, hp, hq]
  by_cases h : classify p ≤ classify q
  · simpa only [pair, if_pos h] using
      hB (classify p, classify q) (by simp [unordered, h]) y hy s hs t ht _ hζ
  · have hb := hB (classify q, classify p) (by simp [unordered, le_of_not_ge h])
      y hy t ht s hs _ hζ
    rw [quotient_swap] at hb
    simpa only [pair, if_neg h] using hb

theorem integral_lower (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q d : ℕ)
    (hd : C.degree u = d) (B : (Fin 5 × Fin 5) → ℝ → ℝ) (hB : Bounds d B)
    (hBi : ∀ c ∈ unordered, IntegrableOn (B c) (Ioi 0)) :
    (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, B (pair p q) y) ≤
      normalizedIntegral C u p q 2 := by
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  apply integral_mono_ae (hBi _ (pair_mem p q)) (logarithm_integrable C u p q 2)
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
  exact graph_lower C u p q d hd B hB y hy

#check @Bounds
#print axioms pair_mem
#print axioms graph_lower
#print axioms integral_lower
attribute [instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassEnvelope

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanScaledQuotient

/-! Polynomial representatives of the three actual scaled norm expressions.
The identities hold for every positive ordinate and arbitrary real parameters.
Concrete arm substitution, cell coverage and integral payments remain required. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassNormPolynomials
open Focus
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def polyA (d P Q : ℝ) : ℂ := ⟨d*(P*Q-1),-d*(P+Q)⟩
def polyB (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ⟨2*y*((2-d)*(P*Q-1)+4)+d*(P+Q),
   (2*y^2+d)*(P*Q-1)+2*d*y*(P+Q)+4*y^2⟩
def polyC (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℂ := ⟨d*(P*Q+1),-d*(P+Q-y)⟩
def polyE (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ⟨2*y*(2-d)*(P*Q+1)+d*(P+Q-y),
   (2*y^2+d)*(P*Q+1)+2*d*y*(P+Q-y)⟩

theorem a_eq (d P Q : ℝ) : a d P Q=polyA d P Q := by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [a,A,polyA]
  ring
theorem c_eq (d y P Q : ℝ) : c d y P Q=polyC d y P Q := by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [c,B,polyC]
  ring
theorem b_eq (d y P Q : ℝ) (hy : 0<y) : b d y P Q=polyB d y P Q := by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [b,A,g,N₀,z,polyB,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.re_ofNat,Complex.im_ofNat] <;>
    field_simp [hy.ne'] <;> ring
theorem e_eq (d y P Q : ℝ) (hy : 0<y) : e d y P Q=polyE d y P Q := by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [e,B,g,D₀,z,polyE,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.re_ofNat,Complex.im_ofNat] <;>
    field_simp [hy.ne'] <;> ring

def U (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let ar := (polyA d P Q).re; let ai := (polyA d P Q).im
  let br := (polyB d y P Q).re; let bi := (polyB d y P Q).im
  let cr := (polyC d y P Q).re; let ci := (polyC d y P Q).im
  let er := (polyE d y P Q).re; let ei := (polyE d y P Q).im
  (br*er+bi*ei-ar*cr-ai*ci)^2+(bi*er-br*ei-ai*cr+ar*ci)^2
def V (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let ar := (polyA d P Q).re; let ai := (polyA d P Q).im
  let br := (polyB d y P Q).re; let bi := (polyB d y P Q).im
  let cr := (polyC d y P Q).re; let ci := (polyC d y P Q).im
  let er := (polyE d y P Q).re; let ei := (polyE d y P Q).im
  (ar*er-ai*ei-br*cr+bi*ci)^2+(ar*ei+ai*er-br*ci-bi*cr)^2
def J (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((polyB d y P Q).re^2+(polyB d y P Q).im^2-
    (polyA d P Q).re^2-(polyA d P Q).im^2)^2

theorem U_actual (d y P Q : ℝ) (hy : 0<y) :
    U d y P Q=‖b d y P Q*star (e d y P Q)-a d P Q*star (c d y P Q)‖^2 := by
  rw [a_eq,b_eq d y P Q hy,c_eq,e_eq d y P Q hy]
  simp [U,Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring
theorem V_actual (d y P Q : ℝ) (hy : 0<y) :
    V d y P Q=‖a d P Q*e d y P Q-b d y P Q*c d y P Q‖^2 := by
  rw [a_eq,b_eq d y P Q hy,c_eq,e_eq d y P Q hy]
  simp [V,Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring
theorem J_actual (d y P Q : ℝ) (hy : 0<y) :
    J d y P Q=(Complex.normSq (b d y P Q)-Complex.normSq (a d P Q))^2 := by
  rw [a_eq,b_eq d y P Q hy]
  simp [J,Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring

theorem polynomial_certificate (d y P Q : ℝ) (hd : 0<d) (hy : 0<y)
    (hP : y≤P) (hQ : y≤Q) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ-g d y‖≤r d y)
    (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0<s)
    (hc : L*((1+s)*U d y P Q+(1+1/s)*V d y P Q)≤J d y P Q) :
    L≤‖quotient y P Q ζ‖^2 := by
  apply concrete_certificate d y P Q hd hy hP hQ ζ hζ s L hs
  rw [← U_actual d y P Q hy,← V_actual d y P Q hy,← J_actual d y P Q hy]
  exact hc

#print axioms a_eq
#print axioms b_eq
#print axioms c_eq
#print axioms e_eq
#print axioms U_actual
#print axioms V_actual
#print axioms J_actual
#print axioms polynomial_certificate
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassNormPolynomials

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTailIntegral
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Integrals.Basic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassScalarIntegrals
open Set MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def origin (y : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (2/5)+Real.log y
def tail (y : ℝ) : ℝ := -(1/2)/y^2

theorem origin_eq (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : origin y=Real.log (2*y/5) := by
  have he : (2 : ℝ)*y/5=(2/5)*y := by ring
  rw [he,Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hy.ne']
  rfl

theorem origin_integrable (a : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable origin volume 0 a :=
  (intervalIntegrable_const).add intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_log'

theorem origin_integral (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..a, origin y)=a*(Real.log (2*a/5)-1) := by
  have he : (2 : ℝ)*a/5=(2/5)*a := by ring
  rw [he,Real.log_mul (by norm_num) ha.ne']
  unfold origin
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
    intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_log',intervalIntegral.integral_const,
    integral_log_from_zero]
  simp only [sub_zero,smul_eq_mul]
  ring

theorem tail_eq (y : ℝ) : tail y= -1/(2*y^2) := by
  unfold tail
  ring

theorem tail_integrable_integral (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    IntegrableOn tail (Ioi Y) ∧ (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, tail y)= -1/(2*Y) := by
  obtain ⟨hi,he⟩ := TailIntegral.inv_square_integrable_integral (1/2) Y (by norm_num) hY
  have ht : tail=(fun y : ℝ => -((1/2 : ℝ)/y^2)) := by
    funext y
    change -(1/2 : ℝ)/y^2 = -((1/2 : ℝ)/y^2)
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [ht]
    exact hi.neg
  · rw [ht,integral_neg,he]
    ring

/-- The origin estimate has its exact improper integral; a constant lower
bound near zero would lose integrability or the quantitative payment. -/
theorem origin_lower (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : ∀ y ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) a, origin y ≤ f y) :
    a*(Real.log (2*a/5)-1) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..a, f y := by
  rw [← origin_integral a ha]
  have hfi := TailIntegral.interval_integrable_of_Ioi hf (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) ha.le
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo ha.le (origin_integrable a) hfi
  intro y hy
  exact hb y ⟨hy.1,hy.2.le⟩

theorem tail_lower (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0))
    (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) (hb : ∀ y ∈ Ioi Y, tail y ≤ f y) :
    -1/(2*Y) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, f y := by
  obtain ⟨hi,he⟩ := tail_integrable_integral Y hY
  rw [← he]
  apply integral_mono_ae hi (hf.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hY.le))
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
  exact hb y hy

#print axioms origin_eq
#print axioms origin_integrable
#print axioms origin_integral
#print axioms tail_eq
#print axioms tail_integrable_integral
#print axioms origin_lower
#print axioms tail_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ClassScalarIntegrals

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFastNestedCellData

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedClassCell
open NestedHorner NestedArithmetic
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem zeroCheck_neg_self (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) :
    NestedAffine.zeroCheck n (add p (scale (-1) p))=true := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [NestedAffine.zeroCheck,add,scale]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons c p hp =>
      simp only [add,scale,List.map_cons,zipAdd,NestedAffine.zeroCheck,List.all_cons]
      simp only [ih,Bool.true_and]
      exact hp

def polynomial (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ) : Expr 3 :=
  if reciprocal=true then (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (NestedClassCell.gap d c₁ c₂ s L)).2
  else NestedClassCell.gap d c₁ c₂ s L

/-- Only rational scalar data are stored. The kernel reconstructs both polynomials. -/
def make (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : FastNestedCellData.Cell :=
  let p := compile (polynomial d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L)
  { reciprocal := reciprocal
    young := s
    squareLower := L
    payment := R
    logarithmK := k
    logarithmN := n
    poly := p
    affine := NestedAffine.transform 3 p l w
    degrees := deg
    left := l
    width := w }

theorem accepts_make (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hpositive : positiveCheck 3 deg
      (NestedAffine.transform 3 (compile (polynomial d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L)) l w)=true)
    (hlog : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂ (make d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L R k n deg l w)=true := by
  apply decide_eq_true
  refine ⟨hs,hw,?_,?_,hpositive,hlog⟩
  · unfold NestedArithmetic.accepts
    exact decide_eq_true rfl
  · exact zeroCheck_neg_self 3 _

#print axioms zeroCheck_neg_self
#print axioms accepts_make

/-! Complete coefficient programs retain arbitrary original rational shifts and
finite arms. Every generated field has the existing polynomial contract. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedGeneralPathData
open PolynomialPathMap
abbrev Poly := HornerCertificates.Poly
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

structure Data where
  a : Poly
  b : Poly
  c : Poly
  e : Poly
  U : Poly
  V : Poly
  J : Poly
  N : Poly
  E : Poly

def build (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : Data :=
  let a := ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.sourceSlopeList x p q)
  let b := ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.sourceCenterList x p q)
  let c := ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.fusedSlopeList x p q)
  let e := ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.fusedCenterList x p q)
  {a:=a,b:=b,c:=c,e:=e,
   U:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.UList a b c e),
   V:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.VList a b c e),
   J:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.JList a b),
   N:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.NList a b),
   E:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.trimZeros (FastGeneralPathCertificates.EList c e)}

theorem path_checked (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) :
    GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q (build x p q).a (build x p q).b
      (build x p q).c (build x p q).e=true := by
  rw [GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨(ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.sourceSlopeList_sound x p q),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.sourceCenterList_sound x p q),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.fusedSlopeList_sound x p q),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.fusedCenterList_sound x p q)⟩

theorem norms_checked (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) :
    RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts (build x p q).a (build x p q).b (build x p q).c (build x p q).e
      (build x p q).U (build x p q).V (build x p q).J (build x p q).N (build x p q).E=true := by
  rw [RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨(ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.UList_sound _ _ _ _),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.VList_sound _ _ _ _),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.JList_sound _ _),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.NList_sound _ _),
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_trim _).trans (FastGeneralPathCertificates.EList_sound _ _)⟩

theorem path_swapped (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) :
    GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x q p (build x p q).a (build x p q).b
      (build x p q).c (build x p q).e=true := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,he⟩ := of_decide_eq_true (path_checked x p q)
  have hA : GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceSlope x p q=GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceSlope x q p := by
    unfold GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceSlope
    ring
  have hO : GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceOffset x p q=GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceOffset x q p := by
    unfold GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceOffset
    ring
  have hB : GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceCenter x p q=GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceCenter x q p := by
    simp only [GeneralPathPolynomials.sourceCenter,hA,hO]
  have hC : GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedSlope x p q=GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedSlope x q p := by
    simp only [GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedSlope,Nat.add_comm p q]
  have hE : GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedCenter x p q=GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedCenter x q p := by
    simp only [GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedCenter,GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedSlope,
      GeneralPathPolynomials.fusedOffset,Nat.add_comm p q]
  rw [GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨ha.trans hA,hb.trans hB,hc.trans hC,he.trans hE⟩

#print axioms path_checked
#print axioms norms_checked
#print axioms path_swapped
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedGeneralPathData

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFastGeneralPathCertificates
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalPolynomialIntegral
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanGeneralPathPolynomialPayments

/-! Computable polynomial programs with generic kernel proofs for normalization,
affine substitution, exact primitives, payments, and positive rays. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedHornerArithmetic
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap
abbrev Poly := HornerCertificates.Poly
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

def trimZeros : Poly → Poly
  | [] => []
  | c :: p =>
      let q := trimZeros p
      if c=0 ∧ q=[] then [] else c :: q

theorem ofList_trim (p : Poly) : ofList (trimZeros p)=ofList p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c p ih =>
      dsimp only [trimZeros]
      split
      · rename_i h
        have hp : ofList p=0 := by simpa only [h.2,ofList] using ih.symm
        simp only [ofList,h.1,map_zero,hp,mul_zero,add_zero]
      · change C c+X*ofList (trimZeros p)=C c+X*ofList p
        rw [ih]

def plus (p q : Poly) : Poly := trimZeros (HornerCertificates.add p q)
def scaled (c : ℚ) (p : Poly) : Poly := trimZeros (HornerCertificates.scale c p)
def times (p q : Poly) : Poly := trimZeros (HornerArithmetic.mul p q)
def difference (p q : Poly) : Poly := plus p (scaled (-1) q)
def square (p : Poly) : Poly := times p p

theorem ofList_plus (p q : Poly) : ofList (plus p q)=ofList p+ofList q := by
  rw [plus,ofList_trim,FastGeneralPathCertificates.ofList_add]
theorem ofList_scaled (c : ℚ) (p : Poly) : ofList (scaled c p)=C c*ofList p := by
  rw [scaled,ofList_trim,FastGeneralPathCertificates.ofList_scale]
theorem ofList_times (p q : Poly) : ofList (times p q)=ofList p*ofList q := by
  rw [times,ofList_trim,FastGeneralPathCertificates.ofList_mul]
theorem ofList_difference (p q : Poly) : ofList (difference p q)=ofList p-ofList q := by
  simp only [difference,ofList_plus,ofList_scaled,map_neg,map_one,neg_one_mul,sub_eq_add_neg]
theorem ofList_square (p : Poly) : ofList (square p)=(ofList p)^2 := by
  simp only [square,ofList_times,pow_two]

def compose : Poly → Poly → Poly
  | [], _ => []
  | c :: p, q => plus [c] (times q (compose p q))
def affine (p : Poly) (a w : ℚ) : Poly := compose p [a,w]

theorem ofList_compose (p q : Poly) :
    ofList (compose p q)=(ofList p).comp (ofList q) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [compose,ofList]
  | cons c p ih =>
      simp only [compose,ofList_plus,ofList_times,ofList,ih,Polynomial.add_comp,
        Polynomial.mul_comp,Polynomial.C_comp,Polynomial.X_comp,mul_zero,add_zero]

theorem eval_ofList (p : Poly) (x : ℚ) : (ofList p).eval x=CheckedRoots.eval p x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [ofList,CheckedRoots.eval]
  | cons c p ih => simp [ofList,CheckedRoots.eval,ih]

theorem affine_evaluation (p : Poly) (a w x : ℚ) :
    CheckedRoots.eval (affine p a w) x=CheckedRoots.eval p (a+w*x) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun r : ℚ[X] => r.eval x) (ofList_compose p [a,w])
  simp only [eval_ofList,Polynomial.eval_comp] at h
  simpa only [affine,CheckedRoots.eval,mul_zero,add_zero,mul_comm] using h

theorem affine_check (M : ℕ) (p : Poly) (a w : ℚ)
    (hlen : p.length≤M+1 ∧ (affine p a w).length≤M+1) :
    HornerCertificates.affineCheck M p (affine p a w) a w=true := by
  rw [HornerCertificates.affineCheck,decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨hlen.1,hlen.2,?_⟩
  intro k
  exact affine_evaluation p a w (k.val : ℚ)

def integrateFrom : ℕ → Poly → Poly
  | _, [] => []
  | n, c :: p => (c/((n : ℚ)+1)) :: integrateFrom (n+1) p
def primitive (p : Poly) : Poly := 0 :: integrateFrom 0 p
def unitIntegral (p : Poly) : ℚ :=
  CheckedRoots.eval (primitive p) 1-CheckedRoots.eval (primitive p) 0

theorem weighted_derivative (p : Poly) (n : ℕ) :
    C ((n : ℚ)+1)*ofList (integrateFrom n p)+
      X*(ofList (integrateFrom n p)).derivative=ofList p := by
  induction p generalizing n with
  | nil => simp [integrateFrom,ofList]
  | cons c p ih =>
      have hn : (n : ℚ)+1≠0 := by positivity
      have hqc : ((n : ℚ)+1)*(c/((n : ℚ)+1))=c := by field_simp [hn]
      have hq := congrArg (fun r : ℚ => (C r : ℚ[X])) hqc
      rw [map_mul] at hq
      have ht := ih (n+1)
      change C ((n : ℚ)+1)*(C (c/((n : ℚ)+1))+X*ofList (integrateFrom (n+1) p))+
        X*(C (c/((n : ℚ)+1))+X*ofList (integrateFrom (n+1) p)).derivative=
          C c+X*ofList p
      simp only [Polynomial.derivative_add,Polynomial.derivative_C,Polynomial.derivative_mul,
        Polynomial.derivative_X,zero_add,one_mul]
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,map_add,map_one] at hq ht ⊢
      linear_combination X*ht+hq

theorem primitive_derivative (p : Poly) : (ofList (primitive p)).derivative=ofList p := by
  have h := weighted_derivative p 0
  simpa only [primitive,ofList,Polynomial.derivative_add,Polynomial.derivative_C,
    Polynomial.derivative_mul,Polynomial.derivative_X,zero_add,one_mul,
    Nat.cast_zero,zero_add,map_one] using h

theorem primitive_checked (p : Poly) :
    RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts p (primitive p) 0 1 (unitIntegral p)=true := by
  rw [RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨primitive_derivative p,by simp only [unitIntegral,eval_ofList]⟩

def paymentList (L : Poly) (c R : ℚ) : Poly :=
  let z := difference (scaled (1/c) L) [1]
  plus [R] (scaled (1/2) (difference
    (plus (difference z (scaled (1/2) (square z))) (scaled (1/3) (times (square z) z)))
    (scaled (1/4) (square (square z)))))

theorem paymentList_sound (L : Poly) (c R : ℚ) :
    ofList (paymentList L c R)=GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.paymentPolynomial (ofList L) c R := by
  simp only [paymentList,ofList_plus,ofList_scaled,ofList_difference,ofList_times,
    ofList_square,ofList,map_one,mul_zero,add_zero,GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.paymentPolynomial]
  ring

def nonnegative (p : Poly) : Bool := p.all (fun c => decide (0≤c))

theorem nonnegative_evaluation (p : Poly) (hc : nonnegative p=true) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0≤x) :
    0≤HornerCertificates.evaluate p x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp only [HornerCertificates.evaluate_nil,le_refl]
  | cons c p ih =>
      have hh : decide (0≤c)=true ∧ nonnegative p=true := by
        simpa only [nonnegative,List.all_cons,Bool.and_eq_true] using hc
      have hcr : (0 : ℝ)≤c := by exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hh.1 : (0 : ℚ)≤c)
      rw [HornerCertificates.evaluate_cons]
      exact add_nonneg hcr (mul_nonneg hx (ih hh.2))

theorem positive_evaluation (p : Poly) (hc : nonnegative p=true)
    (hp : 0<p.headD 0) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0≤x) : 0<HornerCertificates.evaluate p x := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp only [List.headD_nil,lt_self_iff_false] at hp
  | cons c p =>
      have hh : decide (0≤c)=true ∧ nonnegative p=true := by
        simpa only [nonnegative,List.all_cons,Bool.and_eq_true] using hc
      have hcr : (0 : ℝ)<c := by exact_mod_cast hp
      rw [HornerCertificates.evaluate_cons]
      exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hcr (mul_nonneg hx (nonnegative_evaluation p hh.2 x hx))

#print axioms ofList_compose
#print axioms affine_check
#print axioms primitive_derivative
#print axioms primitive_checked
#print axioms paymentList_sound
#print axioms nonnegative_evaluation
#print axioms positive_evaluation

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedIntegralAssembly
open Set MeasureTheory CoreQuotient
open scoped Classical
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def slice (w : ComputedPolynomialCell.Witness) : RationalIntegralPartition.Slice :=
  ⟨w.a,w.b,w.total⟩
def slices (ws : List ComputedPolynomialCell.Witness) : List RationalIntegralPartition.Slice :=
  ws.map slice
def originPayment (n : ℕ) (epsilon logEpsilon logReciprocalB : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  n*epsilon*(2*logEpsilon+2*logReciprocalB-1)

noncomputable section

theorem finite_integral (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (a b : ℚ)
    (ws : List ComputedPolynomialCell.Witness)
    (ha : 0≤a) (hc : RationalIntegralPartition.check a b (slices ws)=true)
    (hw : ∀ w ∈ ws, ComputedPolynomialCell.checks (ComputedGeneralPathData.build x p q) w=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    (RationalIntegralPartition.total (slices ws) : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y := by
  apply RationalIntegralPartition.integral_lower _
    (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable G u p q (x : ℝ)) a b (slices ws) ha hc
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨w,hm,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hz
  exact ComputedPolynomialCell.computed_actual_integral x p q w (hw w hm) G u hd

theorem finite_integral_swapped (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (a b : ℚ)
    (ws : List ComputedPolynomialCell.Witness)
    (ha : 0≤a) (hc : RationalIntegralPartition.check a b (slices ws)=true)
    (hw : ∀ w ∈ ws, ComputedPolynomialCell.checks (ComputedGeneralPathData.build x p q) w=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    (RationalIntegralPartition.total (slices ws) : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u q p) (fused G u q p) x y := by
  apply RationalIntegralPartition.integral_lower _
    (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable G u q p (x : ℝ)) a b (slices ws) ha hc
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨w,hm,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hz
  exact ComputedPolynomialCell.computed_actual_integral_swapped x p q w (hw w hm) G u hd

theorem origin_integral (x epsilon logEpsilon logReciprocalB : ℚ) (p q n kE kB terms : ℕ)
    (hx : x∈Icc (0 : ℚ) 2) (he : 0<epsilon) (he1 : epsilon≤1)
    (hcE : RationalLog.accepts epsilon logEpsilon kE terms=true)
    (hcB : RationalLog.accepts (1/((n : ℚ)^2+3)) logReciprocalB kB terms=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hN : Fintype.card V+p+q+2≤n) :
    (originPayment n epsilon logEpsilon logReciprocalB : ℝ)≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..(epsilon : ℝ),
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y := by
  have hE := RationalLog.sound epsilon logEpsilon kE terms hcE
  have hB := RationalLog.sound (1/((n : ℚ)^2+3)) logReciprocalB kB terms hcB
  push_cast at hB
  rw [one_div,Real.log_inv] at hB
  have hlog : 2*(logEpsilon : ℝ)+2*(logReciprocalB : ℝ)-1≤
      Real.log (epsilon : ℝ)-Real.log ((n : ℝ)^2+3)-1 := by linarith only [hE,hB]
  have her : (0 : ℝ)<epsilon := by exact_mod_cast he
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog
    (show 0≤(n : ℝ)*(epsilon : ℝ) from mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) her.le)
  have hpr : (originPayment n epsilon logEpsilon logReciprocalB : ℝ)≤
      (n : ℝ)*(epsilon : ℝ)*(Real.log (epsilon : ℝ)-Real.log ((n : ℝ)^2+3)-1) := by
    simpa only [originPayment,Rat.cast_mul,Rat.cast_add,Rat.cast_sub,Rat.cast_ofNat,
      Rat.cast_natCast,Rat.cast_one] using hp
  exact hpr.trans (ActualMeanOrigin.actual_origin_lower G u p q n hN x epsilon
    ⟨by exact_mod_cast hx.1,by exact_mod_cast hx.2⟩ her (by exact_mod_cast he1))

theorem normalized_lower (x a Y target O B T : ℚ) (p q : ℕ)
    (ha : 0≤a) (haY : a≤Y) (ht : 0≤target)
    (hbudget : target*(3927/1250)≤O+B+T)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (ho : (O : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..(a : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y)
    (hb : (B : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(Y : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y)
    (hT : (T : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in Ioi (Y : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y) :
    (target : ℝ)≤ActualFusionIntegral.normalizedIntegral G u p q x := by
  let f := MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) (x : ℝ)
  have hall := RationalIntegralPartition.three_region_lower f
    (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable G u p q x) a Y O B T
    (by exact_mod_cast ha) (by exact_mod_cast haY) ho hb hT
  have hpi : Real.pi≤(3927/1250 : ℝ) := le_trans Real.pi_lt_d4.le (by norm_num)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpi (show (0 : ℝ)≤target by exact_mod_cast ht)
  have hbr0 : ((target*(3927/1250) : ℚ) : ℝ)≤((O+B+T : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    exact Rat.cast_le.mpr hbudget
  have hbr : (target : ℝ)*(3927/1250)≤(O : ℝ)+(B : ℝ)+(T : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Rat.cast_mul,Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_ofNat,Rat.cast_add] using hbr0
  have hi := hm.trans (hbr.trans hall)
  have hdiv := (le_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mpr hi
  change (target : ℝ)≤(1/Real.pi)*(∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, f y)
  simpa only [one_div,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm,mul_one] using hdiv

/-! Compact data use the proved coefficient programs and affine identities.
The original fast-cell theorem still supplies the actual-matrix integral bound. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedPolynomialCell
open Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
abbrev Poly := HornerCertificates.Poly
abbrev Data := ComputedGeneralPathData.Data
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure Witness where
  a : ℚ
  b : ℚ
  s : Poly
  L : Poly
  c : ℚ
  R : ℚ
  total : ℚ
  k : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  sFloor : ℚ
  nFloor : ℚ
  eFloor : ℚ

def source (d : Data) : Fin 5 → Poly := ![d.U,d.V,d.J,d.N,d.E]
def affineSource (d : Data) (w : Witness) (i : Fin 5) : Poly :=
  ComputedHornerArithmetic.affine (source d i) w.a (w.b-w.a)
def sourceDegree (d : Data) (w : Witness) : ℕ :=
  Finset.univ.sup (fun i : Fin 5 => max (source d i).length (affineSource d w i).length)

def geometry (d : Data) (w : Witness) : FastPolynomialPaymentCell.Geometry :=
  {U:=affineSource d w 0,V:=affineSource d w 1,J:=affineSource d w 2,
   N:=affineSource d w 3,E:=affineSource d w 4,
   sFloor:=w.sFloor,nFloor:=w.nFloor,eFloor:=w.eFloor,sourceDegree:=sourceDegree d w}

def cell (d : Data) (w : Witness) : PolynomialPaymentCell.Cell :=
  let g := geometry d w
  let pay := ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList w.L w.c w.R
  {a:=w.a,b:=w.b,s:=w.s,L:=w.L,pay:=pay,
   primitive:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.primitive pay,c:=w.c,R:=w.R,
   unitIntegral:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.unitIntegral pay,total:=w.total,k:=w.k,n:=w.n,
   comparisonDegree:=(HornerArithmetic.normMargin w.s w.L g.U g.V g.J).length,
   nDegree:=(HornerArithmetic.floorMargin g.N g.nFloor).length,
   eDegree:=(HornerArithmetic.floorMargin g.E g.eFloor).length,
   sCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,lowerCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,
   comparisonCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,nCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,eCoefficients:=fun _ => 0}

def checks (d : Data) (w : Witness) : Bool :=
  let g := geometry d w
  let z := cell d w
  decide (0<w.a ∧ w.a<w.b ∧ 0<w.c ∧ 0<w.sFloor ∧ 0<w.nFloor ∧ 0<w.eFloor ∧
    HornerCertificates.accepts 2 (HornerArithmetic.floorMargin w.s w.sFloor)=true ∧
    HornerCertificates.accepts 4 (HornerArithmetic.floorMargin w.L w.c)=true ∧
    HornerCertificates.accepts z.nDegree (HornerArithmetic.floorMargin g.N g.nFloor)=true ∧
    HornerCertificates.accepts z.eDegree (HornerArithmetic.floorMargin g.E g.eFloor)=true ∧
    HornerCertificates.accepts z.comparisonDegree (HornerArithmetic.normMargin w.s w.L g.U g.V g.J)=true ∧
    RationalLog.accepts w.c w.R w.k w.n=true ∧ w.total≤(w.b-w.a)*z.unitIntegral)

theorem affine_source_checked (d : Data) (w : Witness) (i : Fin 5) :
    HornerCertificates.affineCheck (sourceDegree d w) (source d i) (affineSource d w i)
      w.a (w.b-w.a)=true := by
  apply ComputedHornerArithmetic.affine_check
  have hm : max (source d i).length (affineSource d w i).length≤sourceDegree d w :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 5 => max (source d j).length (affineSource d w j).length)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact ⟨(Nat.le_max_left _ _).trans (hm.trans (Nat.le_succ _)),
    (Nat.le_max_right _ _).trans (hm.trans (Nat.le_succ _))⟩

theorem geometry_checked (d : Data) (w : Witness) (hc : checks d w=true) :
    FastPolynomialPaymentCell.accepts d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E (cell d w) (geometry d w)=true := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hab,hc0,hsF,hnF,heF,hs,hl,hn,he,hp,_hlog,_hbudget⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [FastPolynomialPaymentCell.accepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨ha,hab,hc0,hsF,hnF,heF,affine_source_checked d w 0,affine_source_checked d w 1,
    affine_source_checked d w 2,affine_source_checked d w 3,affine_source_checked d w 4,
    hs,hl,hn,he,hp⟩

theorem payment_checked (d : Data) (w : Witness) (hc : checks d w=true) :
    PolynomialPaymentCell.paymentAccepts (cell d w)=true := by
  obtain ⟨_ha,_hab,_hc0,_hsF,_hnF,_heF,_hs,_hl,_hn,_he,_hp,_hlog,hbudget⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [PolynomialPaymentCell.paymentAccepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList_sound w.L w.c w.R,hbudget⟩

theorem logarithm_checked (d : Data) (w : Witness) (hc : checks d w=true) :
    RationalLog.accepts w.c w.R w.k w.n=true := by
  obtain ⟨_ha,_hab,_hc0,_hsF,_hnF,_heF,_hs,_hl,_hn,_he,_hp,hlog,_hbudget⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  exact hlog

theorem primitive_checked (d : Data) (w : Witness) :
    RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts (cell d w).pay (cell d w).primitive 0 1 (cell d w).unitIntegral=true :=
  ComputedHornerArithmetic.primitive_checked (ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList w.L w.c w.R)

noncomputable section

theorem actual_integral_lower (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (d : Data)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q d.a d.b d.c d.e=true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E=true)
    (w : Witness) (hc : checks d w=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    (w.total : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (w.a : ℝ)..(w.b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u p q)
        (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x y := by
  have hdata := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have ha : (0 : ℝ)≤w.a := by exact_mod_cast hdata.1.le
  have hab : (w.a : ℝ)≤w.b := by exact_mod_cast hdata.2.1.le
  have hf := TailIntegral.interval_integrable_of_Ioi
    (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable G u p q (x : ℝ)) ha hab
  exact FastPolynomialPaymentCell.actual_integral_lower x p q d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E
    hpath hpoly (cell d w) (geometry d w) (geometry_checked d w hc) (payment_checked d w hc)
    (logarithm_checked d w hc) (primitive_checked d w) G u hd hf

theorem computed_actual_integral (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (w : Witness)
    (hc : checks (ComputedGeneralPathData.build x p q) w=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    (w.total : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (w.a : ℝ)..(w.b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u p q)
        (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x y :=
  actual_integral_lower x p q _ (ComputedGeneralPathData.path_checked x p q)
    (ComputedGeneralPathData.norms_checked x p q) w hc G u hd

theorem computed_actual_integral_swapped (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (w : Witness)
    (hc : checks (ComputedGeneralPathData.build x p q) w=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    (w.total : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (w.a : ℝ)..(w.b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u q p)
        (CoreQuotient.fused G u q p) x y :=
  actual_integral_lower x q p _ (ComputedGeneralPathData.path_swapped x p q)
    (ComputedGeneralPathData.norms_checked x p q) w hc G u hd

#print axioms affine_source_checked
#print axioms geometry_checked
#print axioms payment_checked
#print axioms primitive_checked

#print axioms computed_actual_integral_swapped
end

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanComputedGeneralPathData
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanInversePolynomialNorm
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalPolynomialOrder
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanQuantitativePositiveTail

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ComputedPositiveTail
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial CoreQuotient
open GeneralGraphQuotient Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
abbrev Poly := HornerCertificates.Poly
abbrev Data := ComputedGeneralPathData.Data
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def multiplier : Poly := [0,0,0,2]
def denominator (d : Data) : Poly :=
  ComputedHornerArithmetic.plus
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.times (ComputedHornerArithmetic.plus multiplier [1]) d.U)
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.times
      (ComputedHornerArithmetic.plus (ComputedHornerArithmetic.square multiplier) multiplier) d.V)
def comparison (d : Data) (K : ℚ) : Poly :=
  ComputedHornerArithmetic.difference
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.times [0,0,1]
      (ComputedHornerArithmetic.difference (ComputedHornerArithmetic.times multiplier d.J) (denominator d)))
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.scaled K (denominator d))
def shifted (p : Poly) (Y : ℚ) : Poly := ComputedHornerArithmetic.affine p Y 1
def checks (d : Data) (K Y : ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (0≤K ∧ 0<Y ∧
    ComputedHornerArithmetic.nonnegative (shifted (comparison d K) Y)=true ∧
    ComputedHornerArithmetic.nonnegative (shifted d.N Y)=true ∧
    ComputedHornerArithmetic.nonnegative (shifted d.E Y)=true ∧
    0<(shifted d.N Y).headD 0 ∧ 0<(shifted d.E Y).headD 0)

noncomputable section

theorem shifted_checked (p : Poly) (Y : ℚ)
    (hc : ComputedHornerArithmetic.nonnegative (shifted p Y)=true) :
    RationalPolynomialOrder.rayAccepts (ofList p) Y (shifted p Y)=true := by
  rw [RationalPolynomialOrder.rayAccepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  have he : RationalPolynomialCell.affine Y (Y+1)=ofList [Y,1] := by
    simp [RationalPolynomialCell.affine,ofList]
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [shifted,ComputedHornerArithmetic.affine,he] using
      (ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_compose p [Y,1]).symm
  · simpa only [ComputedHornerArithmetic.nonnegative,List.all_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq] using hc

theorem comparison_sound (d : Data) (K : ℚ) :
    ofList (comparison d K)=
      X^2*((C 2*X^3)*ofList d.J-
        (((C 2*X^3)+1)*ofList d.U+((C 2*X^3)^2+(C 2*X^3))*ofList d.V))-
      C K*(((C 2*X^3)+1)*ofList d.U+((C 2*X^3)^2+(C 2*X^3))*ofList d.V) := by
  simp only [comparison,denominator,multiplier,ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_difference,
    ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_plus,ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_times,
    ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_scaled,ComputedHornerArithmetic.ofList_square,
    ofList,map_zero,map_one,mul_zero,add_zero,zero_add]
  ring

theorem actual_squared_norm (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (d : Data)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q d.a d.b d.c d.e=true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E=true)
    (K Y : ℚ) (hc : checks d K Y=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) (y : ℝ) (hy : (Y : ℝ)≤y) :
    1+(K : ℝ)/y^2≤
      ‖(CoreQuotient.shifted (point x y) (source G u p q)).det /
        (CoreQuotient.shifted (point x y) (fused G u p q)).det‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨_hK,hY,hP,hN,hE,hN0,hE0⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have hYr : (0 : ℝ)<Y := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hy0 : 0<y := hYr.trans_le hy
  have hnp := RationalPolynomialOrder.ray_positive (ofList d.N) Y (shifted d.N Y)
    (shifted_checked d.N Y hN) hN0 y hy
  have hep := RationalPolynomialOrder.ray_positive (ofList d.E) Y (shifted d.E Y)
    (shifted_checked d.E Y hE) hE0 y hy
  have hpc := RationalPolynomialOrder.ray_nonneg (ofList (comparison d K)) Y
    (shifted (comparison d K) Y) (shifted_checked _ Y hP) y hy
  rw [comparison_sound] at hpc
  simp only [map_sub,map_mul,map_add,map_pow,map_one,real_C,real_X] at hpc
  have hb := InversePolynomialNorm.reserve_bound _ _ _ (K : ℝ) y hy0 hpc
  have hi := InversePolynomialNorm.inverse_parameter _ _ _ (2*y^3)
    (1+(K : ℝ)/y^2) (by positivity) hb
  exact GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.actual_norm_lower x y hy0 p q
    d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E hpath hpoly
    (1/(2*y^3)) (1+(K : ℝ)/y^2) (by positivity) hnp hep hi G u hd

theorem actual_integral (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (d : Data)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q d.a d.b d.c d.e=true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E=true)
    (K Y : ℚ) (hc : checks d K Y=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    QuantitativePositiveTail.coefficient (K : ℝ) (Y : ℝ)/(Y : ℝ)≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi (Y : ℝ),
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y := by
  have hh := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have hK : (0 : ℝ)≤K := by exact_mod_cast hh.1
  have hY : (0 : ℝ)<Y := by exact_mod_cast hh.2.1
  have hf := (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable G u p q (x : ℝ)).mono_set
    (show Ioi (Y : ℝ)⊆Ioi 0 from fun _ hy => hY.trans hy)
  apply QuantitativePositiveTail.integral_lower _ (K : ℝ) (Y : ℝ) hK hY hf
  intro y hy
  exact QuantitativePositiveTail.pointwise (K : ℝ) (Y : ℝ) y _ hK hY hy.le
    (actual_squared_norm x p q d hpath hpoly K Y hc G u hd y hy.le)

theorem computed_actual_integral (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (K Y : ℚ)
    (hc : checks (ComputedGeneralPathData.build x p q) K Y=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    QuantitativePositiveTail.coefficient (K : ℝ) (Y : ℝ)/(Y : ℝ)≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi (Y : ℝ),
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u p q) (fused G u p q) x y :=
  actual_integral x p q _ (ComputedGeneralPathData.path_checked x p q)
    (ComputedGeneralPathData.norms_checked x p q) K Y hc G u hd

theorem computed_actual_integral_swapped (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (K Y : ℚ)
    (hc : checks (ComputedGeneralPathData.build x p q) K Y=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    QuantitativePositiveTail.coefficient (K : ℝ) (Y : ℝ)/(Y : ℝ)≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi (Y : ℝ),
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source G u q p) (fused G u q p) x y :=
  actual_integral x q p _ (ComputedGeneralPathData.path_swapped x p q)
    (ComputedGeneralPathData.norms_checked x p q) K Y hc G u hd

#print axioms shifted_checked
#print axioms comparison_sound
#print axioms actual_squared_norm
#print axioms actual_integral
#print axioms computed_actual_integral
#print axioms computed_actual_integral_swapped
end
