import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRewireTopology
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRewireIso

/-!
# Leaf descent for the actual RG source and fused graphs

The indices `p` and `q` are physical arm lengths minus one. In particular,
`p = 0` and `q = 0` are included. The residual degree is the degree in `C`.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.FusionDescent

open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient RewireIso RewireTopology
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V]

theorem base_root_degree (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    (base C u p q).degree (.inl u) = C.degree u + 1 := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ j, if (base C u p q).Adj (.inl u) j
        then 1 else 0 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_id] using
        (base C u p q).degree_eq_sum_if_adj (R := ℕ) (.inl u)
    _ = (∑ j, if C.Adj u j then 1 else 0) + 1 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp [base, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      simpa only [Nat.cast_id] using (C.degree_eq_sum_if_adj (R := ℕ) u).symm

theorem base_endpoint_degree (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    (base C u p q).degree (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p))) = 1 := by
  cases p with
  | zero =>
    have hn : (base C u 0 q).neighborFinset (.inr (.inl (Fin.last 0))) = {.inl u} := by
      ext (x | (x | x)) <;>
        simp [base, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, pathGraph_adj, Fin.ext_iff]
    rw [degree, hn, Finset.card_singleton]
  | succ p =>
    have hn : (base C u (p + 1) q).neighborFinset (.inr (.inl (Fin.last (p + 1)))) =
        {.inr (.inl (⟨p, by omega⟩ : Fin (p + 1 + 1)))} := by
      ext (x | (x | x)) <;>
        simp only [mem_neighborFinset, base, sup_adj, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj,
          pathGraph_adj, Finset.mem_singleton, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq,
          Sum.inl_ne_inr, Sum.inr_ne_inl, false_and, and_false, false_or, or_false,
          Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero, Bool.false_eq_true]
      · constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨h, _⟩, _⟩
          omega
        · intro h
          exact h.elim
      · omega
    rw [degree, hn, Finset.card_singleton]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem base_root_endpoint_reachable (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    (base C u p q).Reachable (.inl u) (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p))) := by
  let f : pathGraph (p + 1) →g base C u p q :=
    { toFun := fun i => .inr (.inl i)
      map_rel' := by intro a b hab; exact Or.inl hab }
  have hpath := (pathGraph_preconnected (p + 1) 0 (Fin.last p)).map f
  have hedge : (base C u p q).Adj (.inl u) (.inr (.inl 0)) := by
    exact Or.inr (by simp [edge_adj])
  exact hedge.reachable.trans hpath

/-- The original and fused trees have the same order and differ by exactly one leaf.
Only treehood of the actual input and positive residual degree are required. -/
theorem fusion_tree_and_leaf_count (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    (fused C u p q).IsTree ∧
      Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) =
        Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) ∧
      leafCount (source C u p q) = leafCount (fused C u p q) + 1 := by
  have hmissing := base_missing_edges C u p q
  have hr := base_root_endpoint_reachable C u p q
  have ht := tree_rewire (base C u p q) (.inl u) (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p)))
    (.inr (.inr 0)) (by simp) (by simp) hmissing.1 hmissing.2 hr hT
  have hl := leaf_count_rewire (base C u p q) (.inl u) (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p)))
    (.inr (.inr 0)) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hmissing.1 hmissing.2
    (by rw [base_root_degree]; omega) (base_endpoint_degree C u p q)
  change (rewired C u p q).IsTree at ht
  have hleaf := leaf_count_iso (fusedIso C u p q)
  refine ⟨(fusedIso C u p q).isTree_iff.mp ht, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  · change leafCount (source C u p q) = leafCount (rewired C u p q) + 1 at hl
    exact hl.trans (congrArg (· + 1) hleaf)

theorem fusion_leaf_count_strict (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    leafCount (fused C u p q) < leafCount (source C u p q) := by
  rw [(fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hT hd).2.2]
  omega

#print axioms base_root_degree
#print axioms base_endpoint_degree
#print axioms base_root_endpoint_reachable
#print axioms fusion_tree_and_leaf_count
#print axioms fusion_leaf_count_strict

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.FusionDescent

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The actual graph characteristic determinants for an arbitrary core and all
positive arm lengths. This module does not prove an energy comparison.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanGraphJoin

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.CoreQuotient

open Matrix Finset
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

open Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

theorem shifted_path (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    shifted z (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) = pathMatrix z n := by
  unfold shifted pathMatrix
  congr 3

/-- Core with two prescribed pendant paths; p and q denote lengths minus one. -/
def source (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    SimpleGraph (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :=
  joinTwo C (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (p + 1)) (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (q + 1)) u 0 0

/-- The fused graph, with the combined path relabelled from its attachment endpoint. -/
def fused (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    SimpleGraph (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) :=
  join C (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (p + q + 2)) u 0

def rootResolvent (z : ℂ) (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) : ℂ :=
  (shifted z C)⁻¹ u u

theorem shifted_isUnit (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (C : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsUnit (shifted z C).det := by
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (shifted_det_ne_zero _ (C.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℂ) z hz)

theorem source_det (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    (shifted z (source C u p q)).det = (shifted z C).det *
      ((den z (p + 1) - num z (p + 1)) *
        (den z (q + 1) - num z (q + 1)) -
        rootResolvent z C u * (2 * den z (p + 1) * den z (q + 1) -
          num z (p + 1) * den z (q + 1) - num z (q + 1) * den z (p + 1))) := by
  unfold source
  rw [shifted_joinTwo, rooted_two_arm_det _ _ _ (shifted_isUnit z hz C)
    (shifted_isUnit z hz _) (shifted_isUnit z hz _)]
  rw [shifted_path, shifted_path]
  change (shifted z C).det * (pathMatrix z (p + 1)).det *
    (pathMatrix z (q + 1)).det *
    ((1 - (pathMatrix z (p + 1))⁻¹ 0 0) *
      (1 - (pathMatrix z (q + 1))⁻¹ 0 0) -
      rootResolvent z C u *
        (2 - (pathMatrix z (p + 1))⁻¹ 0 0 - (pathMatrix z (q + 1))⁻¹ 0 0)) = _
  rw [pathMatrix_det, pathMatrix_det, pathMatrix_inv_endpoint, pathMatrix_inv_endpoint]
  unfold resolventQuotient
  have hp := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz p
  have hq := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz q
  field_simp

theorem fused_det (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    (shifted z (fused C u p q)).det = (shifted z C).det *
      (den z (p + q + 2) - num z (p + q + 2) -
        rootResolvent z C u * den z (p + q + 2)) := by
  unfold fused
  rw [shifted_join, rooted_one_arm_det _ _ (shifted_isUnit z hz C)
    (shifted_isUnit z hz _)]
  rw [shifted_path]
  change (shifted z C).det * (pathMatrix z ((p + q + 1) + 1)).det *
    (1 - rootResolvent z C u - (pathMatrix z ((p + q + 1) + 1))⁻¹ 0 0) = _
  rw [pathMatrix_det, pathMatrix_inv_endpoint]
  unfold resolventQuotient
  have hr := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz (p + q + 1)
  field_simp
  ring

#print axioms source_det
#print axioms fused_det

def twoArmFactor (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) (k : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (den z (p + 1) - num z (p + 1)) * (den z (q + 1) - num z (q + 1)) -
    k * (2 * den z (p + 1) * den z (q + 1) -
      num z (p + 1) * den z (q + 1) - num z (q + 1) * den z (p + 1))

def oneArmFactor (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) (k : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  den z (p + q + 2) - num z (p + q + 2) - k * den z (p + q + 2)

theorem singleton_factor_calibration (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (p q : ℕ) :
    twoArmFactor z p q (1 / z) = oneArmFactor z p q (1 / z) ∧
    z * twoArmFactor z p q (1 / z) = den z (p + q + 3) := by
  have h := singleton_normalization z (p + 1) (q + 1)
  have he : (p + 1) + (q + 1) = p + q + 2 := by omega
  rw [he] at h
  constructor
  · unfold twoArmFactor oneArmFactor
    field_simp
    linear_combination h
  · unfold twoArmFactor
    have hd := den_succ z (p + q + 2)
    rw [show p + q + 2 + 1 = p + q + 3 by omega] at hd
    field_simp
    linear_combination h - hd

/-- The normalized quotient, with the cancelling path factors kept polynomial.
All matrices in this statement are the actual graph Laplacian shifts. -/
theorem normalized_determinant_quotient (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    (shifted z (source C u p q)).det / (shifted z (fused C u p q)).det =
      (twoArmFactor z p q (rootResolvent z C u) / twoArmFactor z p q (1 / z)) *
      (oneArmFactor z p q (1 / z) / oneArmFactor z p q (rootResolvent z C u)) := by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hz; simp [h]
  have hcal := singleton_factor_calibration z hz0 p q
  have hnext := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz (p + q + 2)
  have hf0 : twoArmFactor z p q (1 / z) ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    apply hnext
    rw [show p + q + 2 + 1 = p + q + 3 by omega, ← hcal.2, he, mul_zero]
  have hc : (shifted z C).det ≠ 0 := (shifted_isUnit z hz C).ne_zero
  have hg : oneArmFactor z p q (rootResolvent z C u) ≠ 0 := by
    have hn := (shifted_isUnit z hz (fused C u p q)).ne_zero
    rw [fused_det z hz] at hn
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hn).2
  rw [source_det z hz, fused_det z hz]
  change ((shifted z C).det * twoArmFactor z p q (rootResolvent z C u)) /
    ((shifted z C).det * oneArmFactor z p q (rootResolvent z C u)) = _
  rw [← hcal.1]
  field_simp

#print axioms singleton_factor_calibration
#print axioms normalized_determinant_quotient

theorem twoArmFactor_resolvents (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (p q : ℕ) (k : ℂ) :
    twoArmFactor z p q k = den z (p + 1) * den z (q + 1) *
      ((1 - resolventQuotient z (p + 1)) * (1 - resolventQuotient z (q + 1)) -
        k * (2 - resolventQuotient z (p + 1) - resolventQuotient z (q + 1))) := by
  have hp := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz p
  have hq := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz q
  unfold twoArmFactor resolventQuotient
  field_simp

theorem oneArmFactor_resolvent (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (p q : ℕ) (k : ℂ) :
    oneArmFactor z p q k = den z (p + q + 2) *
      (1 - resolventQuotient z (p + q + 2) - k) := by
  have hr := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz (p + q + 1)
  unfold oneArmFactor resolventQuotient
  field_simp

/-- Lemma 2.2 of the manuscript, in precisely its endpoint-resolvent form. -/
theorem normalized_resolvent_quotient (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    let hp := resolventQuotient z (p + 1)
    let hq := resolventQuotient z (q + 1)
    let hr := resolventQuotient z (p + q + 2)
    let k := rootResolvent z C u
    let A₀ := (1 - hp) * (1 - hq)
    let B₀ := 2 - hp - hq
    let C₀ := 1 - hr
    (shifted z (source C u p q)).det / (shifted z (fused C u p q)).det =
      ((A₀ - B₀ * k) / (A₀ - B₀ * (1 / z))) *
      ((C₀ - 1 / z) / (C₀ - k)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [normalized_determinant_quotient z hz C u p q]
  simp_rw [twoArmFactor_resolvents z hz, oneArmFactor_resolvent z hz]
  have hpq := mul_ne_zero (den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz p)
    (den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz q)
  have hr := den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz (p + q + 1)
  rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hpq, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hr]
  ring

#print axioms normalized_resolvent_quotient

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.CoreQuotient

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFusionDescent
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTreeTerminal

/-!
# The final step of RG leaf descent

An actual RG fusion consumes exactly one unit of branching excess.
If the source tree has three leaves, its fused tree is the path of the same order.
This does not assert existence of a source presentation for an arbitrary tree.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.FusionTerminal

open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient RewireTopology FusionDescent TreeTerminal
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V]

/-- The branching excess is reduced by exactly one by the actual fusion. -/
theorem fusion_branching_excess (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    branchingExcess (source C u p q) = branchingExcess (fused C u p q) + 1 := by
  let : Nontrivial (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :=
    ⟨⟨.inl u, .inr (.inl 0), by simp⟩⟩
  let : Nontrivial (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) :=
    ⟨⟨.inl u, .inr 0, by simp⟩⟩
  have hF := fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hT hd
  have hS := leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess _ hT
  have hB := leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess _ hF.1
  have hl := hF.2.2
  omega

/-- A source tree with positive residual root degree cannot already be a path. -/
theorem fusion_source_not_path (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    ¬Nonempty (source C u p q ≃g pathGraph
      (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)))) := by
  let : Nontrivial (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :=
    ⟨⟨.inl u, .inr (.inl 0), by simp⟩⟩
  intro hpath
  have hl := (tree_two_leaves_iff_path _ hT).mpr hpath
  have he := fusion_branching_excess C u p q hT hd
  have hs := leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess _ hT
  omega

/-- With three source leaves, the actual fused graph is the path of its order. -/
theorem three_leaf_fusion_is_path (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hl : leafCount (source C u p q) = 3) :
    Nonempty (fused C u p q ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)))) := by
  let : Nontrivial (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) :=
    ⟨⟨.inl u, .inr 0, by simp⟩⟩
  have hF := fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hT hd
  apply (tree_two_leaves_iff_path _ hF.1).mp
  have he := hF.2.2
  omega

#print axioms fusion_branching_excess
#print axioms fusion_source_not_path
#print axioms three_leaf_fusion_is_path

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.FusionTerminal

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRootSchur
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanActualFusionIntegral

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralGraphQuotient
open CoreQuotient PathRecurrence
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def point (x y : ℝ) : ℂ := x+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I
def center (x y d : ℝ) : ℂ := (x-d : ℝ)+(y+d/(2*y) : ℝ)*Complex.I

def numeratorCoefficient (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (den z (p+1)-num z (p+1))*(den z (q+1)-num z (q+1))
def sourceConstant (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  2*den z (p+1)*den z (q+1)-num z (p+1)*den z (q+1)-num z (q+1)*den z (p+1)
def denominatorCoefficient (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  den z (p+q+2)-num z (p+q+2)
def fusedConstant (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ := den z (p+q+2)
def quotient (z : ℂ) (p q : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (numeratorCoefficient z p q*s-sourceConstant z p q)/
    (denominatorCoefficient z p q*s-fusedConstant z p q)

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

theorem schur_nonzero (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    RootSchur.schurScalar C u z ≠ 0 := by
  have hi := (RootSchur.graph_schur_disk C u z hz).2
  intro hs
  rw [hs] at hi
  change z.im ≤ 0 at hi
  linarith

/-- Polynomial path factors at arbitrary real shifts, bound to the actual
source/fused Laplacian determinants with their orientation retained. -/
theorem actual_quotient (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im)
    (p q : ℕ) :
    (shifted z (source C u p q)).det/(shifted z (fused C u p q)).det=
      quotient z p q (RootSchur.schurScalar C u z) := by
  let s := RootSchur.schurScalar C u z
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := schur_nonzero C u z hz
  have hc : (shifted z C).det ≠ 0 := (shifted_isUnit z hz.ne' C).ne_zero
  have hf : denominatorCoefficient z p q-s⁻¹*fusedConstant z p q ≠ 0 := by
    have hh := (shifted_isUnit z hz.ne' (fused C u p q)).ne_zero
    rw [fused_det z hz.ne',RootSchur.root_resolvent_schur C u z hz] at hh
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hh).2
  have he : denominatorCoefficient z p q-s⁻¹*fusedConstant z p q=
      (denominatorCoefficient z p q*s-fusedConstant z p q)/s := by
    field_simp [hs]
  have hden : denominatorCoefficient z p q*s-fusedConstant z p q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hf
    rw [he,hzero,zero_div]
  rw [source_det z hz.ne',fused_det z hz.ne',RootSchur.root_resolvent_schur C u z hz]
  change ((shifted z C).det*(numeratorCoefficient z p q-s⁻¹*sourceConstant z p q))/
      ((shifted z C).det*(denominatorCoefficient z p q-s⁻¹*fusedConstant z p q))=
    (numeratorCoefficient z p q*s-sourceConstant z p q)/
      (denominatorCoefficient z p q*s-fusedConstant z p q)
  field_simp [hc,hs,hf,hden]

theorem actual_disk (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ‖RootSchur.schurScalar C u (point x y)-center x y (C.degree u)‖ ≤
      (C.degree u : ℝ)/(2*y) := by
  have hz : 0 < (point x y).im := by simpa [point] using hy
  have h := (RootSchur.graph_schur_disk C u (point x y) hz).1
  have him : (point x y).im=y := by simp [point]
  have he : point x y-(C.degree u : ℂ)+
      ((C.degree u : ℝ)/(2*y) : ℝ)*Complex.I=center x y (C.degree u) := by
    unfold point center
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [him,he] at h
  exact h

theorem actual_logarithm (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source C u p q) (fused C u p q) x y=
      Real.log ‖quotient (point x y) p q (RootSchur.schurScalar C u (point x y))‖ := by
  change Real.log ‖(shifted (point x y) (source C u p q)).det/
    (shifted (point x y) (fused C u p q)).det‖=_
  rw [actual_quotient C u (point x y) (by simpa [point] using hy) p q]

#print axioms schur_nonzero
#print axioms actual_quotient
#print axioms actual_disk
#print axioms actual_logarithm
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralGraphQuotient

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanGeneralPathPolynomials
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalMobiusPolynomials
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanClassCellCertificates

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralPathCellCertificates
open CoreQuotient PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- Source-bound rational coefficient identities, separation and common-basis
checks give a logarithmic payment for the actual two Laplace matrices. -/
theorem actual_log_lower {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (p q : ℕ)
    (as bs cs es us vs js ns sep : List ℚ)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q as bs cs es=true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts as bs cs es us vs js ns sep=true)
    (cu cv cj : J → ℚ) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hcoeff : ClassCellCertificates.accepts cu cv cj s L=true)
    (hlog : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true)
    (w : J → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j)
    (hu : realEvaluator y (ofList us)=∑ j, (cu j : ℝ)*w j)
    (hv : realEvaluator y (ofList vs)=∑ j, (cv j : ℝ)*w j)
    (hj : realEvaluator y (ofList js)=∑ j, (cj j : ℝ)*w j)
    (hn : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList ns))
    (he : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList sep))
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : C.degree u=1) :
    (R : ℝ) ≤ MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source C u p q) (fused C u p q) x y := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,heval⟩ := GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts_sound x p q as bs cs es hpath y
  obtain ⟨huv,hvv,hjv,hnv,hev⟩ :=
    RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts_sound as bs cs es us vs js ns sep hpoly y
  rw [hb,heval,ha,hc] at huv
  rw [ha,heval,hb,hc] at hvv
  rw [hb,ha] at hjv
  rw [hb,ha] at hnv
  rw [heval,hc] at hev
  rw [hnv] at hn
  rw [hev] at he
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hcoeff).1
  have hbound := ClassCellCertificates.coefficient_sound cu cv cj s L hcoeff w hw _ _ _
    (huv.symm.trans hu) (hvv.symm.trans hv) (hjv.symm.trans hj)
  have hnorm := GeneralScaledQuotient.actual_norm_certificate C u hd x y hy p q s L hs he hn hbound
  exact ClassCellCertificates.log_lower_of_square L R k n hlog _ hnorm

#print axioms actual_log_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralPathCellCertificates

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanGeneralPathCellCertificates
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanLogPolynomialLower

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralPathPolynomialPayments
open CoreQuotient GeneralGraphQuotient Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

/-- The Young parameter and the norm payment may vary with the ordinate.
Multiplication by the positive parameter keeps all coefficient obligations polynomial. -/
theorem actual_norm_lower
    (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (p q : ℕ)
    (as bs cs es us vs js ns sep : List ℚ)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q as bs cs es = true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts as bs cs es us vs js ns sep = true)
    (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hn : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList ns))
    (he : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList sep))
    (hbound : L * ((s+s^2)*realEvaluator y (ofList us) +
      (s+1)*realEvaluator y (ofList vs)) ≤ s*realEvaluator y (ofList js))
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : C.degree u = 1) :
    L ≤ ‖(shifted (point x y) (source C u p q)).det /
      (shifted (point x y) (fused C u p q)).det‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,heval⟩ := GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts_sound x p q as bs cs es hpath y
  obtain ⟨huv,hvv,hjv,hnv,hev⟩ :=
    RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts_sound as bs cs es us vs js ns sep hpoly y
  rw [hb,heval,ha,hc] at huv
  rw [ha,heval,hb,hc] at hvv
  rw [hb,ha] at hjv
  rw [hb,ha] at hnv
  rw [heval,hc] at hev
  rw [hnv] at hn
  rw [hev] at he
  have hscale (U V : ℝ) :
      s*(L*((1+s)*U+(1+1/s)*V)) = L*((s+s^2)*U+(s+1)*V) := by
    field_simp [hs.ne']
  have hbnd : L*((1+s)*realEvaluator y (ofList us)+
      (1+1/s)*realEvaluator y (ofList vs)) ≤ realEvaluator y (ofList js) := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hs).mp
    rw [hscale]
    exact hbound
  rw [huv,hvv,hjv] at hbnd
  exact GeneralScaledQuotient.actual_norm_certificate C u hd x y hy p q s L hs he hn hbnd

#print axioms actual_norm_lower

/-- A rational polynomial payment for the logarithm of the actual determinant quotient. -/
theorem actual_log_lower
    (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (p q : ℕ)
    (as bs cs es us vs js ns sep : List ℚ)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q as bs cs es = true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts as bs cs es us vs js ns sep = true)
    (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hn : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList ns))
    (he : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList sep))
    (hbound : L * ((s+s^2)*realEvaluator y (ofList us) +
      (s+1)*realEvaluator y (ofList vs)) ≤ s*realEvaluator y (ofList js))
    (c R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : (c : ℝ) ≤ L)
    (hlog : RationalLog.accepts c R k n = true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : C.degree u = 1) :
    (R : ℝ) + LogPolynomialLower.lowerFour (L/(c : ℝ)-1)/2 ≤
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (source C u p q) (fused C u p q) x y := by
  exact LogPolynomialLower.rational_payment_lower _ L c R k n hc hL hlog
    (actual_norm_lower x y hy p q as bs cs es us vs js ns sep hpath hpoly
      s L hs hn he hbound C u hd)

#print axioms actual_log_lower

def paymentPolynomial (L : ℚ[X]) (c R : ℚ) : ℚ[X] :=
  let z := C (1/c)*L-1
  C R + (z-C (1/2)*z^2+C (1/3)*z^3-C (1/4)*z^4)*C (1/2)

theorem payment_evaluation (L : ℚ[X]) (c R : ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (paymentPolynomial L c R) =
      (R : ℝ) + LogPolynomialLower.lowerFour (realEvaluator y L/(c : ℝ)-1)/2 := by
  simp only [paymentPolynomial,map_add,map_sub,map_mul,map_pow,map_one,real_C,
    Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_one,Rat.cast_ofNat]
  unfold LogPolynomialLower.lowerFour
  ring

#print axioms payment_evaluation
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralPathPolynomialPayments

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPolynomialPathMap
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanGeneralScaledQuotient

/-! Rational polynomial identities for the four actual coefficients. The shift
is an arbitrary rational, so the mean shift 2-2/N is retained exactly. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralPathPolynomials
noncomputable section
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap GeneralGraphQuotient
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

def sourceSlope (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : ℚ[X] :=
  (denPoly x (p+1)-numPoly x (p+1))*(denPoly x (q+1)-numPoly x (q+1))
def sourceOffset (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : ℚ[X] :=
  2*denPoly x (p+1)*denPoly x (q+1)-numPoly x (p+1)*denPoly x (q+1)-
    numPoly x (q+1)*denPoly x (p+1)
def fusedSlope (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : ℚ[X] := denPoly x (p+q+2)-numPoly x (p+q+2)
def fusedOffset (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : ℚ[X] := denPoly x (p+q+2)
def scalePoly : ℚ[X] := 2*X
def centerPoly (x : ℚ) : ℚ[X] := 2*X*(C x-1)+2*X^2-1
def sourceCenter (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : ℚ[X] :=
  sourceSlope x p q*centerPoly x-scalePoly*sourceOffset x p q
def fusedCenter (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) : ℚ[X] :=
  fusedSlope x p q*centerPoly x-scalePoly*fusedOffset x p q

theorem num_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (numPoly x n)=PathRecurrence.num (point (x : ℝ) y) n := by
  simpa only [point,Complex.ofReal_ratCast] using eval_num x y n
theorem den_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (denPoly x n)=PathRecurrence.den (point (x : ℝ) y) n := by
  simpa only [point,Complex.ofReal_ratCast] using eval_den x y n

theorem sourceSlope_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (sourceSlope x p q)=GeneralScaledQuotient.a x y p q := by
  simp only [sourceSlope,GeneralScaledQuotient.a,numeratorCoefficient,
    map_mul,map_sub,num_evaluation,den_evaluation]
theorem sourceOffset_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (sourceOffset x p q)=sourceConstant (point x y) p q := by
  simp only [sourceOffset,sourceConstant,map_sub,map_mul,map_ofNat,num_evaluation,den_evaluation]
theorem fusedSlope_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (fusedSlope x p q)=GeneralScaledQuotient.c x y p q := by
  simp only [fusedSlope,GeneralScaledQuotient.c,denominatorCoefficient,map_sub,
    num_evaluation,den_evaluation]
theorem fusedOffset_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (fusedOffset x p q)=fusedConstant (point x y) p q := by
  exact den_evaluation x y (p+q+2)
theorem scalePoly_evaluation (y : ℝ) :
    evaluator y scalePoly=GeneralScaledQuotient.scale y := by
  simp [scalePoly,evaluator,GeneralScaledQuotient.scale,mul_assoc]
theorem centerPoly_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    evaluator y (centerPoly x)=GeneralScaledQuotient.centerPolynomial x ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I) := by
  simp [centerPoly,evaluator,GeneralScaledQuotient.centerPolynomial]
theorem sourceCenter_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (sourceCenter x p q)=GeneralScaledQuotient.b x y p q := by
  unfold sourceCenter GeneralScaledQuotient.b
  rw [map_sub,map_mul,sourceSlope_evaluation,centerPoly_evaluation,map_mul,
    scalePoly_evaluation,sourceOffset_evaluation]
theorem fusedCenter_evaluation (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (fusedCenter x p q)=GeneralScaledQuotient.e x y p q := by
  unfold fusedCenter GeneralScaledQuotient.e
  rw [map_sub,map_mul,fusedSlope_evaluation,centerPoly_evaluation,map_mul,
    scalePoly_evaluation,fusedOffset_evaluation]

def accepts (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (as bs cs es : List ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (ofList as=sourceSlope x p q ∧ ofList bs=sourceCenter x p q ∧
    ofList cs=fusedSlope x p q ∧ ofList es=fusedCenter x p q)

/-- Closed coefficient checks produce the actual coefficients for every ordinate.
Combined with actual_norm_certificate, they refer to the actual Laplace matrices. -/
theorem accepts_sound (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (as bs cs es : List ℚ)
    (hc : accepts x p q as bs cs es=true) (y : ℝ) :
    evaluator y (ofList as)=GeneralScaledQuotient.a x y p q ∧
      evaluator y (ofList bs)=GeneralScaledQuotient.b x y p q ∧
      evaluator y (ofList cs)=GeneralScaledQuotient.c x y p q ∧
      evaluator y (ofList es)=GeneralScaledQuotient.e x y p q := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,he⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [ha,hb,hc,he]
  exact ⟨sourceSlope_evaluation x y p q,sourceCenter_evaluation x y p q,
    fusedSlope_evaluation x y p q,fusedCenter_evaluation x y p q⟩

#print axioms sourceOffset_evaluation
#print axioms fusedSlope_evaluation
#print axioms fusedOffset_evaluation
#print axioms scalePoly_evaluation
#print axioms centerPoly_evaluation
#print axioms sourceCenter_evaluation
#print axioms fusedCenter_evaluation
#print axioms accepts_sound
end

/-! A rotation of the degree-one Schur disk removes every reciprocal ordinate
from its four scaled coefficients, including at the actual mean shifts. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralScaledQuotient
open GeneralGraphQuotient CoreQuotient
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def scale (y : ℝ) : ℂ := (2*y : ℝ)*Complex.I
def centerPolynomial (x : ℝ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2*w*(x-1)+2*w^2-1
def parameter (x y : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) : ℂ := scale y*(ζ-center x y 1)
def a (x y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ := numeratorCoefficient (point x y) p q
def b (x y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  a x y p q*centerPolynomial x ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)-scale y*sourceConstant (point x y) p q
def c (x y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ := denominatorCoefficient (point x y) p q
def e (x y : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  c x y p q*centerPolynomial x ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)-scale y*fusedConstant (point x y) p q

theorem scale_ne_zero (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : scale y ≠ 0 := by
  exact mul_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)) Complex.I_ne_zero

theorem center_identity (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    centerPolynomial x ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)=scale y*center x y 1 := by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [centerPolynomial,scale,center,pow_two,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.re_ofNat,Complex.im_ofNat,Complex.one_re,Complex.one_im] <;>
    field_simp [hy.ne'] <;> ring

theorem parameter_norm (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hζ : ‖ζ-center x y 1‖ ≤ 1/(2*y)) : ‖parameter x y ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by
  have hp : 0 < 2*y := by positivity
  have hs : ‖scale y‖=2*y := by
    unfold scale
    rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hp]
  rw [parameter,norm_mul,hs]
  calc
    (2*y)*‖ζ-center x y 1‖ ≤ (2*y)*(1/(2*y)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hζ hp.le
    _ = 1 := by field_simp

theorem scaled_quotient (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (p q : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) :
    quotient (point x y) p q ζ=
      (a x y p q*parameter x y ζ+b x y p q)/
        (c x y p q*parameter x y ζ+e x y p q) := by
  have h (A B : ℂ) :
      A*parameter x y ζ+(A*centerPolynomial x ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)-scale y*B)=
        scale y*(A*ζ-B) := by
    rw [center_identity x y hy]
    unfold parameter
    ring
  unfold b e
  rw [h,h,mul_div_mul_left _ _ (scale_ne_zero y hy)]
  rfl

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Exact coefficient and separation checks imply the norm bound on the actual
Laplacian quotient of every degree-one core. -/
theorem actual_norm_certificate (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : C.degree u=1)
    (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (p q : ℕ) (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hE : 0 < Complex.normSq (e x y p q)-Complex.normSq (c x y p q))
    (hN : 0 < Complex.normSq (b x y p q)-Complex.normSq (a x y p q))
    (hL : L*((1+s)*‖b x y p q*star (e x y p q)-a x y p q*star (c x y p q)‖^2+
      (1+1/s)*‖a x y p q*e x y p q-b x y p q*c x y p q‖^2) ≤
        (Complex.normSq (b x y p q)-Complex.normSq (a x y p q))^2) :
    L ≤ ‖(shifted (point x y) (source C u p q)).det/
      (shifted (point x y) (fused C u p q)).det‖^2 := by
  have hζ := actual_disk C u x y hy
  rw [hd] at hζ
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one] at hζ
  rw [actual_quotient C u (point x y) (by simpa [point] using hy) p q,
    scaled_quotient x y hy p q]
  exact Bernstein.mobius_certificate _ _ _ _ _ hE hN
    (parameter_norm x y hy _ hζ) s L hs hL

#print axioms scale_ne_zero
#print axioms center_identity
#print axioms parameter_norm
#print axioms scaled_quotient
#print axioms actual_norm_certificate
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GeneralScaledQuotient

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanIsoEnergy
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFusionTerminal

/-!
# Conditional global assembly of the RG path minimum

This module composes the actual fusion and terminal results with three explicit
inputs: finite base cases, nonpath source presentations, and strict fusion above
an order cutoff. It uses the actual Laplacian energy from Spectral, transported
by IsoEnergy. The singleton case is proved directly.

The three inputs are hypotheses, not verified certificates or new axioms.
The target quantifiers and equality convention follow PR #7399, statement commit
3654bf2bddc5217f904b7b85207b1091e833de49.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GlobalAssembly

open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient RewireTopology FusionDescent TreeTerminal IsoEnergy
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency true
attribute [local irreducible] laplacianEnergy

/-- The minimum and equality conclusions on the original labelled vertex set. -/
def Conclusion {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) : Prop :=
  laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy G ∧
    (laplacianEnergy G = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ↔
      Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph n))

/-- Finite coverage below the cutoff; order one is handled without this input. -/
def SmallOrders (N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → n < N → ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), G.IsTree → Conclusion G

/-- The source is the given tree up to a specified graph isomorphism. -/
def DecomposesAbove (N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), G.IsTree →
    ¬Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph n) →
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
        1 ≤ C.degree u ∧ Nonempty (G ≃g source C u p q)

/-- Strict energy improvement for the actual source/fused pair above the cutoff. -/
def StrictFusionAbove (N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    N ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) →
    (source C u p q).IsTree → 1 ≤ C.degree u →
      laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q)

/-- Energy does not depend on the chosen adjacency decision procedure. -/
theorem energy_decidable_irrel {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (d₁ d₂ : DecidableRel G.Adj) :
    @laplacianEnergy V _ _ G d₁ = @laplacianEnergy V _ _ G d₂ := by
  exact congrArg (fun d => @laplacianEnergy V _ _ G d) (Subsingleton.elim d₁ d₂)

/-- Isomorphism invariance with either classical or concrete adjacency deciders. -/
theorem energy_iso {V W : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (f : G ≃g H) : laplacianEnergy G = laplacianEnergy H := by
  calc
    laplacianEnergy G = @laplacianEnergy V _ _ G
        (fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (G.Adj a b)) := energy_decidable_irrel G _ _
    _ = @laplacianEnergy W _ _ H
        (fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (H.Adj a b)) := IsoEnergy.energy_eq f
    _ = laplacianEnergy H := energy_decidable_irrel H _ _

theorem conclusion_of_iso {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (f : G ≃g pathGraph n) : Conclusion G := by
  have hE : laplacianEnergy G = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) := energy_iso f
  change laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy G ∧
    (laplacianEnergy G = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph n))
  exact ⟨hE.symm.le, ⟨fun _ => ⟨f⟩, fun _ => hE⟩⟩

theorem singleton_conclusion (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 1)) : Conclusion G := by
  have heq : G = pathGraph 1 := by
    ext u v
    have h : v = u := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst v
    simp
  have hiso : Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph 1) := by
    rw [heq]
    exact ⟨Iso.refl⟩
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := hiso
  exact conclusion_of_iso G f

/-- Relabel the actual fused graph back to Fin n, preserving energy and leaves. -/
theorem concrete_descent {N n : ℕ} (hD : DecomposesAbove N)
    (hF : StrictFusionAbove N) (hn : N ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hT : G.IsTree) (hpath : ¬Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph n)) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), H.IsTree ∧ leafCount H + 1 = leafCount G ∧
      laplacianEnergy H < laplacianEnergy G := by
  obtain ⟨m, C, u, p, q, hd, ⟨f⟩⟩ := hD n hn G hT hpath
  have hS : (source C u p q).IsTree := f.isTree_iff.mp hT
  have ht := fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hS hd
  have hnS : n = Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_congr f.toEquiv
  let W := Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)
  have hnW : n = Fintype.card W := hnS.trans ht.2.1
  let e : Fin n ≃ W := (finCongr hnW).trans (Fintype.equivFin W).symm
  let H := (fused C u p q).comap e
  let g : H ≃g fused C u p q := Iso.comap e (fused C u p q)
  refine ⟨H, g.isTree_iff.mpr ht.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hlG := leaf_count_iso f
    have hlH := leaf_count_iso g
    have hl := ht.2.2
    omega
  · calc
      laplacianEnergy H = laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) := energy_iso g
      _ < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) :=
        hF m C u p q (by rw [← hnS]; exact hn) hS hd
      _ = laplacianEnergy G := (energy_iso f).symm

/-- Leaf induction closes the minimum and its equality characterization together. -/
theorem conclusion_of_descent {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hstep : ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), G.IsTree →
      ¬Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph n) →
        ∃ H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), H.IsTree ∧ leafCount H + 1 = leafCount G ∧
          laplacianEnergy H < laplacianEnergy G)
    (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : G.IsTree) : Conclusion G := by
  let : Nontrivial (Fin n) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hn
  have main : ∀ k, ∀ T : SimpleGraph (Fin n), leafCount T = k → T.IsTree →
      Conclusion T := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro T hk hTree
      by_cases hleaf : leafCount T ≤ 2
      · have he := leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess T hTree
        have hl : leafCount T = 2 := by omega
        have hp := (tree_two_leaves_iff_path T hTree).mp hl
        rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hp
        obtain ⟨f⟩ := hp
        exact conclusion_of_iso T f
      · have hp : ¬Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph n) := by
          intro hiso
          have hleaf' := (tree_two_leaves_iff_path T hTree).mpr
            (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact hiso)
          omega
        obtain ⟨H, hHT, hL, hE⟩ := hstep T hTree hp
        have hlt : leafCount H < k := by omega
        have hIH := ih (leafCount H) hlt H rfl hHT
        have hstrict : laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) < laplacianEnergy T :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt hIH.1 hE
        refine ⟨hstrict.le, ?_⟩
        constructor
        · intro heq
          exact ((ne_of_gt hstrict) heq).elim
        · intro hiso
          exact (hp hiso).elim
  exact main (leafCount G) G rfl hT

/-- The global targets follow from three explicit remaining inputs. -/
theorem universal_conclusion (N : ℕ) (hsmall : SmallOrders N)
    (hD : DecomposesAbove N) (hF : StrictFusionAbove N)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : G.IsTree) : Conclusion G := by
  by_cases hn1 : n = 1
  · subst n
    exact singleton_conclusion G
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  by_cases hsmalln : n < N
  · exact hsmall n hn2 hsmalln G hT
  · apply conclusion_of_descent hn2 ?_ G hT
    intro T hTree hpath
    exact concrete_descent hD hF (by omega) T hTree hpath

theorem path_minimum_of_inputs (N : ℕ) (hsmall : SmallOrders N)
    (hD : DecomposesAbove N) (hF : StrictFusionAbove N)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : G.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy G :=
  (universal_conclusion N hsmall hD hF n hn G hT).1

theorem path_equality_of_inputs (N : ℕ) (hsmall : SmallOrders N)
    (hD : DecomposesAbove N) (hF : StrictFusionAbove N)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : G.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy G = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph n) :=
  (universal_conclusion N hsmall hD hF n hn G hT).2

#print axioms energy_decidable_irrel
#print axioms energy_iso
#print axioms conclusion_of_iso
#print axioms singleton_conclusion
#print axioms concrete_descent
#print axioms conclusion_of_descent
#print axioms universal_conclusion
#print axioms path_minimum_of_inputs
#print axioms path_equality_of_inputs

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GlobalAssembly

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Actual graph determinant integrals and the strict comparison from an integral
reserve. No uniform positive reserve is assumed implicitly or claimed here.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Sections 2.1--2.3.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanCoulson
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanCountTransport
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFusionQuotient

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.GraphIntegral

open Matrix Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

theorem complex_laplacian (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (G.lapMatrix ℝ).map Complex.ofRealHom = G.lapMatrix ℂ := by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> by_cases ha : G.Adj i j <;>
    simp [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
      hij, ha]

def graphLogarithm (G H : SimpleGraph V) (t y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log ‖(CoreQuotient.shifted ((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) G).det /
    (CoreQuotient.shifted ((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) H).det‖

theorem graphLogarithm_eq (G H : SimpleGraph V) (t : ℝ) :
    graphLogarithm G H t = Coulson.matrixLogarithm (G.lapMatrix ℝ) (H.lapMatrix ℝ) t := by
  funext y
  simp only [graphLogarithm, Coulson.matrixLogarithm, complex_laplacian, CoreQuotient.shifted]

theorem graph_integrable (G H : SimpleGraph V) (t : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (graphLogarithm G H t) (Ioi 0) := by
  rw [graphLogarithm_eq G H t]
  exact Coulson.matrix_integrable _ _ (G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ)
    (H.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ) t

theorem graph_stopLoss_integral (G H : SimpleGraph V) (he : G.edgeFinset.card = H.edgeFinset.card) (t : ℝ) :
    (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, graphLogarithm G H t y) =
      stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) t - stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) t := by
  rw [graphLogarithm_eq G H t]
  exact Coulson.matrix_stopLoss_integral _ _ (G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ)
    (H.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ) (by rw [laplacian_trace, laplacian_trace, he]) t

/-- The exact remaining analytic premise, separated from the count-gap theorem. -/
theorem strict_graphs_of_count_gap_and_reserve (T F : SimpleGraph V)
    (hT : T.IsTree) (hF : F.IsTree)
    (hc : ∀ t, |aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum T) t - aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum F) t| ≤ 1)
    (hreserve : 2 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) <
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, graphLogarithm T F 2 y)) :
    laplacianEnergy F < laplacianEnergy T := by
  have hn := hT.connected.nonempty
  have he : T.edgeFinset.card = F.edgeFinset.card := by
    have hs := hT.card_edgeFinset
    have hf := hF.card_edgeFinset
    omega
  rw [graph_stopLoss_integral T F he 2] at hreserve
  have ht := stopLoss_difference_lipschitz (laplacianSpectrum T) (laplacianSpectrum F) hc
    (2 - 2 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) 2
  have habs : |(2 - 2 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) - 2| =
      2 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by
    rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [habs, abs_le] at ht
  apply (strict_comparison_iff T F he).mpr
  rw [tree_meanDegree T hT]
  linarith [ht.1]

#print axioms graph_integrable
#print axioms graph_stopLoss_integral
#print axioms strict_graphs_of_count_gap_and_reserve

Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Graph-to-matrix bridge for the arbitrary-core determinant quotient.

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanCoreQuotient
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Sum
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Operations
import Aesop

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.CoreQuotient

open Matrix Finset
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.instLocallyFiniteSumSumOfDecidableEq

variable {V W X : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
  [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

/-- Graph union gives Laplacian addition when the edge sets are disjoint. -/
theorem lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint (G H : SimpleGraph V)
    (h : Disjoint G H) :
    (G ⊔ H).lapMatrix K = G.lapMatrix K + H.lapMatrix K := by
  have hd (v : V) : (G ⊔ H).degree v = G.degree v + H.degree v := by
    unfold SimpleGraph.degree
    rw [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_sup_of_disjoint v h, Finset.card_disjUnion]
  ext i j
  simp only [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix,
    Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hd]
  · have hnot : ¬(G.Adj i j ∧ H.Adj i j) := by
      intro hx
      exact SimpleGraph.disjoint_left.mp h i j hx.1 hx.2
    simp only [hij, if_false, zero_sub, SimpleGraph.sup_adj]
    by_cases hg : G.Adj i j <;> by_cases hh : H.Adj i j <;> simp_all

/-- A single edge contributes exactly its incidence-vector outer product. -/
theorem lapMatrix_edge (u w : V) (huw : u ≠ w) :
    (SimpleGraph.edge u w).lapMatrix K =
      Matrix.vecMulVec (incidence u w) (incidence u w) := by
  have hnu : (SimpleGraph.edge u w).neighborFinset u = {w} := by
    ext x
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.edge_adj,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    aesop
  have hnw : (SimpleGraph.edge u w).neighborFinset w = {u} := by
    ext x
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.edge_adj,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    aesop
  have hno (x : V) (hxu : x ≠ u) (hxw : x ≠ w) :
      (SimpleGraph.edge u w).neighborFinset x = ∅ := by
    ext y
    simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.edge_adj, hxu, hxw]
  have hd (x : V) : (SimpleGraph.edge u w).degree x =
      if x = u ∨ x = w then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hxu : x = u
    · subst x
      simp only [SimpleGraph.degree, hnu, Finset.card_singleton, true_or, ite_true]
    · by_cases hxw : x = w
      · subst x
        simp only [SimpleGraph.degree, hnw, Finset.card_singleton, or_true, ite_true]
      · simp only [SimpleGraph.degree, hno x hxu hxw, Finset.card_empty,
          hxu, hxw, or_self, ite_false]
  ext i j
  simp only [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    incidence]
  rw [hd i]
  clear hd hnu hnw hno
  by_cases hiu : i = u <;> by_cases hiw : i = w <;>
    by_cases hju : j = u <;> by_cases hjw : j = w <;>
      simp_all [SimpleGraph.edge_adj] <;> aesop


theorem lapMatrix_sum (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    (G ⊕g H).lapMatrix K = fromBlocks (G.lapMatrix K) 0 0 (H.lapMatrix K) := by
  have hdl (i : V) : (G ⊕g H).degree (.inl i) = G.degree i := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : V ⊕ W, if (G ⊕g H).Adj (.inl i) j then 1 else 0 := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_id] using (G ⊕g H).degree_eq_sum_if_adj (R := ℕ) (.inl i)
      _ = ∑ j : V, if G.Adj i j then 1 else 0 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
        simp
      _ = _ := by simpa only [Nat.cast_id] using (G.degree_eq_sum_if_adj (R := ℕ) i).symm
  have hdr (i : W) : (G ⊕g H).degree (.inr i) = H.degree i := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : V ⊕ W, if (G ⊕g H).Adj (.inr i) j then 1 else 0 := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_id] using (G ⊕g H).degree_eq_sum_if_adj (R := ℕ) (.inr i)
      _ = ∑ j : W, if H.Adj i j then 1 else 0 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
        simp
      _ = _ := by simpa only [Nat.cast_id] using (H.degree_eq_sum_if_adj (R := ℕ) i).symm
  ext (i | i) (j | j) <;>
    simp only [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.diagonal_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
      Sum.inl.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl_ne_inr, Sum.inr_ne_inl,
      hdl, hdr, if_false, Matrix.zero_apply] <;> simp [SimpleGraph.sum]

def shifted (z : K) (G : SimpleGraph V) : Matrix V V K :=
  z • 1 - G.lapMatrix K

theorem shifted_sum (z : K) (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    shifted z (G ⊕g H) = fromBlocks (shifted z G) 0 0 (shifted z H) := by
  rw [shifted, lapMatrix_sum]
  ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> simp [shifted, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.one_apply]

/-- Add one root edge between two otherwise disjoint graphs. -/
def join (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (u : V) (v : W) :
    SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W) :=
  (G ⊕g H) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr v)

theorem shifted_join (z : K) (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)
    (u : V) (v : W) :
    shifted z (join G H u v) = fromBlocks (shifted z G) 0 0 (shifted z H) -
      vecMulVec (incidence (.inl u) (.inr v)) (incidence (.inl u) (.inr v)) := by
  have hd : Disjoint (G ⊕g H) (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr v)) := by
    apply (SimpleGraph.disjoint_edge _).mpr
    simp [SimpleGraph.sum]
  have hl : ((G ⊕g H) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr v)).lapMatrix K =
      (G ⊕g H).lapMatrix K + (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr v)).lapMatrix K := by
    convert lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint (K := K) _ _ hd using 1 <;> congr 3
  calc
    _ = z • (1 : Matrix (V ⊕ W) (V ⊕ W) K) -
        ((G ⊕g H).lapMatrix K + (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr v)).lapMatrix K) := by
      unfold join shifted
      convert congrArg (fun A : Matrix (V ⊕ W) (V ⊕ W) K => z • 1 - A) hl using 1; congr 3
    _ = _ := by
      rw [lapMatrix_edge (K := K) _ _ (by simp), ← sub_sub, ← shifted, shifted_sum]

def joinTwo (G : SimpleGraph V) (P : SimpleGraph W) (Q : SimpleGraph X)
    (u : V) (v : W) (w : X) : SimpleGraph (V ⊕ W ⊕ X) :=
  ((G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))) ⊔
    SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inr w))

theorem shifted_joinTwo (z : K) (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (P : SimpleGraph W) (Q : SimpleGraph X) (u : V) (v : W) (w : X) :
    shifted z (joinTwo G P Q u v w) =
      forestMatrix (shifted z G) (shifted z P) (shifted z Q) -
      vecMulVec (incidence (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v)))
        (incidence (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))) -
      vecMulVec (incidence (.inl u) (.inr (.inr w)))
        (incidence (.inl u) (.inr (.inr w))) := by
  have hd : Disjoint (G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q))
      (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))) := by
    apply (SimpleGraph.disjoint_edge _).mpr
    simp [SimpleGraph.sum]
  have he : Disjoint ((G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q)) ⊔
      SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v)))
      (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inr w))) := by
    apply (SimpleGraph.disjoint_edge _).mpr
    simp [SimpleGraph.sum, SimpleGraph.edge_adj]
  have hl : (((G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))) ⊔
      SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inr w))).lapMatrix K =
      ((G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))).lapMatrix K +
      (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inr w))).lapMatrix K := by
    convert lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint (K := K) _ _ he using 1 <;> congr 3
  have hm : ((G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q)) ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))).lapMatrix K =
      (G ⊕g (P ⊕g Q)).lapMatrix K +
      (SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl v))).lapMatrix K := by
    convert lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint (K := K) _ _ hd using 1 <;> congr 3
  unfold joinTwo shifted
  rw [hl, hm,
    lapMatrix_edge (K := K) _ _ (by simp), lapMatrix_edge (K := K) _ _ (by simp)]
  rw [← sub_sub, ← sub_sub, ← shifted, shifted_sum, shifted_sum]
  rfl

#print axioms shifted_join
#print axioms shifted_joinTwo

attribute [instance] SimpleGraph.instLocallyFiniteSumSumOfDecidableEq

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.CoreQuotient

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanHornerCertificates
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalComplexPolynomial

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.HornerArithmetic
open HornerCertificates

def mul : Poly → Poly → Poly
  | [], _ => []
  | c :: p, q => add (scale c q) (0 :: mul p q)

def floorMargin (p : Poly) (c : ℚ) : Poly := add p [-c]

def normMargin (s L U V J : Poly) : Poly :=
  add (mul s J) (scale (-1) (mul L
    (add (mul (add s (mul s s)) U) (mul (add s [1]) V))))

noncomputable section

theorem evaluate_mul (p q : Poly) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (mul p q) x = evaluate p x * evaluate q x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [mul]
  | cons c p ih =>
      simp only [mul,evaluate_add,evaluate_scale,evaluate_cons,ih,Rat.cast_zero]
      ring

theorem evaluate_floorMargin (p : Poly) (c : ℚ) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (floorMargin p c) x = evaluate p x-(c : ℝ) := by
  simp [floorMargin,evaluate_add,sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem evaluate_normMargin (s L U V J : Poly) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (normMargin s L U V J) x = evaluate s x*evaluate J x-
      evaluate L x*((evaluate s x+(evaluate s x)^2)*evaluate U x+
        (evaluate s x+1)*evaluate V x) := by
  simp only [normMargin,evaluate_add,evaluate_scale,evaluate_mul,evaluate_cons,
    evaluate_nil,Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_one,mul_zero,add_zero]
  ring

theorem real_evaluation (p : Poly) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate p x = RationalComplexPolynomial.realEvaluator x (PolynomialPathMap.ofList p) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [PolynomialPathMap.ofList]
  | cons c p ih =>
      simp only [evaluate_cons,PolynomialPathMap.ofList,map_add,map_mul,
        RationalComplexPolynomial.real_C,RationalComplexPolynomial.real_X,ih]

#print axioms evaluate_mul
#print axioms evaluate_floorMargin
#print axioms evaluate_normMargin
#print axioms real_evaluation
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.HornerArithmetic

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Compact exact univariate certificates. Affine identities are certified by
rational evaluations and a proved degree bound, not by numerical sampling.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanCheckedRoots
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalTensorFast

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.HornerCertificates
open Polynomial Set
abbrev Poly := List ℚ

noncomputable def evaluate (p : Poly) (x : ℝ) : ℝ := (CheckedRoots.polynomial p).eval x

@[simp] theorem evaluate_nil (x : ℝ) : evaluate [] x = 0 := by simp [evaluate, CheckedRoots.polynomial]
@[simp] theorem evaluate_cons (c : ℚ) (p : Poly) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (c :: p) x = (c : ℝ) + x * evaluate p x := by
  simp [evaluate, CheckedRoots.polynomial]

def add : Poly → Poly → Poly
  | [], q => q
  | p, [] => p
  | c :: p, d :: q => (c + d) :: add p q

def scale (c : ℚ) (p : Poly) : Poly := p.map (fun a => c * a)

theorem evaluate_add (p q : Poly) (x : ℝ) : evaluate (add p q) x = evaluate p x + evaluate q x := by
  induction p generalizing q with
  | nil => simp [add]
  | cons c p ih =>
    cases q with
    | nil => simp [add]
    | cons d q => simp only [add, evaluate_cons, Rat.cast_add, ih]; ring

theorem evaluate_scale (c : ℚ) (p : Poly) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (scale c p) x = (c : ℝ) * evaluate p x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [scale]
  | cons d p ih => simp only [scale, List.map_cons, evaluate_cons, Rat.cast_mul] at *; rw [ih]; ring

def margin (u v j : Poly) (L s : ℚ) : Poly :=
  add j (scale (-L) (add (scale (1 + s) u) (scale (1 + 1 / s) v)))

theorem evaluate_margin (u v j : Poly) (L s : ℚ) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (margin u v j L s) x = evaluate j x -
      (L : ℝ) * ((1 + (s : ℝ)) * evaluate u x + (1 + 1 / (s : ℝ)) * evaluate v x) := by
  simp only [margin, evaluate_add, evaluate_scale, Rat.cast_neg, Rat.cast_add,
    Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_div]
  ring

def tensorFrom : ℕ → Poly → RationalTensorPolynomial.Poly 1
  | _, [] => []
  | n, c :: p => (c, fun _ => n) :: tensorFrom (n + 1) p

theorem tensorFrom_evaluate (p : Poly) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    RationalTensorPolynomial.evaluate (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) (tensorFrom n p) =
      x ^ n * evaluate p x := by
  induction p generalizing n with
  | nil => simp [tensorFrom, RationalTensorPolynomial.evaluate]
  | cons c p ih =>
    simp only [tensorFrom, RationalTensorPolynomial.evaluate, RationalTensorPolynomial.monomial,
      Fin.prod_univ_one, evaluate_cons, ih, pow_succ]
    ring

def accepts (M : ℕ) (p : Poly) : Bool :=
  RationalTensorPolynomial.acceptsFast (fun _ : Fin 1 => M) (tensorFrom 0 p)

theorem accepts_sound (M : ℕ) (p : Poly) (h : accepts M p = true)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ evaluate p x := by
  have hp := RationalTensorPolynomial.acceptsFast_sound (fun _ : Fin 1 => M)
    (tensorFrom 0 p) h (fun _ => x) (fun _ => hx)
  simpa only [tensorFrom_evaluate, pow_zero, one_mul] using hp

/-- M+1 exact rational evaluations establish an affine polynomial identity. -/
def affineCheck (M : ℕ) (p a : Poly) (l w : ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (p.length ≤ M + 1 ∧ a.length ≤ M + 1 ∧
    ∀ k : Fin (M + 1), CheckedRoots.eval a k.val =
      CheckedRoots.eval p (l + w * k.val))

theorem affineCheck_sound (M : ℕ) (p a : Poly) (l w : ℚ)
    (hc : affineCheck M p a l w = true) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate a x = evaluate p ((l : ℝ) + w * x) := by
  obtain ⟨hp, ha, hs⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  let linear : ℝ[X] := C (l : ℝ) + C (w : ℝ) * X
  have hP : (CheckedRoots.polynomial p).natDegree ≤ M := by
    have := CheckedRoots.degree_bound p
    omega
  have hA : (CheckedRoots.polynomial a).natDegree ≤ M := by
    have := CheckedRoots.degree_bound a
    omega
  have hlin : linear.natDegree ≤ 1 := by dsimp [linear]; compute_degree
  have hcomp : ((CheckedRoots.polynomial p).comp linear).natDegree ≤ M := by
    have h := Polynomial.natDegree_comp_le (p := CheckedRoots.polynomial p) (q := linear)
    exact h.trans (by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul hP hlin)
  have he : CheckedRoots.polynomial a = (CheckedRoots.polynomial p).comp linear := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq _ _
      (f := fun k : Fin (M + 1) => (k.val : ℝ))
    · intro i j h
      apply Fin.ext
      change (i.val : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    · intro k
      have h := congrArg (fun z : ℚ => (z : ℝ)) (hs k)
      rw [CheckedRoots.eval_cast, CheckedRoots.eval_cast] at h
      simpa [linear, Polynomial.eval_comp] using h
    · simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
      omega
  change (CheckedRoots.polynomial a).eval x = _
  rw [he, Polynomial.eval_comp]
  simp only [linear, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, evaluate]

theorem evaluate_append (p q : Poly) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (p ++ q) x = evaluate p x + x ^ p.length * evaluate q x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c p ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, evaluate_cons, List.length_cons, pow_succ, ih]
    ring

theorem reverse_scaled (p : Poly) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x ^ p.length * evaluate p.reverse (1 / x) = x * evaluate p x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c p ih =>
    rw [List.reverse_cons, evaluate_append]
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_reverse, evaluate_cons, evaluate_nil,
      mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [pow_succ]
    have he : x ^ p.length * (1 / x) ^ p.length = (1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← mul_pow]
      simp [hx]
    calc
      x ^ p.length * x * (evaluate p.reverse (1 / x) + (1 / x) ^ p.length * c) =
          x * (x ^ p.length * evaluate p.reverse (1 / x)) +
            x * (x ^ p.length * (1 / x) ^ p.length) * c := by ring
      _ = x * (x * evaluate p x) + x * c := by rw [ih, he]; ring
      _ = x * ((c : ℝ) + x * evaluate p x) := by ring

def specialize (p : List Poly) (d : ℚ) : Poly := p.map (fun c => CheckedRoots.eval c d)

noncomputable def nestedEvaluate : List Poly → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | c :: p, d, x => evaluate c d + x * nestedEvaluate p d x

theorem specialize_sound (p : List Poly) (d : ℚ) (x : ℝ) :
    evaluate (specialize p d) x = nestedEvaluate p (d : ℝ) x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [specialize, nestedEvaluate]
  | cons c p ih =>
    simp only [specialize, List.map_cons, evaluate_cons, nestedEvaluate] at *
    rw [CheckedRoots.eval_cast]
    change evaluate c (d : ℝ) + x * _ = _
    rw [ih]

theorem cell_sound (M : ℕ) (u v j a : Poly) (L s l w : ℚ)
    (ha : affineCheck M (margin u v j L s) a l w = true)
    (hb : accepts M a = true) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ evaluate j ((l : ℝ) + w * t) - (L : ℝ) *
      ((1 + (s : ℝ)) * evaluate u ((l : ℝ) + w * t) +
        (1 + 1 / (s : ℝ)) * evaluate v ((l : ℝ) + w * t)) := by
  have h := accepts_sound M a hb t ht
  rw [affineCheck_sound M _ _ _ _ ha, evaluate_margin] at h
  exact h

theorem reverse_margin_sound (u v j : Poly) (n : ℕ)
    (hu : u.length = n) (hv : v.length = n) (hj : j.length = n)
    (L s y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y)
    (h : 0 ≤ evaluate j.reverse (1 / y) - L *
      ((1 + s) * evaluate u.reverse (1 / y) + (1 + 1 / s) * evaluate v.reverse (1 / y))) :
    0 ≤ evaluate j y - L * ((1 + s) * evaluate u y + (1 + 1 / s) * evaluate v y) := by
  have hU := reverse_scaled u y hy.ne'
  have hV := reverse_scaled v y hy.ne'
  have hJ := reverse_scaled j y hy.ne'
  rw [hu] at hU
  rw [hv] at hV
  rw [hj] at hJ
  have hm := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hy.le n) h
  have he : y ^ n * (evaluate j.reverse (1 / y) - L *
      ((1 + s) * evaluate u.reverse (1 / y) + (1 + 1 / s) * evaluate v.reverse (1 / y))) =
      y * (evaluate j y - L * ((1 + s) * evaluate u y + (1 + 1 / s) * evaluate v y)) := by
    calc
      _ = y ^ n * evaluate j.reverse (1 / y) - L *
          ((1 + s) * (y ^ n * evaluate u.reverse (1 / y)) +
            (1 + 1 / s) * (y ^ n * evaluate v.reverse (1 / y))) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hU, hV, hJ]; ring
  rw [he] at hm
  by_contra hn
  have hn' := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hy (lt_of_not_ge hn)
  linarith

#print axioms specialize_sound
#print axioms cell_sound
#print axioms reverse_margin_sound
#print axioms evaluate_add
#print axioms evaluate_scale
#print axioms evaluate_margin
#print axioms tensorFrom_evaluate
#print axioms accepts_sound
#print axioms affineCheck_sound
#print axioms evaluate_append
#print axioms reverse_scaled
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.HornerCertificates

theorem checked (raw b a : NestedInteger.Poly 3) (l w D : Fin 3 → ℤ)

    (ha : a=NestedInteger.clearedOuter (l 0) (w 0) (D 0) b) :

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanComputedClassCell
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedPositiveScale
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedIntegerAffine

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerComputedClassCell
open NestedArithmetic
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def integerize : (n : ℕ) → ℚ → NestedHorner.Poly n → NestedInteger.Poly n
  | 0,K,p => (K*p).num
  | n+1,K,p => p.map (integerize n K)

def pad : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → NestedInteger.Poly n → NestedInteger.Poly n
  | 0,_,p => p
  | n+1,d,p => List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (d 0+1) =>
      pad n (fun j => d j.succ) (p.getD i.val (NestedInteger.zero n)))

def denominator (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (i : Fin 3) : ℤ := (l i).den*(w i).den
def leftNumerator (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (i : Fin 3) : ℤ := (l i).num*(w i).den
def widthNumerator (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (i : Fin 3) : ℤ := (w i).num*(l i).den
def baseScale (s L : ℚ) : ℚ := ((L*(1+s)).den : ℚ)*((L*(1+1/s)).den : ℚ)

def integerAffine (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : NestedInteger.Poly 3 :=
  let p := compile (ComputedClassCell.polynomial d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L)
  let raw := pad 3 deg (integerize 3 (baseScale s L) p)
  NestedInteger.clearedAll 3 raw (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w)

def totalScale (s L : ℚ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  baseScale s L*(NestedInteger.factor 3 deg (denominator l w) : ℚ)

def make (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : FastNestedCellData.Cell :=
  let p := compile (ComputedClassCell.polynomial d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L)
  let a := integerAffine d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L deg l w
  { reciprocal := reciprocal
    young := s
    squareLower := L
    payment := R
    logarithmK := k
    logarithmN := n
    poly := p
    affine := NestedHorner.scale (1/totalScale s L deg l w) (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 a)
    degrees := deg
    left := l
    width := w }

/-- Integer signs imply the original rational certificate; exact affine equality
still checks every reconstruction and denominator against the actual program. -/
theorem accepts_make (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hK : 0 < totalScale s L deg l w) (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (ha : NestedAffine.check 3 (compile (ComputedClassCell.polynomial d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L))
      (NestedHorner.scale (1/totalScale s L deg l w)
        (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (integerAffine d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L deg l w))) l w=true)
    (hb : NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck 3 deg (integerAffine d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L deg l w)=true)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂ (make d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L R k n deg l w)=true := by
  apply decide_eq_true
  refine ⟨hs,hw,?_,ha,?_,hl⟩
  · unfold NestedArithmetic.accepts
    exact decide_eq_true rfl
  · exact NestedPositiveScale.positiveCheck_scale 3 deg _ (1/totalScale s L deg l w)
      (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hK.le) (NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck_to_rational 3 deg _ hb)

#print axioms accepts_make
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerComputedClassCell

syntax (name := rgIntegerDataLiteral) "rg_integer_data% " term : term

/-- This untrusted computation returns integer data only. Every use below still
requires a kernel-checked equality to the defining arithmetic expression and
kernel-checked Bernstein signs. No proposition is evaluated to produce a proof. -/
@[term_elab rgIntegerDataLiteral]
unsafe def elabRGIntegerDataLiteral : Lean.Elab.Term.TermElab := fun stx _ => do
  let `(rg_integer_data% $t) := stx | Lean.Elab.throwUnsupportedSyntax
  let ty ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabType (← `(List (List (List Int))))
  let e ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTermEnsuringType t ty
  Lean.Elab.Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
  let e ← Lean.instantiateMVars e
  if e.hasMVar then
    throwError "Integer certificate data must be closed"
  let value ← Lean.Meta.evalExpr (List (List (List Int))) ty e
  return Lean.toExpr value

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerDataElaboration

/-- A prepared literal has no mathematical force without this exact equality. -/
theorem checked_identity (computed literal : NestedInteger.Poly 3)
    (h : computed=literal) : literal=computed := h.symm

#print axioms checked_identity
#print axioms IntegerLiteral.accepts_materialized

/-- Materialize only integer data. The separate equality and sign proofs are
checked by the kernel; this elaborator returns no proof or logical assumption. -/
elab "rg_integer_tensor% " t:term : term => do
  let e ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm t none
  let e ← Lean.instantiateMVars e
  Lean.Meta.withTransparency .all (Lean.Meta.reduce e)

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerLiteral

theorem accepts_materialized {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (a : NestedInteger.Poly 3)
    (ha : PackedIntegerClassCell.integerAffine p reciprocal s L deg l w=a)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hr : PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.rawCheck (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L)
      (IntegerComputedClassCell.baseScale s L) deg=true)
    (hb : NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck 3 deg a=true)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂
      (PackedIntegerClassCell.make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w)=true := by
  apply PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.accepts_make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w hs hw hr _ hl
  rw [ha]
  exact hb

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanLiteralIntegerCell

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerNormProgramPack
open NestedHorner
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

structure Pack {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂) where
  u : NestedInteger.Poly 3
  v : NestedInteger.Poly 3
  j : NestedInteger.Poly 3
  ui : NestedInteger.Poly 3
  vi : NestedInteger.Poly 3
  ji : NestedInteger.Poly 3
  hu : NestedInteger.castPoly 3 u=p.u
  hv : NestedInteger.castPoly 3 v=p.v
  hj : NestedInteger.castPoly 3 j=p.j
  hui : NestedInteger.castPoly 3 ui=p.ui
  hvi : NestedInteger.castPoly 3 vi=p.vi
  hji : NestedInteger.castPoly 3 ji=p.ji

def shiftY (k : ℕ) (p : NestedInteger.Poly 3) : NestedInteger.Poly 3 :=
  List.replicate k (NestedInteger.zero 2) ++ p

def zeroCheck : (n : ℕ) → NestedInteger.Poly n → Bool
  | 0,p => decide (p=0)
  | n+1,p => p.all (zeroCheck n)

def polynomial {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} {p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂}
    (q : Pack p) (reciprocal : Bool) (K A B : ℤ) : NestedInteger.Poly 3 :=
  if reciprocal=true then
    let duv := max p.du p.dv
    let D := max p.dj duv
    NestedInteger.add (shiftY (D-p.dj) (NestedInteger.scale K q.ji))
      (shiftY (D-duv) (NestedInteger.add
        (shiftY (duv-p.du) (NestedInteger.scale (-A) q.ui))
        (shiftY (duv-p.dv) (NestedInteger.scale (-B) q.vi))))
  else NestedInteger.add (NestedInteger.scale K q.j)
    (NestedInteger.add (NestedInteger.scale (-A) q.u) (NestedInteger.scale (-B) q.v))

def rawCheck {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} {p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂}
    (q : Pack p) (reciprocal : Bool) (K A B : ℤ) (raw : NestedInteger.Poly 3) : Bool :=
  zeroCheck 3 (NestedInteger.add raw (NestedInteger.scale (-1) (polynomial q reciprocal K A B)))

noncomputable section
theorem eval_shiftY (k : ℕ) (p : NestedInteger.Poly 3) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (shiftY k p)) x=
      x 0^k*eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 p) x := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [shiftY]
  | succ k ih =>
    change eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 2 (NestedInteger.zero 2)::
      NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (shiftY k p)) x=_
    rw [eval_cons,NestedInteger.cast_zero,eval_zero,zero_add,ih,pow_succ]
    ring

theorem zeroCheck_sound (n : ℕ) (p : NestedInteger.Poly n)
    (h : zeroCheck n p=true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : eval (NestedInteger.castPoly n p) x=0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hp : p=0 := of_decide_eq_true h
    subst p
    norm_num [NestedInteger.castPoly,eval]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons c p hp =>
      have hh : zeroCheck n c=true ∧ zeroCheck (n+1) p=true := by
        simpa only [zeroCheck,List.all_cons,Bool.and_eq_true] using h
      change eval (NestedInteger.castPoly n c::NestedInteger.castPoly (n+1) p) x=0
      rw [eval_cons,ih c hh.1,hp hh.2]
      ring

theorem eval_polynomial {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} {p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂}
    (q : Pack p) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ) (K A B : ℤ)
    (hA : (A : ℚ)=(K : ℚ)*(L*(1+s)))
    (hB : (B : ℚ)=(K : ℚ)*(L*(1+1/s))) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (polynomial q reciprocal K A B)) x=
      (K : ℝ)*eval (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L) x := by
  have hAr : (A : ℝ)=(K : ℝ)*((L : ℝ)*(1+(s : ℝ))) := by exact_mod_cast hA
  have hBr : (B : ℝ)=(K : ℝ)*((L : ℝ)*(1+1/(s : ℝ))) := by exact_mod_cast hB
  by_cases hr : reciprocal=true
  · simp only [polynomial,NormProgramPack.polynomial,if_pos hr,
      NestedInteger.cast_add,eval_add,eval_shiftY,NestedInteger.cast_scale,eval_scale,
      q.hui,q.hvi,q.hji,NestedArithmetic.eval_mul,NestedArithmetic.eval_power,
      NestedArithmetic.eval_coordinate]
    push_cast
    rw [hAr,hBr]
    ring
  · simp only [polynomial,NormProgramPack.polynomial,if_neg hr,
      NestedInteger.cast_add,eval_add,NestedInteger.cast_scale,eval_scale,q.hu,q.hv,q.hj]
    push_cast
    rw [hAr,hBr]
    ring

/-- The rational source identity follows from a pure integer coefficient check
and three scalar equalities. No rational scalar is recomputed per coefficient. -/
theorem raw_checked {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} {p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂}
    (q : Pack p) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ) (K A B : ℤ) (raw : NestedInteger.Poly 3)
    (hK : (K : ℚ)=IntegerComputedClassCell.baseScale s L)
    (hA : (A : ℚ)=(K : ℚ)*(L*(1+s)))
    (hB : (B : ℚ)=(K : ℚ)*(L*(1+1/s)))
    (hr : rawCheck q reciprocal K A B raw=true) :
    LiteralIntegerCell.rawCheck (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L)
      (IntegerComputedClassCell.baseScale s L) raw=true := by
  apply NestedAffine.zeroCheck_complete
  intro x
  have hh := zeroCheck_sound 3 _ hr x
  rw [NestedInteger.cast_add,eval_add,NestedInteger.cast_scale,eval_scale,
    eval_polynomial q reciprocal s L K A B hA hB] at hh
  change eval (NestedHorner.add (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 raw)
    (NestedHorner.scale (-IntegerComputedClassCell.baseScale s L)
      (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L))) x=0
  rw [eval_add,eval_scale,← hK]
  push_cast at hh ⊢
  linarith only [hh]

theorem accepts_make {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} {p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂}
    (q : Pack p) (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (K A B : ℤ) (raw a : NestedInteger.Poly 3)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hK : (K : ℚ)=IntegerComputedClassCell.baseScale s L)
    (hA : (A : ℚ)=(K : ℚ)*(L*(1+s)))
    (hB : (B : ℚ)=(K : ℚ)*(L*(1+1/s)))
    (hr : rawCheck q reciprocal K A B raw=true)
    (hrect : NestedInteger.rectangular 3 deg raw=true)
    (ha : a=NestedInteger.clearedAll 3 raw
      (IntegerComputedClassCell.leftNumerator l w) (IntegerComputedClassCell.widthNumerator l w)
      (IntegerComputedClassCell.denominator l w))
    (hb : NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck 3 deg a=true)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂ (LiteralIntegerCell.make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w a)=true :=
  LiteralIntegerCell.accepts_make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w raw a hs hw
    (raw_checked q reciprocal s L K A B raw hK hA hB hr) hrect ha hb hl

#print axioms eval_polynomial
#print axioms raw_checked
#print axioms accepts_make
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerNormProgramPack

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanIntegerAffineStages

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerOuterTerms
open NestedInteger NestedHorner Finset
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- The finite binomial expansion of a single shifted monomial. -/
def term {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (l w K : ℤ) (c : NestedInteger.Poly n) :
    NestedInteger.Poly (n+1) :=
  List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (k+1) => NestedInteger.scale
    (K*(Nat.fast_choose k j.val : ℤ)*l^(k-j.val)*w^j.val) c)

/-- Each coefficient contributes once. In particular, the recursively prepared
tail is not duplicated by the two arms of a Horner substitution. -/
def transform {n : ℕ} (l w D : ℤ) : ℕ → NestedInteger.Poly (n+1) → NestedInteger.Poly (n+1)
  | _,[] => []
  | k,c::p => NestedInteger.add (term k l w (D^p.length) c) (transform l w D (k+1) p)

noncomputable section
theorem eval_ofFn {n : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (f : Fin N → NestedInteger.Poly n)
    (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    eval (castPoly (n+1) (List.ofFn f)) x=
      ∑ j : Fin N, eval (castPoly n (f j)) (fun i => x i.succ)*x 0^j.val := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [List.ofFn_zero,castPoly,eval]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ]
    change eval (castPoly n (f 0)::castPoly (n+1) (List.ofFn (fun j => f j.succ))) x=_
    rw [eval_cons,ih,Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_succ,pow_zero,mul_one]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring

theorem eval_term {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (l w K : ℤ) (c : NestedInteger.Poly n)
    (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    eval (castPoly (n+1) (term k l w K c)) x=
      (K : ℝ)*((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)^k*eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ) := by
  rw [term,eval_ofFn,add_comm (l : ℝ),add_pow]
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun j : ℕ => ((w : ℝ)*x 0)^j*(l : ℝ)^(k-j)*(k.choose j : ℝ)) (k+1)]
  simp only [cast_scale,eval_scale,← Nat.choose_eq_fast_choose]
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [mul_pow]
  ring

theorem eval_from {n : ℕ} (l w D : ℤ) (hD : D ≠ 0) (k : ℕ)
    (p : NestedInteger.Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    (D : ℝ)*eval (castPoly (n+1) (transform l w D k p)) x=
      ((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)^k*(D : ℝ)^p.length*
        eval (castPoly (n+1) p)
          (Fin.cons (((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)/(D : ℝ)) (fun i => x i.succ)) := by
  have hDr : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD
  induction p generalizing k with
  | nil => simp [transform,castPoly,eval]
  | cons c p ih =>
    rw [transform,cast_add,eval_add,eval_term,mul_add,ih]
    change _=_*(_ : ℝ)^(p.length+1)*
      (eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ)+
        (((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)/(D : ℝ))*
          eval (castPoly (n+1) p) (Fin.cons _ _))
    push_cast
    rw [pow_succ,pow_succ]
    field_simp

/-- The new finite coefficient transform has exactly the old substitution's
semantics. Its data is still checked by the Lean kernel at every concrete use. -/
theorem eval_eq_clearedOuter {n : ℕ} (l w D : ℤ) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (p : NestedInteger.Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    eval (castPoly (n+1) (transform l w D 0 p)) x=
      eval (castPoly (n+1) (NestedInteger.clearedOuter l w D p)) x := by
  have hDr : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hDr)
  rw [eval_from l w D hD,NestedInteger.clearedOuter_sound l w D p x hD]
  simp only [pow_zero,one_mul]

#print axioms eval_ofFn
#print axioms eval_term
#print axioms eval_from
#print axioms eval_eq_clearedOuter
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerOuterTerms
