import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanSemanticPolynomialPaymentCell
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanIntegerOuterTerms

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IntegerPolynomialPaymentCell
open Set
abbrev IP := NestedInteger.Poly 1
abbrev Witness := ComputedPolynomialCell.Witness
abbrev Data := ComputedGeneralPathData.Data
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

noncomputable def value (p : IP) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  NestedHorner.eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 p) (fun _ => t)

theorem value_cast (p : IP) (x : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    NestedHorner.eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 p) x=
      HornerCertificates.evaluate (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 p) (x 0) := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      change (0 : ℝ)=HornerCertificates.evaluate [] (x 0)
      exact (HornerCertificates.evaluate_nil (x 0)).symm
  | cons c p ih =>
      calc
        _ = ((c : ℚ) : ℝ)+x 0*NestedHorner.eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 p) x := rfl
        _ = ((c : ℚ) : ℝ)+x 0*HornerCertificates.evaluate (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 p) (x 0) := by rw [ih]
        _ = _ := (HornerCertificates.evaluate_cons (c : ℚ) (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 p) (x 0)).symm

theorem value_cons (c : ℤ) (p : IP) (t : ℝ) :
    value (c::p) t=(c : ℝ)+t*value p t := by
  change ((c : ℚ) : ℝ)+t*value p t=_
  push_cast
  rfl

theorem value_add (p q : IP) (t : ℝ) :
    value (NestedInteger.add p q) t=value p t+value q t := by
  exact (congrArg (fun z => NestedHorner.eval z (fun _ => t))
    (NestedInteger.cast_add p q)).trans (NestedHorner.eval_add _ _ _)

theorem value_scale (c : ℤ) (p : IP) (t : ℝ) :
    value (NestedInteger.scale c p) t=(c : ℝ)*value p t := by
  dsimp [value]
  rw [NestedInteger.cast_scale,NestedHorner.eval_scale]
  push_cast
  rfl

@[simp] theorem value_singleton (c : ℤ) (t : ℝ) : value [c] t=(c : ℝ) := by
  simp [value,NestedInteger.castPoly,NestedHorner.eval]

def times : IP → IP → IP
  | [],_ => []
  | c::p,q => NestedInteger.add (NestedInteger.scale c q) (0::times p q)

theorem value_times (p q : IP) (t : ℝ) : value (times p q) t=value p t*value q t := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [times,value,NestedInteger.castPoly,NestedHorner.eval]
  | cons c p ih =>
      rw [times,value_add,value_scale]
      rw [value_cons,value_cons,Int.cast_zero,zero_add,ih]
      ring

def zeroCheck (p : List ℚ) : Bool := p.all (fun c => decide (c=0))

theorem zero_sound (p : List ℚ) (h : zeroCheck p=true) (t : ℝ) :
    HornerCertificates.evaluate p t=0 := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact HornerCertificates.evaluate_nil t
  | cons c p ih =>
      have hh : decide (c=0)=true ∧ zeroCheck p=true := by
        simpa only [zeroCheck,List.all_cons,Bool.and_eq_true] using h
      rw [HornerCertificates.evaluate_cons,of_decide_eq_true hh.1,ih hh.2]
      simp

def bindingCheck (D : ℤ) (a : IP) (p : List ℚ) : Bool :=
  zeroCheck (HornerCertificates.add (NestedInteger.castPoly 1 a)
    (HornerCertificates.scale (-(D : ℚ)) p))

theorem binding_sound (D : ℤ) (a : IP) (p : List ℚ)
    (h : bindingCheck D a p=true) (t : ℝ) :
    value a t=(D : ℝ)*HornerCertificates.evaluate p t := by
  have hz := zero_sound _ h t
  rw [HornerCertificates.evaluate_add,HornerCertificates.evaluate_scale] at hz
  change NestedHorner.eval _ _=_
  rw [value_cast]
  push_cast at hz
  linarith only [hz]

def affine (p : IP) (A B T : ℤ) : IP :=
  NestedInteger.scale T (IntegerOuterTerms.transform A B T 0 p)

theorem affine_value (p : IP) (A B T : ℤ) (hT : T≠0) (t : ℝ) :
    value (affine p A B T) t=(T : ℝ)^p.length*
      value p (((A : ℝ)+(B : ℝ)*t)/(T : ℝ)) := by
  have h := IntegerOuterTerms.eval_from A B T hT 0 p (fun _ => t)
  change value (NestedInteger.scale T (IntegerOuterTerms.transform A B T 0 p)) t=_
  rw [value_scale]
  simp only [pow_zero,one_mul] at h
  rw [value_cast] at h
  rw [value_cast] at h
  simpa only [value,value_cast,Fin.cons_zero] using h

structure Source where
  den : ℤ
  length : ℕ
  poly : Fin 5 → IP

def sourceChecks (d : Data) (s : Source) : Bool :=
  decide (0<s.den ∧ ∀ i, (s.poly i).length=s.length ∧
    bindingCheck s.den (s.poly i) (ComputedPolynomialCell.source d i)=true)

structure Geometry where
  left : ℤ
  width : ℤ
  den : ℤ
  localDen : ℤ
  lowerC : ℤ
  s : IP
  L : IP
  transformed : Fin 5 → IP

def floorPoly (p : IP) (c : ℤ) : IP := NestedInteger.add p [-c]

theorem value_floor (p : IP) (c : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    value (floorPoly p c) t=value p t-(c : ℝ) := by
  rw [floorPoly,value_add]
  rw [value_singleton,Int.cast_neg]
  ring

def margin (g : Geometry) : IP :=
  NestedInteger.add (NestedInteger.scale (g.localDen^2) (times g.s (g.transformed 2)))
    (NestedInteger.scale (-1) (times g.L (times (NestedInteger.add g.s [g.localDen])
      (NestedInteger.add (times g.s (g.transformed 0))
        (NestedInteger.scale g.localDen (g.transformed 1))))))

def positive (p : IP) : Bool := NestedInteger.accepts 1 (fun _ => p.length) p

theorem positive_sound (p : IP) (h : positive p=true) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0≤value p t := NestedInteger.accepts_sound 1 _ p h (fun _ => t) (fun _ => ht)

def checks (s : Source) (w : Witness) (g : Geometry) : Bool :=
  decide (0<w.a ∧ w.a<w.b ∧ 0<w.c ∧ 0<g.den ∧ 0<g.localDen ∧
    (g.left : ℚ)/(g.den : ℚ)=w.a ∧ (g.width : ℚ)/(g.den : ℚ)=w.b-w.a ∧
    (g.lowerC : ℚ)=(g.localDen : ℚ)*w.c ∧
    bindingCheck g.localDen g.s w.s=true ∧ bindingCheck g.localDen g.L w.L=true ∧
    (∀ i, g.transformed i=affine (s.poly i) g.left g.width g.den) ∧
    positive (floorPoly g.s 1)=true ∧ positive (floorPoly g.L g.lowerC)=true ∧
    positive (floorPoly (g.transformed 3) 1)=true ∧
    positive (floorPoly (g.transformed 4) 1)=true ∧ positive (margin g)=true)

noncomputable section
theorem conditions (d : Data) (s : Source) (w : Witness) (g : Geometry)
    (hs : sourceChecks d s=true) (hc : checks s w g=true) :
    SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.Conditions d w := by
  obtain ⟨hD,hsrc⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hs
  obtain ⟨ha,hab,hc0,hT,hDS,hA,hB,hC,hS,hL,htrans,hsp,hlp,hnp,hep,hmp⟩ :=
    of_decide_eq_true hc
  refine ⟨ha,hab,hc0,?_⟩
  intro t ht
  let DS : ℝ := g.localDen
  let DG : ℝ := (g.den : ℝ)^s.length*(s.den : ℝ)
  have hDSr : 0<DS := by dsimp [DS]; exact_mod_cast hDS
  have hDGr : 0<DG := mul_pos (pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast hT) _) (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  have hAr : (g.left : ℝ)/(g.den : ℝ)=(w.a : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hA
  have hBr : (g.width : ℝ)/(g.den : ℝ)=((w.b-w.a : ℚ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hloc : ((g.left : ℝ)+(g.width : ℝ)*t)/(g.den : ℝ)=
      SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t := by
    calc
      _ = (g.left : ℝ)/(g.den : ℝ)+((g.width : ℝ)/(g.den : ℝ))*t := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hAr,hBr]; rfl
  have hv (i : Fin 5) : value (g.transformed i) t=
      DG*HornerCertificates.evaluate (ComputedPolynomialCell.source d i)
        (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t) := by
    rw [htrans i,affine_value _ _ _ _ hT.ne' t,(hsrc i).1,hloc,
      binding_sound _ _ _ (hsrc i).2]
    ring
  have hsv : value g.s t=DS*HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t := binding_sound _ _ _ hS t
  have hlv : value g.L t=DS*HornerCertificates.evaluate w.L t := binding_sound _ _ _ hL t
  have hCr : (g.lowerC : ℝ)=DS*(w.c : ℝ) := by dsimp [DS]; exact_mod_cast hC
  have hS0 := positive_sound _ hsp t ht
  have hL0 := positive_sound _ hlp t ht
  have hN0 := positive_sound _ hnp t ht
  have hE0 := positive_sound _ hep t ht
  rw [value_floor,Int.cast_one] at hS0 hN0 hE0
  rw [value_floor] at hL0
  rw [hsv] at hS0
  rw [hlv,hCr] at hL0
  rw [hv 3] at hN0
  rw [hv 4] at hE0
  have hsr : 0<HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t := by nlinarith only [hS0,hDSr]
  have hlr : (w.c : ℝ)≤HornerCertificates.evaluate w.L t := by nlinarith only [hL0,hDSr]
  have hnr : 0<HornerCertificates.evaluate d.N (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t) := by
    change 0≤DG*HornerCertificates.evaluate d.N _-1 at hN0
    nlinarith only [hN0,hDGr]
  have her : 0<HornerCertificates.evaluate d.E (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t) := by
    change 0≤DG*HornerCertificates.evaluate d.E _-1 at hE0
    nlinarith only [hE0,hDGr]
  refine ⟨hsr,hlr,hnr,her,?_⟩
  have hm := positive_sound _ hmp t ht
  simp only [margin,value_add,value_scale,value_times,
    Int.cast_neg,Int.cast_one,Int.cast_pow,hsv,hlv,hv] at hm
  rw [value_singleton] at hm
  change 0≤DS^2*(DS*HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t*
    (DG*HornerCertificates.evaluate d.J (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t)))+
    -1*(DS*HornerCertificates.evaluate w.L t*((DS*HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t+DS)*
      (DS*HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t*
        (DG*HornerCertificates.evaluate d.U (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t))+
        DS*(DG*HornerCertificates.evaluate d.V (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t))))) at hm
  have hm' : 0≤DS^3*DG*(HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t*
      HornerCertificates.evaluate d.J (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t)-
      HornerCertificates.evaluate w.L t*
        ((HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t+(HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t)^2)*
          HornerCertificates.evaluate d.U (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t)+
          (HornerCertificates.evaluate w.s t+1)*
            HornerCertificates.evaluate d.V (SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell.location w t))) := by
    convert hm using 1
    ring
  exact sub_nonneg.mp (nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right hm' (mul_pos (pow_pos hDSr _) hDGr))

theorem inverse_parameter (U V J M L : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hb : L*((M+1)*U+(M^2+M)*V) ≤ M*J) :
    L*((1/M+(1/M)^2)*U+(1/M+1)*V) ≤ (1/M)*J := by
  calc
    _ = (L*((M+1)*U+(M^2+M)*V))/(M^2) := by
      field_simp [hM.ne']
      ring
    _ ≤ (M*J)/(M^2) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb (sq_nonneg M)
    _ = _ := by field_simp [hM.ne']

theorem reserve_bound (D J M K y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hP : 0 ≤ y^2*(M*J-D)-K*D) : (1+K/y^2)*D ≤ M*J := by
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hy)).mp
  have he : y^2*((1+K/y^2)*D) = (y^2+K)*D := by field_simp [hy.ne']
  rw [he]
  nlinarith only [hP]

under graph isomorphisms, including isomorphisms between different vertex types.

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.IsoEnergy
open Matrix
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V W : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

theorem laplacian_reindex {𝕜 : Type*} [CommRing 𝕜]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ≃g H) :
    Matrix.reindex f.toEquiv f.toEquiv (G.lapMatrix 𝕜) = H.lapMatrix 𝕜 := by
  ext i j
  change (G.lapMatrix 𝕜) (f.symm i) (f.symm j) = (H.lapMatrix 𝕜) i j
  have hd := f.degree_eq (f.symm i)
  rw [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] at hd
  have he : (f.symm i = f.symm j) ↔ i = j := f.symm.injective.eq_iff
  have ha : G.Adj (f.symm i) (f.symm j) ↔ H.Adj i j := f.symm.map_adj_iff
  simp only [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, SimpleGraph.degMatrix, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
    SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
    he, ha, hd]

theorem charpoly_eq {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ≃g H) :
    (G.lapMatrix ℝ).charpoly = (H.lapMatrix ℝ).charpoly := by
  rw [← laplacian_reindex f, Matrix.charpoly_reindex]

theorem spectral_sum_roots (G : SimpleGraph V) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, φ (laplacianSpectrum G i)) =
      ((G.lapMatrix ℝ).charpoly.roots.map φ).sum := by
  rw [(G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ).roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues]
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

theorem spectral_sum_eq {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (f : G ≃g H) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, φ (laplacianSpectrum G i)) = (∑ j, φ (laplacianSpectrum H j)) := by
  rw [spectral_sum_roots, spectral_sum_roots, charpoly_eq f]

omit [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq W] in
theorem meanDegree_eq {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ≃g H) :
    meanDegree G = meanDegree H := by
  simp only [meanDegree, f.card_edgeFinset_eq, Fintype.card_congr f.toEquiv]

theorem energy_eq {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ≃g H) :
    laplacianEnergy G = laplacianEnergy H := by
  unfold laplacianEnergy centredEnergy
  rw [meanDegree_eq f]
  exact spectral_sum_eq f (fun x => |x - meanDegree H|)

theorem fused_energy (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    laplacianEnergy (RewireIso.rewired C u p q) =
      laplacianEnergy (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) :=
  energy_eq (RewireIso.fusedIso C u p q)

#print axioms laplacian_reindex
#print axioms charpoly_eq
#print axioms spectral_sum_eq
#print axioms energy_eq
#print axioms fused_energy

end

/-!
# The actual degree-46 numerical reserve

Source: the revised universal manuscript and
`other_degrees/source/rg_multiarm_large_degree_integral_certificate.py`,
with cutoff 46, XLO = 653/2000 and PAYMENT = 21/25.

This proves the closed transcendental reserve, without importing Python
interval endpoints or assuming a positive numerical margin. The missing
pointwise polynomial certificates and the integral-to-primitive identity
remain separate obligations. In particular this module does not inhabit
`OriginalAssembly.Inputs.degreeGeFortysix`.
-/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.LargeDegreeReserve
open Real Set
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def atanLower (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x - x ^ 3 / 3
def atanUpper (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x - x ^ 3 / 3 + x ^ 5 / 5

theorem atan_lower (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : atanLower x ≤ arctan x := by
  have hd (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun z => arctan z - atanLower z)
      (y ^ 4 / (1 + y ^ 2)) y := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_arctan y).sub
      ((hasDerivAt_id y).sub (((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 3).div_const 3))
    simp only [id_eq] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (field_simp [show 1+y^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]; ring)
  have hm := monotone_of_hasDerivAt_nonneg hd (by intro y; positivity)
  have h := hm hx
  norm_num [atanLower] at h
  dsimp [atanLower]
  linarith only [h]

theorem atan_upper (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : arctan x ≤ atanUpper x := by
  have hd (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun z => atanUpper z - arctan z)
      (y ^ 6 / (1 + y ^ 2)) y := by
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_id y).sub (((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 3).div_const 3)).add
      (((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 5).div_const 5)).sub (hasDerivAt_arctan y)
    simp only [id_eq] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (field_simp [show 1+y^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]; ring)
  have hm := monotone_of_hasDerivAt_nonneg hd (by intro y; positivity)
  have h := hm hx
  norm_num [atanUpper] at h
  dsimp [atanUpper]
  linarith only [h]

theorem atan_le_self (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : arctan x ≤ x := by
  have hd (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun z => z - arctan z)
      (y ^ 2 / (1 + y ^ 2)) y := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_id y).sub (hasDerivAt_arctan y) using 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (field_simp [show 1+y^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]; ring)
  have hm := monotone_of_hasDerivAt_nonneg hd (by intro y; positivity)
  have h := hm hx
  norm_num at h
  linarith only [h]

theorem log_two_upper : log 2 ≤ (69315 / 100000 : ℝ) := by
  have h := Real.log_div_le_sum_range_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/3)
    (by norm_num : (1/3 : ℝ) < 1) 6
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h
  linarith only [h]

theorem log_three_upper : log 3 ≤ (109862 / 100000 : ℝ) := by
  have h := Real.log_div_le_sum_range_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2)
    (by norm_num : (1/2 : ℝ) < 1) 10
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h
  linarith only [h]

theorem log_small_lower : (19 / 40 : ℝ) ≤ log (4021 / 2500 : ℝ) := by
  have h := Real.sum_range_le_log_div (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1521/6521)
    (by norm_num : (1521/6521 : ℝ) < 1) 4
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h
  linarith only [h]

def tailParameter (y : ℝ) : ℝ := (sqrt (y ^ 2 + 4) - y) / 2

/-- The original tail primitive, not an asserted value of an integral. -/
def tailPrimitive (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let t := tailParameter y;
  -((t - 1/t) * log (1 + t ^ 2) - 2*t + 4*arctan t) / 2

theorem tail_parameter_properties (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    0 < tailParameter y ∧ tailParameter y ≤ 1 ∧
      (tailParameter y) ^ 2 + y * tailParameter y = 1 := by
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ y^2+4 by positivity)
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (y^2+4)
  have ht : 0 < tailParameter y := by unfold tailParameter; nlinarith
  have he : (tailParameter y)^2 + y * tailParameter y = 1 := by
    unfold tailParameter
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨ht, ?_, he⟩
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hy ht.le]

theorem tail_lower (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) : -tailParameter y ≤ tailPrimitive y := by
  obtain ⟨ht, ht1, _⟩ := tail_parameter_properties y hy
  have hc : tailParameter y - 1 / tailParameter y ≤ 0 := by
    have hs : (tailParameter y)^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have h : tailParameter y ≤ 1/tailParameter y :=
      (le_div_iff₀ ht).mpr (by nlinarith)
    nlinarith
  have hl : 0 ≤ log (1 + (tailParameter y)^2) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tailParameter y)])
  have hm := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc hl
  have ha := atan_le_self (tailParameter y) ht.le
  unfold tailPrimitive
  linarith only [hm, ha]

theorem far_tail_lower : -(1 / 460 : ℝ) ≤ tailPrimitive 460 := by
  obtain ⟨ht, _, he⟩ := tail_parameter_properties 460 (by norm_num)
  have hb : tailParameter 460 ≤ (1/460 : ℝ) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tailParameter 460)]
  linarith [tail_lower 460 (by norm_num)]

theorem half_parameter_bounds :
    (78077 / 100000 : ℝ) ≤ tailParameter (1/2) ∧
      tailParameter (1/2) ≤ (78078 / 100000 : ℝ) := by
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^2+4 by norm_num)
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((1/2 : ℝ)^2+4)
  unfold tailParameter
  constructor <;> nlinarith

theorem half_log_lower : (19/40 : ℝ) ≤ log (1 + (tailParameter (1/2))^2) := by
  have ht := half_parameter_bounds.1
  have ht0 := (tail_parameter_properties (1/2) (by norm_num)).1
  have hb : (4021/2500 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + (tailParameter (1/2))^2 := by nlinarith
  exact log_small_lower.trans (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hb)

theorem half_angle :
    arctan (tailParameter (1/2)) +
      arctan ((1-tailParameter (1/2))/(1+tailParameter (1/2))) = Real.pi/4 := by
  let t := tailParameter (1/2)
  have ht : 0 < t := (tail_parameter_properties (1/2) (by norm_num)).1
  have hd : 0 < 1+t := by positivity
  have hp : t * ((1-t)/(1+t)) < 1 := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_lt_one hd).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have he : (t+(1-t)/(1+t))/(1-t*((1-t)/(1+t))) = 1 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hd, ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hp), show 1+t^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]
    ring_nf
    field_simp [show 1+t^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]
    ring
  have h := Real.arctan_add hp
  rw [he, Real.arctan_one] at h
  exact h

theorem half_tail_lower :
    (78077/100000 : ℝ) + (19/160 : ℝ) - Real.pi/2 +
      2 * atanLower (1231/10000) ≤ tailPrimitive (1/2) := by
  let t := tailParameter (1/2)
  obtain ⟨ht, _, hq⟩ := tail_parameter_properties (1/2) (by norm_num)
  have hc : t - 1/t = -(1/2 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp [ht.ne']
    nlinarith [hq]
  have hu : (1231/10000 : ℝ) ≤ (1-t)/(1+t) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 1+t)).mpr
    have hb := half_parameter_bounds.2
    change t ≤ _ at hb
    linarith
  have ha := (atan_lower (1231/10000) (by norm_num)).trans
    (Real.arctan_le_arctan_iff.mpr hu)
  have he : tailPrimitive (1/2) = t + log (1+t^2)/4 - 2*arctan t := by
    change -((t-1/t)*log (1+t^2)-2*t+4*arctan t)/2 = _
    rw [hc]
    ring
  have hang := half_angle
  have hb := half_parameter_bounds.1
  have hl := half_log_lower
  rw [he]
  change arctan t + arctan ((1-t)/(1+t)) = _ at hang
  change _ ≤ t at hb
  change _ ≤ log (1+t^2) at hl
  linarith only [ha, hang, hb, hl]

def reserve : ℝ :=
  (-(8/3 : ℝ)*log 2 - 2*log 3 + 2/(5*(653/2000 : ℝ)))/46 - log 2/2 +
    tailPrimitive (1/2) + (21/25 : ℝ)*(arctan 10 - arctan (653/2000)) + tailPrimitive 460

theorem reserve_transport_paid : (2/47 : ℝ) < reserve / Real.pi := by
  have hp : Real.pi < (22/7 : ℝ) := lt_trans Real.pi_lt_d4 (by norm_num)
  have h10 : arctan (10 : ℝ) = Real.pi/2 - arctan (1/10 : ℝ) := by
    simpa using Real.arctan_inv_of_pos (x := (1/10 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have h1 := atan_upper (1/10) (by norm_num)
  have h2 := atan_upper (653/2000) (by norm_num)
  have hj := half_tail_lower
  have hf := far_tail_lower
  have hl2 := log_two_upper
  have hl3 := log_three_upper
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mpr
  unfold reserve
  norm_num [atanLower, atanUpper] at h1 h2 hj
  linarith only [hp, h10, h1, h2, hj, hf, hl2, hl3]

theorem reserve_positive : 0 < reserve := by
  have h := (lt_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mp reserve_transport_paid
  exact lt_trans (by positivity) h

def coefficient : ℝ := -(8/3 : ℝ)*log 2 - 2*log 3 + 2/(5*(653/2000 : ℝ))
def coefficientLower : ℝ :=
  -(8/3 : ℝ)*(69315/100000) - 2*(109862/100000) + 2/(5*(653/2000 : ℝ))

theorem coefficient_uniform (d : ℝ) (hd : 46 ≤ d) :
    coefficientLower / 46 ≤ coefficient / d := by
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
  have hc : coefficientLower ≤ coefficient := by
    unfold coefficientLower coefficient
    linarith [log_two_upper, log_three_upper]
  have hn : coefficientLower ≤ 0 := by norm_num [coefficientLower]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 46) hd0).mpr
  calc
    coefficientLower * d ≤ coefficientLower * 46 := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hd hn
    _ ≤ coefficient * 46 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by norm_num)

theorem far_tail_uniform (d : ℝ) (hd : 46 ≤ d) :
    -(1/460 : ℝ) ≤ tailPrimitive (10*d) := by
  have hy : 0 ≤ 10*d := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ht, _, he⟩ := tail_parameter_properties (10*d) hy
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (460 : ℝ) ≤ 10*d by linarith) ht.le
  have hb : tailParameter (10*d) ≤ (1/460 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tailParameter (10*d))]
  linarith [tail_lower (10*d) hy]

/-- The original degree-dependent closed expression, for all real d >= 46. -/
def reserveAt (d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  coefficient/d - log 2/2 + tailPrimitive (1/2) +
    (21/25 : ℝ)*(arctan 10 - arctan (653/2000)) + tailPrimitive (10*d)

theorem uniform_transport_paid (d : ℝ) (hd : 46 ≤ d) :
    (2/47 : ℝ) < reserveAt d / Real.pi := by
  have hp : Real.pi < (22/7 : ℝ) := lt_trans Real.pi_lt_d4 (by norm_num)
  have h10 : arctan (10 : ℝ) = Real.pi/2 - arctan (1/10 : ℝ) := by
    simpa using Real.arctan_inv_of_pos (x := (1/10 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have h1 := atan_upper (1/10) (by norm_num)
  have h2 := atan_upper (653/2000) (by norm_num)
  have hj := half_tail_lower
  have hf := far_tail_uniform d hd
  have hc := coefficient_uniform d hd
  have hl2 := log_two_upper
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mpr
  unfold reserveAt
  norm_num [atanLower, atanUpper] at h1 h2 hj
  norm_num [coefficientLower] at hc
  linarith only [hp, h10, h1, h2, hj, hf, hc, hl2]

/-- Only the actual graph-integral comparison remains as a premise here.
This premise still requires the original polynomial and integration proofs. -/
theorem strict_fusion_of_original_integral_bound {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m))
    (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ) (hT : (CoreQuotient.source C u p q).IsTree)
    (hd : 46 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hI : reserveAt (C.degree u) / Real.pi ≤
      ActualFusionIntegral.normalizedIntegral C u p q 2) :
    laplacianEnergy (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) <
      laplacianEnergy (CoreQuotient.source C u p q) := by
  have hn := OriginalAssembly.source_order_ge_degree_add_three C u p q
  apply OriginalAssembly.strict_of_cutoff_reserve C u p q 47 hT (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (uniform_transport_paid _ (by exact_mod_cast hd)) hI

#print axioms atan_lower
#print axioms atan_upper
#print axioms atan_le_self
#print axioms log_two_upper

#print axioms tail_lower
#print axioms far_tail_lower
#print axioms half_parameter_bounds
#print axioms half_log_lower
#print axioms half_angle
#print axioms half_tail_lower
#print axioms reserve_transport_paid
#print axioms reserve_positive
#print axioms coefficient_uniform
#print axioms far_tail_uniform
#print axioms uniform_transport_paid
#print axioms strict_fusion_of_original_integral_bound
end

def rawCheck (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (raw : NestedInteger.Poly 3) : Bool :=
  NestedAffine.zeroCheck 3 (add (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 raw) (scale (-K) p))

def make {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (a : NestedInteger.Poly 3) : FastNestedCellData.Cell :=
  { reciprocal := reciprocal
    young := s
    squareLower := L
    payment := R
    logarithmK := k
    logarithmN := n
    poly := NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L
    affine := scale (1/totalScale s L deg l w) (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 a)
    degrees := deg
    left := l
    width := w }

noncomputable section
theorem raw_eval (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (raw : NestedInteger.Poly 3)
    (h : rawCheck p K raw=true) (z : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 raw) z=(K : ℝ)*eval p z := by
  have hh := NestedAffine.zeroCheck_sound 3 _ h z
  rw [eval_add,eval_scale] at hh
  push_cast at hh
  linarith only [hh]

theorem affine_checked (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (raw a : NestedInteger.Poly 3)
    (hr : rawCheck p K raw=true) (hrect : NestedInteger.rectangular 3 deg raw=true)
    (ha : a=NestedInteger.clearedAll 3 raw
      (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w)) :
    NestedAffine.check 3 p
      (scale (1/(K*(NestedInteger.factor 3 deg (denominator l w) : ℚ)))
        (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 a)) l w=true := by
  apply NestedAffine.check_complete
  intro x
  have he := NestedInteger.clearedAll_sound 3 deg raw
    (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w)
    hrect (fun i => (PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.denominator_pos l w i).ne') x
  rw [eval_scale,ha,he,raw_eval p K raw hr]
  have hv : (fun i => ((leftNumerator l w i : ℝ)+(widthNumerator l w i : ℝ)*x i)/
      (denominator l w i : ℝ)) = (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i) := by
    funext i
    exact PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.coordinate_eq l w x i
  rw [hv]
  have hKr : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hF : (0 : ℝ) < NestedInteger.factor 3 deg (denominator l w) := by
    exact_mod_cast NestedInteger.factor_pos 3 deg (denominator l w)
      (PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.denominator_pos l w)
  push_cast
  field_simp

/-- The raw program identity and the integer transform identity are checked
separately. Thus neither identity repeatedly reconstructs the other tensor. -/
theorem accepts_make {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (raw a : NestedInteger.Poly 3) (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hr : rawCheck (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L) (baseScale s L) raw=true)
    (hrect : NestedInteger.rectangular 3 deg raw=true)
    (ha : a=NestedInteger.clearedAll 3 raw
      (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w))
    (hb : NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck 3 deg a=true)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂ (make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w a)=true := by
  apply decide_eq_true
  refine ⟨hs,hw,NormProgramPack.accepts_polynomial p reciprocal s L,?_,?_,hl⟩
  · exact affine_checked _ (baseScale s L) (PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.baseScale_pos s L)
      deg l w raw a hr hrect ha
  · exact NestedPositiveScale.positiveCheck_scale 3 deg _ (1/totalScale s L deg l w)
      (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (PackedIntegerSemanticAffine.totalScale_pos s L deg l w).le)
      (NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck_to_rational 3 deg a hb)

#print axioms affine_checked
#print axioms accepts_make
end

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalLog
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.LogPolynomialLower

open Set
noncomputable section

def lowerFour (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x - x ^ 2 / 2 + x ^ 3 / 3 - x ^ 4 / 4
def remainder (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (1 + x) - lowerFour x

theorem remainder_derivative (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    HasDerivAt remainder (x ^ 4 / (1 + x)) x := by
  have hl := ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_add 1).log (show 1 + x ≠ 0 by linarith)
  have hp := ((((hasDerivAt_id x).sub (((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).div_const 2)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 3).div_const 3)).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 4).div_const 4))
  simp only [id_eq] at hl hp
  convert hl.sub hp using 1 <;> first
    | rfl
    | (field_simp [show 1 + x ≠ 0 by linarith]; ring)

/-- The fourth alternating polynomial is a lower bound on the whole positive ray. -/
theorem logarithm_lower_four (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    lowerFour x ≤ Real.log (1 + x) := by
  have hc : ContinuousOn remainder (Ici 0) :=
    fun y hy => (remainder_derivative y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hm : MonotoneOn remainder (Ici 0) :=
    monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Ici 0) hc
      (fun y hy => (remainder_derivative y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun y hy => by
        have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := interior_subset hy
        exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith))
  have h := hm (by simp) (by simpa using hx) hx
  have hz : remainder 0 = 0 := by simp [remainder, lowerFour]
  rw [hz] at h
  exact sub_nonneg.mp h

theorem scaled_logarithm_lower (L c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : c ≤ L) :
    Real.log c + lowerFour (L / c - 1) ≤ Real.log L := by
  have hL0 : 0 < L := hc.trans_le hL
  have hd : 0 ≤ L / c - 1 := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hc).mpr
    simpa using hL
  have h := logarithm_lower_four (L / c - 1) hd
  rw [show 1 + (L / c - 1) = L / c by ring,
    Real.log_div hL0.ne' hc.ne'] at h
  linarith

theorem norm_logarithm_lower (q L c R : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : c ≤ L)
    (hR : R ≤ Real.log c / 2) (hbound : L ≤ q ^ 2) :
    R + lowerFour (L / c - 1) / 2 ≤ Real.log q := by
  have hL0 : 0 < L := hc.trans_le hL
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hL0 hbound
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  norm_num at hlog
  have hl := scaled_logarithm_lower L c hc hL
  linarith

/-- A checked rational constant plus an integrable polynomial payment. -/
theorem rational_payment_lower (q L : ℝ) (c R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hL : (c : ℝ) ≤ L)
    (hlog : RationalLog.accepts c R k n = true) (hbound : L ≤ q ^ 2) :
    (R : ℝ) + lowerFour (L / (c : ℝ) - 1) / 2 ≤ Real.log q :=
  norm_logarithm_lower q L c R (by exact_mod_cast hc) hL
    (RationalLog.sound c R k n hlog) hbound

#print axioms remainder_derivative
#print axioms logarithm_lower_four
#print axioms scaled_logarithm_lower
#print axioms norm_logarithm_lower
#print axioms rational_payment_lower

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.LogPolynomialLower

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanOrderFour

/-!
# The first actual strict pendant-fusion case

Every admissible four-vertex source is the star, and its own fused graph is
the four-vertex path. Their exact energy drop is 3 - 2 sqrt(2) > 0.
Consequently strict fusion above five is equivalent to uniform strict fusion.
Neither of these equivalent unrestricted hypotheses is proved here.

This extends the source-bound order-four checkpoint in RG_ORDER_FOUR_20261020.
The actual source/fused definitions and both physical arm lengths are retained.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MinimalFusion

open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient RewireTopology GlobalAssembly FourVertexSpectrum
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

theorem starFour_leaves : leafCount starFour = 3 := by
  have hdeg (i : Fin 4) : starFour.degree i = if i = 0 then 3 else 1 := by
    have hs : starFour.degree i =
        ∑ j : Fin 4, if starFour.Adj i j then (1 : ℕ) else 0 :=
      starFour.degree_eq_sum_if_adj i
    rw [hs]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero] <;>
      norm_num [starFour, starGraph_adj, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hc : starFour.degree 0 = 3 := by
    simpa using hdeg 0
  have he : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin 4 => starFour.degree i = 1) =
      Finset.univ.erase 0 := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [hc]
    · have hd : starFour.degree i = 1 := by simpa only [if_neg hi] using hdeg i
      simp [hd, hi]
  unfold leafCount
  rw [he]
  norm_num

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V]

/-- Relabeling preserves the given source, rather than choosing a replacement graph. -/
theorem source_iso_star_four (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 4) :
    Nonempty (source C u p q ≃g starFour) := by
  let S := V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)
  let e : Fin 4 ≃ S := (finCongr hn.symm).trans (Fintype.equivFin S).symm
  let T := (source C u p q).comap e
  let f : T ≃g source C u p q := Iso.comap e (source C u p q)
  have hp : ¬Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph 4) := by
    rintro ⟨g⟩
    apply FusionTerminal.fusion_source_not_path C u p q hT hd
    rw [hn]
    exact ⟨f.symm.trans g⟩
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := OrderFour.nonpath_iso_starFour T (f.isTree_iff.mpr hT) hp
  exact ⟨f.symm.trans g⟩

/-- This is the actual fusion of the same source and the same two arms. -/
theorem fused_iso_path_four (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 4) :
    Nonempty (fused C u p q ≃g pathGraph 4) := by
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := source_iso_star_four C u p q hT hd hn
  have hl : leafCount (source C u p q) = 3 :=
    (leaf_count_iso f).trans starFour_leaves
  have ht := FusionDescent.fusion_tree_and_leaf_count C u p q hT hd
  have hnF : Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) = 4 := ht.2.1.symm.trans hn
  have hp := FusionTerminal.three_leaf_fusion_is_path C u p q hT hd hl
  rw [hnF] at hp
  exact hp

variable [DecidableEq V]

theorem actual_energies_four (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 4) :
    laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) = 5 ∧
      laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) = 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := source_iso_star_four C u p q hT hd hn
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := fused_iso_path_four C u p q hT hd hn
  exact ⟨(energy_iso f).trans starFour_energy, (energy_iso g).trans pathFour_energy⟩

theorem exact_drop_four (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 4) :
    laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) - laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) =
      3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hf⟩ := actual_energies_four C u p q hT hd hn
  rw [hs, hf]
  ring

theorem strictFusion_four (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 4) :
    laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hf⟩ := actual_energies_four C u p q hT hd hn
  rw [hs, hf]
  simpa only [pathFour_energy, starFour_energy] using pathFour_energy_lt_starFour

/-- The minimal admissible order forces two single-edge arms and a two-vertex core. -/
theorem minimal_parameters {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m)
    (p q : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) = 4) :
    m = 2 ∧ p = 0 ∧ q = 0 ∧ C.degree u = 1 := by
  have hm := C.degree_lt_card_verts u
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hm
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin] at hn
  omega

/-- All admissible orders below five are covered; no smaller admissible order exists. -/
theorem strictFusion_below_five {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m)
    (p q : ℕ) (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hn : Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) < 5) :
    laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) := by
  have hmin := SmallOrders.four_le_source_order C u p q hd
  exact strictFusion_four C u p q hT hd (by omega)

/-- Raising any cutoff at most five to five removes only the now-proved finite case. -/
theorem strictFusionAbove_iff_five (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≤ 5) :
    StrictFusionAbove N ↔ StrictFusionAbove 5 := by
  constructor
  · intro h m C u p q hn hT hd
    exact h m C u p q (by omega) hT hd
  · intro h m C u p q _ hT hd
    by_cases hn : 5 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))
    · exact h m C u p q hn hT hd
    · exact strictFusion_below_five C u p q hT hd (by omega)

theorem uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_five :
    SmallOrders.UniformStrictFusion ↔ StrictFusionAbove 5 :=
  SmallOrders.uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_four.trans
    (strictFusionAbove_iff_five 4 (by omega))

#check @strictFusion_four
#check @minimal_parameters
#check @strictFusionAbove_iff_five
#check @uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_five

#print axioms starFour_leaves
#print axioms source_iso_star_four
#print axioms fused_iso_path_four
#print axioms actual_energies_four
#print axioms exact_drop_four
#print axioms strictFusion_four
#print axioms minimal_parameters
#print axioms strictFusion_below_five
#print axioms strictFusionAbove_iff_five
#print axioms uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_five

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MinimalFusion

Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Determinant logarithms for graphs with different finite vertex types.
The cardinality premise is explicit; no unproved integrability is assumed.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanGraphIntegral
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanIsoEnergy

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MixedGraphIntegral
open Matrix Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V W : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

def logarithm (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (t y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log ‖(CoreQuotient.shifted ((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) G).det /
    (CoreQuotient.shifted ((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) H).det‖

theorem shifted_det_eq {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ≃g H) (z : ℂ) :
    (CoreQuotient.shifted z G).det = (CoreQuotient.shifted z H).det := by
  have h : Matrix.reindex f.toEquiv f.toEquiv (CoreQuotient.shifted z G) =
      CoreQuotient.shifted z H := by
    change (z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - G.lapMatrix ℂ).submatrix
      f.toEquiv.symm f.toEquiv.symm = z • (1 : Matrix W W ℂ) - H.lapMatrix ℂ
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_sub, Matrix.submatrix_smul, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]
    rw [show (G.lapMatrix ℂ).submatrix f.toEquiv.symm f.toEquiv.symm = H.lapMatrix ℂ from
      IsoEnergy.laplacian_reindex f]
  rw [← h, Matrix.det_reindex_self]

theorem integrable (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)
    (hc : Fintype.card V = Fintype.card W) (t : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (logarithm G H t) (Ioi 0) := by
  let e : V ≃ W := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hc
  let H' : SimpleGraph V := H.comap e
  let f : H' ≃g H := { toEquiv := e, map_rel_iff' := by intro a b; rfl }
  have he : logarithm G H t = GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm G H' t := by
    funext y
    unfold logarithm GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm
    rw [shifted_det_eq f]
  rw [he]
  exact GraphIntegral.graph_integrable G H' t

#print axioms shifted_det_eq
#print axioms integrable

attribute [instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MixedGraphIntegral

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanMixedGraphIntegral

/-! Exact Coulson stop-loss identity across distinct vertex types and adjacency deciders. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MixedStopLoss
open SimpleGraph Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
variable {V W : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]

attribute [-instance] SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSetSup

theorem spectral_sum_iso {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] (f : G ≃g H) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, φ (laplacianSpectrum G i)) = (∑ i, φ (laplacianSpectrum H i)) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, φ (@laplacianSpectrum V _ _ G
        (fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (G.Adj a b)) i) :=
      congrArg (fun d => ∑ i, φ (@laplacianSpectrum V _ _ G d i)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    _ = ∑ i, φ (@laplacianSpectrum W _ _ H
        (fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (H.Adj a b)) i) :=
      IsoEnergy.spectral_sum_eq f φ
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun d => ∑ i, φ (@laplacianSpectrum W _ _ H d i))
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

theorem stopLoss_iso {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] (f : G ≃g H) (t : ℝ) :
    stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) t = stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) t := by
  unfold stopLoss
  exact spectral_sum_iso f (fun x => max (x - t) 0)

theorem aboveCount_iso {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] (f : G ≃g H) (t : ℝ) :
    aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum G) t = aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum H) t := by
  unfold aboveCount
  exact spectral_sum_iso f (fun x => if t < x then 1 else 0)

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U]

theorem rewire_count_gap_iso (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V)
    (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w) (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w)
    {S : SimpleGraph W} {H : SimpleGraph U} [DecidableRel S.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (f : (G ⊔ edge u w) ≃g S) (g : (G ⊔ edge v w) ≃g H) (t : ℝ) :
    |aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum S) t - aboveCount (laplacianSpectrum H) t| ≤ 1 := by
  have h := CountGap.rewire_count_gap G u v w huw hvw hguw hgvw t
  rw [aboveCount_iso f t, aboveCount_iso g t] at h
  exact h

theorem rewire_stopLoss_transport_iso (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V)
    (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w) (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w)
    {S : SimpleGraph W} {H : SimpleGraph U} [DecidableRel S.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (f : (G ⊔ edge u w) ≃g S) (g : (G ⊔ edge v w) ≃g H) (s t : ℝ) :
    |(stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum S) s - stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) s) -
      (stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum S) t - stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) t)| ≤ |s-t| := by
  have h := CountGap.rewire_stopLoss_transport G u v w huw hvw hguw hgvw s t
  rw [stopLoss_iso f s, stopLoss_iso g s, stopLoss_iso f t, stopLoss_iso g t] at h
  exact h

theorem integral_eq (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)
    (hc : Fintype.card V = Fintype.card W)
    (he : G.edgeFinset.card = H.edgeFinset.card) (t : ℝ) :
    (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm G H t y) =
      stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) t - stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) t := by
  let e : V ≃ W := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hc
  let H' : SimpleGraph V := H.comap e
  let f : H' ≃g H := { toEquiv := e, map_rel_iff' := by intro a b; rfl }
  have hlog : MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm G H t =
      GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm G H' t := by
    funext y
    unfold MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm GraphIntegral.graphLogarithm
    rw [MixedGraphIntegral.shifted_det_eq f]
  have he' : G.edgeFinset.card = H'.edgeFinset.card :=
    he.trans f.card_edgeFinset_eq.symm
  rw [hlog, GraphIntegral.graph_stopLoss_integral G H' he' t, stopLoss_iso f t]

#print axioms spectral_sum_iso
#print axioms stopLoss_iso
#print axioms aboveCount_iso
#print axioms rewire_count_gap_iso
#print axioms rewire_stopLoss_transport_iso
#print axioms integral_eq

end

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Linear-fractional disk enclosure and its rationalized distance bound.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Section 4.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanReciprocalDisk

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MobiusDisk

open Complex

theorem numerator_identity (a b c d η : ℂ) :
    ((Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c : ℝ) : ℂ) * (a * η + b) -
      (b * star d - a * star c) * (c * η + d) =
      (a * d - b * c) * (star c + star d * η) := by
  have hc : (Complex.normSq c : ℂ) = c * star c := by
    simpa only [Complex.star_def] using (Complex.mul_conj c).symm
  have hd : (Complex.normSq d : ℂ) = d * star d := by
    simpa only [Complex.star_def] using (Complex.mul_conj d).symm
  push_cast
  rw [hc, hd]
  ring

theorem circle_identity (c d η : ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq (c * η + d) - Complex.normSq (star c + star d * η) =
      (Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c) * (1 - Complex.normSq η) := by
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.mul_im, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

theorem denominator_ne_zero (c d η : ℂ)
    (hE : 0 < Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c) (hη : ‖η‖ ≤ 1) :
    c * η + d ≠ 0 := by
  have hnorm : ‖c‖ < ‖d‖ := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at hE
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg c, norm_nonneg d]
  intro he
  have hd : d = -(c * η) := by linear_combination he
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hη (norm_nonneg c)
  rw [hd, norm_neg, norm_mul] at hnorm
  nlinarith

/-- The disk image enclosure, without assuming a minimum formula. -/
theorem image_disk (a b c d η : ℂ)
    (hE : 0 < Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c) (hη : ‖η‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖(a * η + b) / (c * η + d) -
        (b * star d - a * star c) / (Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c : ℝ)‖ ≤
      ‖a * d - b * c‖ / (Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c) := by
  let E := Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c
  have hE0 : (E : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hE.ne'
  have hden := denominator_ne_zero c d η hE hη
  have hη2 : Complex.normSq η ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg η]
  have hcircle : ‖star c + star d * η‖ ≤ ‖c * η + d‖ := by
    have h := circle_identity c d η
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at h
    have hp := mul_nonneg hE.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hη2)
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (star c + star d * η), norm_nonneg (c * η + d)]
  have hid : (a * η + b) / (c * η + d) - (b * star d - a * star c) / (E : ℂ) =
      ((a * d - b * c) * ((star c + star d * η) / (c * η + d))) / (E : ℂ) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hE0).mpr
    rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hE0, ← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (eq_div_iff hden).mpr
    rw [sub_mul, mul_right_comm _ (E : ℂ), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden]
    convert numerator_identity a b c d η using 1; ring
  rw [hid, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hE,
    norm_mul, norm_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hE.le
  calc
    ‖a * d - b * c‖ * (‖star c + star d * η‖ / ‖c * η + d‖) ≤
        ‖a * d - b * c‖ * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((div_le_one (norm_pos_iff.mpr hden)).mpr hcircle)
        (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := mul_one _

theorem center_distance_identity (a b c d : ℂ) :
    ‖b * star d - a * star c‖ ^ 2 - ‖a * d - b * c‖ ^ 2 =
      (Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c) *
        (Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a) := by
  simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

/-- The rationalized distance from zero; this is the lower bound used by certificates. -/
theorem rationalized_lower_bound (a b c d η : ℂ)
    (hE : 0 < Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c)
    (hN : 0 < Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a) (hη : ‖η‖ ≤ 1) :
    (Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a) /
      (‖b * star d - a * star c‖ + ‖a * d - b * c‖) ≤
      ‖(a * η + b) / (c * η + d)‖ := by
  let E := Complex.normSq d - Complex.normSq c
  let N := Complex.normSq b - Complex.normSq a
  let C := b * star d - a * star c
  let D := a * d - b * c
  let f := (a * η + b) / (c * η + d)
  have hid : ‖C‖ ^ 2 - ‖D‖ ^ 2 = E * N := center_distance_identity a b c d
  have hsep : ‖D‖ < ‖C‖ := by
    have hp := mul_pos hE hN
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg C, norm_nonneg D]
  have hsum : 0 < ‖C‖ + ‖D‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg D]
  have h := image_disk a b c d η hE hη
  change ‖f - C / (E : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖D‖ / E at h
  have ht := norm_sub_norm_le (C / (E : ℂ)) f
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at ht
  rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hE] at ht
  change ‖C‖ / E - ‖f‖ ≤ ‖f - C / (E : ℂ)‖ at ht
  have hbound : ‖C‖ - ‖D‖ ≤ E * ‖f‖ := by
    have hh : (‖C‖ - ‖D‖) / E ≤ ‖f‖ := by rw [sub_div]; linarith
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hE).mp hh
  have heq : N / (‖C‖ + ‖D‖) = (‖C‖ - ‖D‖) / E := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hsum.ne' hE.ne').mpr
    nlinarith [hid]
  change N / (‖C‖ + ‖D‖) ≤ ‖f‖
  rw [heq]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hE).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hbound)

#print axioms image_disk
#print axioms rationalized_lower_bound

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.MobiusDisk

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedArithmetic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedAffine
open NestedHorner NestedArithmetic
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- Exact coefficient substitution, using Horner multiplication by a linear polynomial. -/
def transform : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → (Fin n → ℚ) → (Fin n → ℚ) → Poly n
  | 0,p,_,_ => p
  | n+1,p,l,w => p.foldr (fun c a =>
      add [transform n c (fun i => l i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ)]
        (mul [constant n (l 0),constant n (w 0)] a)) []

def zeroCheck : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → Bool
  | 0,p => decide (p=0)
  | n+1,p => p.all (zeroCheck n)

def check (n : ℕ) (p a : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ) : Bool :=
  zeroCheck n (add (transform n p l w) (scale (-1) a))

noncomputable section
theorem transform_sound (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (transform n p l w) x = eval p (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => simp [transform]
    | cons c p hp =>
      simp only [transform] at hp
      simp only [transform,List.foldr_cons,eval_add,eval_mul,eval_cons,eval_nil,
        mul_zero,add_zero,eval_constant]
      rw [ih,hp]
      ring

theorem zeroCheck_sound (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (h : zeroCheck n p=true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval p x=0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hp : p=0 := of_decide_eq_true h
    subst p
    norm_num [eval]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons c p hp =>
      have hh : zeroCheck n c=true ∧ zeroCheck (n+1) p=true := by
        simpa only [zeroCheck,List.all_cons,Bool.and_eq_true] using h
      simp only [eval_cons,ih c hh.1 (fun i => x i.succ),hp hh.2,mul_zero,add_zero]

theorem check_sound (n : ℕ) (p a : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (h : check n p a l w=true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval a x=eval p (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i) := by
  have hh := zeroCheck_sound n _ h x
  rw [eval_add,eval_scale,transform_sound] at hh
  norm_num only [Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_one] at hh
  linarith only [hh]

#print axioms transform_sound
#print axioms zeroCheck_sound
#print axioms check_sound
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedAffine

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedAffine

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedAffine
open NestedHorner Polynomial
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem coefficients_zero_of_parameter_zero {n : ℕ} (p : Poly (n+1))
    (h : ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, parameterPolynomial p x=0) :
    ∀ c ∈ p, ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, eval c x=0 := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c p ih =>
    have hc (x : Fin n → ℝ) : eval c x=0 := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun P : ℝ[X] => P.coeff 0) (h x)
      simpa [parameterPolynomial] using hh
    have hp (x : Fin n → ℝ) : parameterPolynomial p x=0 := by
      have hh : (Polynomial.X : ℝ[X])*parameterPolynomial p x=0 := by
        simpa only [parameterPolynomial,hc,Polynomial.C_0,zero_add] using h x
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left Polynomial.X_ne_zero
    intro a ha x
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with he | he
    · subst a
      exact hc x
    · exact ih hp a he x

/-- Exact vanishing is complete even when nested lists retain zero padding. -/
theorem zeroCheck_complete (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (h : ∀ x, eval p x=0) :
    zeroCheck n p=true := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    apply decide_eq_true
    have hh : (p : ℝ)=0 := h (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
    exact_mod_cast hh
  | succ n ih =>
    have hp (x : Fin n → ℝ) : parameterPolynomial p x=0 := by
      apply Polynomial.funext
      intro t
      rw [parameterPolynomial_eval,Polynomial.eval_zero]
      exact h _
    have hc := coefficients_zero_of_parameter_zero p hp
    simp only [zeroCheck,List.all_eq_true]
    intro c hm
    exact ih c (hc c hm)

/-- A proved integer substitution identity can discharge the rational checker
without evaluating the rational substitution separately in every leaf. -/
theorem check_complete (n : ℕ) (p a : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (h : ∀ x, eval a x=eval p (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i)) :
    check n p a l w=true := by
  apply zeroCheck_complete
  intro x
  rw [eval_add,eval_scale,transform_sound,← h x]
  norm_num

#print axioms zeroCheck_complete
#print axioms check_complete
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedAffine

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedHorner

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedArithmetic
open NestedHorner
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- Exact convolution, retaining every parameter coordinate. -/
def productRows {n : ℕ} (f : Poly n → Poly n → Poly n) :
    Poly (n+1) → Poly (n+1) → Poly (n+1)
  | [], _ => []
  | c :: p, q => add (q.map (f c)) (zero n :: productRows f p q)

def mul : {n : ℕ} → Poly n → Poly n → Poly n
  | 0, p, q => p*q
  | _+1, p, q => productRows mul p q

def constant : (n : ℕ) → ℚ → Poly n
  | 0, c => c
  | n+1, c => [constant n c]

def coordinate : (n : ℕ) → Fin n → Poly n
  | 0, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | n+1, i => if h : i.val=0 then [zero n, constant n 1]
      else [coordinate n ⟨i.val-1, by omega⟩]

def power {n : ℕ} (p : Poly n) : ℕ → Poly n
  | 0 => constant n 1
  | k+1 => mul p (power p k)

noncomputable section

theorem eval_productRows {n : ℕ} (f : Poly n → Poly n → Poly n)
    (hf : ∀ p q x, eval (f p q) x=eval p x*eval q x)
    (p q : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    eval (productRows f p q) x=eval p x*eval q x := by
  have hm (c : Poly n) (q : Poly (n+1)) :
      eval (q.map (f c)) x=eval c (fun i => x i.succ)*eval q x := by
    induction q with
    | nil => simp
    | cons d q ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, eval_cons, hf, ih]
      ring
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [productRows]
  | cons c p ih =>
    rw [productRows, eval_add, hm, eval_cons, eval_zero, ih, eval_cons]
    ring

theorem eval_mul {n : ℕ} (p q : Poly n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (mul p q) x=eval p x*eval q x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [mul, eval]
  | succ n ih => exact eval_productRows _ ih p q x

theorem eval_constant (n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (constant n c) x=(c : ℝ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [constant, ih]

theorem eval_coordinate (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (coordinate n i) x=x i := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases h : i.val=0
    · have hi : i=0 := Fin.ext h
      subst i
      simp [coordinate, eval_constant]
    · simp only [coordinate, dif_neg h, eval_cons, eval_nil, mul_zero, add_zero]
      rw [ih]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_succ]
      omega

theorem eval_power {n : ℕ} (p : Poly n) (k : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (power p k) x=eval p x^k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [power, eval_constant]
  | succ k ih => rw [power, eval_mul, ih]; ring

end

/-- A computable polynomial program; every closed equality can be checked
in the kernel without evaluating noncomputable real polynomial instances. -/
inductive Expr (n : ℕ)
  | rational : ℚ → Expr n
  | indet : Fin n → Expr n
  | plus : Expr n → Expr n → Expr n
  | times : Expr n → Expr n → Expr n
  | scaled : ℚ → Expr n → Expr n
  | pow : Expr n → ℕ → Expr n

def compile {n : ℕ} : Expr n → Poly n
  | .rational c => constant n c
  | .indet i => coordinate n i
  | .plus a b => add (compile a) (compile b)
  | .times a b => mul (compile a) (compile b)
  | .scaled c a => scale c (compile a)
  | .pow a k => power (compile a) k

noncomputable def value {n : ℕ} : Expr n → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ
  | .rational c, _ => c
  | .indet i, x => x i
  | .plus a b, x => value a x+value b x
  | .times a b, x => value a x*value b x
  | .scaled c a, x => c*value a x
  | .pow a k, x => value a x^k

theorem compile_sound {n : ℕ} (e : Expr n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (compile e) x=value e x := by
  induction e with
  | rational c => exact eval_constant n c x
  | indet i => exact eval_coordinate n i x
  | plus a b ha hb => rw [compile, eval_add, ha, hb]; rfl
  | times a b ha hb => rw [compile, eval_mul, ha, hb]; rfl
  | scaled c a ha => rw [compile, eval_scale, ha]; rfl
  | pow a k ha => rw [compile, eval_power, ha]; rfl

def polyDecidableEq : (n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (Poly n)
  | 0 => inferInstance
  | n+1 => by
    letI : DecidableEq (Poly n) := polyDecidableEq n
    exact inferInstance

def accepts {n : ℕ} (e : Expr n) (p : Poly n) : Bool :=
  letI : DecidableEq (Poly n) := polyDecidableEq n
  decide (compile e=p)

noncomputable section
theorem accepts_sound {n : ℕ} (e : Expr n) (p : Poly n)
    (h : accepts e p=true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : eval p x=value e x := by
  let : DecidableEq (Poly n) := polyDecidableEq n
  have hp : compile e=p := of_decide_eq_true h
  rw [← hp]
  exact compile_sound e x

#print axioms eval_productRows
#print axioms eval_mul
#print axioms eval_constant
#print axioms eval_coordinate
#print axioms eval_power
#print axioms compile_sound
#print axioms accepts_sound
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedArithmetic

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedClassNorms
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanClassCellCertificates

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedClassCell
open NestedArithmetic NestedClassPolynomials
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- One polynomial inequality retains the same Young parameter for the
whole ordinate/arm cell. All arithmetic in the program is rational. -/
def gap (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (s L : ℚ) : Expr 3 :=
  .plus (programJ d c₁ c₂)
    (.plus (.scaled (-(L*(1+s))) (programU d c₁ c₂))
      (.scaled (-(L*(1+1/s))) (programV d c₁ c₂)))

noncomputable section
def point (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*t i

/-- Exact compilation, affine identity and Bernstein signs imply the
logarithmic bound throughout the cell for the actual arm classes. -/
theorem logarithm_lower (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (p a : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hprogram : NestedArithmetic.accepts (gap d c₁ c₂ s L) p=true)
    (haffine : NestedHorner.affineCheck 3 deg p a l w=true)
    (hpositive : NestedHorner.positiveCheck 3 deg a=true)
    (hlog : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true)
    (hd : 0 < (d : ℝ)) (hs : 0 < s)
    (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hy : 0 < point l w t 0)
    (h₁ : point l w t 1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (h₂ : point l w t 2 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ-Focus.g d (point l w t 0)‖ ≤ Focus.r d (point l w t 0)) :
    (R : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ‖Focus.quotient (point l w t 0)
      (ArmClasses.parameter (point l w t 0) c₁ (point l w t 1))
      (ArmClasses.parameter (point l w t 0) c₂ (point l w t 2)) ζ‖ := by
  have he := NestedArithmetic.accepts_sound _ _ hprogram (point l w t)
  have ha := NestedHorner.affineCheck_sound 3 deg p a l w haffine t
  have hp := NestedHorner.positiveCheck_sound 3 deg a hpositive t ht
  have hg : 0 ≤ value (gap d c₁ c₂ s L) (point l w t) := by
    calc
      0 ≤ NestedHorner.eval a t := hp
      _ = NestedHorner.eval p (point l w t) := ha
      _ = value (gap d c₁ c₂ s L) (point l w t) := he
  have hcert : (L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*value (programU d c₁ c₂) (point l w t)+
      (1+1/(s : ℝ))*value (programV d c₁ c₂) (point l w t)) ≤
        value (programJ d c₁ c₂) (point l w t) := by
    simp only [gap,value,Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_mul,Rat.cast_add,Rat.cast_div,
      Rat.cast_one] at hg
    linarith
  have hsr : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hnorm := NestedClassNorms.polynomial_certificate d c₁ c₂ (point l w t)
    hd hy h₁ h₂ ζ hζ s L hsr hcert
  exact ClassCellCertificates.log_lower_of_square L R k n hlog _ hnorm

#print axioms logarithm_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedClassCell
