import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedClassPolynomials

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedClassNorms
open NestedArithmetic NestedClassPolynomials ClassNormPolynomials
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem complexValue_add (a b : CP) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    complexValue (cadd a b) x=complexValue a x+complexValue b x := by
  rfl

theorem complexValue_sub (a b : CP) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    complexValue (csub a b) x=complexValue a x-complexValue b x := by
  apply Complex.ext <;> dsimp [complexValue,csub,NestedClassPolynomials.sub,value] <;> ring

theorem complexValue_mul (a b : CP) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    complexValue (cmul a b) x=complexValue a x*complexValue b x := by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [complexValue,cmul,NestedClassPolynomials.add,
    NestedClassPolynomials.sub,NestedClassPolynomials.mul,value,
    Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem complexValue_star (a : CP) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    complexValue (cstar a) x=star (complexValue a x) := by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [complexValue,cstar,rat,NestedClassPolynomials.mul,value]

theorem normValue (a : CP) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    value (cnorm a) x=Complex.normSq (complexValue a x) := by
  simp [cnorm,NestedClassPolynomials.add,NestedClassPolynomials.pow,value,
    complexValue,Complex.normSq_apply,pow_two]

theorem normSq_scaled (l : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq ((l : ℂ)*z)=l^2*Complex.normSq z := by
  simp [Complex.normSq_apply,pow_two]
  ring

theorem common_positive (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hx : 0 < x 0) :
    0 < value (common c₁ c₂) x := by
  change 0 < value (armDen c₁) x*value (armDen c₂) x
  rw [armDen_sound,armDen_sound]
  exact mul_pos (ArmRationalForm.denominator_positive c₁ (x 0) hx)
    (ArmRationalForm.denominator_positive c₂ (x 0) hx)

/-- The common arm denominators occur to the same fourth power in all
three norm expressions. No identification by numerical values is used. -/
theorem programs_sound (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hx : 0 < x 0) :
    let l := value (common c₁ c₂) x
    let p := ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₁ (x 1)
    let q := ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₂ (x 2)
    value (programU d c₁ c₂) x=l^4*U d (x 0) p q ∧
    value (programV d c₁ c₂) x=l^4*V d (x 0) p q ∧
    value (programJ d c₁ c₂) x=l^4*J d (x 0) p q := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,he⟩ := coefficients_sound d c₁ c₂ x hx
  let l := value (common c₁ c₂) x
  let p := ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₁ (x 1)
  let q := ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₂ (x 2)
  have hu : U d (x 0) p q=Complex.normSq
      (polyB d (x 0) p q*star (polyE d (x 0) p q)-polyA d p q*star (polyC d (x 0) p q)) := by
    simp [U,Complex.normSq_apply,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im]
    ring
  have hv : V d (x 0) p q=Complex.normSq
      (polyA d p q*polyE d (x 0) p q-polyB d (x 0) p q*polyC d (x 0) p q) := by
    simp [V,Complex.normSq_apply,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im]
    ring
  have hj : J d (x 0) p q=(Complex.normSq (polyB d (x 0) p q)-Complex.normSq (polyA d p q))^2 := by
    simp [J,Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  have hscale (z : ℂ) : Complex.normSq ((l : ℂ)^2*z)=l^4*Complex.normSq z := by
    have heq : (l : ℂ)^2*z=(l : ℂ)*((l : ℂ)*z) := by ring
    rw [heq,normSq_scaled,normSq_scaled]
    ring
  change value (programU d c₁ c₂) x=l^4*U d (x 0) p q ∧
    value (programV d c₁ c₂) x=l^4*V d (x 0) p q ∧
    value (programJ d c₁ c₂) x=l^4*J d (x 0) p q
  constructor
  · rw [hu]
    simp only [programU,normValue,complexValue_sub,complexValue_mul,complexValue_star,
      ha,hb,hc,he]
    have heq : ((l : ℂ)*polyB d (x 0) p q)*star ((l : ℂ)*polyE d (x 0) p q)-
        ((l : ℂ)*polyA d p q)*star ((l : ℂ)*polyC d (x 0) p q)=
        (l : ℂ)^2*(polyB d (x 0) p q*star (polyE d (x 0) p q)-
          polyA d p q*star (polyC d (x 0) p q)) := by
      simp only [star_mul,Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_ofReal]
      ring
    rw [heq,hscale]
  · constructor
    · rw [hv]
      simp only [programV,normValue,complexValue_sub,complexValue_mul,ha,hb,hc,he]
      have heq : ((l : ℂ)*polyA d p q)*((l : ℂ)*polyE d (x 0) p q)-
          ((l : ℂ)*polyB d (x 0) p q)*((l : ℂ)*polyC d (x 0) p q)=
          (l : ℂ)^2*(polyA d p q*polyE d (x 0) p q-polyB d (x 0) p q*polyC d (x 0) p q) := by ring
      rw [heq,hscale]
    · rw [hj]
      simp only [programJ,NestedClassPolynomials.pow,NestedClassPolynomials.sub,value,
        normValue,ha,hb,normSq_scaled]
      ring

/-- A single common-denominator certificate supplies the actual Mobius
norm bound for every point of the entire arm parameter box. -/
theorem polynomial_certificate (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < (d : ℝ)) (hx : 0 < x 0)
    (h₁ : x 1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (h₂ : x 2 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ-Focus.g d (x 0)‖ ≤ Focus.r d (x 0))
    (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hcert : L*((1+s)*value (programU d c₁ c₂) x+
      (1+1/s)*value (programV d c₁ c₂) x) ≤ value (programJ d c₁ c₂) x) :
    L ≤ ‖Focus.quotient (x 0) (ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₁ (x 1))
      (ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₂ (x 2)) ζ‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hpa⟩ := ArmRationalForm.parameter_enclosure c₁ (x 0) (x 1) hx h₁
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hpb⟩ := ArmRationalForm.parameter_enclosure c₂ (x 0) (x 2) hx h₂
  have hp : x 0 ≤ ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₁ (x 1) := by
    rw [hpa]
    have := div_nonneg ha.1 hx.le
    linarith
  have hq : x 0 ≤ ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₂ (x 2) := by
    rw [hpb]
    have := div_nonneg hb.1 hx.le
    linarith
  apply ClassNormPolynomials.polynomial_certificate d (x 0) _ _ hd hx hp hq ζ hζ s L hs
  obtain ⟨hu,hv,hj⟩ := programs_sound d c₁ c₂ x hx
  rw [hu,hv,hj] at hcert
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (pow_pos (common_positive c₁ c₂ x hx) 4)).mp
  calc
    _ = L*((1+s)*(value (common c₁ c₂) x^4*U d (x 0) _ _)+
        (1+1/s)*(value (common c₁ c₂) x^4*V d (x 0) _ _)) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := hcert

#print axioms complexValue_add
#print axioms complexValue_sub
#print axioms complexValue_mul
#print axioms complexValue_star
#print axioms normValue
#print axioms normSq_scaled
#print axioms common_positive
#print axioms programs_sound
#print axioms polynomial_certificate
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedClassNorms

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0. -/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedArithmetic
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanArmRationalForm
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanClassNormPolynomials

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedClassPolynomials
open NestedArithmetic
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

abbrev P := Expr 3
def rat (q : ℚ) : P := .rational q
def y : P := .indet 0
def add (a b : P) : P := .plus a b
def sub (a b : P) : P := .plus a (.scaled (-1) b)
def mul (a b : P) : P := .times a b
def pow (a : P) (k : ℕ) : P := .pow a k
local infixl:65 " +ₚ " => add
local infixl:65 " -ₚ " => sub
local infixl:70 " *ₚ " => mul

/-- The class indices are precisely those of ArmClasses.parameter. -/
def armDen (c : Fin 5) : P :=
  if c.val=0 then rat 1 else if c.val=1 then y
  else if c.val=2 then pow y 2 +ₚ rat 1
  else if c.val=3 then pow y 3 +ₚ rat 2 *ₚ y
  else y *ₚ (pow y 4 +ₚ rat 3 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat 1) *ₚ
    (pow y 4 +ₚ rat 4 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat 3)

def armNum (c : Fin 5) (i : Fin 3) : P :=
  if c.val=0 then y else if c.val=1 then pow y 2 +ₚ rat 1
  else if c.val=2 then pow y 3 +ₚ rat 2 *ₚ y
  else if c.val=3 then pow y 4 +ₚ rat 3 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat 1
  else pow y 2 *ₚ (pow y 4 +ₚ rat 3 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat 1) *ₚ
    (pow y 4 +ₚ rat 4 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat 3) +ₚ
    (pow y 4 +ₚ rat 2 *ₚ pow y 2) *ₚ (pow y 4 +ₚ rat 4 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat 3) +ₚ .indet i

abbrev CP := P × P
def cadd (a b : CP) : CP := (a.1 +ₚ b.1,a.2 +ₚ b.2)
def csub (a b : CP) : CP := (a.1 -ₚ b.1,a.2 -ₚ b.2)
def cmul (a b : CP) : CP := (a.1 *ₚ b.1 -ₚ a.2 *ₚ b.2,a.1 *ₚ b.2 +ₚ a.2 *ₚ b.1)
def cstar (a : CP) : CP := (a.1,rat (-1) *ₚ a.2)
def cnorm (a : CP) : P := pow a.1 2 +ₚ pow a.2 2

def common (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : P := armDen c₁ *ₚ armDen c₂
def sumNum (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : P := armNum c₁ 1 *ₚ armDen c₂ +ₚ armNum c₂ 2 *ₚ armDen c₁
def prodNum (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : P := armNum c₁ 1 *ₚ armNum c₂ 2

def coeffA (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : CP :=
  (rat d *ₚ (prodNum c₁ c₂ -ₚ common c₁ c₂),rat (-d) *ₚ sumNum c₁ c₂)
def coeffB (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : CP :=
  (rat 2 *ₚ y *ₚ (rat (2-d) *ₚ (prodNum c₁ c₂ -ₚ common c₁ c₂) +ₚ rat 4 *ₚ common c₁ c₂) +ₚ rat d *ₚ sumNum c₁ c₂,
   (rat 2 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat d) *ₚ (prodNum c₁ c₂ -ₚ common c₁ c₂) +ₚ
      rat (2*d) *ₚ y *ₚ sumNum c₁ c₂ +ₚ rat 4 *ₚ pow y 2 *ₚ common c₁ c₂)
def coeffC (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : CP :=
  (rat d *ₚ (prodNum c₁ c₂ +ₚ common c₁ c₂),
   rat (-d) *ₚ (sumNum c₁ c₂ -ₚ y *ₚ common c₁ c₂))
def coeffE (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : CP :=
  (rat 2 *ₚ y *ₚ rat (2-d) *ₚ (prodNum c₁ c₂ +ₚ common c₁ c₂) +ₚ
      rat d *ₚ (sumNum c₁ c₂ -ₚ y *ₚ common c₁ c₂),
   (rat 2 *ₚ pow y 2 +ₚ rat d) *ₚ (prodNum c₁ c₂ +ₚ common c₁ c₂) +ₚ
      rat (2*d) *ₚ y *ₚ (sumNum c₁ c₂ -ₚ y *ₚ common c₁ c₂))

def programU (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : P :=
  cnorm (csub (cmul (coeffB d c₁ c₂) (cstar (coeffE d c₁ c₂)))
    (cmul (coeffA d c₁ c₂) (cstar (coeffC d c₁ c₂))))
def programV (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : P :=
  cnorm (csub (cmul (coeffA d c₁ c₂) (coeffE d c₁ c₂))
    (cmul (coeffB d c₁ c₂) (coeffC d c₁ c₂)))
def programJ (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) : P :=
  pow (cnorm (coeffB d c₁ c₂) -ₚ cnorm (coeffA d c₁ c₂)) 2

noncomputable section
def complexValue (a : CP) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℂ := ⟨value a.1 x,value a.2 x⟩

theorem armDen_sound (c : Fin 5) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    value (armDen c) x=ArmRationalForm.denominator c (x 0) := by
  fin_cases c <;> norm_num [armDen,ArmRationalForm.denominator,rat,y,add,mul,pow,value]

theorem armNum_sound (c : Fin 5) (i : Fin 3) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    value (armNum c i) x=ArmRationalForm.numerator c (x 0) (x i) := by
  fin_cases c <;> norm_num [armNum,ArmRationalForm.numerator,rat,y,add,mul,pow,value]

theorem armNum_cleared (c : Fin 5) (i : Fin 3) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hx : 0 < x 0) :
    value (armNum c i) x=value (armDen c) x*ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c (x i) := by
  rw [armDen_sound,armNum_sound,ArmRationalForm.parameter_identity c (x 0) (x i) hx]
  have h := ArmRationalForm.denominator_positive c (x 0) hx
  field_simp

theorem coefficients_sound (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hx : 0 < x 0) :
    let l := value (common c₁ c₂) x
    let p := ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₁ (x 1)
    let q := ArmClasses.parameter (x 0) c₂ (x 2)
    complexValue (coeffA d c₁ c₂) x=(l : ℂ)*ClassNormPolynomials.polyA d p q ∧
    complexValue (coeffB d c₁ c₂) x=(l : ℂ)*ClassNormPolynomials.polyB d (x 0) p q ∧
    complexValue (coeffC d c₁ c₂) x=(l : ℂ)*ClassNormPolynomials.polyC d (x 0) p q ∧
    complexValue (coeffE d c₁ c₂) x=(l : ℂ)*ClassNormPolynomials.polyE d (x 0) p q := by
  have h₁ := armNum_cleared c₁ 1 x hx
  have h₂ := armNum_cleared c₂ 2 x hx
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [complexValue,coeffA,common,prodNum,sumNum,
      rat,add,sub,mul,value,h₁,h₂,ClassNormPolynomials.polyA,
      Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
      Rat.cast_neg] <;> ring
  · constructor
    · apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [complexValue,coeffB,common,prodNum,sumNum,
        rat,y,add,sub,mul,pow,value,h₁,h₂,ClassNormPolynomials.polyB,
        Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
        Rat.cast_mul,Rat.cast_sub,Rat.cast_ofNat] <;> ring
    · constructor
      · apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [complexValue,coeffC,common,prodNum,sumNum,
          rat,y,add,sub,mul,value,h₁,h₂,ClassNormPolynomials.polyC,
          Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
          Rat.cast_neg] <;> ring
      · apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [complexValue,coeffE,common,prodNum,sumNum,
          rat,y,add,sub,mul,pow,value,h₁,h₂,ClassNormPolynomials.polyE,
          Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
          Rat.cast_mul,Rat.cast_sub,Rat.cast_ofNat] <;> ring

#print axioms armDen_sound
#print axioms armNum_sound
#print axioms armNum_cleared
#print axioms coefficients_sound
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedClassPolynomials

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Exact nested Horner certificates for complete parameter boxes.
No numerical sampling is used as a proof: the interpolation checker checks
degree bounds and a complete rational grid, and Bernstein positivity is proved.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTensorPolynomial

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedHorner
open Polynomial Set Finset
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

abbrev Poly : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℚ
  | n + 1 => List (Poly n)

def zero : (n : ℕ) → Poly n
  | 0 => 0
  | _ + 1 => []

def zipAdd {A : Type*} (f : A → A → A) : List A → List A → List A
  | [], q => q
  | p, [] => p
  | c :: p, d :: q => f c d :: zipAdd f p q

def add : {n : ℕ} → Poly n → Poly n → Poly n
  | 0, p, q => p + q
  | _ + 1, p, q => zipAdd add p q

def scale (c : ℚ) : {n : ℕ} → Poly n → Poly n
  | 0, p => c * p
  | _ + 1, p => p.map (scale c)

noncomputable def eval : {n : ℕ} → Poly n → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0, p, _ => p
  | _ + 1, p, x => p.foldr (fun c z => eval c (fun i => x i.succ) + x 0 * z) 0

@[simp] theorem eval_nil {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : eval ([] : Poly (n+1)) x = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem eval_cons {n : ℕ} (c : Poly n) (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    eval (c :: p) x = eval c (fun i => x i.succ) + x 0 * eval p x := rfl

@[simp] theorem eval_zero (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : eval (zero n) x = 0 := by
  cases n <;> simp [zero, eval]

theorem eval_add {n : ℕ} (p q : Poly n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (add p q) x = eval p x + eval q x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [add, eval]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p generalizing q with
    | nil => simp [add, zipAdd]
    | cons c p hp =>
      cases q with
      | nil => simp [add, zipAdd]
      | cons d q =>
        change eval (add c d) (fun i => x i.succ) + x 0 * eval (add p q) x = _
        rw [ih, hp]
        simp only [eval_cons]
        ring

theorem eval_scale (c : ℚ) {n : ℕ} (p : Poly n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (scale c p) x = (c : ℝ) * eval p x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [scale, eval]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => simp [scale]
    | cons d p hp =>
      simp only [scale, List.map_cons, eval_cons] at *
      rw [ih, hp]
      ring

def pointValue {n : ℕ} : Poly (n+1) → ℚ → Poly n
  | [], _ => zero n
  | c :: p, t => add c (scale t (pointValue p t))

theorem pointValue_sound {n : ℕ} (p : Poly (n+1)) (t : ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (pointValue p t) x = eval p (Fin.cons (t : ℝ) x) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [pointValue]
  | cons c p ih => simp only [pointValue, eval_add, eval_scale, eval_cons, Fin.cons_succ,
      Fin.cons_zero, ih]

noncomputable def parameterPolynomial {n : ℕ} : Poly (n+1) → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ[X]
  | [], _ => 0
  | c :: p, x => C (eval c x) + X * parameterPolynomial p x

theorem parameterPolynomial_eval {n : ℕ} (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (parameterPolynomial p x).eval t = eval p (Fin.cons t x) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [parameterPolynomial]
  | cons c p ih => simp only [parameterPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ih, eval_cons, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero]

theorem parameterPolynomial_degree {n : ℕ} (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (parameterPolynomial p x).natDegree ≤ p.length - 1 := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [parameterPolynomial]
  | cons c p ih =>
    cases p with
    | nil => simp [parameterPolynomial]
    | cons d ds =>
      have hm := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (p := (X : ℝ[X])) (q := parameterPolynomial (d :: ds) x)
      have ha := Polynomial.natDegree_add_le (C (eval c x)) (X * parameterPolynomial (d :: ds) x)
      simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_X, Polynomial.natDegree_C, max_eq_right (Nat.zero_le _)] at ha hm
      change (C (eval c x) + X * parameterPolynomial (d :: ds) x).natDegree ≤ _
      simp only [List.length_cons] at ih ⊢
      omega

def affineCheck : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → Poly n → Poly n → (Fin n → ℚ) → (Fin n → ℚ) → Bool
  | 0, _, p, a, _, _ => decide (a = p)
  | n+1, d, p, a, l, w => decide (p.length ≤ d 0 + 1 ∧ a.length ≤ d 0 + 1 ∧
      ∀ k : Fin (d 0 + 1), affineCheck n (fun i => d i.succ)
        (pointValue p (l 0 + w 0 * k.val)) (pointValue a k.val)
        (fun i => l i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ) = true)

noncomputable section
theorem affineCheck_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p a : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hc : affineCheck n d p a l w = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval a x = eval p (fun i => (l i : ℝ) + (w i : ℝ) * x i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h : a = p := of_decide_eq_true hc
    subst a
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hp, ha, hs⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
    let inner : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (l i.succ : ℝ) + (w i.succ : ℝ) * x i.succ
    let linear : ℝ[X] := C (l 0 : ℝ) + C (w 0 : ℝ) * X
    have hP : (parameterPolynomial p inner).natDegree ≤ d 0 := by
      have := parameterPolynomial_degree p inner
      omega
    have hA : (parameterPolynomial a (fun i => x i.succ)).natDegree ≤ d 0 := by
      have := parameterPolynomial_degree a (fun i => x i.succ)
      omega
    have hlin : linear.natDegree ≤ 1 := by dsimp [linear]; compute_degree
    have hcomp : ((parameterPolynomial p inner).comp linear).natDegree ≤ d 0 := by
      have h := Polynomial.natDegree_comp_le (p := parameterPolynomial p inner) (q := linear)
      exact h.trans (by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul hP hlin)
    have he : parameterPolynomial a (fun i => x i.succ) = (parameterPolynomial p inner).comp linear := by
      apply Polynomial.eq_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq _ _
        (f := fun k : Fin (d 0 + 1) => (k.val : ℝ))
      · intro i j h
        apply Fin.ext
        change (i.val : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) at h
        exact_mod_cast h
      · intro k
        have h := ih _ _ _ _ _ (hs k) (fun i => x i.succ)
        rw [pointValue_sound, pointValue_sound] at h
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_comp, linear, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_C,
          Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, parameterPolynomial_eval]
        simpa only [Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_natCast] using h
      · simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
        omega
    have h := congrArg (fun z : ℝ[X] => z.eval (x 0)) he
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_comp, linear, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, parameterPolynomial_eval] at h
    convert h using 1
    · congr 1
      exact (Fin.cons_self_tail x).symm
    · congr 1
      ext i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

end
def coefficientFrom {n : ℕ} (D j : ℕ) : ℕ → Poly (n+1) → Poly n
  | _, [] => zero n
  | k, c :: p => add (if k ≤ j then scale (Nat.fast_choose (D-k) (j-k)) c else zero n)
      (coefficientFrom D j (k+1) p)

def positiveCheck : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → Poly n → Bool
  | 0, _, p => decide (0 ≤ p)
  | n+1, d, p => decide (p.length ≤ d 0 + 1 ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (d 0 + 1), positiveCheck n (fun i => d i.succ) (coefficientFrom (d 0) j.val 0 p) = true)

noncomputable section
theorem coefficientFrom_cons {n : ℕ} (D j k : ℕ) (c : Poly n) (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (coefficientFrom D j k (c :: p)) x =
      (if k ≤ j then (Nat.choose (D-k) (j-k) : ℝ) else 0) * eval c x +
        eval (coefficientFrom D j (k+1) p) x := by
  by_cases h : k ≤ j <;> simp [coefficientFrom, h, eval_add, eval_scale, ← Nat.choose_eq_fast_choose]

theorem representation {n : ℕ} (D : ℕ) (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (hp : k + p.length ≤ D+1) :
    t ^ k * eval p (Fin.cons t x) = ∑ j : Fin (D+1),
      eval (coefficientFrom D j.val k p) x * (t ^ j.val * (1-t) ^ (D-j.val)) := by
  induction p generalizing k with
  | nil => simp [coefficientFrom]
  | cons c p ih =>
    have hk : k ≤ D := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hp; omega
    have hr := ih (k+1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hp; omega)
    have ht : t ^ k = ∑ j : Fin (D+1),
        (if k ≤ j.val then (Nat.choose (D-k) (j.val-k) : ℝ) else 0) *
          (t ^ j.val * (1-t) ^ (D-j.val)) := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ => (if k ≤ j then (Nat.choose (D-k) (j-k) : ℝ) else 0) * (t ^ j * (1-t) ^ (D-j))) (D+1)]
      simpa only [ite_mul, zero_mul, mul_assoc] using TensorPolynomial.power_expansion D k hk t
    calc
      _ = eval c x * t ^ k + t ^ (k+1) * eval p (Fin.cons t x) := by
        simp only [eval_cons, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero, pow_succ]
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [ht, hr, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        rw [coefficientFrom_cons]
        ring

theorem positiveCheck_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n)
    (hc : positiveCheck n d p = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ eval p x := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc : (0 : ℚ) ≤ p)
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hp, hs⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
    have he := representation (d 0) p (fun i => x i.succ) (x 0) 0 (by omega)
    have hvec : Fin.cons (x 0) (fun i => x i.succ) = x := by
      ext i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, hvec] at he
    rw [he]
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro j _
    apply mul_nonneg (ih _ _ (hs j) _ (fun i => hx i.succ))
    exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hx 0).1 _) (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx 0).2) _)

#print axioms eval_add
#print axioms pointValue_sound
#print axioms affineCheck_sound
#print axioms representation
#print axioms positiveCheck_sound
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedHorner

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Uniform exact box margins and reciprocal ordinate coordinates.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedHorner
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanHornerCertificates

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedHorner
open Set
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def margin {n : ℕ} (u v j : Poly n) (L s : ℚ) : Poly n :=
  add j (scale (-L) (add (scale (1+s) u) (scale (1+1/s) v)))

theorem eval_margin {n : ℕ} (u v j : Poly n) (L s : ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (margin u v j L s) x = eval j x - (L : ℝ) *
      ((1+(s : ℝ)) * eval u x + (1+1/(s : ℝ)) * eval v x) := by
  simp only [margin, eval_add, eval_scale, Rat.cast_neg, Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_div]
  ring

theorem box_margin_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (u v j a : Poly n)
    (L s : ℚ) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (ha : affineCheck n d (margin u v j L s) a l w = true)
    (hb : positiveCheck n d a = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (l i : ℝ) ((l i : ℝ)+w i)) :
    0 ≤ eval j x - (L : ℝ) * ((1+(s : ℝ)) * eval u x + (1+1/(s : ℝ)) * eval v x) := by
  let t : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (x i - (l i : ℝ)) / (w i : ℝ)
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) < w i := by exact_mod_cast hw i
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx i).1) hi.le
    · apply (div_le_one hi).mpr
      linarith [(hx i).2]
  have h := positiveCheck_sound n d a hb t ht
  rw [affineCheck_sound n d _ _ _ _ ha, eval_margin] at h
  have he : (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*t i) = x := by
    ext i
    have hi : (w i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast hw i)
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
    ring
  simpa only [he] using h

def reverseLast : (n : ℕ) → ℕ → Poly n → Poly n
  | 0, _, p => p
  | 1, M, p => (p ++ List.replicate (M+1-p.length) 0).reverse
  | n+2, M, p => p.map (reverseLast (n+1) M)

theorem box_scaled_margin_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (u v j a : Poly n)
    (K L s : ℚ) (hK : 0 < K) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (ha : affineCheck n d (scale K (margin u v j L s)) a l w = true)
    (hb : positiveCheck n d a = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (l i : ℝ) ((l i : ℝ)+w i)) :
    0 ≤ eval j x-(L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*eval u x+(1+1/(s : ℝ))*eval v x) := by
  let t : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (x i-(l i : ℝ))/(w i : ℝ)
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) < w i := by exact_mod_cast hw i
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx i).1) hi.le
    · apply (div_le_one hi).mpr
      linarith [(hx i).2]
  have h := positiveCheck_sound n d a hb t ht
  rw [affineCheck_sound n d _ _ _ _ ha, eval_scale, eval_margin] at h
  have he : (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*t i) = x := by
    ext i
    have hi : (w i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast hw i)
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he] at h
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h (by exact_mod_cast hK)

def lastBound : (n : ℕ) → ℕ → Poly n → Bool
  | 0, _, _ => true
  | 1, M, p => decide (p.length ≤ M+1)
  | n+2, M, p => p.all (lastBound (n+1) M)

noncomputable def lastValue : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | 1, x => x 0
  | _+2, x => lastValue (fun i => x i.succ)

noncomputable def inverseLast : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ)
  | 0, x => x
  | 1, x => fun _ => 1 / x 0
  | _+2, x => Fin.cons (x 0) (inverseLast (fun i => x i.succ))

theorem univariate_eval (p : Poly 1) (x : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    eval p x = HornerCertificates.evaluate p (x 0) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => change (0 : ℝ) = HornerCertificates.evaluate [] (x 0); simp
  | cons c p ih =>
    change (c : ℝ)+x 0*eval p x = _
    rw [ih, HornerCertificates.evaluate_cons]

private theorem evaluate_zeros (m : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    HornerCertificates.evaluate (List.replicate m 0) y = 0 := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, ih]

theorem reverseLast_sound (n M : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (hb : lastBound n M p = true)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : 0 < lastValue x) :
    lastValue x ^ M * eval (reverseLast n M p) (inverseLast x) = eval p x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [lastValue, reverseLast, inverseLast]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hp : p.length ≤ M+1 := of_decide_eq_true hb
      let pad := p ++ List.replicate (M+1-p.length) 0
      have hlen : pad.length = M+1 := by dsimp [pad]; simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate]; omega
      have hev (y : ℝ) : HornerCertificates.evaluate pad y = HornerCertificates.evaluate p y := by
        simp [pad, HornerCertificates.evaluate_append, evaluate_zeros]
      have h := HornerCertificates.reverse_scaled pad (x 0) (show x 0 ≠ 0 from hy.ne')
      rw [hlen, hev] at h
      simp only [lastValue, reverseLast, univariate_eval, inverseLast]
      change x 0 ^ M * HornerCertificates.evaluate pad.reverse (1/x 0) = _
      rw [pow_succ] at h
      have hy0 : 0 < x 0 := hy
      nlinarith
    | succ n =>
      induction p with
      | nil => change lastValue x ^ M * 0 = 0; ring
      | cons c p hp =>
        have hparts : lastBound (n+1) M c = true ∧ p.all (lastBound (n+1) M) = true := by
          simpa only [lastBound, List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] using hb
        have hc := ih c hparts.1 (fun i => x i.succ) hy
        have hr := hp hparts.2
        change lastValue (fun i => x i.succ) ^ M *
            (eval (reverseLast (n+1) M c) (inverseLast (fun i => x i.succ)) +
              x 0 * eval (reverseLast (n+2) M p) (inverseLast x)) =
            eval c (fun i => x i.succ) + x 0 * eval p x
        calc
          _ = lastValue (fun i => x i.succ) ^ M * eval (reverseLast (n+1) M c) (inverseLast (fun i => x i.succ)) +
              x 0 * (lastValue x ^ M * eval (reverseLast (n+2) M p) (inverseLast x)) := by
            change _ = lastValue (fun i => x i.succ) ^ M * _ + x 0 * (lastValue (fun i => x i.succ) ^ M * _)
            ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hc, hr]


theorem reverse_margin_sound (n M : ℕ) (u v j : Poly n)
    (hu : lastBound n M u = true) (hv : lastBound n M v = true) (hj : lastBound n M j = true)
    (L s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : 0 < lastValue x)
    (h : 0 ≤ eval (reverseLast n M j) (inverseLast x) - L *
      ((1+s)*eval (reverseLast n M u) (inverseLast x) +
        (1+1/s)*eval (reverseLast n M v) (inverseLast x))) :
    0 ≤ eval j x-L*((1+s)*eval u x+(1+1/s)*eval v x) := by
  have hU := reverseLast_sound n M u hu x hy
  have hV := reverseLast_sound n M v hv x hy
  have hJ := reverseLast_sound n M j hj x hy
  have hp := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hy.le M) h
  have he : lastValue x ^ M * (eval (reverseLast n M j) (inverseLast x)-L*
      ((1+s)*eval (reverseLast n M u) (inverseLast x)+(1+1/s)*eval (reverseLast n M v) (inverseLast x))) =
      eval j x-L*((1+s)*eval u x+(1+1/s)*eval v x) := by
    calc
      _ = lastValue x ^ M * eval (reverseLast n M j) (inverseLast x)-L*
          ((1+s)*(lastValue x ^ M * eval (reverseLast n M u) (inverseLast x))+
            (1+1/s)*(lastValue x ^ M * eval (reverseLast n M v) (inverseLast x))) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hU, hV, hJ]
  rwa [he] at hp

#print axioms box_margin_sound
#print axioms reverseLast_sound
#print axioms reverse_margin_sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedHorner

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Exact affine substitution by polynomial arithmetic. The supplied transformed
coefficients are compared with a proved recursive transformation in the kernel.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedHornerCells
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedHorner
open Set
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def polyDecidableEq (n : ℕ) : DecidableEq (Poly n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq ℚ)
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    exact inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (List (Poly n)))

def affineOuter {n : ℕ} (l w : ℚ) : Poly (n+1) → Poly (n+1)
  | [] => []
  | c :: p =>
    let q := affineOuter l w p
    add [c] (add (scale l q) (zero n :: scale w q))

def affineAll : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → (Fin n → ℚ) → (Fin n → ℚ) → Poly n
  | 0, p, _, _ => p
  | n+1, p, l, w => affineOuter (l 0) (w 0)
      (p.map (fun c => affineAll n c (fun i => l i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ)))

def affineCheckFast (n : ℕ) (p a : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ) : Bool :=
  @decide (a = affineAll n p l w) (polyDecidableEq n a (affineAll n p l w))

def powerCheck : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → Bool
  | 0, p => decide (0 ≤ p)
  | n+1, p => p.all (powerCheck n)

def positiveCheckCombined (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n) : Bool :=
  powerCheck n p || positiveCheck n d p

theorem powerCheck_sound (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (hc : powerCheck n p = true)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) : 0 ≤ eval p x := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc : (0 : ℚ) ≤ p)
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => exact le_rfl
    | cons c p hp =>
      have hh : powerCheck n c = true ∧ p.all (powerCheck n) = true := by
        simpa only [powerCheck, List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] using hc
      change 0 ≤ eval c (fun i => x i.succ)+x 0*eval p x
      exact add_nonneg (ih c hh.1 _ (fun i => hx i.succ)) (mul_nonneg (hx 0) (hp hh.2))

theorem positiveCheckCombined_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n)
    (hc : positiveCheckCombined n d p = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ eval p x := by
  have hh : powerCheck n p = true ∨ positiveCheck n d p = true := by
    simpa only [positiveCheckCombined, Bool.or_eq_true] using hc
  rcases hh with hp | hb
  · exact powerCheck_sound n p hp x (fun i => (hx i).1)
  · exact positiveCheck_sound n d p hb x hx

theorem affineOuter_sound {n : ℕ} (l w : ℚ) (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    eval (affineOuter l w p) x = eval p (Fin.cons ((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0) (fun i => x i.succ)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c p ih =>
    change eval (add [c] (add (scale l (affineOuter l w p)) (zero n :: scale w (affineOuter l w p)))) x = _
    rw [eval_add, eval_add, eval_scale]
    have hc : eval ([c] : Poly (n+1)) x = eval c (fun i => x i.succ) := by
      change eval c (fun i => x i.succ)+x 0*0 = _
      ring
    have hz : eval (zero n :: scale w (affineOuter l w p)) x = x 0*eval (scale w (affineOuter l w p)) x := by
      change eval (zero n) (fun i => x i.succ)+x 0*eval (scale w (affineOuter l w p)) x = _
      rw [eval_zero, zero_add]
    rw [hc, hz, eval_scale, ih]
    change _ = eval c (fun i => x i.succ)+((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)*eval p (Fin.cons _ _)
    ring

theorem eval_map {n : ℕ} (f : Poly n → Poly n) (p : Poly (n+1))
    (x y : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (h : ∀ c, eval (f c) x = eval c y) :
    eval (p.map f) (Fin.cons t x) = eval p (Fin.cons t y) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c p ih =>
    change eval (f c) x+t*eval (p.map f) (Fin.cons t x) = eval c y+t*eval p (Fin.cons t y)
    rw [h, ih]

theorem affineAll_sound (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval (affineAll n p l w) x = eval p (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [affineAll, affineOuter_sound]
    rw [eval_map _ p (fun i => x i.succ)
      (fun i => (l i.succ : ℝ)+(w i.succ : ℝ)*x i.succ) _ (fun c => ih c _ _ _)]
    congr 1
    ext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

theorem affineCheckFast_sound (n : ℕ) (p a : Poly n) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (h : affineCheckFast n p a l w = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    eval a x = eval p (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i) := by
  let _ : DecidableEq (Poly n) := polyDecidableEq n
  have he : a = affineAll n p l w := of_decide_eq_true h
  rw [he, affineAll_sound]

theorem box_scaled_margin_fast_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (u v j a : Poly n)
    (K L s : ℚ) (hK : 0 < K) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (ha : affineCheckFast n (scale K (margin u v j L s)) a l w = true)
    (hb : positiveCheckCombined n d a = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (l i : ℝ) ((l i : ℝ)+w i)) :
    0 ≤ eval j x-(L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*eval u x+(1+1/(s : ℝ))*eval v x) := by
  let t : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (x i-(l i : ℝ))/(w i : ℝ)
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) < w i := by exact_mod_cast hw i
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx i).1) hi.le
    · apply (div_le_one hi).mpr
      linarith [(hx i).2]
  have h := positiveCheckCombined_sound n d a hb t ht
  rw [affineCheckFast_sound n _ _ _ _ ha, eval_scale, eval_margin] at h
  have he : (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*t i) = x := by
    ext i
    have hi : (w i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast hw i)
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he] at h
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h (by exact_mod_cast hK)

#print axioms affineOuter_sound
#print axioms affineAll_sound
#print axioms affineCheckFast_sound
#print axioms positiveCheckCombined_sound
#print axioms box_scaled_margin_fast_sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedHorner

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Integer-only Bernstein arithmetic after exact positive denominator clearing.
Its acceptance theorem is reduced to the proved rational checker.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedHornerTransform
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedInteger
open Set
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
abbrev Poly : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℤ
  | n+1 => List (Poly n)
def zero : (n : ℕ) → Poly n
  | 0 => 0
  | _+1 => []
def add : {n : ℕ} → Poly n → Poly n → Poly n
  | 0, p, q => p+q
  | _+1, p, q => NestedHorner.zipAdd add p q
def scale (c : ℤ) : {n : ℕ} → Poly n → Poly n
  | 0, p => c*p
  | _+1, p => p.map (scale c)
def castPoly : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → NestedHorner.Poly n
  | 0, p => (p : ℚ)
  | n+1, p => p.map (castPoly n)

theorem cast_zero (n : ℕ) : castPoly n (zero n) = NestedHorner.zero n := by
  cases n <;> simp [castPoly, zero, NestedHorner.zero]
theorem cast_add {n : ℕ} (p q : Poly n) :
    castPoly n (add p q) = NestedHorner.add (castPoly n p) (castPoly n q) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [castPoly, add, NestedHorner.add]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p generalizing q with
    | nil => simp [castPoly, add, NestedHorner.add, NestedHorner.zipAdd]
    | cons c p hp =>
      cases q with
      | nil => simp [castPoly, add, NestedHorner.add, NestedHorner.zipAdd]
      | cons d q =>
        change castPoly n (add c d) :: castPoly (n+1) (add p q) =
          NestedHorner.add (castPoly n c) (castPoly n d) :: NestedHorner.add (castPoly (n+1) p) (castPoly (n+1) q)
        rw [ih, hp]
theorem cast_scale (c : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (p : Poly n) :
    castPoly n (scale c p) = NestedHorner.scale (c : ℚ) (castPoly n p) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [castPoly, scale, NestedHorner.scale]
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons d p hp =>
      change castPoly n (scale c d) :: castPoly (n+1) (scale c p) =
        NestedHorner.scale (c : ℚ) (castPoly n d) :: NestedHorner.scale (c : ℚ) (castPoly (n+1) p)
      rw [ih, hp]

def coefficientFrom {n : ℕ} (D j : ℕ) : ℕ → Poly (n+1) → Poly n
  | _, [] => zero n
  | k, c :: p => add (if k ≤ j then scale (Nat.fast_choose (D-k) (j-k)) c else zero n)
      (coefficientFrom D j (k+1) p)
theorem cast_coefficientFrom {n : ℕ} (D j k : ℕ) (p : Poly (n+1)) :
    castPoly n (coefficientFrom D j k p) = NestedHorner.coefficientFrom D j k (castPoly (n+1) p) := by
  induction p generalizing k with
  | nil => simp [coefficientFrom, castPoly, NestedHorner.coefficientFrom, cast_zero]
  | cons c p ih =>
    by_cases h : k ≤ j
    · simp only [coefficientFrom, castPoly, List.map_cons, NestedHorner.coefficientFrom, if_pos h,
        cast_add, cast_scale, Int.cast_natCast, ih]
    · simp only [coefficientFrom, castPoly, List.map_cons, NestedHorner.coefficientFrom, if_neg h,
        cast_add, cast_zero, ih]

def bernsteinCheck : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → Poly n → Bool
  | 0, _, p => decide (0 ≤ p)
  | n+1, d, p => decide (p.length ≤ d 0+1 ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (d 0+1), bernsteinCheck n (fun i => d i.succ) (coefficientFrom (d 0) j.val 0 p) = true)
def powerCheck : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → Bool
  | 0, p => decide (0 ≤ p)
  | n+1, p => p.all (powerCheck n)
def accepts (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n) : Bool := powerCheck n p || bernsteinCheck n d p

theorem bernsteinCheck_to_rational (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n)
    (hc : bernsteinCheck n d p = true) : NestedHorner.positiveCheck n d (castPoly n p) = true := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    apply decide_eq_true
    change (0 : ℚ) ≤ (p : ℚ)
    exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc : (0 : ℤ) ≤ p)
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hp, hs⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
    apply decide_eq_true
    refine ⟨by simpa only [castPoly, List.length_map] using hp, ?_⟩
    intro j
    have h := ih _ _ (hs j)
    rwa [cast_coefficientFrom] at h

theorem powerCheck_sound (n : ℕ) (p : Poly n) (hc : powerCheck n p = true)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) : 0 ≤ NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n p) x := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p : ℚ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hc : (0 : ℤ) ≤ p)
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => exact le_rfl
    | cons c p hp =>
      have hh : powerCheck n c = true ∧ p.all (powerCheck n) = true := by
        simpa only [powerCheck, List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] using hc
      change 0 ≤ NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ)+x 0*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) p) x
      exact add_nonneg (ih c hh.1 _ (fun i => hx i.succ)) (mul_nonneg (hx 0) (hp hh.2))

theorem accepts_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n) (hc : accepts n d p = true)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n p) x := by
  have hh : powerCheck n p = true ∨ bernsteinCheck n d p = true := by simpa only [accepts, Bool.or_eq_true] using hc
  rcases hh with hp | hb
  · exact powerCheck_sound n p hp x (fun i => (hx i).1)
  · exact NestedHorner.positiveCheck_sound n d _ (bernsteinCheck_to_rational n d p hb) x hx

theorem box_scaled_margin_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (u v j : NestedHorner.Poly n) (a : Poly n)
    (K L s : ℚ) (hK : 0 < K) (l w : Fin n → ℚ)
    (ha : NestedHorner.affineCheckFast n (NestedHorner.scale K (NestedHorner.margin u v j L s)) (castPoly n a) l w = true)
    (hb : accepts n d a = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc (l i : ℝ) ((l i : ℝ)+w i)) :
    0 ≤ NestedHorner.eval j x-(L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*NestedHorner.eval u x+(1+1/(s : ℝ))*NestedHorner.eval v x) := by
  let t : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (x i-(l i : ℝ))/(w i : ℝ)
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) < w i := by exact_mod_cast hw i
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx i).1) hi.le
    · apply (div_le_one hi).mpr
      linarith [(hx i).2]
  have h := accepts_sound n d a hb t ht
  rw [NestedHorner.affineCheckFast_sound n _ _ _ _ ha, NestedHorner.eval_scale, NestedHorner.eval_margin] at h
  have he : (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*t i) = x := by
    ext i
    have hi : (w i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast hw i)
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he] at h
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h (by exact_mod_cast hK)

#print axioms cast_coefficientFrom
#print axioms bernsteinCheck_to_rational
#print axioms accepts_sound
#print axioms box_scaled_margin_sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedInteger

/- Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Exact affine substitution with integer denominator clearing at every coordinate.
The checker never approximates, truncates, or samples a polynomial.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedInteger
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedInteger
open Set
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def clearedOuter {n : ℕ} (l w D : ℤ) : Poly (n+1) → Poly (n+1)
  | [] => []
  | c :: p =>
    let q := clearedOuter l w D p
    add [scale (D^p.length) c] (add (scale l q) (zero n :: scale w q))
def clearedAll : (n : ℕ) → Poly n → (Fin n → ℤ) → (Fin n → ℤ) → (Fin n → ℤ) → Poly n
  | 0, p, _, _, _ => p
  | n+1, p, l, w, D => clearedOuter (l 0) (w 0) (D 0)
      (p.map (fun c => clearedAll n c (fun i => l i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ) (fun i => D i.succ)))
def rectangular : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → Poly n → Bool
  | 0, _, _ => true
  | n+1, d, p => decide (p.length=d 0+1) && p.all (rectangular n (fun i => d i.succ))
def factor : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin n → ℤ) → ℤ
  | 0, _, _ => 1
  | n+1, d, D => D 0 ^ d 0 * factor n (fun i => d i.succ) (fun i => D i.succ)

theorem factor_pos (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (D : Fin n → ℤ) (hD : ∀ i, 0 < D i) :
    0 < factor n d D := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Int.zero_lt_one
  | succ n ih => exact mul_pos (pow_pos (hD 0) _) (ih _ _ (fun i => hD i.succ))

theorem clearedOuter_cons {n : ℕ} (l w D : ℤ) (c : Poly n) (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter l w D (c::p))) x =
      (D : ℝ)^p.length*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ)+
      ((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter l w D p)) x := by
  change NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (add [scale (D^p.length) c]
    (add (scale l (clearedOuter l w D p)) (zero n :: scale w (clearedOuter l w D p))))) x = _
  rw [cast_add, cast_add, NestedHorner.eval_add, NestedHorner.eval_add, cast_scale, NestedHorner.eval_scale]
  change NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n (scale (D^p.length) c)) (fun i => x i.succ)+x 0*0+
    (((l : ℚ) : ℝ)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter l w D p)) x+
    (NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n (zero n)) (fun i => x i.succ)+
      x 0*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (scale w (clearedOuter l w D p))) x)) = _
  rw [cast_scale, cast_scale, cast_zero, NestedHorner.eval_zero, NestedHorner.eval_scale, NestedHorner.eval_scale]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem clearedOuter_sound {n : ℕ} (l w D : ℤ) (p : Poly (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    (D : ℝ)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter l w D p)) x =
      (D : ℝ)^p.length*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) p)
        (Fin.cons (((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)/(D : ℝ)) (fun i => x i.succ)) := by
  have hD0 : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD
  induction p with
  | nil => change (D : ℝ)*0=(D : ℝ)^0*0; ring
  | cons c p ih =>
    rw [clearedOuter_cons]
    change (D : ℝ)*((D : ℝ)^p.length*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ)+
      ((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter l w D p)) x) =
      (D : ℝ)^(p.length+1)*(NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ)+
        (((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)/(D : ℝ))*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) p) (Fin.cons _ _))
    calc
      _ = (D : ℝ)^p.length*(D : ℝ)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) (fun i => x i.succ)+
          ((l : ℝ)+(w : ℝ)*x 0)*((D : ℝ)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter l w D p)) x) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [ih, pow_succ]; field_simp

theorem eval_map_scaled {n : ℕ} (f : Poly n → Poly n) (p : Poly (n+1))
    (x y : Fin n → ℝ) (t K : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ c ∈ p, NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n (f c)) x=K*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) y) :
    NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (p.map f)) (Fin.cons t x) =
      K*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) p) (Fin.cons t y) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => change 0=K*0; ring
  | cons c p ih =>
    have hc := h c (by simp)
    have hp := ih (fun c hc => h c (by simp [hc]))
    change NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n (f c)) x+t*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (p.map f)) (Fin.cons t x) =
      K*(NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n c) y+t*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) p) (Fin.cons t y))
    rw [hc,hp]
    ring

theorem clearedAll_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n) (l w D : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hr : rectangular n d p=true) (hD : ∀ i, D i ≠ 0) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n (clearedAll n p l w D)) x =
      (factor n d D : ℝ)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly n p)
        (fun i => ((l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i)/(D i : ℝ)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [clearedAll, factor, castPoly, NestedHorner.eval]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hb : decide (p.length=d 0+1)=true ∧ p.all (rectangular n (fun i => d i.succ))=true := by
      simpa only [rectangular, Bool.and_eq_true] using hr
    have hlen : p.length=d 0+1 := of_decide_eq_true hb.1
    have hs : ∀ c ∈ p, rectangular n (fun i => d i.succ) c=true := by
      simpa only [List.all_eq_true] using hb.2
    let f := fun c => clearedAll n c (fun i => l i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ) (fun i => D i.succ)
    have h := clearedOuter_sound (l 0) (w 0) (D 0) (p.map f) x (hD 0)
    rw [List.length_map, hlen, pow_succ] at h
    have hD0 : (D 0 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD 0
    have he : NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedAll (n+1) p l w D)) x =
        (D 0 : ℝ)^d 0*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (p.map f))
          (Fin.cons (((l 0 : ℝ)+(w 0 : ℝ)*x 0)/(D 0 : ℝ)) (fun i => x i.succ)) := by
      apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hD0)
      change (D 0 : ℝ)*NestedHorner.eval (castPoly (n+1) (clearedOuter (l 0) (w 0) (D 0) (p.map f))) x = _
      rw [h]
      ring
    rw [he, eval_map_scaled f p _ _ _ (factor n (fun i => d i.succ) (fun i => D i.succ) : ℝ)
      (fun c hc => ih _ c _ _ _ (hs c hc) (fun i => hD i.succ) _)]
    simp only [factor, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 2

theorem box_cleared_margin_sound (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (u v j : NestedHorner.Poly n) (a raw : Poly n)
    (K L s : ℚ) (hK : 0 < K) (l w D : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hraw : castPoly n raw=NestedHorner.scale K (NestedHorner.margin u v j L s))
    (hr : rectangular n d raw=true) (ha : a=clearedAll n raw l w D)
    (hb : accepts n d a=true) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hD : ∀ i, 0 < D i)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Icc ((l i : ℝ)/(D i : ℝ)) (((l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ))/(D i : ℝ))) :
    0 ≤ NestedHorner.eval j x-(L : ℝ)*((1+(s : ℝ))*NestedHorner.eval u x+(1+1/(s : ℝ))*NestedHorner.eval v x) := by
  let t : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ((D i : ℝ)*x i-(l i : ℝ))/(w i : ℝ)
  have ht : ∀ i, t i ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro i
    have hw0 : (0 : ℝ) < w i := by exact_mod_cast hw i
    have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D i := by exact_mod_cast hD i
    have hl := (div_le_iff₀ hD0).mp (hx i).1
    have hu := (le_div_iff₀ hD0).mp (hx i).2
    constructor
    · apply div_nonneg _ hw0.le
      nlinarith
    · apply (div_le_one hw0).mpr
      nlinarith
  have he := clearedAll_sound n d raw l w D hr (fun i => (hD i).ne') t
  rw [← ha] at he
  have h := accepts_sound n d a hb t ht
  rw [he] at h
  have hvec : (fun i => ((l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*t i)/(D i : ℝ))=x := by
    ext i
    have hwi : (w i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hw i).ne'
    have hDi : (D i : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hD i).ne'
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hvec,hraw,NestedHorner.eval_scale,NestedHorner.eval_margin] at h
  have hfactor : (0 : ℝ) < factor n d D := by exact_mod_cast factor_pos n d D hD
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right (nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h hfactor) (by exact_mod_cast hK)

#print axioms clearedOuter_sound
#print axioms clearedAll_sound
#print axioms box_cleared_margin_sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedInteger

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedHorner

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedPositiveScale
open NestedHorner
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem scale_add (n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (p q : Poly n) :
    scale c (add p q)=add (scale c p) (scale c q) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [scale,add]; ring
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p generalizing q with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a p hp =>
      cases q with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b q =>
        simp only [scale,add,zipAdd,List.map_cons]
        rw [ih]
        congr 1
        exact hp q

theorem scale_scale (n : ℕ) (c d : ℚ) (p : Poly n) :
    scale c (scale d p)=scale (c*d) p := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [scale]; ring
  | succ n ih =>
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a p hp =>
      simp only [scale,List.map_cons]
      rw [ih]
      congr 1

theorem scale_zero (n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) : scale c (zero n)=zero n := by
  cases n <;> simp [zero,scale]

theorem coefficientFrom_scale {n : ℕ} (D j k : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (p : Poly (n+1)) :
    coefficientFrom D j k (scale c p)=scale c (coefficientFrom D j k p) := by
  induction p generalizing k with
  | nil => simp [scale,coefficientFrom,scale_zero]
  | cons a p hp =>
    simp only [scale] at hp
    simp only [scale,List.map_cons,coefficientFrom]
    rw [scale_add,hp]
    by_cases h : k ≤ j
    · simp only [if_pos h,scale_scale]
      rw [mul_comm (Nat.fast_choose (D-k) (j-k) : ℚ) c]
    · simp only [if_neg h,scale_zero]

theorem positiveCheck_scale (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (p : Poly n)
    (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hp : positiveCheck n d p=true) :
    positiveCheck n d (scale c p)=true := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    apply decide_eq_true
    exact mul_nonneg hc (of_decide_eq_true hp)
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hlen,hcoeff⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hp
    apply decide_eq_true
    refine ⟨by simpa only [scale,List.length_map] using hlen,?_⟩
    intro j
    rw [coefficientFrom_scale]
    exact ih _ _ (hcoeff j)

#print axioms coefficientFrom_scale
#print axioms positiveCheck_scale
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedPositiveScale

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedArithmetic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedReciprocal
open NestedArithmetic
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- Clear exactly a sufficient power of the first coordinate, retaining all
other parameters. The transform is a computable rational polynomial program. -/
def homogenize {n : ℕ} : Expr (n+1) → ℕ × Expr (n+1)
  | .rational c => (0,.rational c)
  | .indet i => if i=0 then (1,.rational 1) else (0,.indet i)
  | .plus a b =>
    let pa := homogenize a; let pb := homogenize b
    let d := max pa.1 pb.1
    (d,.plus (.times pa.2 (.pow (.indet 0) (d-pa.1)))
      (.times pb.2 (.pow (.indet 0) (d-pb.1))))
  | .times a b =>
    let pa := homogenize a; let pb := homogenize b
    (pa.1+pb.1,.times pa.2 pb.2)
  | .scaled c a =>
    let pa := homogenize a
    (pa.1,.scaled c pa.2)
  | .pow a k =>
    let pa := homogenize a
    (pa.1*k,.pow pa.2 k)

noncomputable section
def invert {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Fin (n+1) → ℝ :=
  fun i => if i=0 then 1/x 0 else x i

@[simp] theorem invert_zero {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : invert x 0=1/x 0 := by
  simp [invert]

theorem invert_other {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    invert x i=x i := by simp [invert,hi]

theorem homogenize_sound {n : ℕ} (e : Expr (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hx : x 0 ≠ 0) :
    value (homogenize e).2 x=x 0^(homogenize e).1*value e (invert x) := by
  induction e with
  | rational c => simp [homogenize,value]
  | indet i =>
    by_cases hi : i=0
    · subst i
      simp [homogenize,value,hx]
    · simp [homogenize,value,invert,hi]
  | plus a b ha hb =>
    have hpa : x 0^(homogenize a).1*x 0^(max (homogenize a).1 (homogenize b).1-(homogenize a).1)=
        x 0^max (homogenize a).1 (homogenize b).1 := by
      rw [← pow_add,Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_max_left _ _)]
    have hpb : x 0^(homogenize b).1*x 0^(max (homogenize a).1 (homogenize b).1-(homogenize b).1)=
        x 0^max (homogenize a).1 (homogenize b).1 := by
      rw [← pow_add,Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_max_right _ _)]
    simp only [homogenize,value]
    rw [ha,hb]
    calc
      _ = (x 0^(homogenize a).1*x 0^(max (homogenize a).1 (homogenize b).1-(homogenize a).1))*value a (invert x)+
        (x 0^(homogenize b).1*x 0^(max (homogenize a).1 (homogenize b).1-(homogenize b).1))*value b (invert x) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hpa,hpb]; ring
  | times a b ha hb =>
    simp only [homogenize,value,ha,hb,pow_add]
    ring
  | scaled c a ha =>
    simp only [homogenize,value,ha]
    ring
  | pow a k ha =>
    simp only [homogenize,value,ha,mul_pow,pow_mul]

theorem nonneg_of_homogenize {n : ℕ} (e : Expr (n+1)) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hx : 0 < x 0) (h : 0 ≤ value (homogenize e).2 x) : 0 ≤ value e (invert x) := by
  rw [homogenize_sound e x hx.ne'] at h
  have hc : x 0^(homogenize e).1*0 ≤ x 0^(homogenize e).1*value e (invert x) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using h
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (pow_pos hx _)).mp hc

#print axioms invert_zero
#print axioms invert_other
#print axioms homogenize_sound
#print axioms nonneg_of_homogenize
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NestedReciprocal

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTreeTerminal

/-!
# Actual pendant arms in a finite nonpath tree

Choose a branching vertex farthest from a fixed root. At most one neighbor
points towards the root, so at least two point outwards. Maximal outward paths
end in leaves and have no other branching vertices. The paths are actual walks
in the given tree and meet only at their common branching root.

This is the arm-selection part of the source-presentation obligation. It does
not yet provide the labelled `CoreQuotient.source` isomorphism.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NonpathFork

open SimpleGraph TreeTerminal
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}

theorem path_length_eq_dist (hT : G.IsTree) {u v : V}
    (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath) : p.length = G.dist u v := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hlen⟩ := hT.connected.exists_path_of_dist u v
  have he : p = q := Subtype.mk.inj (hT.isAcyclic.subsingleton_path u v |>.elim
    ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩)
  simpa only [he] using hlen

theorem dist_le_of_mem_path (hT : G.IsTree) {r v x : V}
    (p : G.Walk r v) (hp : p.IsPath) (hx : x ∈ p.support) :
    G.dist r x ≤ G.dist r v := by
  calc
    G.dist r x ≤ (p.takeUntil x hx).length := G.dist_le _
    _ ≤ p.length := p.length_takeUntil_le_length hx
    _ = G.dist r v := path_length_eq_dist hT p hp

/-- A tree has at most one neighbor closer to the chosen root. -/
theorem parent_unique (hT : G.IsTree) (r u : V) {a b : V}
    (ha : G.Adj u a) (hb : G.Adj u b)
    (hda : G.dist r a + 1 = G.dist r u)
    (hdb : G.dist r b + 1 = G.dist r u) : a = b := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hT.connected.exists_isPath r a
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hT.connected.exists_isPath r b
  have hua : u ∉ p.support := by
    intro hu
    have := dist_le_of_mem_path hT p hp hu
    omega
  have hub : u ∉ q.support := by
    intro hu
    have := dist_le_of_mem_path hT q hq hu
    omega
  have he : p.concat ha.symm = q.concat hb.symm :=
    Subtype.mk.inj (hT.isAcyclic.subsingleton_path r u |>.elim
      ⟨_, hp.concat hua ha.symm⟩ ⟨_, hq.concat hub hb.symm⟩)
  exact (Walk.concat_inj he).1

/-- Two of the neighbors of any branching vertex point away from a fixed root. -/
theorem two_outward_neighbors [Fintype V] (hT : G.IsTree) (r u : V) (hu : 3 ≤ G.degree u) :
    ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj u b ∧
      G.dist r a = G.dist r u + 1 ∧ G.dist r b = G.dist r u + 1 := by
  let s := G.neighborFinset u
  let out := s.filter (fun x => G.dist r u < G.dist r x)
  let inside := s.filter (fun x => ¬G.dist r u < G.dist r x)
  have hin : inside.card ≤ 1 := by
    apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
    intro a ha b hb
    have ha' : G.Adj u a ∧ ¬G.dist r u < G.dist r a := by simpa [inside, s] using ha
    have hb' : G.Adj u b ∧ ¬G.dist r u < G.dist r b := by simpa [inside, s] using hb
    apply parent_unique hT r u ha'.1 hb'.1
    · have := hT.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj r ha'.1
      omega
    · have := hT.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj r hb'.1
      omega
  have hsum : out.card + inside.card = G.degree u := by
    simpa only [out, inside, s, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using
      Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := s) (p := fun x => G.dist r u < G.dist r x)
  have hout : 1 < out.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hout
  have ha' : G.Adj u a ∧ G.dist r u < G.dist r a := by simpa [out, s] using ha
  have hb' : G.Adj u b ∧ G.dist r u < G.dist r b := by simpa [out, s] using hb
  refine ⟨a, b, hab, ha'.1, hb'.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hT.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj r ha'.1
    omega
  · have := hT.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj r hb'.1
    omega

/-- Every vertex of this actual walk lies at its stated outward distance. -/
def Outward (r : V) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i ≤ p.length → G.dist r (p.getVert i) = G.dist r u + i

theorem outward_singleton (r : V) {u a : V} (ha : G.Adj u a)
    (hd : G.dist r a = G.dist r u + 1) :
    Outward r (Walk.cons ha Walk.nil) := by
  intro i hi
  have hi1 : i ≤ 1 := by simpa only [Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_nil] using hi
  have hi' : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
  rcases hi' with rfl | rfl <;> simp [hd]

theorem outward_concat (r : V) {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (hp : Outward r p) (h : G.Adj v w)
    (hd : G.dist r w = G.dist r v + 1) : Outward r (p.concat h) := by
  intro i hi
  have hdv : G.dist r v = G.dist r u + p.length := by
    simpa only [Walk.getVert_length] using hp p.length (by rfl)
  by_cases hil : i ≤ p.length
  · simpa only [Walk.concat_eq_append, Walk.getVert_append', if_pos hil] using hp i hil
  · have hi' : i = (p.concat h).length := by simp only [Walk.length_concat] at *; omega
    rw [hi', Walk.getVert_length, hd, hdv, Walk.length_concat]
    omega

/-- There is a longest outward path with a prescribed first edge. -/
theorem maximal_outward_path [Fintype V] (r : V) {u a : V} (ha : G.Adj u a)
    (hd : G.dist r a = G.dist r u + 1) :
    ∃ (v : V) (p : G.Walk u v), p.IsPath ∧ p.snd = a ∧ Outward r p ∧
      ∀ w (q : G.Walk u w), q.IsPath → q.snd = a → Outward r q → q.length ≤ p.length := by
  let s := {n | ∃ (v : V) (p : G.Walk u v), p.IsPath ∧ p.snd = a ∧ Outward r p ∧ p.length = n}
  have hs : s.Finite := (Set.finite_le_nat (Fintype.card V)).subset (by
    rintro n ⟨v, p, hp, _, _, rfl⟩
    exact hp.length_lt.le)
  have hne : s.Nonempty := ⟨1, a, Walk.cons ha Walk.nil, by simp [ha.ne],
    by simp, outward_singleton r ha hd, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨⟨v, p, hp, hpa, hpo, hpk⟩, hmax⟩⟩ := hs.exists_maximal hne
  refine ⟨v, p, hp, hpa, hpo, ?_⟩
  intro w q hq hqa hqo
  have := hmax ⟨w, q, hq, hqa, hqo, rfl⟩
  omega

/-- A maximal outward path ends in a leaf of the original tree. -/
theorem maximal_outward_ends_leaf [Fintype V] (hT : G.IsTree) (r : V) {u a v : V}
    (ha : G.Adj u a) (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath) (hpa : p.snd = a)
    (hpo : Outward r p)
    (hmax : ∀ w (q : G.Walk u w), q.IsPath → q.snd = a → Outward r q →
      q.length ≤ p.length) : G.degree v = 1 := by
  have hnil : ¬p.Nil := by
    intro hn
    have he : p.snd = u := by cases p <;> simp_all
    exact ha.ne (he.symm.trans hpa)
  have hl : 0 < p.length := Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mp hnil
  have hpred := p.adj_penultimate hnil
  have hdv : G.dist r v = G.dist r u + p.length := by
    simpa only [Walk.getVert_length] using hpo p.length (by rfl)
  have hdpre : G.dist r p.penultimate + 1 = G.dist r v := by
    have := hpo (p.length - 1) (by omega)
    dsimp only [Walk.penultimate] at *
    omega
  rw [degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj]
  refine ⟨p.penultimate, hpred.symm, ?_⟩
  intro w hvw
  by_contra hne
  have hdw : G.dist r w = G.dist r v + 1 := by
    rcases hT.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj r hvw with hback | hfwd
    · exact (hne (parent_unique hT r v hvw hpred.symm (by omega) hdpre)).elim
    · exact hfwd
  have hw : w ∉ p.support := by
    intro hw
    exact hne (hT.isAcyclic.eq_penultimate_of_adj_end hp hvw hw)
  have hq := hp.concat hw hvw
  have hqa : (p.concat hvw).snd = a := by
    change (p.concat hvw).getVert 1 = a
    rw [Walk.concat_eq_append, Walk.getVert_append', if_pos (by omega : 1 ≤ p.length)]
    exact hpa
  have := hmax w (p.concat hvw) hq hqa (outward_concat r p hpo hvw hdw)
  simp only [Walk.length_concat] at this
  omega

theorem paths_with_distinct_first_disjoint (hT : G.IsTree) {u v w : V}
    (p : G.Walk u v) (q : G.Walk u w) (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hfirst : p.snd ≠ q.snd) {x : V} (hxp : x ∈ p.support) (hxq : x ∈ q.support) :
    x = u := by
  by_contra hxu
  have he : p.takeUntil x hxp = q.takeUntil x hxq :=
    Subtype.mk.inj (hT.isAcyclic.subsingleton_path u x |>.elim
      ⟨_, hp.takeUntil hxp⟩ ⟨_, hq.takeUntil hxq⟩)
  have := congrArg Walk.snd he
  rw [Walk.snd_takeUntil hxu, Walk.snd_takeUntil hxu] at this
  exact hfirst this

variable [Fintype V]

/-- The two actual positive arms selected in the original labelled tree. -/
structure PendantFork (G : SimpleGraph V) where
  root : V
  leftLeaf : V
  rightLeaf : V
  left : G.Walk root leftLeaf
  right : G.Walk root rightLeaf
  left_path : left.IsPath
  right_path : right.IsPath
  left_positive : 0 < left.length
  right_positive : 0 < right.length
  root_degree : 3 ≤ G.degree root
  left_leaf : G.degree leftLeaf = 1
  right_leaf : G.degree rightLeaf = 1
  left_unbranched : ∀ x ∈ left.support, x ≠ root → G.degree x ≤ 2
  right_unbranched : ∀ x ∈ right.support, x ≠ root → G.degree x ≤ 2
  intersection : ∀ x, x ∈ left.support → x ∈ right.support → x = root

/-- Every finite nontrivial nonpath tree has two genuine pendant arms at one branch. -/
theorem nonpath_has_pendant_fork [Nontrivial V] (hT : G.IsTree)
    (hpath : ¬Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card V))) : Nonempty (PendantFork G) := by
  have hbranch : ∃ r, 3 ≤ G.degree r := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hpath (tree_path_iso_of_degree_le_two G hT (fun v => by have := h v; omega))
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hbranch
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hmax⟩ := (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => 3 ≤ G.degree v)).exists_max_image
    (fun v => G.dist r v) ⟨r, by simp [hr]⟩
  have hud : 3 ≤ G.degree u := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2
  have hfar : ∀ x, G.dist r u < G.dist r x → G.degree x ≤ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hd
    have := hmax x (by simp; omega)
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, ha, hb, hda, hdb⟩ := two_outward_neighbors hT r u hud
  obtain ⟨v, p, hp, hpa, hpo, hpm⟩ := maximal_outward_path r ha hda
  obtain ⟨w, q, hq, hqb, hqo, hqm⟩ := maximal_outward_path r hb hdb
  have hposp : 0 < p.length := by
    have := hpm a (Walk.cons ha Walk.nil) (by simp [ha.ne]) (by simp)
      (outward_singleton r ha hda)
    simp only [Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_nil] at this
    omega
  have hposq : 0 < q.length := by
    have := hqm b (Walk.cons hb Walk.nil) (by simp [hb.ne]) (by simp)
      (outward_singleton r hb hdb)
    simp only [Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_nil] at this
    omega
  refine ⟨⟨u, v, w, p, q, hp, hq, hposp, hposq, hud,
    maximal_outward_ends_leaf hT r ha p hp hpa hpo hpm,
    maximal_outward_ends_leaf hT r hb q hq hqb hqo hqm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro x hx hxu
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hil⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp hx
    have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst i; simp at hi; exact hxu hi.symm
    have hd := hpo i hil
    rw [hi] at hd
    exact hfar x (by omega)
  · intro x hx hxu
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hil⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp hx
    have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst i; simp at hi; exact hxu hi.symm
    have hd := hqo i hil
    rw [hi] at hd
    exact hfar x (by omega)
  · intro x hxp hxq
    exact paths_with_distinct_first_disjoint hT p q hp hq (by simpa [hpa, hqb] using hab) hxp hxq

#print axioms path_length_eq_dist
#print axioms dist_le_of_mem_path
#print axioms parent_unique
#print axioms two_outward_neighbors
#print axioms outward_singleton
#print axioms outward_concat
#print axioms maximal_outward_path
#print axioms maximal_outward_ends_leaf
#print axioms paths_with_distinct_first_disjoint
#print axioms nonpath_has_pendant_fork

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NonpathFork

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanComputedClassCell

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NormProgramPack
open NestedHorner NestedArithmetic NestedClassPolynomials
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- Six once-checked normal forms, including the exact reciprocal degrees. -/
structure Pack (d : ℚ) (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) where
  u : NestedHorner.Poly 3
  v : NestedHorner.Poly 3
  j : NestedHorner.Poly 3
  ui : NestedHorner.Poly 3
  vi : NestedHorner.Poly 3
  ji : NestedHorner.Poly 3
  du : ℕ
  dv : ℕ
  dj : ℕ
  hu : compile (programU d c₁ c₂)=u
  hv : compile (programV d c₁ c₂)=v
  hj : compile (programJ d c₁ c₂)=j
  hui : compile (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (programU d c₁ c₂)).2=ui
  hvi : compile (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (programV d c₁ c₂)).2=vi
  hji : compile (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (programJ d c₁ c₂)).2=ji
  hdu : (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (programU d c₁ c₂)).1=du
  hdv : (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (programV d c₁ c₂)).1=dv
  hdj : (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (programJ d c₁ c₂)).1=dj

def polynomial {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ) : NestedHorner.Poly 3 :=
  if reciprocal=true then
    let duv := max p.du p.dv
    let D := max p.dj duv
    add (mul p.ji (power (coordinate 3 0) (D-p.dj)))
      (mul (add (mul (scale (-(L*(1+s))) p.ui) (power (coordinate 3 0) (duv-p.du)))
        (mul (scale (-(L*(1+1/s))) p.vi) (power (coordinate 3 0) (duv-p.dv))))
        (power (coordinate 3 0) (D-duv)))
  else add p.j (add (scale (-(L*(1+s))) p.u) (scale (-(L*(1+1/s))) p.v))

theorem compile_linear (a b c : Expr 3) (A B : ℚ) :
    compile (.plus c (.plus (.scaled A a) (.scaled B b)))=
      add (compile c) (add (scale A (compile a)) (scale B (compile b))) := rfl

theorem compile_inverse_linear (a b c : Expr 3) (A B : ℚ) :
    compile (NestedReciprocal.homogenize (.plus c (.plus (.scaled A a) (.scaled B b)))).2=
      let pa := NestedReciprocal.homogenize a
      let pb := NestedReciprocal.homogenize b
      let pc := NestedReciprocal.homogenize c
      let duv := max pa.1 pb.1
      let D := max pc.1 duv
      add (mul (compile pc.2) (power (coordinate 3 0) (D-pc.1)))
        (mul (add (mul (scale A (compile pa.2)) (power (coordinate 3 0) (duv-pa.1)))
          (mul (scale B (compile pb.2)) (power (coordinate 3 0) (duv-pb.1))))
          (power (coordinate 3 0) (D-duv))) := rfl

theorem accepts_polynomial {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ) :
    NestedArithmetic.accepts (ComputedClassCell.polynomial d c₁ c₂ reciprocal s L)
      (polynomial p reciprocal s L)=true := by
  unfold NestedArithmetic.accepts
  apply decide_eq_true
  by_cases hr : reciprocal=true
  · simp only [ComputedClassCell.polynomial,polynomial,if_pos hr,NestedClassCell.gap]
    rw [compile_inverse_linear]
    dsimp only
    simp only [p.hdu,p.hdv,p.hdj,p.hui,p.hvi,p.hji]
  · simp only [ComputedClassCell.polynomial,polynomial,if_neg hr,NestedClassCell.gap]
    rw [compile_linear,p.hu,p.hv,p.hj]

theorem compile_eq_of_accepts (e : Expr 3) (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3)
    (h : NestedArithmetic.accepts e p=true) : compile e=p := by
  let : DecidableEq (NestedHorner.Poly 3) := polyDecidableEq 3
  exact of_decide_eq_true h

#print axioms accepts_polynomial
#print axioms compile_eq_of_accepts
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.NormProgramPack

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFourVertexSpectrum

/-!
# Complete RG energy coverage through order four

A four-vertex nonpath tree is a star. Exact path/star energies therefore
discharge SmallOrders 5, including the equality characterization. Uniform
strict fusion above five is still an explicit unproved global input.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.OrderFour

open SimpleGraph TreeTerminal GlobalAssembly FourVertexSpectrum
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def starIso (r : Fin 4) : starGraph r ≃g starFour := by
  let e := Equiv.swap r (0 : Fin 4)
  have he : e r = 0 := by simp [e]
  have f : starGraph r ≃g starGraph (e r) :=
    { toEquiv := e
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro a b
        simp only [starGraph_adj, ne_eq, e.injective.eq_iff] }
  simpa only [he, starFour] using f

theorem nonpath_iso_starFour (T : SimpleGraph (Fin 4)) (hT : T.IsTree)
    (hp : ¬Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph 4)) : Nonempty (T ≃g starFour) := by
  have hd : ¬∀ v, T.degree v ≤ 2 := by
    intro h
    apply hp
    have hi := tree_path_iso_of_degree_le_two T hT h
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hi
    exact hi
  push Not at hd
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hd
  have hlt := T.degree_lt_card_verts r
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hlt
  have he : T.degree r = 3 := by omega
  have hu : T.IsUniversal r := (T.degree_eq_card_sub_one r).mp (by simpa using he)
  have hle : starGraph r ≤ T := by
    intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨hne, h | h⟩ := starGraph_adj.mp hab
    · subst a
      exact hu hne
    · subst b
      exact (hu hne.symm).symm
  have heq : starGraph r = T := le_antisymm hle
    ((isTree_iff_minimal_connected.mp hT).2 (connected_starGraph r) hle)
  rw [← heq]
  exact ⟨starIso r⟩

theorem conclusion_four (T : SimpleGraph (Fin 4)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Conclusion T := by
  by_cases hp : Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph 4)
  · obtain ⟨f⟩ := hp
    exact conclusion_of_iso T f
  · obtain ⟨f⟩ := nonpath_iso_starFour T hT hp
    have he := energy_iso f
    have hs : laplacianEnergy (pathGraph 4) < laplacianEnergy T := by
      rw [he]
      exact pathFour_energy_lt_starFour
    refine ⟨hs.le, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ((ne_of_gt hs) h).elim
    · intro h
      exact (hp h).elim

theorem smallOrders_five : GlobalAssembly.SmallOrders 5 := by
  intro n hn hn5 T hT
  by_cases hn4 : n < 4
  · exact SmallOrders.smallOrders_four n hn hn4 T hT
  · have he : n = 4 := by omega
    subst n
    exact conclusion_four T hT

theorem smallOrders_iff_from_five (N : ℕ) :
    GlobalAssembly.SmallOrders N ↔
      ∀ n, 5 ≤ n → n < N → ∀ T : SimpleGraph (Fin n), T.IsTree → Conclusion T := by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn hnN T hT
    exact h n (by omega) hnN T hT
  · intro h n hn hnN T hT
    by_cases hn5 : n < 5
    · exact smallOrders_five n hn hn5 T hT
    · exact h n (by omega) hnN T hT

theorem universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_five (hF : StrictFusionAbove 5)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Conclusion T :=
  SourcePresentation.universal_conclusion_of_inputs 5 smallOrders_five hF n hn T hT

theorem path_minimum_of_strictFusion_five (hF : StrictFusionAbove 5)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy T :=
  (universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_five hF n hn T hT).1

theorem path_equality_of_strictFusion_five (hF : StrictFusionAbove 5)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy T = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ↔ Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph n) :=
  (universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_five hF n hn T hT).2

#check @smallOrders_five
#check @universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_five
#check @path_minimum_of_strictFusion_five
#check @path_equality_of_strictFusion_five

end

/-!
# Exact assembly of the seven original certificate ranges

The seven fields below are unproved Lean certificate inputs. This module
checks their exhaustive composition, the physical order bounds and the
numeric cutoff payments. It does not promote stored Python witnesses to
kernel certificates. Source: unified manuscript revised 22 September 2026,
the coverage table and the final proof of the local transformation theorem.
-/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.OriginalAssembly
open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient ActualFusionIntegral GlobalAssembly
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

abbrev order {m : ℕ} (_C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (p q : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1))

abbrev meanIntegral {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  normalizedIntegral C u p q (2 - 2 / (order C p q : ℝ))

structure Inputs : Prop where
  degreeOneSmall : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → C.degree u = 1 → order C p q ≤ 13 →
      0 < meanIntegral C u p q
  degreeOneMiddle : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → C.degree u = 1 → 14 ≤ order C p q → order C p q ≤ 52 →
      0 < meanIntegral C u p q
  degreeOneLarge : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → C.degree u = 1 → 53 ≤ order C p q →
      189 / 5000 < normalizedIntegral C u p q 2
  degreeTwoThree : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → (C.degree u = 2 ∨ C.degree u = 3) →
      0 < meanIntegral C u p q
  degreeGeFourSmall : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → 4 ≤ C.degree u → order C p q ≤ 12 →
      0 < meanIntegral C u p q
  degreeFourToFortyfive : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → 4 ≤ C.degree u → C.degree u ≤ 45 → 13 ≤ order C p q →
      2 / 13 < normalizedIntegral C u p q 2
  degreeGeFortysix : ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → 46 ≤ C.degree u →
      2 / 47 < normalizedIntegral C u p q 2

theorem source_order_ge_degree_add_three {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m)
    (p q : ℕ) : C.degree u + 3 ≤ order C p q := by
  have hd := C.degree_lt_card_verts u
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hd
  simp only [order, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

theorem strict_of_cutoff_reserve {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q K : ℕ)
    (hT : (source C u p q).IsTree) (hd : 1 ≤ C.degree u) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hn : K ≤ order C p q) (hr : 2 / (K : ℝ) < normalizedIntegral C u p q 2) :
    laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q) := by
  apply strict_of_reserve C u p q hT hd
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hnr : (K : ℝ) ≤ order C p q := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnp : (0 : ℝ) < order C p q := lt_of_lt_of_le hk hnr
  have hle : (2 : ℝ) / (order C p q : ℝ) ≤ 2 / (K : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hnp hk).mpr
    nlinarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hr

theorem inputs_imply_uniform (h : Inputs) : SmallOrders.UniformStrictFusion := by
  intro m C u p q hT hd
  by_cases h1 : C.degree u = 1
  · by_cases hn13 : order C p q ≤ 13
    · exact (strict_iff_mean_integral_pos C u p q hT hd).mpr
        (h.degreeOneSmall m C u p q hT h1 hn13)
    · by_cases hn52 : order C p q ≤ 52
      · exact (strict_iff_mean_integral_pos C u p q hT hd).mpr
          (h.degreeOneMiddle m C u p q hT h1 (by omega) hn52)
      · have hn53 : 53 ≤ order C p q := by omega
        apply strict_of_cutoff_reserve C u p q 53 hT hd (by omega) hn53
        exact lt_trans (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) / 53 < 189 / 5000)
          (h.degreeOneLarge m C u p q hT h1 hn53)
  · by_cases h3 : C.degree u ≤ 3
    · exact (strict_iff_mean_integral_pos C u p q hT hd).mpr
        (h.degreeTwoThree m C u p q hT (by omega))
    · have h4 : 4 ≤ C.degree u := by omega
      by_cases hn12 : order C p q ≤ 12
      · exact (strict_iff_mean_integral_pos C u p q hT hd).mpr
          (h.degreeGeFourSmall m C u p q hT h4 hn12)
      · by_cases h45 : C.degree u ≤ 45
        · exact strict_of_cutoff_reserve C u p q 13 hT hd (by omega) (by omega)
            (h.degreeFourToFortyfive m C u p q hT h4 h45 (by omega))
        · have h46 : 46 ≤ C.degree u := by omega
          have hn := source_order_ge_degree_add_three C u p q
          exact strict_of_cutoff_reserve C u p q 47 hT hd (by omega) (by omega)
            (h.degreeGeFortysix m C u p q hT h46)

theorem universal_conclusion_of_original_inputs (h : Inputs) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Conclusion T :=
  OrderFour.universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_five
    (MinimalFusion.uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_five.mp (inputs_imply_uniform h)) n hn T hT

#check @Inputs
#check @inputs_imply_uniform
#check @universal_conclusion_of_original_inputs
#print axioms source_order_ge_degree_add_three
#print axioms strict_of_cutoff_reserve
#print axioms inputs_imply_uniform
#print axioms universal_conclusion_of_original_inputs
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.OriginalAssembly

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanIntegerComputedClassCell
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNormProgramPack

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PackedIntegerClassCell
open IntegerComputedClassCell
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def integerAffine {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L : ℚ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : NestedInteger.Poly 3 :=
  let raw := pad 3 deg (integerize 3 (baseScale s L) (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L))
  NestedInteger.clearedAll 3 raw (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w)

def make {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) : FastNestedCellData.Cell :=
  let a := integerAffine p reciprocal s L deg l w
  { reciprocal := reciprocal
    young := s
    squareLower := L
    payment := R
    logarithmK := k
    logarithmN := n
    poly := NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L
    affine := NestedHorner.scale (1/totalScale s L deg l w) (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 a)
    degrees := deg
    left := l
    width := w }

/-- Reuse the six closed normal-form proofs. Every leaf still checks its exact
affine reconstruction, denominator clearing, integer Bernstein signs and log. -/
theorem accepts_make {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hK : 0 < totalScale s L deg l w) (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (ha : NestedAffine.check 3 (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L)
      (NestedHorner.scale (1/totalScale s L deg l w)
        (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (integerAffine p reciprocal s L deg l w))) l w=true)
    (hb : NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck 3 deg (integerAffine p reciprocal s L deg l w)=true)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂ (make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w)=true := by
  apply decide_eq_true
  refine ⟨hs,hw,?_,ha,?_,hl⟩
  · exact NormProgramPack.accepts_polynomial p reciprocal s L
  · exact NestedPositiveScale.positiveCheck_scale 3 deg _ (1/totalScale s L deg l w)
      (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hK.le) (NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck_to_rational 3 deg _ hb)

#print axioms accepts_make
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PackedIntegerClassCell
