import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPackedIntegerClassCell
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanNestedAffineComplete

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PackedIntegerSemanticAffine
open IntegerComputedClassCell NestedHorner
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem pad_rectangular (n : ℕ) (deg : Fin n → ℕ) (p : NestedInteger.Poly n) :
    NestedInteger.rectangular n deg (pad n deg p)=true := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [pad,NestedInteger.rectangular,List.length_ofFn,decide_true,Bool.true_and]
    apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hc
    exact ih _ _

theorem denominator_pos (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (i : Fin 3) : 0 < denominator l w i := by
  unfold denominator
  exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast (l i).den_pos) (by exact_mod_cast (w i).den_pos)

theorem coordinate_eq (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ((leftNumerator l w i : ℝ)+(widthNumerator l w i : ℝ)*x i)/
      (denominator l w i : ℝ) = (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i := by
  have hl : (0 : ℝ) < (l i).den := by exact_mod_cast (l i).den_pos
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) < (w i).den := by exact_mod_cast (w i).den_pos
  unfold leftNumerator widthNumerator denominator
  push_cast
  rw [Rat.cast_def,Rat.cast_def]
  field_simp

def raw (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) : NestedInteger.Poly 3 :=
  pad 3 deg (integerize 3 K p)

def rawCheck (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) : Bool :=
  NestedAffine.zeroCheck 3 (add (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (raw p K deg)) (scale (-K) p))

theorem raw_eval (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (h : rawCheck p K deg=true) (z : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    eval (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (raw p K deg)) z=(K : ℝ)*eval p z := by
  have hh := NestedAffine.zeroCheck_sound 3 _ h z
  rw [eval_add,eval_scale] at hh
  push_cast at hh
  linarith only [hh]

theorem affine_checked (p : NestedHorner.Poly 3) (K : ℚ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hr : rawCheck p K deg=true) :
    NestedAffine.check 3 p
      (scale (1/(K*(NestedInteger.factor 3 deg (denominator l w) : ℚ)))
        (NestedInteger.castPoly 3 (NestedInteger.clearedAll 3 (raw p K deg)
          (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w)))) l w=true := by
  apply NestedAffine.check_complete
  intro x
  have he := NestedInteger.clearedAll_sound 3 deg (raw p K deg)
    (leftNumerator l w) (widthNumerator l w) (denominator l w)
    (pad_rectangular 3 deg _) (fun i => (denominator_pos l w i).ne') x
  rw [eval_scale,he,raw_eval p K deg hr]
  have hv : (fun i => ((leftNumerator l w i : ℝ)+(widthNumerator l w i : ℝ)*x i)/
      (denominator l w i : ℝ)) = (fun i => (l i : ℝ)+(w i : ℝ)*x i) := by
    funext i
    exact coordinate_eq l w x i
  rw [hv]
  have hKr : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hF : (0 : ℝ) < NestedInteger.factor 3 deg (denominator l w) := by
    exact_mod_cast NestedInteger.factor_pos 3 deg (denominator l w) (denominator_pos l w)
  push_cast
  field_simp

theorem baseScale_pos (s L : ℚ) : 0 < baseScale s L := by
  unfold baseScale
  exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast (L*(1+s)).den_pos)
    (by exact_mod_cast (L*(1+1/s)).den_pos)

theorem totalScale_pos (s L : ℚ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    0 < totalScale s L deg l w := by
  unfold totalScale
  exact mul_pos (baseScale_pos s L) (by
    exact_mod_cast NestedInteger.factor_pos 3 deg (denominator l w) (denominator_pos l w))

/-- Only the untransformed denominator clearing and integer Bernstein signs are
computed per leaf. The full affine identity follows from the proved transform. -/
theorem accepts_make {d : ℚ} {c₁ c₂ : Fin 5} (p : NormProgramPack.Pack d c₁ c₂)
    (reciprocal : Bool) (s L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (deg : Fin 3 → ℕ) (l w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hr : rawCheck (NormProgramPack.polynomial p reciprocal s L) (baseScale s L) deg=true)
    (hb : NestedInteger.bernsteinCheck 3 deg
      (PackedIntegerClassCell.integerAffine p reciprocal s L deg l w)=true)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts L R k n=true) :
    FastNestedCellData.accepts d c₁ c₂
      (PackedIntegerClassCell.make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w)=true := by
  apply PackedIntegerClassCell.accepts_make p reciprocal s L R k n deg l w
    (totalScale_pos s L deg l w) hs hw _ hb hl
  exact affine_checked _ (baseScale s L) (baseScale_pos s L) deg l w hr

#print axioms affine_checked
#print axioms accepts_make
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PackedIntegerSemanticAffine

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.

All-length determinant bridge for the path recurrence.
This file does not assert the strict fusion inequality or global path minimum.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPathRecurrence
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.NonsingularInverse
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.LapMatrix
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Hasse

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence

open Matrix Finset

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

instance pathGraphAdjDecidable (n : ℕ) :
    DecidableRel (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj := by
  intro i j
  exact decidable_of_iff (i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val)
    SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj.symm

/-- Symmetric tridiagonal matrix with unit off-diagonals. -/
def tridiagonal {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → R) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R :=
  fun i j => if i = j then d i else
    if i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val then 1 else 0

@[simp] theorem tridiagonal_diag {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → R) (i : Fin n) :
    tridiagonal d i i = d i := by simp [tridiagonal]

theorem tridiagonal_tail {n : ℕ} (d : Fin (n + 1) → R) :
    (tridiagonal d).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      tridiagonal (fun i => d i.succ) := by
  ext i j
  simp [tridiagonal, submatrix_apply, Fin.succ_inj, Fin.val_succ]

/-- Continuant recurrence, proved from two exact cofactor expansions. -/
theorem det_tridiagonal {n : ℕ} (d : Fin (n + 2) → R) :
    det (tridiagonal d) =
      d 0 * det (tridiagonal (fun i => d i.succ)) -
        det (tridiagonal (fun i => d i.succ.succ)) := by
  let M := tridiagonal d
  have hminor : (M.submatrix Fin.succ (1 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove).submatrix
      Fin.succ Fin.succ = tridiagonal (fun i => d i.succ.succ) := by
    ext i j
    simp [M, submatrix_apply, tridiagonal, Fin.succ_inj, Fin.val_succ]
  have hcol : det (M.submatrix Fin.succ (1 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove) =
      det (tridiagonal (fun i => d i.succ.succ)) := by
    rw [det_succ_column_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have hzero : ∀ i : Fin n,
        (M.submatrix Fin.succ (1 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove) i.succ 0 = 0 := by
      intro i
      simp [M, submatrix_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne_zero_zero, tridiagonal,
        Fin.val_succ, Fin.ext_iff]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero, hminor]
    simp [M, submatrix_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne_zero_zero, tridiagonal,
      Fin.val_succ]
  rw [det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hzero : ∀ i : Fin n, M 0 i.succ.succ = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp [M, tridiagonal, Fin.val_succ, Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero,
    Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.val_one, pow_one]
  change d 0 * det (M.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ) +
    ((-1 : R) * M 0 1 * det (M.submatrix Fin.succ (1 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove) +
      ∑ i : Fin n, (-1 : R) ^ (i.succ.succ.val) * M 0 i.succ.succ *
        det (M.submatrix Fin.succ i.succ.succ.succAbove)) = _
  rw [show M.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = _ from tridiagonal_tail d, hcol]
  simp [hzero, M, tridiagonal, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- Grounded path tail: diagonal z-2 except at its terminal vertex, z-1. -/
def pathTail (z : R) (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R :=
  tridiagonal (fun i => if i.val + 1 = n then z - 1 else z - 2)

theorem num_characteristic_recurrence (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    num z (n + 2) = (z - 2) * num z (n + 1) - num z n := by
  rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega, num_succ, den_succ, num_succ]
  ring

theorem pathTail_det_recurrence (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    det (pathTail z (n + 2)) =
      (z - 2) * det (pathTail z (n + 1)) - det (pathTail z n) := by
  unfold pathTail
  rw [det_tridiagonal]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, zero_add, show ¬1 = n + 2 by omega, ite_false]
  congr 2 <;> congr 1 <;> funext i <;>
    simp [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]

/-- The numerator recurrence is the determinant of the actual tridiagonal tail. -/
theorem pathTail_det (z : R) (n : ℕ) : det (pathTail z n) = num z (n + 1) := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp [pathTail]
  | one => simp [pathTail, tridiagonal]
  | more n ih ih' =>
    calc
      det (pathTail z (n + 2)) =
          (z - 2) * det (pathTail z (n + 1)) - det (pathTail z n) :=
        pathTail_det_recurrence z n
      _ = (z - 2) * num z (n + 2) - num z (n + 1) := by rw [ih, ih']
      _ = num z (n + 2 + 1) := (num_characteristic_recurrence z (n + 1)).symm

/-- The two terminal vertices of a nontrivial path have degree one; all others two. -/
theorem pathGraph_degree (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 2)).degree i =
      if i.val = 0 ∨ i.val + 1 = n + 2 then 1 else 2 := by
  by_cases hi0 : i.val = 0
  · have hn : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 2)).neighborFinset i = {⟨1, by omega⟩} := by
      ext j
      simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj,
        Finset.mem_singleton, Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
    simp [SimpleGraph.degree, hn, hi0]
  · by_cases hilast : i.val + 1 = n + 2
    · have hn : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 2)).neighborFinset i = {⟨n, by omega⟩} := by
        ext j
        simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj,
          Finset.mem_singleton, Fin.ext_iff]
        omega
      simp [SimpleGraph.degree, hn, hilast]
    · let l : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩
      let r : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩
      have hlr : l ≠ r := by
        simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, l, r]
        omega
      have hn : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 2)).neighborFinset i = {l, r} := by
        ext j
        simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj,
          Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, Fin.ext_iff, l, r]
        omega
      have hilast' : i.val ≠ n + 1 := by omega
      simp [SimpleGraph.degree, hn, hi0, hilast', hlr]

/-- The actual shifted graph Laplacian, not a recursively specified determinant. -/
def pathMatrix (z : R) (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R :=
  z • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) - (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).lapMatrix R

theorem pathMatrix_tridiagonal (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    pathMatrix z (n + 2) = tridiagonal (fun i =>
      if i.val = 0 ∨ i.val + 1 = n + 2 then z - 1 else z - 2) := by
  ext i j
  simp only [pathMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
    SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [tridiagonal, pathGraph_degree]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · simp [tridiagonal, hij, SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj]

theorem pathMatrix_tail (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (pathMatrix z (n + 1)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = pathTail z n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ n =>
    rw [pathMatrix_tridiagonal, tridiagonal_tail]
    unfold pathTail
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]

/-- Characteristic determinant of every nonempty path equals the scalar denominator. -/
theorem pathMatrix_det (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    det (pathMatrix z (n + 1)) = den z (n + 1) := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp [pathMatrix, SimpleGraph.lapMatrix,
      SimpleGraph.degMatrix, SimpleGraph.degree, SimpleGraph.neighborFinset, den, state]
  | succ n =>
    rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega, pathMatrix_tridiagonal, det_tridiagonal]
    have ht : tridiagonal (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
        if i.succ.val = 0 ∨ i.succ.val + 1 = n + 2 then z - 1 else z - 2) =
        pathTail z (n + 1) := by
      unfold pathTail
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]
    have htt : tridiagonal (fun i : Fin n =>
        if i.succ.succ.val = 0 ∨ i.succ.succ.val + 1 = n + 2 then z - 1 else z - 2) =
        pathTail z n := by
      unfold pathTail
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_assoc]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, true_or, ite_true, ht, htt, pathTail_det]
    rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega, den_succ]
    have h := num_succ z (n + 1)
    rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega] at h
    linear_combination (z - 1) * h

variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

/-- Exact endpoint resolvent entry. Division follows Lean's total field convention;
the separately proved upper-half-plane nonvanishing will make it a genuine inverse. -/
theorem pathMatrix_inv_endpoint (z : K) (n : ℕ) :
    (pathMatrix z (n + 1))⁻¹ 0 0 = resolventQuotient z (n + 1) := by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, add_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero,
    pathMatrix_tail, pathTail_det, pathMatrix_det, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  unfold resolventQuotient
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The invariant interval for the real continued-fraction arm recurrence.
The index n represents manuscript arm length n+1. The connection of this
real recurrence to the complex graph resolvent is a separate bridge.
-/
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathEnclosure

noncomputable section

def arm (y : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 + arm y n)

def lower (y : ℝ) : ℝ := (y ^ 4 + 2 * y ^ 2) / (y ^ 4 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 1)
def upper (y : ℝ) : ℝ := (y ^ 4 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 1) / (y ^ 4 + 4 * y ^ 2 + 3)

theorem arm_nonneg (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ arm y n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ n ih => exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg y) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg y) ih)

theorem arm_le_one (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) : arm y n ≤ 1 := by
  cases n with
  | zero => norm_num [arm]
  | succ n =>
    have ha := arm_nonneg y n
    have hp : 0 < y ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)

theorem arm_four (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : arm y 4 = lower y := by
  have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
  simp only [arm]
  unfold lower
  field_simp
  ring

theorem interval_width (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    upper y - lower y =
      1 / ((y ^ 4 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 1) * (y ^ 4 + 4 * y ^ 2 + 3)) := by
  have h4 : 0 ≤ y ^ 4 := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 ≤ y ^ 2 := sq_nonneg y
  unfold upper lower
  field_simp
  ring

theorem step_lower (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 + lower y) = upper y := by
  have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
  unfold lower upper
  field_simp
  ring

theorem step_upper_ge_lower (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    lower y ≤ y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 + upper y) := by
  have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
  have h4 : 0 ≤ y ^ 4 := by positivity
  unfold lower upper
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
  field_simp
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y ^ 2), sq_nonneg (y ^ 3)]

/-- Every arm length at least five lies in this single invariant interval. -/
theorem all_long_arms (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) :
    lower y ≤ arm y (n + 4) ∧ arm y (n + 4) ≤ upper y := by
  have hl : 0 ≤ lower y := by unfold lower; positivity
  have hu : lower y ≤ upper y := by
    have h := interval_width y hy
    have hp : 0 < 1 / ((y ^ 4 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 1) * (y ^ 4 + 4 * y ^ 2 + 3)) := by
      positivity
    linarith
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [zero_add, arm_four y hy] using And.intro le_rfl hu
  | succ n ih =>
    change lower y ≤ y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 + arm y (n + 4)) ∧
      y ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 + arm y (n + 4)) ≤ upper y
    have ha : 0 ≤ arm y (n + 4) := arm_nonneg y _
    have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy
    constructor
    · exact (step_upper_ge_lower y hy).trans
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg y) (by positivity) (by linarith [ih.2]))
    · rw [← step_lower y hy]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg y) (by positivity) (by linarith [ih.1])

#print axioms all_long_arms

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathEnclosure

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

The exact all-length path recurrence and singleton-normalization identity
used by the RG reconstruction. The determinant/resolvent interpretation and
the analytic sign certificates remain separate proof obligations.
-/
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- Numerator and denominator states, including the algebraic initial state. -/
def state (z : R) : ℕ → R × R
  | 0 => (-1, 0)
  | n + 1 => let s := state z n
             (s.2 - s.1, (z - 1) * s.2 - z * s.1)

def num (z : R) (n : ℕ) : R := (state z n).1
def den (z : R) (n : ℕ) : R := (state z n).2

@[simp] theorem num_zero (z : R) : num z 0 = -1 := rfl
@[simp] theorem den_zero (z : R) : den z 0 = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem num_succ (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    num z (n + 1) = den z n - num z n := rfl
@[simp] theorem den_succ (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    den z (n + 1) = (z - 1) * den z n - z * num z n := rfl

theorem initial_state (z : R) : num z 1 = 1 ∧ den z 1 = z := by
  simp

/-- The two coupled addition formulas; no division or nonzero premise. -/
theorem addition (z : R) (p q : ℕ) :
    den z (p + q) = den z p * den z q - num z p * den z q -
      num z q * den z p ∧
    z * num z (p + q) = den z p * den z q - z * num z p * num z q := by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ p ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨hb, ha⟩
    constructor
    · rw [Nat.succ_add, den_succ, hb, ha, den_succ, num_succ]
      ring
    · rw [Nat.succ_add, num_succ, mul_sub, hb, ha, den_succ, num_succ]
      ring

/-- The singleton-core cancellation is valid for every pair of arm lengths. -/
theorem singleton_normalization (z : R) (p q : ℕ) :
    z * ((den z p - num z p) * (den z q - num z q)) -
      (2 * den z p * den z q - num z p * den z q - num z q * den z p) =
    z * (den z (p + q) - num z (p + q)) - den z (p + q) := by
  rcases addition z p q with ⟨hb, ha⟩
  rw [hb]
  linear_combination ha

theorem characteristic_recurrence (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    den z (n + 2) = (z - 2) * den z (n + 1) - den z n := by
  rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega, den_succ, num_succ, den_succ]
  ring

variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

def resolventQuotient (z : K) (n : ℕ) : K := num z n / den z n

/-- The endpoint rational recurrence from Lemma 2.3 of the RG manuscript. -/
theorem resolventQuotient_succ (z : K) (n : ℕ) (hb : den z n ≠ 0) :
    resolventQuotient z (n + 1) =
      (1 - resolventQuotient z n) / (z - 1 - z * resolventQuotient z n) := by
  unfold resolventQuotient
  rw [num_succ, den_succ]
  field_simp

#print axioms addition
#print axioms singleton_normalization
#print axioms characteristic_recurrence
#print axioms resolventQuotient_succ

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Nonreal spectral parameters give genuine inverses of the path Laplacian.
The global energy and strict fusion inequalities are not asserted here.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPathDeterminant
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Spectrum

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence

open Matrix Finset

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Exact characteristic factorization evaluated away from the real spectrum. -/
theorem shifted_det_product (A : Matrix V V ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (z : ℂ) :
    det (z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - A) =
      ∏ i, (z - (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.eval z) hA.charpoly_eq
  simpa [Matrix.eval_charpoly, Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    using h

/-- Every nonreal shift of a finite Hermitian matrix has nonzero determinant. -/
theorem shifted_det_ne_zero (A : Matrix V V ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    det (z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - A) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [shifted_det_product A hA z]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _ hi
  have he := congrArg Complex.im (sub_eq_zero.mp hi)
  exact hz (by simpa using he)

/-- The scalar denominator is nonzero at every nonreal spectral parameter. -/
theorem den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    den z (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← pathMatrix_det]
  exact shifted_det_ne_zero _ ((SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 1)).isHermitian_lapMatrix ℂ) z hz

theorem pathMatrix_mul_inverse (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    pathMatrix z (n + 1) * (pathMatrix z (n + 1))⁻¹ = 1 := by
  apply Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv
  rw [pathMatrix_det]
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz n)

/-- Endpoint entry and recurrence now concern genuine graph resolvents. -/
theorem endpoint_resolvent_recurrence (z : ℂ) (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (pathMatrix z (n + 2))⁻¹ 0 0 =
      (1 - (pathMatrix z (n + 1))⁻¹ 0 0) /
        (z - 1 - z * (pathMatrix z (n + 1))⁻¹ 0 0) := by
  rw [pathMatrix_inv_endpoint, pathMatrix_inv_endpoint]
  exact resolventQuotient_succ z (n + 1) (den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero z hz n)

#print axioms shifted_det_ne_zero
#print axioms den_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
#print axioms pathMatrix_mul_inverse
#print axioms endpoint_resolvent_recurrence

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathRecurrence

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Actual graph Laplacian identities for the pendant-path fusion formalization.
These lemmas do not assume or assert the strict fusion inequality.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanSpectral
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Operations

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman

open Finset Matrix

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Graph union gives Laplacian addition when the edge sets are disjoint. -/
theorem lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint (G H : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj] (h : Disjoint G H) :
    (G ⊔ H).lapMatrix ℝ = G.lapMatrix ℝ + H.lapMatrix ℝ := by
  have hd (v : V) : (G ⊔ H).degree v = G.degree v + H.degree v := by
    unfold SimpleGraph.degree
    rw [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_sup_of_disjoint v h, Finset.card_disjUnion]
  ext i j
  simp only [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix,
    Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hd]
  · have hnot : ¬(G.Adj i j ∧ H.Adj i j) := by
      intro hx
      exact SimpleGraph.disjoint_left.mp h i j hx.1 hx.2
    simp only [hij, if_false, zero_sub, SimpleGraph.sup_adj]
    by_cases hg : G.Adj i j <;> by_cases hh : H.Adj i j <;> simp_all

/-- The incidence vector of an oriented edge; the outer product is orientation-free. -/
def edgeVector (u w : V) : V → ℝ :=
  fun x => (if x = u then 1 else 0) - (if x = w then 1 else 0)

/-- A single edge contributes exactly its incidence-vector outer product. -/
theorem lapMatrix_edge (u w : V) (huw : u ≠ w) :
    (SimpleGraph.edge u w).lapMatrix ℝ =
      Matrix.vecMulVec (edgeVector u w) (edgeVector u w) := by
  have hnu : (SimpleGraph.edge u w).neighborFinset u = {w} := by
    ext x
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.edge_adj,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    aesop
  have hnw : (SimpleGraph.edge u w).neighborFinset w = {u} := by
    ext x
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.edge_adj,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    aesop
  have hno (x : V) (hxu : x ≠ u) (hxw : x ≠ w) :
      (SimpleGraph.edge u w).neighborFinset x = ∅ := by
    ext y
    simp [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.edge_adj, hxu, hxw]
  have hd (x : V) : (SimpleGraph.edge u w).degree x =
      if x = u ∨ x = w then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hxu : x = u
    · subst x
      simp only [SimpleGraph.degree, hnu, Finset.card_singleton, true_or, ite_true]
    · by_cases hxw : x = w
      · subst x
        simp only [SimpleGraph.degree, hnw, Finset.card_singleton, or_true, ite_true]
      · simp only [SimpleGraph.degree, hno x hxu hxw, Finset.card_empty,
          hxu, hxw, or_self, ite_false]
  ext i j
  simp only [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    edgeVector]
  rw [hd i]
  clear hd hnu hnw hno
  by_cases hiu : i = u <;> by_cases hiw : i = w <;>
    by_cases hju : j = u <;> by_cases hjw : j = w <;>
      simp_all [SimpleGraph.edge_adj] <;> aesop

/-- Replacing one edge has the exact difference of two rank-one matrices. -/
theorem rewire_laplacian_difference (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (u v w : V) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w)
    (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w) :
    (G ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge u w).lapMatrix ℝ -
        (G ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge v w).lapMatrix ℝ =
      Matrix.vecMulVec (edgeVector u w) (edgeVector u w) -
        Matrix.vecMulVec (edgeVector v w) (edgeVector v w) := by
  rw [lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint G _ ((SimpleGraph.disjoint_edge G).mpr hguw),
    lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint G _ ((SimpleGraph.disjoint_edge G).mpr hgvw),
    lapMatrix_edge u w huw, lapMatrix_edge v w hvw]
  abel

/-- Evaluation of an incidence-vector dot product, independent of the graph. -/
theorem edgeVector_dot (u w : V) (x : V → ℝ) :
    edgeVector u w ⬝ᵥ x = x u - x w := by
  unfold edgeVector dotProduct
  simp_rw [sub_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp

/-- The two vectors in a three-distinct-vertex rewiring have norms squared two
and inner product one. These are exact equalities over the real numbers. -/
theorem rewire_gram (u v w : V) (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    edgeVector u w ⬝ᵥ edgeVector u w = 2 ∧
    edgeVector v w ⬝ᵥ edgeVector v w = 2 ∧
    edgeVector u w ⬝ᵥ edgeVector v w = 1 := by
  norm_num [edgeVector_dot, edgeVector, huw, hvw, huv, Ne.symm huw, Ne.symm hvw]

/-- Rewiring preserves the trace, directly from the two rank-one contributions. -/
theorem rewire_trace_zero (u v w : V) (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    (Matrix.vecMulVec (edgeVector u w) (edgeVector u w) -
      Matrix.vecMulVec (edgeVector v w) (edgeVector v w)).trace = 0 := by
  rw [Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec,
    (rewire_gram u v w huv huw hvw).1, (rewire_gram u v w huv huw hvw).2.1]
  norm_num

#print axioms lapMatrix_sup_of_disjoint
#print axioms lapMatrix_edge
#print axioms rewire_laplacian_difference
#print axioms edgeVector_dot
#print axioms rewire_gram
#print axioms rewire_trace_zero

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPathRecurrence
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Eval.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Algebra.CharZero.Infinite
import Mathlib.Data.Complex.Basic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PolynomialPathMap
noncomputable section
open PathRecurrence Polynomial
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

theorem map_num_den {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (z : R) (n : ℕ) :
    f (num z n)=num (f z) n ∧ f (den z n)=den (f z) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    constructor
    · simp only [num_succ,map_sub,ih.1,ih.2]
    · simp only [den_succ,map_sub,map_mul,map_one,ih.1,ih.2]

theorem map_num {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (z : R) (n : ℕ) : f (num z n)=num (f z) n :=
  (map_num_den f z n).1
theorem map_den {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (z : R) (n : ℕ) : f (den z n)=den (f z) n :=
  (map_num_den f z n).2

def pointPoly (x : ℚ) : ℚ[X] := Polynomial.C x+Polynomial.X
def numPoly (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : ℚ[X] := num (pointPoly x) n
def denPoly (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : ℚ[X] := den (pointPoly x) n

noncomputable def evaluator (y : ℝ) : ℚ[X] →+* ℂ :=
  Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (Rat.castHom ℂ) ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)

theorem eval_point (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    evaluator y (pointPoly x)=(x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I := by
  simp [evaluator,pointPoly]

theorem eval_num (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (numPoly x n)=num ((x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I) n := by
  change evaluator y (num (pointPoly x) n)=_
  rw [map_num,eval_point]

theorem eval_den (x : ℚ) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    evaluator y (denPoly x n)=den ((x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I) n := by
  change evaluator y (den (pointPoly x) n)=_
  rw [map_den,eval_point]

def ofList : List ℚ → ℚ[X]
  | [] => 0
  | c :: p => Polynomial.C c+Polynomial.X*ofList p

def pathAccepts (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) (ns ds : List ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (ofList ns=numPoly x n ∧ ofList ds=denPoly x n)

/-- Closed rational polynomial equalities give the actual recurrence at every
ordinate; floating evaluation and sampled polynomial identities are unnecessary. -/
theorem pathAccepts_sound (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) (ns ds : List ℚ)
    (h : pathAccepts x n ns ds=true) (y : ℝ) :
    evaluator y (ofList ns)=num ((x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I) n ∧
      evaluator y (ofList ds)=den ((x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I) n := by
  have hh : ofList ns=numPoly x n ∧ ofList ds=denPoly x n := of_decide_eq_true h
  constructor
  · rw [hh.1]
    exact eval_num x y n
  · rw [hh.2]
    exact eval_den x y n

theorem mean14_path1 : pathAccepts (13/7) 1 [1] [13/7,1]=true := by
  rw [pathAccepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  all_goals apply Polynomial.funext
  all_goals intro t
  all_goals norm_num [ofList,numPoly,denPoly,pointPoly,num,den,state]
theorem mean14_path2 : pathAccepts (13/7) 2 [6/7,1] [-13/49,12/7,1]=true := by
  rw [pathAccepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  all_goals apply Polynomial.funext
  all_goals intro t
  all_goals norm_num [ofList,numPoly,denPoly,pointPoly,num,den,state]
  all_goals ring

#print axioms map_num_den
#print axioms eval_point
#print axioms eval_num
#print axioms eval_den
#print axioms pathAccepts_sound
#print axioms mean14_path1
#print axioms mean14_path2
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PolynomialPathMap

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PolynomialPaymentCell
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial RationalPolynomialCell
open Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure Cell where
  a : ℚ
  b : ℚ
  s : List ℚ
  L : List ℚ
  pay : List ℚ
  primitive : List ℚ
  c : ℚ
  R : ℚ
  unitIntegral : ℚ
  total : ℚ
  k : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  comparisonDegree : ℕ
  nDegree : ℕ
  eDegree : ℕ
  sCoefficients : Fin 3 → ℚ
  lowerCoefficients : Fin 5 → ℚ
  comparisonCoefficients : Fin (comparisonDegree+1) → ℚ
  nCoefficients : Fin (nDegree+1) → ℚ
  eCoefficients : Fin (eDegree+1) → ℚ

def comparison (us vs js : List ℚ) (z : Cell) : ℚ[X] :=
  let S := ofList z.s
  let A := affine z.a z.b
  S*(ofList js).comp A - ofList z.L*
    ((S+S^2)*(ofList us).comp A+(S+1)*(ofList vs).comp A)

def accepts (us vs js ns es : List ℚ) (z : Cell) : Bool :=
  decide (0 < z.a ∧ z.a < z.b ∧ 0 < z.c ∧
    ofList z.s = form 2 z.sCoefficients ∧ (∀ i, 0 < z.sCoefficients i) ∧
    ofList z.L-C z.c = form 4 z.lowerCoefficients ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ z.lowerCoefficients i) ∧
    comparison us vs js z = form z.comparisonDegree z.comparisonCoefficients ∧
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ z.comparisonCoefficients i) ∧
    (ofList ns).comp (affine z.a z.b) = form z.nDegree z.nCoefficients ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < z.nCoefficients i) ∧
    (ofList es).comp (affine z.a z.b) = form z.eDegree z.eCoefficients ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < z.eCoefficients i))

def paymentAccepts (z : Cell) : Bool :=
  decide (ofList z.pay = GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.paymentPolynomial (ofList z.L) z.c z.R ∧
    z.total ≤ (z.b-z.a)*z.unitIntegral)

def ordinate (z : Cell) (y : ℝ) : ℝ := (y-(z.a : ℝ))/((z.b : ℝ)-z.a)
def density (z : Cell) (y : ℝ) : ℝ := realEvaluator (ordinate z y) (ofList z.pay)

theorem pointwise (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (as bs cs es us vs js ns sep : List ℚ)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q as bs cs es = true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts as bs cs es us vs js ns sep = true)
    (z : Cell) (hz : accepts us vs js ns sep z = true)
    (hpay : paymentAccepts z = true) (hl : RationalLog.accepts z.c z.R z.k z.n = true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u = 1)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (z.a : ℝ) (z.b : ℝ)) :
    density z y ≤ MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u p q)
      (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x y := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hab,hc,hs,hsp,hL,hLp,hP,hPp,hn,hnp,he,hep⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hz
  obtain ⟨hpayment,_⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hpay
  let t := ordinate z y
  have ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := cell_coordinate z.a z.b hab y hy
  have hs0 := RationalPolynomialOrder.form_positive _ 2 z.sCoefficients hs hsp t ht
  have hL0 := RationalPolynomialOrder.form_nonneg _ 4 z.lowerCoefficients hL hLp t ht
  rw [map_sub,real_C] at hL0
  have hN := RationalPolynomialOrder.form_positive _ z.nDegree z.nCoefficients hn hnp t ht
  have hE := RationalPolynomialOrder.form_positive _ z.eDegree z.eCoefficients he hep t ht
  have hPr := RationalPolynomialOrder.form_nonneg _ z.comparisonDegree
    z.comparisonCoefficients hP hPp t ht
  have habr : (z.a : ℝ) < z.b := by exact_mod_cast hab
  have hcoord : (z.a : ℝ)+((z.b : ℝ)-z.a)*t = y := by
    dsimp [t,ordinate]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr habr)]
    ring
  rw [affine_evaluation,hcoord] at hN hE
  simp only [comparison,map_sub,map_mul,map_add,map_pow,map_one,affine_evaluation,hcoord] at hPr
  have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast ha) hy.1
  have h := GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.actual_log_lower x y hy0 p q
    as bs cs es us vs js ns sep hpath hpoly (realEvaluator t (ofList z.s))
    (realEvaluator t (ofList z.L)) hs0 hN hE (sub_nonneg.mp hPr) z.c z.R z.k z.n
    hc (sub_nonneg.mp hL0) hl G u hd
  rw [density,hpayment,GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.payment_evaluation]
  exact h

theorem integral (z : Cell) (hz : z.a < z.b)
    (hi : RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts z.pay z.primitive 0 1 z.unitIntegral = true)
    (hp : paymentAccepts z = true) :
    (z.total : ℝ) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (z.a : ℝ)..(z.b : ℝ), density z y := by
  have h := RationalPolynomialAffineIntegral.sound z.pay z.primitive z.a z.b z.unitIntegral hz hi
  change (z.total : ℝ) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (z.a : ℝ)..(z.b : ℝ),
    realEvaluator ((y-(z.a : ℝ))/((z.b : ℝ)-z.a)) (ofList z.pay)
  rw [h]
  exact_mod_cast (of_decide_eq_true hp).2

theorem density_continuous (z : Cell) : Continuous (density z) :=
  (RationalPolynomialIntegral.evaluation_continuous (ofList z.pay)).comp
    ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)

theorem actual_integral_lower (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (as bs cs es us vs js ns sep : List ℚ)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q as bs cs es = true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts as bs cs es us vs js ns sep = true)
    (z : Cell) (hz : accepts us vs js ns sep z = true)
    (hpay : paymentAccepts z = true) (hl : RationalLog.accepts z.c z.R z.k z.n = true)
    (hi : RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts z.pay z.primitive 0 1 z.unitIntegral = true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u = 1)
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable (MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm
      (CoreQuotient.source G u p q) (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x) volume (z.a : ℝ) (z.b : ℝ)) :
    (z.total : ℝ) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (z.a : ℝ)..(z.b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u p q)
        (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x y := by
  have hab := (of_decide_eq_true hz).2.1
  have habr : (z.a : ℝ) ≤ z.b := by exact_mod_cast hab.le
  exact le_trans (integral z hab hi hpay)
    (intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on habr ((density_continuous z).intervalIntegrable _ _) hf
      (fun y hy => pointwise x p q as bs cs es us vs js ns sep hpath hpoly z hz hpay hl G u hd y hy))

#print axioms pointwise
#print axioms integral
#print axioms density_continuous
#print axioms actual_integral_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PolynomialPaymentCell

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTailIntegral

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.QuantitativePositiveTail
open Set MeasureTheory
noncomputable section

def coefficient (K Y : ℝ) : ℝ := K*Y^2/(2*(Y^2+K))

/-- A quantitative payment, retaining the gain lost by a merely nonnegative tail. -/
theorem pointwise (K Y y q : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hY : 0 < Y) (hy : Y ≤ y)
    (hbound : 1+K/y^2 ≤ q^2) : coefficient K Y/y^2 ≤ Real.log q := by
  have hy0 : 0 < y := hY.trans_le hy
  have hy2 : 0 < y^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy0
  have hY2 : 0 < Y^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hY
  have hu : 0 < 1+K/y^2 := by positivity
  have hl := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hu
  have he : 1-(1+K/y^2)⁻¹ = K/(y^2+K) := by
    field_simp [hy0.ne',show y^2+K ≠ 0 by positivity]
    ring
  rw [he] at hl
  have hq := Real.log_le_log hu hbound
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hq
  norm_num at hq
  have hsq : Y^2 ≤ y^2 := by nlinarith
  have hb : 2*(coefficient K Y/y^2) ≤ K/(y^2+K) := by
    have hid : 2*(coefficient K Y/y^2) = (K*Y^2/(Y^2+K))/y^2 := by
      unfold coefficient
      field_simp [hy0.ne',show Y^2+K ≠ 0 by positivity]
    rw [hid]
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < y^2)
      (by positivity : 0 < y^2+K)).mpr
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < Y^2+K)).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hK (mul_nonneg hK (sub_nonneg.mpr hsq))]
  linarith

theorem integral_lower (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K Y : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi Y))
    (hb : ∀ y ∈ Ioi Y, coefficient K Y/y^2 ≤ f y) :
    coefficient K Y/Y ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, f y := by
  have hc : 0 ≤ coefficient K Y := by unfold coefficient; positivity
  have hi := TailIntegral.inv_square_integrable_integral (coefficient K Y) Y hc hY
  have h := integral_mono_ae hi.1 hf (by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
    exact hb y hy)
  rw [hi.2] at h
  exact h

#print axioms pointwise
#print axioms integral_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.QuantitativePositiveTail

Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The all-length real arm addition law and the concrete reciprocal quotient.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanScaledQuotient
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanArmBridge

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathEnclosure

theorem rho_ge (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) : y ≤ rho y n := by
  unfold rho
  have hn := arm_nonneg y n
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hn hy.le)

theorem rho_addition (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (p q : ℕ) :
    rho y (p + q + 1) = (1 + rho y p * rho y q) / (rho y p + rho y q - y) := by
  have h0 : rho y 0 = y := by simp [rho, arm]
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_add, rho_succ y hy q, h0]
    have hq := (rho_pos y hy q).ne'
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    field_simp
    ring
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [show p + 1 + q + 1 = (p + q + 1) + 1 by omega,
      rho_succ y hy (p + q + 1), ih, rho_succ y hy p]
    have hpp := rho_pos y hy p
    have hp := hpp.ne'
    have hq := rho_pos y hy q
    have hprod : 1 + rho y p * rho y q ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hsum : rho y p + rho y q - y ≠ 0 := by
      have h := rho_ge y hy p
      linarith
    have he : (y + 1 / rho y p) + rho y q - y =
        (1 + rho y p * rho y q) / rho y p := by field_simp; ring
    rw [he]
    field_simp [hprod, hp]
    ring

#print axioms rho_addition

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.PathEnclosure

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.Focus

noncomputable section

def m (y P Q : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + P * Q) / (P + Q - y)

/-- The exact normalized endpoint formula equals the concrete Mobius quotient. -/
theorem normalized_mobius (y P Q : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (hP : y ≤ P) (hQ : y ≤ Q)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) :
    let hp : ℂ := 1 - (1 + Complex.I * (P : ℂ)) / z y
    let hq : ℂ := 1 - (1 + Complex.I * (Q : ℂ)) / z y
    let hr : ℂ := 1 - (1 + Complex.I * (m y P Q : ℂ)) / z y
    let k := ζ⁻¹
    let A₀ := (1 - hp) * (1 - hq)
    let B₀ := 2 - hp - hq
    let C₀ := 1 - hr
    ((A₀ - B₀ * k) / (A₀ - B₀ * (1 / z y))) *
      ((C₀ - 1 / z y) / (C₀ - k)) = quotient y P Q ζ := by
  dsimp only
  have hp : 0 < P := lt_of_lt_of_le hy hP
  have hq : 0 < Q := lt_of_lt_of_le hy hQ
  have hsum : 0 < P + Q - y := by linarith
  have hprod : 0 < 1 + P * Q := by positivity
  have hz : z y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hi := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp [z] at hi
    linarith
  have hs : ((P + Q - y : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hsum.ne'
  have hpc : ((1 + P * Q : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hprod.ne'
  push_cast at hs hpc
  have hB0 : (2 - (1 - (1 + Complex.I * (P : ℂ)) / z y) -
      (1 - (1 + Complex.I * (Q : ℂ)) / z y)) =
      (2 + Complex.I * ((P : ℂ) + (Q : ℂ))) / z y := by ring
  rw [hB0]
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel]
  have hA : ((1 + Complex.I * (P : ℂ)) / z y) *
      ((1 + Complex.I * (Q : ℂ)) / z y) = -(A P Q) / z y ^ 2 := by
    unfold A
    push_cast
    field_simp [hz]
    ring_nf
    norm_num [Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  rw [hA]
  have hNorm : -(A P Q) / z y ^ 2 -
      ((2 + Complex.I * ((P : ℂ) + (Q : ℂ))) / z y) * (1 / z y) =
      -((1 + (P : ℂ) * (Q : ℂ))) / z y ^ 2 := by
    unfold A
    push_cast
    field_simp [hz]
    ring
  rw [hNorm]
  have hNum : -(A P Q) / z y ^ 2 -
      ((2 + Complex.I * ((P : ℂ) + (Q : ℂ))) / z y) * ζ⁻¹ =
      -(A P Q * ζ + N₀ y P Q) / (z y ^ 2 * ζ) := by
    unfold N₀
    push_cast
    field_simp [hz, hζ]
    ring
  rw [hNum]
  have hC : (1 + Complex.I * (m y P Q : ℂ)) / z y - ζ⁻¹ =
      Complex.I * (B y P Q * ζ + D₀ y P Q) /
        (((P : ℂ) + (Q : ℂ) - (y : ℂ)) * z y * ζ) := by
    unfold B D₀ m
    push_cast
    field_simp [hz, hζ, hs]
    ring_nf
    norm_num [Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  rw [hC]
  have hC0 : (1 + Complex.I * (m y P Q : ℂ)) / z y - 1 / z y =
      Complex.I * (m y P Q : ℂ) / z y := by ring
  rw [hC0]
  unfold quotient m
  push_cast
  field_simp [hz, hζ, hs, hpc, Complex.I_ne_zero]

#print axioms normalized_mobius

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.Focus

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPolynomialPathMap

/-! Exact real and imaginary polynomial representatives of rational Horner
lists evaluated on the imaginary axis. No sampled identity is used. -/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalComplexPolynomial
noncomputable section
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def parts : List ℚ → ℚ[X] × ℚ[X]
  | [] => (0,0)
  | c :: p => (C c-X*(parts p).2,X*(parts p).1)

noncomputable def realEvaluator (y : ℝ) : ℚ[X] →+* ℝ :=
  Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (Rat.castHom ℝ) y

theorem complex_C (y : ℝ) (c : ℚ) : evaluator y (C c)=(c : ℂ) := by
  simp [evaluator]
theorem complex_X (y : ℝ) : evaluator y X=(y : ℂ)*Complex.I := by
  simp [evaluator]
theorem real_C (y : ℝ) (c : ℚ) : realEvaluator y (C c)=(c : ℝ) := by
  simp [realEvaluator]
theorem real_X (y : ℝ) : realEvaluator y X=y := by
  simp [realEvaluator]

theorem eval_parts (p : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    evaluator y (ofList p)=(realEvaluator y (parts p).1 : ℂ)+
      (realEvaluator y (parts p).2 : ℂ)*Complex.I := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [ofList,parts]
  | cons c p ih =>
    change evaluator y (C c+X*ofList p)=
      (realEvaluator y (C c-X*(parts p).2) : ℂ)+
        (realEvaluator y (X*(parts p).1) : ℂ)*Complex.I
    simp only [map_add,map_sub,map_mul,complex_C,complex_X,real_C,real_X]
    rw [ih]
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
        Complex.ratCast_re,Complex.ratCast_im] <;> ring

def normPolynomial (p : List ℚ) : ℚ[X] := (parts p).1^2+(parts p).2^2

theorem normPolynomial_sound (p : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (normPolynomial p)=Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList p)) := by
  rw [eval_parts]
  simp [normPolynomial,Complex.normSq_apply,pow_two]

/-- The checker compares complete rational polynomials. Its soundness retains
every real ordinate, including irrational cell endpoints. -/
def normAccepts (p cs : List ℚ) : Bool := decide (ofList cs=normPolynomial p)

theorem normAccepts_sound (p cs : List ℚ) (hc : normAccepts p cs=true) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (ofList cs)=Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList p)) := by
  rw [show ofList cs=normPolynomial p from of_decide_eq_true hc]
  exact normPolynomial_sound p y

theorem norm_control : normAccepts [2,3] [4,0,9]=true := by
  rw [normAccepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro t
  norm_num [ofList,normPolynomial,parts]
  all_goals ring
theorem reject_false_norm : normAccepts [2,3] [4,0,8]=false := by
  rw [normAccepts,decide_eq_false_iff_not]
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun p : ℚ[X] => p.eval 1) h
  norm_num [ofList,normPolynomial,parts] at he

#print axioms eval_parts
#print axioms normPolynomial_sound
#print axioms normAccepts_sound
#print axioms norm_control
#print axioms reject_false_norm
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalComplexPolynomial

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTailIntegral

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalIntegralPartition
open Set MeasureTheory

structure Slice where
  a : ℚ
  b : ℚ
  payment : ℚ

def check : ℚ → ℚ → List Slice → Bool
  | a, b, [] => decide (a=b)
  | a, b, c :: cs => decide (c.a=a ∧ c.a≤c.b) && check c.b b cs

def total : List Slice → ℚ
  | [] => 0
  | c :: cs => c.payment+total cs

theorem order (a b : ℚ) (cs : List Slice) (hc : check a b cs = true) : a ≤ b := by
  induction cs generalizing a with
  | nil => exact (of_decide_eq_true hc).le
  | cons c cs ih =>
      have h : decide (c.a=a ∧ c.a≤c.b) = true ∧ check c.b b cs = true :=
        by simpa only [check,Bool.and_eq_true] using hc
      obtain ⟨he,hb⟩ := of_decide_eq_true h.1
      rw [← he]
      exact hb.trans (ih c.b h.2)

noncomputable section

/-- Checked adjacency and proved payments cover the entire closed interval. -/
theorem integral_lower (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0))
    (a b : ℚ) (cs : List Slice) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : check a b cs = true)
    (hp : ∀ c ∈ cs, (c.payment : ℝ) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (c.a : ℝ)..(c.b : ℝ), f y) :
    (total cs : ℝ) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(b : ℝ), f y := by
  induction cs generalizing a with
  | nil =>
      have he : a=b := of_decide_eq_true hc
      subst b
      simp [total]
  | cons c cs ih =>
      have h : decide (c.a=a ∧ c.a≤c.b) = true ∧ check c.b b cs = true :=
        by simpa only [check,Bool.and_eq_true] using hc
      obtain ⟨he,hab⟩ := of_decide_eq_true h.1
      have hcb : a ≤ c.b := by simpa [he] using hab
      have hcb0 : 0 ≤ c.b := ha.trans hcb
      have hrest := ih c.b hcb0 h.2 (fun d hd => hp d (by simp [hd]))
      have hfirst := hp c (by simp)
      rw [he] at hfirst
      have hi0 := TailIntegral.interval_integrable_of_Ioi hf
        (a := (a : ℝ)) (b := (c.b : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast ha) (by exact_mod_cast hcb)
      have hi1 := TailIntegral.interval_integrable_of_Ioi hf
        (a := (c.b : ℝ)) (b := (b : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hcb0)
        (by exact_mod_cast order c.b b cs h.2)
      calc
        (total (c :: cs) : ℝ) = (c.payment : ℝ)+(total cs : ℝ) := by simp [total]
        _ ≤ (∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(c.b : ℝ), f y)+
          (∫ y : ℝ in (c.b : ℝ)..(b : ℝ), f y) := add_le_add hfirst hrest
        _ = _ := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi0 hi1

theorem three_region_lower (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0))
    (a Y O B T : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haY : a ≤ Y)
    (ho : O ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..a, f y)
    (hb : B ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in a..Y, f y)
    (ht : T ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, f y) :
    O+B+T ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, f y := by
  have h0 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi hf ha
  have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi (hf.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi ha)) haY
  linarith only [ho,hb,ht,h0,h1]

#print axioms order
#print axioms integral_lower
#print axioms three_region_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalIntegralPartition

Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Exact rational logarithm certificates with power-of-two range reduction.
Source: the atanh series bounds in Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv.
-/
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalLog

def seriesPart (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1)

def error (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : ℚ := x ^ (2 * n + 1) / (1 - x ^ 2)

def accepts (L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) : Bool :=
  let v := 2 ^ k * L
  decide (0 < L ∧ 1 ≤ v ∧
    R ≤ seriesPart ((v - 1) / (v + 1)) n - k * (seriesPart (1 / 3) n + error (1 / 3) n))

theorem seriesPart_cast (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (seriesPart x n : ℝ) =
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x : ℝ) ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1) := by
  simp [seriesPart]

theorem sound (L R : ℚ) (k n : ℕ) (hc : accepts L R k n = true) :
    (R : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (L : ℝ) / 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hL, hv, hR⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  let v : ℚ := 2 ^ k * L
  let u : ℚ := (v - 1) / (v + 1)
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hv1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ v := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 ^ k * L : ℚ)
    exact_mod_cast hv
  have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := by linarith
  have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    push_cast
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hu1 : (u : ℝ) < 1 := by
    dsimp [u]
    push_cast
    apply (div_lt_one (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < v + 1)).mpr
    linarith
  have huEq : (1 + (u : ℝ)) / (1 - (u : ℝ)) = v := by
    dsimp [u]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have hs := Real.sum_range_le_log_div hu0 hu1 n
  rw [huEq, ← seriesPart_cast] at hs
  have ht := Real.log_div_le_sum_range_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 1) n
  have htEq : (1 + (1 / 3 : ℝ)) / (1 - 1 / 3) = 2 := by norm_num
  rw [htEq] at ht
  have ht' : Real.log 2 / 2 ≤ (seriesPart (1 / 3) n + error (1 / 3) n : ℚ) := by
    simpa [seriesPart_cast, error, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using ht
  have hvEq : Real.log (v : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log (L : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [v]
    push_cast
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hL0.ne', Real.log_pow]
  have hR' : (R : ℝ) ≤ (seriesPart u n : ℝ) -
      k * ((seriesPart (1 / 3) n + error (1 / 3) n : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [u, v]
    exact_mod_cast hR
  have hpay := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht' (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)
  rw [hvEq] at hs
  linarith only [hs, hR', hpay]

#print axioms sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalLog

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalComplexPolynomial
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Norm

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalMobiusPolynomials
noncomputable section
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def U (a b c e : List ℚ) : ℚ[X] :=
  let ar := (parts a).1; let ai := (parts a).2
  let br := (parts b).1; let bi := (parts b).2
  let cr := (parts c).1; let ci := (parts c).2
  let er := (parts e).1; let ei := (parts e).2
  (br*er+bi*ei-ar*cr-ai*ci)^2+(bi*er-br*ei-ai*cr+ar*ci)^2
def V (a b c e : List ℚ) : ℚ[X] :=
  let ar := (parts a).1; let ai := (parts a).2
  let br := (parts b).1; let bi := (parts b).2
  let cr := (parts c).1; let ci := (parts c).2
  let er := (parts e).1; let ei := (parts e).2
  (ar*er-ai*ei-br*cr+bi*ci)^2+(ar*ei+ai*er-br*ci-bi*cr)^2
def N (a b : List ℚ) : ℚ[X] := normPolynomial b-normPolynomial a
def E (c e : List ℚ) : ℚ[X] := normPolynomial e-normPolynomial c
def J (a b : List ℚ) : ℚ[X] := (N a b)^2

theorem U_sound (a b c e : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (U a b c e)=
      ‖evaluator y (ofList b)*star (evaluator y (ofList e))-
        evaluator y (ofList a)*star (evaluator y (ofList c))‖^2 := by
  rw [eval_parts b y,eval_parts e y,eval_parts a y,eval_parts c y]
  simp [U,Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
  all_goals ring
theorem V_sound (a b c e : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (V a b c e)=
      ‖evaluator y (ofList a)*evaluator y (ofList e)-
        evaluator y (ofList b)*evaluator y (ofList c)‖^2 := by
  rw [eval_parts a y,eval_parts e y,eval_parts b y,eval_parts c y]
  simp [V,Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
  all_goals ring
theorem N_sound (a b : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (N a b)=
      Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList b))-Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList a)) := by
  rw [N,map_sub,normPolynomial_sound,normPolynomial_sound]
theorem E_sound (c e : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (E c e)=
      Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList e))-Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList c)) := by
  exact N_sound c e y
theorem J_sound (a b : List ℚ) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (J a b)=
      (Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList b))-Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList a)))^2 := by
  rw [J,map_pow,N_sound]

def accepts (a b c e us vs js ns es : List ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (ofList us=U a b c e ∧ ofList vs=V a b c e ∧ ofList js=J a b ∧
    ofList ns=N a b ∧ ofList es=E c e)

theorem accepts_sound (a b c e us vs js ns es : List ℚ)
    (hc : accepts a b c e us vs js ns es=true) (y : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator y (ofList us)=
      ‖evaluator y (ofList b)*star (evaluator y (ofList e))-
        evaluator y (ofList a)*star (evaluator y (ofList c))‖^2 ∧
    realEvaluator y (ofList vs)=
      ‖evaluator y (ofList a)*evaluator y (ofList e)-
        evaluator y (ofList b)*evaluator y (ofList c)‖^2 ∧
    realEvaluator y (ofList js)=
      (Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList b))-Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList a)))^2 ∧
    realEvaluator y (ofList ns)=
      Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList b))-Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList a)) ∧
    realEvaluator y (ofList es)=
      Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList e))-Complex.normSq (evaluator y (ofList c)) := by
  obtain ⟨hu,hv,hj,hn,he⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [hu,hv,hj,hn,he]
  exact ⟨U_sound a b c e y,V_sound a b c e y,J_sound a b y,N_sound a b y,E_sound c e y⟩

#print axioms U_sound
#print axioms V_sound
#print axioms N_sound
#print axioms E_sound
#print axioms J_sound
#print axioms accepts_sound
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalMobiusPolynomials

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalPolynomialIntegral

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialAffineIntegral
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial MeasureTheory
noncomputable section

theorem sound (p F : List ℚ) (a b L : ℚ) (hab : a < b)
    (hcheck : RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts p F 0 1 L = true) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(b : ℝ),
      realEvaluator ((y-(a : ℝ))/((b : ℝ)-a)) (ofList p)) =
      ((b : ℝ)-a)*(L : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨hd,he⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hcheck
  have hw : (b : ℝ)-(a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hab.ne')
  let w : ℝ := (b : ℝ)-a
  have hw' : w ≠ 0 := hw
  have hf (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt
      (fun z => w*realEvaluator ((z-(a : ℝ))/w) (ofList F))
      (realEvaluator ((y-(a : ℝ))/w) (ofList p)) y := by
    have hp := RationalPolynomialIntegral.derivative_evaluation (ofList F) ((y-(a : ℝ))/w)
    rw [hd] at hp
    have h := (hp.comp y (((hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const (a : ℝ)).div_const w)).const_mul w
    convert h using 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | field_simp [hw']
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => realEvaluator ((y-(a : ℝ))/w) (ofList p)) :=
    (RationalPolynomialIntegral.evaluation_continuous (ofList p)).comp
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const w)
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun y _ => hf y)
    (hc.intervalIntegrable (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
  have h0 : ((a : ℝ)-a)/w = 0 := by simp
  have h1 : ((b : ℝ)-a)/w = 1 := div_self hw'
  rw [h0,h1,show (0 : ℝ)=((0 : ℚ) : ℝ) by norm_num,
    show (1 : ℝ)=((1 : ℚ) : ℝ) by norm_num,
    RationalPolynomialIntegral.rational_evaluation,
    RationalPolynomialIntegral.rational_evaluation] at hi
  calc
    _ = w*((((ofList F).eval 1 : ℚ) : ℝ)-(((ofList F).eval 0 : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hi]; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← Rat.cast_sub,he]

#print axioms sound
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialAffineIntegral

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalComplexPolynomial
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanBernstein

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialCell
noncomputable section
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

def affine (a b : ℚ) : ℚ[X] := C a+C (b-a)*X
def form (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ) : ℚ[X] :=
  ∑ i, C (cs i)*bernsteinPolynomial ℚ d i
def accepts (p : List ℚ) (a b : ℚ) (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide ((ofList p).comp (affine a b)=form d cs)

theorem affine_evaluation (p : ℚ[X]) (a b : ℚ) (t : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator t (p.comp (affine a b))=
      realEvaluator ((a : ℝ)+((b : ℝ)-(a : ℝ))*t) p := by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [Polynomial.add_comp,map_add,hp,hq]
  | monomial n c =>
    simp only [Polynomial.monomial_comp,map_mul,map_pow,real_C]
    simp only [affine,map_add,map_mul,real_C,real_X]
    simp [realEvaluator]

theorem basis_evaluation (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d+1)) (t : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator t (bernsteinPolynomial ℚ d i)=Bernstein.basis d i t := by
  unfold Bernstein.basis bernsteinPolynomial
  simp only [map_mul,map_pow,map_natCast,map_sub,map_one,real_X,
    Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_pow,Polynomial.eval_natCast,
    Polynomial.eval_X,Polynomial.eval_sub,Polynomial.eval_one]

theorem form_evaluation (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ) (t : ℝ) :
    realEvaluator t (form d cs)=∑ i, (cs i : ℝ)*Bernstein.basis d i t := by
  unfold form
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_mul,real_C,basis_evaluation]

/-- Kernel-checked polynomial equality proves the representation on the entire
real cell, including irrational ordinates. -/
theorem representation (p : List ℚ) (a b : ℚ) (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ)
    (hc : accepts p a b d cs=true) (y : ℝ) (hab : a < b) :
    realEvaluator y (ofList p)=
      ∑ i, (cs i : ℝ)*Bernstein.basis d i ((y-a)/(b-a)) := by
  have he : (ofList p).comp (affine a b)=form d cs := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have habr : (a : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hab
  have hr : (a : ℝ)+((b : ℝ)-a)*((y-a)/(b-a))=y := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr habr)]
    all_goals ring
  have hh := congrArg (realEvaluator ((y-a)/(b-a))) he
  rw [affine_evaluation,form_evaluation,hr] at hh
  exact hh

theorem cell_coordinate (a b : ℚ) (hab : a < b) (y : ℝ)
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) : (y-a)/(b-a) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
  have habr : (a : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hab
  constructor
  · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hy.1) (sub_pos.mpr habr).le
  · apply (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr habr)).mpr
    linarith only [hy.2]

theorem nonneg (p : List ℚ) (a b : ℚ) (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ)
    (hc : accepts p a b d cs=true) (hcs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ cs i) (hab : a < b)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) : 0 ≤ realEvaluator y (ofList p) := by
  rw [representation p a b d cs hc y hab]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  exact mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hcs i)
    (Bernstein.basis_nonneg d i _ (cell_coordinate a b hab y hy))

theorem positive (p : List ℚ) (a b : ℚ) (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ)
    (hc : accepts p a b d cs=true) (hcs : ∀ i, 0 < cs i) (hab : a < b)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)) : 0 < realEvaluator y (ofList p) := by
  let t := (y-a)/(b-a)
  have ht := cell_coordinate a b hab y hy
  have hex : ∃ i : Fin (d+1), 0 < Bernstein.basis d i t := by
    by_contra! h
    have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => h i)
    rw [Bernstein.basis_sum] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  rw [representation p a b d cs hc y hab]
  apply (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (hcs i).le) (Bernstein.basis_nonneg d i _ ht))).mpr
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ _,mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hcs i) hi⟩

theorem linear_control : accepts [1,1] 1 2 1 ![2,3]=true := by
  rw [accepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro t
  norm_num [ofList,affine,form,bernsteinPolynomial,Nat.choose,Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  all_goals ring
theorem rejects_false_control : accepts [1,1] 1 2 1 ![2,4]=false := by
  rw [accepts,decide_eq_false_iff_not]
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun p : ℚ[X] => p.eval 1) h
  norm_num [ofList,affine,form,bernsteinPolynomial,Nat.choose,Fin.sum_univ_succ] at he

#print axioms affine_evaluation
#print axioms basis_evaluation
#print axioms form_evaluation
#print axioms representation
#print axioms cell_coordinate
#print axioms nonneg
#print axioms positive
#print axioms linear_control
#print axioms rejects_false_control
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialCell

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalComplexPolynomial
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Integrals.Basic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialIntegral

open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial MeasureTheory
noncomputable section

theorem derivative_evaluation (p : ℚ[X]) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => realEvaluator y p) (realEvaluator x p.derivative) x := by
  simpa [realEvaluator, Polynomial.derivative_map, Polynomial.eval_map] using
    (p.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)).hasDerivAt x

theorem evaluation_continuous (p : ℚ[X]) : Continuous (fun y => realEvaluator y p) :=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => (derivative_evaluation p y).continuousAt)

theorem rational_evaluation (p : ℚ[X]) (x : ℚ) :
    realEvaluator (x : ℝ) p = ((p.eval x : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      simp only [map_add, Polynomial.eval_add, Rat.cast_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial n c => simp [realEvaluator]

def accepts (p F : List ℚ) (a b L : ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide ((ofList F).derivative = ofList p ∧ (ofList F).eval b - (ofList F).eval a = L)

/-- The exact rational primitive is checked before any integral payment is used. -/
theorem sound (p F : List ℚ) (a b L : ℚ) (hcheck : accepts p F a b L = true) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in (a : ℝ)..(b : ℝ), realEvaluator y (ofList p)) = (L : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨hd,he⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hcheck
  have hF (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun t => realEvaluator t (ofList F))
      (realEvaluator y (ofList p)) y := by
    have h := derivative_evaluation (ofList F) y
    rw [hd] at h
    exact h
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun y _ => hF y)
    ((evaluation_continuous (ofList p)).intervalIntegrable (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))
  rw [rational_evaluation, rational_evaluation, ← Rat.cast_sub, he] at h
  exact h

theorem control : accepts [1,1] [0,1,1/2] 0 1 (3/2) = true := by
  rw [accepts, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · apply Polynomial.funext
    intro t
    norm_num [ofList]
    ring
  · norm_num [ofList]
theorem rejects_wrong_payment : accepts [1,1] [0,1,1/2] 0 1 2 = false := by
  rw [accepts, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
  rintro ⟨_, h⟩
  norm_num [ofList] at h

#print axioms derivative_evaluation
#print axioms evaluation_continuous
#print axioms rational_evaluation
#print axioms sound
#print axioms control
#print axioms rejects_wrong_payment

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialIntegral
