import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalPolynomialCell

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialOrder
open Polynomial PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial RationalPolynomialCell
noncomputable section

theorem form_nonneg (p : ℚ[X]) (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ)
    (he : p = form d cs) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ cs i) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 ≤ realEvaluator t p := by
  rw [he,form_evaluation]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hc i) (Bernstein.basis_nonneg d i t ht))

theorem form_positive (p : ℚ[X]) (d : ℕ) (cs : Fin (d+1) → ℚ)
    (he : p = form d cs) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < cs i) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < realEvaluator t p := by
  have hex : ∃ i : Fin (d+1), 0 < Bernstein.basis d i t := by
    by_contra! h
    have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => h i)
    rw [Bernstein.basis_sum] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  rw [he,form_evaluation]
  apply (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (hc i).le) (Bernstein.basis_nonneg d i t ht))).mpr
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ _,mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hc i) hi⟩

theorem list_nonneg (p : List ℚ) (hc : ∀ c ∈ p, 0 ≤ c) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ realEvaluator t (ofList p) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [ofList]
  | cons c p ih =>
      change 0 ≤ realEvaluator t (C c+X*ofList p)
      rw [map_add,map_mul,real_C,real_X]
      exact add_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hc c (by simp))
        (mul_nonneg ht (ih (fun d hd => hc d (by simp [hd]))))

theorem list_positive (p : List ℚ) (hc : ∀ c ∈ p, 0 ≤ c)
    (h0 : 0 < p.headD 0) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 < realEvaluator t (ofList p) := by
  cases p with
  | nil => norm_num at h0
  | cons c p =>
      change 0 < realEvaluator t (C c+X*ofList p)
      rw [map_add,map_mul,real_C,real_X]
      have hp := list_nonneg p (fun d hd => hc d (by simp [hd])) t ht
      have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) < c := by exact_mod_cast h0
      exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hc0 (mul_nonneg ht hp)

def rayAccepts (p : ℚ[X]) (Y : ℚ) (cs : List ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (p.comp (affine Y (Y+1)) = ofList cs ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, 0 ≤ c)

theorem ray_nonneg (p : ℚ[X]) (Y : ℚ) (cs : List ℚ)
    (hc : rayAccepts p Y cs = true) (y : ℝ) (hy : (Y : ℝ) ≤ y) :
    0 ≤ realEvaluator y p := by
  obtain ⟨he,hn⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have hv := congrArg (realEvaluator (y-(Y : ℝ))) he
  rw [affine_evaluation] at hv
  have heq : (Y : ℝ)+(((Y+1 : ℚ) : ℝ)-Y)*(y-Y) = y := by push_cast; ring
  rw [heq] at hv
  rw [hv]
  exact list_nonneg cs hn _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hy)

theorem ray_positive (p : ℚ[X]) (Y : ℚ) (cs : List ℚ)
    (hc : rayAccepts p Y cs = true) (h0 : 0 < cs.headD 0)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : (Y : ℝ) ≤ y) : 0 < realEvaluator y p := by
  obtain ⟨he,hn⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have hv := congrArg (realEvaluator (y-(Y : ℝ))) he
  rw [affine_evaluation] at hv
  have heq : (Y : ℝ)+(((Y+1 : ℚ) : ℝ)-Y)*(y-Y) = y := by push_cast; ring
  rw [heq] at hv
  rw [hv]
  exact list_positive cs hn h0 _ (sub_nonneg.mpr hy)

#print axioms form_nonneg
#print axioms form_positive
#print axioms list_nonneg
#print axioms list_positive
#print axioms ray_nonneg
#print axioms ray_positive
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalPolynomialOrder

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Fast exact binomial evaluation for rational Bernstein certificates.
The computational checker is proved equivalent to the original checker.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanRationalTensorPolynomial

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalTensorPolynomial
open Finset

def fastFactor {n : ℕ} (d e j : Exponent n) : ℚ :=
  ∏ i, if e i ≤ j i then (Nat.fast_choose (d i - e i) (j i - e i) : ℚ) else 0

def fastCoefficient {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) : Poly n → ℚ
  | [] => 0
  | t :: p => t.1 * fastFactor d t.2 j + fastCoefficient d j p

theorem fastFactor_eq {n : ℕ} (d e j : Exponent n) : fastFactor d e j = factor d e j := by
  simp only [fastFactor, factor, ← Nat.choose_eq_fast_choose]

theorem fastCoefficient_eq {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) :
    fastCoefficient d j p = coefficient d j p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t p ih => simp only [fastCoefficient, coefficient, fastFactor_eq, ih]

def acceptsFast {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Bool :=
  decide (bounded d p ∧ ∀ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
    0 ≤ fastCoefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p)

theorem acceptsFast_sound {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n)
    (hc : acceptsFast d p = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ evaluate x p := by
  have h : bounded d p ∧ ∀ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      0 ≤ fastCoefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p := of_decide_eq_true hc
  have hold : accepts d p = true := by
    apply decide_eq_true
    simpa only [fastCoefficient_eq] using h
  exact accepts_sound d p hold x hx

#print axioms fastFactor_eq
#print axioms fastCoefficient_eq
#print axioms acceptsFast_sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalTensorPolynomial

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The univariate expansion proof is adapted from LeanCert contributors,
Apache 2.0, commit 621a43d7cf21f87872392a01e874f2f1dbddc926.
Rational tensor Bernstein coefficients for the finite-degree integral cells.
Source: the compact integral certificates for pendant-path fusion,
September 2026, and the binomial expansion of monomials.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanTensorPolynomial

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalTensorPolynomial
open Finset
open scoped Classical

abbrev Exponent (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℕ
abbrev Term (n : ℕ) := ℚ × Exponent n
abbrev Poly (n : ℕ) := List (Term n)

noncomputable def monomial {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (e : Exponent n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, x i ^ e i

noncomputable def evaluate {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Poly n → ℝ
  | [] => 0
  | t :: p => t.1 * monomial x t.2 + evaluate x p

def bounded {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Prop :=
  ∀ t ∈ p, ∀ i, t.2 i ≤ d i

instance {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Decidable (bounded d p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ t ∈ p, ∀ i, t.2 i ≤ d i))

def factor {n : ℕ} (d e j : Exponent n) : ℚ :=
  ∏ i, if e i ≤ j i then (Nat.choose (d i - e i) (j i - e i) : ℚ) else 0

def coefficient {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) : Poly n → ℚ
  | [] => 0
  | t :: p => t.1 * factor d t.2 j + coefficient d j p

noncomputable def weight {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, x i ^ j i * (1 - x i) ^ (d i - j i)

theorem weight_nonneg {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ weight d j x := by
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hx i).1 _) (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx i).2) _))

theorem monomial_expansion {n : ℕ} (d e : Exponent n) (he : ∀ i, e i ≤ d i)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    monomial x e = ∑ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      (factor d e (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) : ℝ) *
        weight d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) x := by
  have hi (i : Fin n) : x i ^ e i = ∑ j : Fin (d i + 1),
      ((if e i ≤ (j : ℕ) then
        (Nat.choose (d i - e i) ((j : ℕ) - e i) : ℚ) else 0 : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        (x i ^ (j : ℕ) * (1 - x i) ^ (d i - (j : ℕ))) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ =>
      ((if e i ≤ j then (Nat.choose (d i - e i) (j - e i) : ℚ) else 0 : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        (x i ^ j * (1 - x i) ^ (d i - j))) (d i + 1)]
    simpa only [apply_ite, Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_zero, mul_assoc,
      ite_mul, zero_mul] using
      TensorPolynomial.power_expansion (d i) (e i) (he i) (x i)
  unfold monomial
  simp_rw [hi]
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [factor, weight, Rat.cast_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib

theorem representation {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) (hp : bounded d p)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    evaluate x p = ∑ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      (coefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p : ℝ) *
        weight d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [evaluate, coefficient]
  | cons t p ih =>
    have ht : ∀ i, t.2 i ≤ d i := hp t (by simp)
    have hrest : bounded d p := fun u hu => hp u (by simp [hu])
    simp only [evaluate, coefficient, Rat.cast_add, Rat.cast_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← ih hrest]
    rw [monomial_expansion d t.2 ht x, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring

def accepts {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Bool :=
  decide (bounded d p ∧ ∀ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
    0 ≤ coefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p)

theorem accepts_sound {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n)
    (hc : accepts d p = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ evaluate x p := by
  have h : bounded d p ∧ ∀ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      0 ≤ coefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [representation d p h.1 x]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  exact mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast h.2 j) (weight_nonneg d _ x hx)

#print axioms monomial_expansion
#print axioms representation
#print axioms accepts_sound
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RationalTensorPolynomial

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Circle inversion for the genuine reciprocal Schur disk.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Section 3.1.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanResolventDisk
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ResolventDisk

/-- Inversion of a closed disk that excludes zero. -/
theorem inverse_disk (g w : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hsep : 0 < Complex.normSq g - r ^ 2) (hw : ‖w - g‖ ≤ r) :
    w ≠ 0 ∧
      ‖w⁻¹ - star g / (Complex.normSq g - r ^ 2 : ℝ)‖ ≤
        r / (Complex.normSq g - r ^ 2) := by
  let δ := Complex.normSq g - r ^ 2
  have hδ : 0 < δ := hsep
  have hd0 : (δ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hδ.ne'
  have hw2 : Complex.normSq (w - g) ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw 2
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    simp only [hz, zero_sub, Complex.normSq_neg] at hw2
    dsimp [δ] at hδ
    linarith
  refine ⟨hw0, ?_⟩
  have hN : 0 < Complex.normSq w := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hw0
  have hid : Complex.normSq ((δ : ℂ) - w * star g) - r ^ 2 * Complex.normSq w =
      δ * (Complex.normSq (w - g) - r ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
    dsimp [δ]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  have hle : Complex.normSq ((δ : ℂ) - w * star g) ≤ r ^ 2 * Complex.normSq w := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hw2)]
  have he : w⁻¹ - star g / (δ : ℂ) = ((δ : ℂ) - w * star g) / (w * (δ : ℂ)) := by
    field_simp
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (div_nonneg hr hδ.le)).mp
  rw [Complex.sq_norm, he, Complex.normSq_div, Complex.normSq_mul,
    Complex.normSq_ofReal]
  rw [div_pow]
  simp only [← pow_two]
  exact (div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hN (sq_pos_of_pos hδ))
    (sq_pos_of_pos hδ)).mpr (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg δ) (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)])

/-- The explicit reciprocal disk in Lemma 3.1, including its normalization. -/
theorem reciprocal_schur_disk (d y : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hy : 0 < y) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hζ : ‖ζ - ((2 - d : ℝ) + (y + d / (2 * y) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      d / (2 * y)) :
    let Δ := (d - 2) ^ 2 + d + y ^ 2
    let c : ℂ := ((2 - d) / Δ : ℝ) - ((2 * y ^ 2 + d) / (2 * y * Δ) : ℝ) * Complex.I
    let R : ℝ := d / (2 * y * Δ)
    ζ ≠ 0 ∧ ‖ζ⁻¹ - c‖ ≤ R ∧ Complex.normSq c - R ^ 2 = 1 / Δ := by
  dsimp only
  let Δ := (d - 2) ^ 2 + d + y ^ 2
  let g : ℂ := ((2 - d : ℝ) + (y + d / (2 * y) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
  let r := d / (2 * y)
  have hΔ : 0 < Δ := by dsimp [Δ]; positivity
  have hg : Complex.normSq g - r ^ 2 = Δ := by
    dsimp [g, r, Δ]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hinv := inverse_disk g ζ r (by dsimp [r]; positivity) (hg ▸ hΔ) hζ
  have hc : star g / (Δ : ℂ) =
      (((2 - d) / Δ : ℝ) - ((2 * y ^ 2 + d) / (2 * y * Δ) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
    dsimp [g]
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp only [Complex.div_re, Complex.div_im, Complex.normSq_ofReal,
        Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        add_zero, zero_add, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero] <;> field_simp <;> ring
  rw [hg, hc] at hinv
  refine ⟨hinv.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [r, div_div] using hinv.2
  · rw [← hc]
    rw [Complex.normSq_div, show Complex.normSq (star g) = Complex.normSq g from
      Complex.normSq_conj g, Complex.normSq_ofReal]
    have hrel : Complex.normSq g = Δ + r ^ 2 := by linarith
    rw [hrel]
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp
    ring

#print axioms inverse_disk
#print axioms reciprocal_schur_disk

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ResolventDisk

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The Hermitian resolvent disk used by the arbitrary-core Schur reduction.
No integral sign estimate or global energy inequality is asserted here.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanPathResolvent
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ResolventDisk

open Matrix
open scoped InnerProductSpace

theorem scalar_disk (q : ℂ) (d t y : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcs : Complex.normSq q ≤ d * t) (him : q.im = -y * t) :
    ‖q + (d / (2 * y) : ℝ) * Complex.I‖ ≤ d / (2 * y) := by
  have hr : 0 ≤ d / (2 * y) := by positivity
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr).mp
  rw [Complex.sq_norm]
  have hpay : q.im * (2 * (d / (2 * y))) = -(d * t) := by
    rw [him]
    field_simp
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, sub_self,
    add_zero, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im] at *
  nlinarith

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

/-- Cauchy--Schwarz and the imaginary resolvent identity give the disk directly. -/
theorem disk_of_equation (T : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) (hT : T.IsSymmetric)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (b x : E) (hx : z • x - T x = b) :
    ‖⟪b, x⟫_ℂ + (‖b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im) : ℝ) * Complex.I‖ ≤
      ‖b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im) := by
  have him : (⟪b, x⟫_ℂ).im = -z.im * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hx, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
    have ht := hT.im_inner_apply_self x
    change (⟪T x, x⟫_ℂ).im = 0 at ht
    simp [← Complex.ofReal_pow, ht]
  have hnorm := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) b x
  have hcs : Complex.normSq (⟪b, x⟫_ℂ) ≤ ‖b‖ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (⟪b, x⟫_ℂ), norm_nonneg b, norm_nonneg x]
  exact scalar_disk _ _ _ _ (sq_nonneg _) hz hcs him

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- A disk bound on the actual inverse of every nonreal Hermitian shift. -/
theorem hermitian_resolvent_disk (H : Matrix V V ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (b : V → ℂ) :
    ‖star b ⬝ᵥ ((z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - H)⁻¹ *ᵥ b) +
      (‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℂ V)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im) : ℝ) * Complex.I‖ ≤
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℂ V)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im) := by
  let M := z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - H
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℂ V := WithLp.toLp 2 (M⁻¹ *ᵥ b)
  let B : EuclideanSpace ℂ V := WithLp.toLp 2 b
  have hM : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (PathRecurrence.shifted_det_ne_zero H hH z hz.ne')
  have hvec : (z • (M⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) - H *ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ b) = b := by
    have h : M *ᵥ (M⁻¹ *ᵥ b) = b := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    dsimp only [M] at h
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
    exact h
  have hx : z • x - H.toEuclideanLin x = B := by
    ext i
    exact congrFun hvec i
  have h := disk_of_equation H.toEuclideanLin
    (Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hH) z hz B x hx
  simpa [x, B, M, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm] using h

#print axioms disk_of_equation
#print axioms hermitian_resolvent_disk

/-- The actual Schur-complement scalar is in the predicted upper-half-plane
disk. The root diagonal is real and no property of a particular core is assumed. -/
theorem schur_complement_disk (H : Matrix V V ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (d : ℝ) (b : V → ℂ) :
    let r : ℝ := ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℂ V)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im)
    let q := star b ⬝ᵥ ((z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - H)⁻¹ *ᵥ b)
    ‖(z - d - q) - (z - d + r * Complex.I)‖ ≤ r ∧
      z.im ≤ (z - d - q).im := by
  dsimp only
  let r : ℝ := ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 b : EuclideanSpace ℂ V)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * z.im)
  let q := star b ⬝ᵥ ((z • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - H)⁻¹ *ᵥ b)
  have h := hermitian_resolvent_disk H hH z hz b
  change ‖q + r * Complex.I‖ ≤ r at h
  have hi := Complex.im_le_norm (q + r * Complex.I)
  have hqi : q.im ≤ 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero] at hi
    linarith
  constructor
  · change ‖(z - d - q) - (z - d + r * Complex.I)‖ ≤ r
    have he : (z - d - q) - (z - d + r * Complex.I) = -(q + r * Complex.I) := by ring
    rw [he, norm_neg]
    exact h
  · change z.im ≤ (z - d - q).im
    simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
    linarith

#print axioms schur_complement_disk

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ResolventDisk

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The explicit all-length isomorphism between the fused joined-path graph and
the delete/add rewiring on the original labelled vertex set.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Definition 1.2.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFusionQuotient
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanCountTransport

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RewireIso

open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V : Type*}

def base (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    SimpleGraph (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :=
  (C ⊕g (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (p + 1) ⊕g SimpleGraph.pathGraph (q + 1))) ⊔
    SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inl 0))

def rewired (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    SimpleGraph (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :=
  base C u p q ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p))) (.inr (.inr 0))

def armEquiv (p q : ℕ) : Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1) ≃ Fin (p + q + 2) :=
  finSumFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (by omega))

def vertices (p q : ℕ) : (V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) ≃ (V ⊕ Fin (p + q + 2)) :=
  Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl V) (armEquiv p q)

theorem armEquiv_left (p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + 1)) :
    (armEquiv p q (.inl i)).val = i.val := by
  simp [armEquiv]

theorem armEquiv_right (p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (q + 1)) :
    (armEquiv p q (.inr i)).val = p + 1 + i.val := by
  simp [armEquiv]

theorem rewired_adj (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ)
    (i j : V ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) :
    (rewired C u p q).Adj i j ↔
      (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q).Adj (vertices p q i) (vertices p q j) := by
  rcases i with i | (i | i) <;> rcases j with j | (j | j) <;>
    simp only [rewired, base, CoreQuotient.fused, CoreQuotient.join,
      SimpleGraph.sup_adj, SimpleGraph.edge_adj, SimpleGraph.sum,
      vertices, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Sum.map_inr, Equiv.refl_apply,
      Sum.inl.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq,
      Sum.inl_ne_inr, Sum.inr_ne_inl, false_and, and_false, false_or, or_false,
      SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj]
  all_goals simp only [Fin.ext_iff, armEquiv_left, armEquiv_right, Fin.val_zero,
    Fin.val_last, ne_eq, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl_ne_inr, Sum.inr_ne_inl,
    Bool.false_eq_true, false_or, and_true,
    not_false_eq_true]
  all_goals first | rfl | omega | (constructor <;> intro h <;> simp_all)

/-- All positive arm lengths, including singleton arms, on the original vertex set. -/
def fusedIso (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    rewired C u p q ≃g CoreQuotient.fused C u p q where
  toEquiv := vertices p q
  map_rel_iff' := fun {i j} => (rewired_adj C u p q i j).symm

theorem source_eq (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    CoreQuotient.source C u p q =
      base C u p q ⊔ SimpleGraph.edge (.inl u) (.inr (.inr 0)) := rfl

theorem base_missing_edges (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (p q : ℕ) :
    ¬(base C u p q).Adj (.inl u) (.inr (.inr 0)) ∧
      ¬(base C u p q).Adj (.inr (.inl (Fin.last p))) (.inr (.inr 0)) := by
  simp [base, SimpleGraph.sum, SimpleGraph.edge_adj]

#print axioms fusedIso
#print axioms base_missing_edges

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RewireIso

import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Operations

/-!
# Tree preservation and leaf descent for pendant-path fusion

The base graph omits the edge from the branching root `u` to the second arm `w`.
Fusion replaces that edge by the edge from the first arm's endpoint `v` to `w`.
All statements use the original labelled vertex set.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RewireTopology

open SimpleGraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

variable {V : Type*}

/-- Transport a walk by replacing each of its edges with a reachable pair. -/
theorem reachable_transfer (G H : SimpleGraph V)
    (h : ∀ {x y}, G.Adj x y → H.Reachable x y) {x y : V}
    (hxy : G.Reachable x y) : H.Reachable x y := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
  induction p with
  | nil => exact Reachable.rfl
  | cons ha p ih => exact (h ha).trans ih

/-- Moving one bridge attachment within its component preserves connectedness. -/
theorem connected_rewire (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V) (hvw : v ≠ w)
    (huv : G.Reachable u v) (hG : (G ⊔ edge u w).Connected) :
    (G ⊔ edge v w).Connected := by
  let H := G ⊔ edge v w
  have hvw' : H.Reachable v w :=
    (show H.Adj v w from Or.inr (by simp [edge_adj, hvw])).reachable
  have huw : H.Reachable u w := (huv.mono le_sup_left).trans hvw'
  let : Nonempty V := ⟨u⟩
  refine ⟨fun x y => reachable_transfer _ H ?_ (hG x y)⟩
  intro a b hab
  rcases hab with hab | hab
  · exact (show H.Adj a b from Or.inl hab).reachable
  · rcases ((edge_adj u w a b).mp hab).1 with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact huw
    · exact huw.symm

variable [Fintype V]

/-- The deleted and inserted edges are both new to the same base graph. -/
theorem edge_count_rewire (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V)
    (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w) (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w) :
    (G ⊔ edge u w).edgeFinset.card = (G ⊔ edge v w).edgeFinset.card := by
  rw [G.card_edgeFinset_sup_edge hguw huw, G.card_edgeFinset_sup_edge hgvw hvw]

/-- The actual rewiring preserves the tree property, with no spectral premise. -/
theorem tree_rewire (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V)
    (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w) (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w)
    (huv : G.Reachable u v) (hG : (G ⊔ edge u w).IsTree) :
    (G ⊔ edge v w).IsTree := by
  apply isTree_iff_connected_and_card.mpr
  refine ⟨connected_rewire G u v w hvw huv hG.connected, ?_⟩
  have hc := (isTree_iff_connected_and_card.mp hG).2
  have he := edge_count_rewire G u v w huw hvw hguw hgvw
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← edgeFinset_card, ← he] using hc

theorem degree_edge (u w x : V) (huw : u ≠ w) :
    (edge u w).degree x = if x = u ∨ x = w then 1 else 0 := by
  have hnu : (edge u w).neighborFinset u = {w} := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_neighborFinset, edge_adj, Finset.mem_singleton]
    aesop
  have hnw : (edge u w).neighborFinset w = {u} := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_neighborFinset, edge_adj, Finset.mem_singleton]
    aesop
  by_cases hxu : x = u
  · subst x
    simp [degree, hnu]
  · by_cases hxw : x = w
    · subst x
      simp [degree, hnw]
    · have hn : (edge u w).neighborFinset x = ∅ := by
        ext y
        simp [mem_neighborFinset, edge_adj, hxu, hxw]
      simp [degree, hn, hxu, hxw]

theorem degree_sup_edge (G : SimpleGraph V) (u w x : V)
    (huw : u ≠ w) (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) :
    (G ⊔ edge u w).degree x = G.degree x + if x = u ∨ x = w then 1 else 0 := by
  have hd : Disjoint G (edge u w) := (disjoint_edge G).mpr hguw
  unfold degree
  rw [neighborFinset_sup_of_disjoint x hd, Finset.card_disjUnion]
  exact congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (G.neighborFinset x).card + k) (degree_edge u w x huw)

/-- The number of degree-one vertices, including all vertex labels. -/
def leafCount (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter fun x => G.degree x = 1).card

theorem leaf_count_iso {W : Type*} [Fintype W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ≃g H) :
    leafCount G = leafCount H := by
  unfold leafCount
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => f x)
  · intro x hx
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, f.degree_eq] using hx
  · intro x _ y _ hxy
    exact f.injective hxy
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨f.symm y, ?_, f.apply_symm_apply y⟩
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, f.symm.degree_eq] using hy

/-- Exactly the old endpoint ceases to be a leaf; every other leaf is retained.
The base root has degree at least two, and the first-arm endpoint has degree one. -/
theorem leaf_count_rewire (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w)
    (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w)
    (hdu : 2 ≤ G.degree u) (hdv : G.degree v = 1) :
    leafCount (G ⊔ edge u w) = leafCount (G ⊔ edge v w) + 1 := by
  classical
  have hv : v ∉ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (G ⊔ edge v w).degree x = 1) := by
    simp [degree_sup_edge G v w v hvw hgvw, hdv]
  have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (G ⊔ edge u w).degree x = 1) =
      insert v (Finset.univ.filter fun x => (G ⊔ edge v w).degree x = 1) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
      degree_sup_edge G u w x huw hguw, degree_sup_edge G v w x hvw hgvw]
    by_cases hxu : x = u
    · subst x
      simp [huv, huw]
      omega
    · by_cases hxv : x = v
      · subst x
        simp [Ne.symm huv, hvw, hdv]
      · by_cases hxw : x = w <;> simp_all
  have hcard := congrArg Finset.card he
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hv] at hcard
  simpa only [leafCount, ← card_neighborSet_eq_degree, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard

/-- A natural-number descent measure for every genuine pendant-path fusion. -/
theorem leaf_count_strict (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w)
    (hguw : ¬G.Adj u w) (hgvw : ¬G.Adj v w)
    (hdu : 2 ≤ G.degree u) (hdv : G.degree v = 1) :
    leafCount (G ⊔ edge v w) < leafCount (G ⊔ edge u w) := by
  rw [leaf_count_rewire G u v w huv huw hvw hguw hgvw hdu hdv]
  omega

#print axioms reachable_transfer
#print axioms connected_rewire
#print axioms edge_count_rewire
#print axioms tree_rewire
#print axioms degree_sup_edge
#print axioms leaf_count_iso
#print axioms leaf_count_rewire
#print axioms leaf_count_strict

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RewireTopology

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
Complete root isolation from exact signs on ordered disjoint intervals.
The degree bound certifies that no additional real root is omitted.
-/
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RootIsolation
open Polynomial Set Finset
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem root_between (p : ℝ[X]) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hsign : p.eval a * p.eval b < 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioo a b, p.eval x = 0 := by
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hsign with h | h
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hp⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo' hab.le p.continuous.continuousOn ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, hp⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hp⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo hab.le p.continuous.continuousOn h
    exact ⟨x, hx, hp⟩

theorem complete_roots (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i) (hsign : ∀ i, p.eval (a i) * p.eval (b i) < 0)
    (horder : ∀ i j, i < j → b i ≤ a j) :
    ∃ r : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, r i ∈ Ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
      p.roots = Multiset.map r (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val := by
  choose r hrmem hrroot using (fun i => root_between p (a i) (b i) (hab i) (hsign i))
  have hrmono : StrictMono r := by
    intro i j hij
    exact (hrmem i).2.trans_le (horder i j hij) |>.trans (hrmem j).1
  let embedding : Fin n ↪ ℝ := ⟨r, hrmono.injective⟩
  let roots : Finset ℝ := Finset.univ.map embedding
  have hroots (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ roots) : p.eval x = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hx
    subst x
    exact hrroot i
  have hcard : p.natDegree ≤ roots.card := by simpa [roots] using hn
  have he := Polynomial.roots_eq_of_natDegree_le_card_of_ne_zero hroots hcard hp
  exact ⟨r, hrmem, he⟩

theorem stop_loss_bounds (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i) (hsign : ∀ i, p.eval (a i) * p.eval (b i) < 0)
    (horder : ∀ i j, i < j → b i ≤ a j) (α : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, max (a i - α) 0) ≤ (p.roots.map (fun x => max (x - α) 0)).sum ∧
      (p.roots.map (fun x => max (x - α) 0)).sum ≤ ∑ i, max (b i - α) 0 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, he⟩ := complete_roots p hp n hn a b hab hsign horder
  have hs : (p.roots.map (fun x => max (x - α) 0)).sum = ∑ i, max (r i - α) 0 := by
    rw [he, Multiset.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [hs]
  constructor
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact max_le_max (sub_le_sub_right (hr i).1.le α) le_rfl
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact max_le_max (sub_le_sub_right (hr i).2.le α) le_rfl

#print axioms root_between
#print axioms complete_roots
#print axioms stop_loss_bounds
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RootIsolation

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The actual graph-root resolvent and its principal-minor Schur complement.
The principal minor retains the degrees in the original core graph.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Section 3.1.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFusionQuotient
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanReciprocalDisk

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RootSchur

open Matrix Finset
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

abbrev Rest (u : V) := {v : V // v ≠ u}

def principalLaplacian (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) : Matrix (Rest u) (Rest u) ℂ :=
  (C.lapMatrix ℂ).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

def rootNeighbors (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) : Rest u → ℂ :=
  fun v => if C.Adj u v then 1 else 0

def schurScalar (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  z - (C.degree u : ℂ) - star (rootNeighbors C u) ⬝ᵥ
    ((z • (1 : Matrix (Rest u) (Rest u) ℂ) - principalLaplacian C u)⁻¹ *ᵥ
      rootNeighbors C u)

theorem principal_isHermitian (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) :
    (principalLaplacian C u).IsHermitian :=
  (C.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℂ).submatrix Subtype.val

omit [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] in
theorem rootNeighbors_star (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) :
    star (rootNeighbors C u) = rootNeighbors C u := by
  ext v
  simp [rootNeighbors]

theorem rootNeighbors_norm (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (rootNeighbors C u) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Rest u))‖ ^ 2 =
      (C.degree u : ℝ) := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [rootNeighbors]
  simp_rw [show ∀ v : Rest u, ‖(if C.Adj u v then (1 : ℂ) else 0)‖ ^ 2 =
    (if C.Adj u v then (1 : ℝ) else 0) from fun v => by split_ifs <;> norm_num]
  have hs : (∑ v : Rest u, if C.Adj u v then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = C.degree u := by
    have hfull := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne
      (fun v : V => if C.Adj u v then (1 : ℝ) else 0) u
    have hdeg : (∑ v : V, if C.Adj u v then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = C.degree u := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_boole, SimpleGraph.degree, SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter]
    simpa using hfull.symm.trans hdeg
  simpa using hs

theorem shifted_principal (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (z : ℂ) :
    (CoreQuotient.shifted z C).submatrix (fun v : Rest u => v.val) Subtype.val =
      z • (1 : Matrix (Rest u) (Rest u) ℂ) - principalLaplacian C u := by
  ext i j
  simp [CoreQuotient.shifted, principalLaplacian, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Subtype.val_inj]

/-- The inverse's genuine root diagonal is the inverse Schur scalar. -/
theorem root_resolvent_schur (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    CoreQuotient.rootResolvent z C u = (schurScalar C u z)⁻¹ := by
  let M := CoreQuotient.shifted z C
  let R := z • (1 : Matrix (Rest u) (Rest u) ℂ) - principalLaplacian C u
  let b := rootNeighbors C u
  let x : V → ℂ := fun v => M⁻¹ v u
  let k := x u
  have hM : IsUnit M.det := CoreQuotient.shifted_isUnit z hz.ne' C
  have hR : IsUnit R.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (PathRecurrence.shifted_det_ne_zero _ (principal_isHermitian C u) z hz.ne')
  have hMx (i : V) : (M *ᵥ x) i = if i = u then 1 else 0 := by
    exact congrArg (fun N : Matrix V V ℂ => N i u) (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM)
  have hdiag : M u u = z - (C.degree u : ℂ) := by
    simp [M, CoreQuotient.shifted, SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix,
      SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  have hrow (v : Rest u) : M u v = b v := by
    simp [M, CoreQuotient.shifted, SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix,
      SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, b, rootNeighbors, v.property.symm]
  have hcol (v : Rest u) : M v u = b v := by
    simp [M, CoreQuotient.shifted, SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix,
      SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, b, rootNeighbors, v.property, C.adj_comm]
  have hrest : R *ᵥ (fun v : Rest u => x v) = -(k • b) := by
    ext i
    have hi := hMx i
    rw [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne _ u] at hi
    rw [hcol, if_neg i.property] at hi
    have he : (R *ᵥ (fun v : Rest u => x v)) i =
        ∑ j : Rest u, M i j * x j := by
      change (∑ j : Rest u, R i j * x j) = _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      have hh := congrArg (fun N : Matrix (Rest u) (Rest u) ℂ => N i j)
        (shifted_principal C u z)
      exact congrArg (fun a : ℂ => a * x j) hh.symm
    rw [he]
    change _ = -(k * b i)
    dsimp only [k]
    linear_combination hi
  have hx : (fun v : Rest u => x v) = -(k • (R⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => R⁻¹ *ᵥ v) hrest
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul R hR, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_neg, Matrix.mulVec_smul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hroot := hMx u
  rw [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne _ u,
    hdiag, if_pos rfl] at hroot
  have hsum : (∑ j : Rest u, M u j * x j) =
      -(k * (b ⬝ᵥ (R⁻¹ *ᵥ b))) := by
    simp_rw [hrow]
    change b ⬝ᵥ (fun j : Rest u => x j) = _
    rw [hx, dotProduct_neg, dotProduct_smul]
    rfl
  rw [hsum] at hroot
  have hprod : schurScalar C u z * k = 1 := by
    unfold schurScalar
    rw [rootNeighbors_star]
    change (z - (C.degree u : ℂ) - b ⬝ᵥ (R⁻¹ *ᵥ b)) * k = 1
    dsimp only [k] at hroot ⊢
    linear_combination hroot
  exact (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hprod).symm

/-- The graph-theoretic Schur scalar satisfies the degree-specific disk bound. -/
theorem graph_schur_disk (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ‖schurScalar C u z -
        (z - (C.degree u : ℂ) + (C.degree u / (2 * z.im) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      (C.degree u : ℝ) / (2 * z.im) ∧ z.im ≤ (schurScalar C u z).im := by
  have h := ResolventDisk.schur_complement_disk (principalLaplacian C u)
    (principal_isHermitian C u) z hz (C.degree u) (rootNeighbors C u)
  simpa only [rootNeighbors_norm, schurScalar, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using h

/-- The explicit k-plane disk is now attached to the actual core Laplacian. -/
theorem graph_root_disk (C : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    let d : ℝ := C.degree u
    let Δ := (d - 2) ^ 2 + d + y ^ 2
    let c : ℂ := ((2 - d) / Δ : ℝ) - ((2 * y ^ 2 + d) / (2 * y * Δ) : ℝ) * Complex.I
    let R : ℝ := d / (2 * y * Δ)
    CoreQuotient.rootResolvent (2 + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) C u ≠ 0 ∧
      ‖CoreQuotient.rootResolvent (2 + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) C u - c‖ ≤ R ∧
      Complex.normSq c - R ^ 2 = 1 / Δ := by
  dsimp only
  have hz : 0 < (2 + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im := by simpa using hy
  have h := graph_schur_disk C u (2 + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) hz
  have hd := ResolventDisk.reciprocal_schur_disk (C.degree u) y
    (by positivity) hy (schurScalar C u (2 + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
    (by convert h.1 using 2 <;> simp [sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_assoc, add_mul])
  rw [root_resolvent_schur C u _ hz]
  exact ⟨inv_ne_zero hd.1, hd.2⟩

#print axioms rootNeighbors_norm
#print axioms root_resolvent_schur
#print axioms graph_schur_disk
#print axioms graph_root_disk

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.RootSchur

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The convergent scalar logarithmic integral underlying the Coulson identity.
Source: Gebendorfer, Laplacian energy of trees and pendant-path fusion,
5 September 2026, Lemma 2.4.
-/
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ImproperIntegrals
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.NegMulLog
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ScalarIntegral

open Real Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped Topology

noncomputable def kernel (a y : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * log (1 + (a / y) ^ 2)

noncomputable def primitive (a y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  y / 2 * log (y ^ 2 + a ^ 2) - y * log y + a * arctan (y / a)

theorem kernel_nonneg (a y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ kernel a y := by
  apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
  apply Real.log_nonneg
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a / y)]

theorem kernel_log_difference (a y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    kernel a y = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * log (y ^ 2 + a ^ 2) - log y := by
  have he : 1 + (a / y) ^ 2 = (y ^ 2 + a ^ 2) / y ^ 2 := by field_simp
  unfold kernel
  rw [he, Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
  ring

theorem primitive_derivative (a y : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasDerivAt (primitive a) (kernel a y) y := by
  have hp : 0 < y ^ 2 + a ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_id y).div_const 2).mul
    (((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 2).add_const (a ^ 2) |>.log hp.ne')
  have h2 := (hasDerivAt_id y).mul ((hasDerivAt_id y).log hy.ne')
  have h3 := ((hasDerivAt_id y).div_const a).arctan.const_mul a
  dsimp at h1 h2 h3
  convert! (h1.sub h2).add h3 using 1
  rw [kernel_log_difference a y hy]
  field_simp [hy.ne', ha.ne', hp.ne', show a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 by positivity]
  ring

theorem primitive_continuousAt_zero (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ContinuousAt (primitive a) 0 := by
  unfold primitive
  apply ContinuousAt.add
  · apply ContinuousAt.sub
    · apply ContinuousAt.mul (by fun_prop)
      apply ContinuousAt.log (by fun_prop)
      positivity
    · exact Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousAt
  · fun_prop

theorem primitive_tendsto (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (primitive a) atTop (𝓝 (a * (Real.pi / 2))) := by
  have hsmall : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => y * kernel a y) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hupper : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, y * kernel a y ≤ (a ^ 2 / 2) / y := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
      have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1 + (a / y) ^ 2 by positivity)
      have hk : kernel a y ≤ a ^ 2 / (2 * y ^ 2) := by
        calc
          kernel a y ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (a / y) ^ 2 := by unfold kernel; linarith
          _ = a ^ 2 / (2 * y ^ 2) := by ring
      calc
        y * kernel a y ≤ y * (a ^ 2 / (2 * y ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk hy.le
        _ = (a ^ 2 / 2) / y := by field_simp
    have hlower : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, 0 ≤ y * kernel a y := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
      exact mul_nonneg hy (kernel_nonneg a y)
    exact squeeze_zero' hlower hupper (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_id)
  have harctan : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => a * arctan (y / a)) atTop
      (𝓝 (a * (Real.pi / 2))) := by
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      (Real.tendsto_arctan_atTop.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds |>.comp
        (tendsto_id.atTop_div_const ha))
  have hsum := hsmall.add harctan
  simp only [zero_add] at hsum
  apply hsum.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
  rw [kernel_log_difference a y hy]
  unfold primitive
  ring

theorem kernel_integrable (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : IntegrableOn (kernel a) (Ioi 0) := by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha
  · have he : kernel 0 = fun _ : ℝ => 0 := by funext y; simp [kernel]
    rw [he]
    exact integrableOn_zero
  · exact integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg
      (primitive_continuousAt_zero a ha).continuousWithinAt
      (fun y hy => primitive_derivative a y ha hy) (fun y _ => kernel_nonneg a y)
      (primitive_tendsto a ha)

theorem kernel_integral (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, kernel a y) = a * (Real.pi / 2) := by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha
  · simp [kernel]
  · have h := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg
      (primitive_continuousAt_zero a ha).continuousWithinAt
      (fun y hy => primitive_derivative a y ha hy) (fun y _ => kernel_nonneg a y)
      (primitive_tendsto a ha)
    simpa [primitive] using h

theorem shifted_log_norm (a t y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Real.log ‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (a : ℂ)‖ =
      Real.log y + kernel |a - t| y := by
  have hs : ‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (a : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 =
      y ^ 2 + (a - t) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Complex.sq_norm]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have hl := congrArg Real.log hs
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hl
  norm_num at hl
  rw [kernel_log_difference _ y hy, sq_abs]
  linarith

theorem shifted_norm_pos (a t y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < ‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (a : ℂ)‖ := by
  apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
  intro hz
  have him := congrArg Complex.im hz
  simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
    mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, sub_zero, Complex.zero_im] at him
  linarith

theorem scalar_log_ratio (a b t y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Real.log (‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (a : ℂ)‖ /
      ‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (b : ℂ)‖) =
      kernel |a - t| y - kernel |b - t| y := by
  rw [Real.log_div (shifted_norm_pos a t y hy).ne' (shifted_norm_pos b t y hy).ne',
    shifted_log_norm a t y hy, shifted_log_norm b t y hy]
  ring

theorem scalar_log_ratio_integrable (a b t : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => Real.log
      (‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (a : ℂ)‖ /
        ‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (b : ℂ)‖)) (Ioi 0) := by
  apply ((kernel_integrable |a - t| (abs_nonneg _)).sub
    (kernel_integrable |b - t| (abs_nonneg _))).congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
  exact (scalar_log_ratio a b t y hy).symm

/-- The scalar improper integral, including zero shifted eigenvalues. -/
theorem scalar_log_ratio_integral (a b t : ℝ) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, Real.log
      (‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (a : ℂ)‖ /
        ‖((t : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (b : ℂ)‖)) =
      (Real.pi / 2) * (|a - t| - |b - t|) := by
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun y hy => scalar_log_ratio a b t y hy),
    integral_sub (kernel_integrable |a - t| (abs_nonneg _))
      (kernel_integrable |b - t| (abs_nonneg _)),
    kernel_integral _ (abs_nonneg _), kernel_integral _ (abs_nonneg _)]
  ring

#print axioms kernel_integrable
#print axioms kernel_integral
#print axioms scalar_log_ratio_integrable
#print axioms scalar_log_ratio_integral

end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.ScalarIntegral

/-
Copyright 2026 Jonas J. Gebendorfer. Apache 2.0.
The actual reciprocal-coordinate coefficients, their disk parameter and
the concrete coefficientwise certificate interface for the RG quotient.
-/
import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanFocus

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.Focus

noncomputable section

def a (d P Q : ℝ) : ℂ := (d : ℂ) * A P Q
def b (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℂ := (2 * y : ℝ) * (A P Q * g d y + N₀ y P Q)
def c (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℂ := (d : ℂ) * B y P Q
def e (d y P Q : ℝ) : ℂ := (2 * y : ℝ) * (B y P Q * g d y + D₀ y P Q)

theorem scaled_separation_general (a b center : ℂ) (d y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y)
    (h : 0 < Complex.normSq (a * center + b) - r d y ^ 2 * Complex.normSq a) :
    0 < Complex.normSq ((2 * y : ℝ) * (a * center + b)) -
      Complex.normSq ((d : ℂ) * a) := by
  have hfactor : Complex.normSq ((2 * y : ℝ) * (a * center + b)) -
      Complex.normSq ((d : ℂ) * a) =
      (2 * y) ^ 2 * (Complex.normSq (a * center + b) - r d y ^ 2 * Complex.normSq a) := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_ofReal,
      Complex.normSq_ofReal]
    unfold r
    field_simp
  rw [hfactor]
  exact mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith)) h

theorem scaled_separation (d y P Q : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hP : y ≤ P) (hQ : y ≤ Q) :
    0 < Complex.normSq (e d y P Q) - Complex.normSq (c d y P Q) ∧
    0 < Complex.normSq (b d y P Q) - Complex.normSq (a d P Q) := by
  have hs := concrete_separation d y P Q hd hy hP hQ
  exact ⟨scaled_separation_general _ _ _ d y hy hs.1,
    scaled_separation_general _ _ _ d y hy hs.2⟩

theorem disk_parameter (d y : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hy : 0 < y) (ζ : ℂ)
    (hζ : ‖ζ - g d y‖ ≤ r d y) :
    ‖(ζ - g d y) / (r d y : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ζ = g d y + (r d y : ℂ) * ((ζ - g d y) / (r d y : ℂ)) := by
  have hr : 0 < r d y := div_pos hd (by linarith)
  constructor
  · rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
    exact (div_le_one hr).mpr hζ
  · field_simp [Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne']
    ring

theorem scaled_quotient (d y P Q : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hy : 0 < y)
    (ζ : ℂ) :
    let η := (ζ - g d y) / (r d y : ℂ)
    quotient y P Q ζ = (a d P Q * η + b d y P Q) /
      (c d y P Q * η + e d y P Q) := by
  dsimp only
  have hr : r d y ≠ 0 := (div_pos hd (show 0 < 2 * y by linarith)).ne'
  have hrc : (r d y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr
  have hdc : (d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'
  have hyc : (y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy.ne'
  have hf (A N : ℂ) : (d : ℂ) * A * ((ζ - g d y) / (r d y : ℂ)) +
      (2 * y : ℝ) * (A * g d y + N) = (2 * y : ℝ) * (A * ζ + N) := by
    unfold r
    push_cast
    field_simp [hdc, hyc]
    ring
  unfold quotient a b c e
  rw [hf, hf, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (show 2 * y ≠ 0 by linarith))]

/-- All geometric premises are discharged for the concrete coefficient family.
Only the exact coefficient/integral work remains to supply hL. -/
theorem concrete_certificate (d y P Q : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hP : y ≤ P) (hQ : y ≤ Q) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ - g d y‖ ≤ r d y)
    (s L : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hL : L * ((1 + s) * ‖b d y P Q * star (e d y P Q) -
          a d P Q * star (c d y P Q)‖ ^ 2 +
        (1 + 1 / s) * ‖a d P Q * e d y P Q - b d y P Q * c d y P Q‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (Complex.normSq (b d y P Q) - Complex.normSq (a d P Q)) ^ 2) :
    L ≤ ‖quotient y P Q ζ‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hsep := scaled_separation d y P Q hd.le hy hP hQ
  rw [scaled_quotient d y P Q hd hy ζ]
  exact Bernstein.mobius_certificate _ _ _ _ _ hsep.1 hsep.2
    (disk_parameter d y hd hy ζ hζ).1 s L hs hL

#print axioms scaled_separation
#print axioms scaled_quotient
#print axioms concrete_certificate

theorem denominator_nonzero (d y P Q : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hP : y ≤ P) (hQ : y ≤ Q) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ‖ζ - g d y‖ ≤ r d y) :
    B y P Q * ζ + D₀ y P Q ≠ 0 := by
  have hsep := scaled_separation d y P Q hd.le hy hP hQ
  let η := (ζ - g d y) / (r d y : ℂ)
  have hn := MobiusDisk.denominator_ne_zero (c d y P Q) (e d y P Q) η
    hsep.1 (disk_parameter d y hd hy ζ hζ).1
  have hdc : (d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'
  have hyc : (y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hy.ne'
  have he : c d y P Q * η + e d y P Q =
      (2 * y : ℝ) * (B y P Q * ζ + D₀ y P Q) := by
    unfold c e η r
    push_cast
    field_simp [hdc, hyc]
    ring
  intro hz
  apply hn
  rw [he, hz, mul_zero]

#print axioms denominator_nonzero

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.Focus

import Proofs.RadenkovicGutmanComputedPolynomialCell

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell
open Set MeasureTheory PolynomialPathMap RationalComplexPolynomial
open PolynomialPaymentCell HornerCertificates
open scoped Classical
abbrev Witness := ComputedPolynomialCell.Witness
abbrev Data := ComputedGeneralPathData.Data
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def cell (w : Witness) : PolynomialPaymentCell.Cell :=
  let pay := ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList w.L w.c w.R
  {a:=w.a,b:=w.b,s:=w.s,L:=w.L,pay:=pay,
   primitive:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.primitive pay,c:=w.c,R:=w.R,
   unitIntegral:=ComputedHornerArithmetic.unitIntegral pay,total:=w.total,k:=w.k,n:=w.n,
   comparisonDegree:=0,nDegree:=0,eDegree:=0,
   sCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,lowerCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,
   comparisonCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,nCoefficients:=fun _ => 0,eCoefficients:=fun _ => 0}

def Budget (w : Witness) : Prop :=
  w.total≤(w.b-w.a)*ComputedHornerArithmetic.unitIntegral
    (ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList w.L w.c w.R)

theorem payment_checked (w : Witness) (h : Budget w) : paymentAccepts (cell w)=true := by
  rw [paymentAccepts,decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList_sound w.L w.c w.R,h⟩

theorem primitive_checked (w : Witness) :
    RationalPolynomialIntegral.accepts (cell w).pay (cell w).primitive 0 1 (cell w).unitIntegral=true :=
  ComputedHornerArithmetic.primitive_checked (ComputedHornerArithmetic.paymentList w.L w.c w.R)

noncomputable section
def location (w : Witness) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (w.a : ℝ)+((w.b-w.a : ℚ) : ℝ)*t

/-- These pointwise conditions retain every positivity and comparison obligation
of the original polynomial cell, independently of the arithmetic representation. -/
def Conditions (d : Data) (w : Witness) : Prop :=
  0<w.a ∧ w.a<w.b ∧ 0<w.c ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
    0<evaluate w.s t ∧ (w.c : ℝ)≤evaluate w.L t ∧
    0<evaluate d.N (location w t) ∧ 0<evaluate d.E (location w t) ∧
    evaluate w.L t*((evaluate w.s t+(evaluate w.s t)^2)*evaluate d.U (location w t)+
      (evaluate w.s t+1)*evaluate d.V (location w t))≤
      evaluate w.s t*evaluate d.J (location w t)

theorem pointwise (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (d : Data)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q d.a d.b d.c d.e=true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E=true)
    (w : Witness) (hcnd : Conditions d w) (hb : Budget w)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts w.c w.R w.k w.n=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (w.a : ℝ) (w.b : ℝ)) :
    density (cell w) y≤MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u p q)
      (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x y := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hab,hc,hconditions⟩ := hcnd
  let t := ordinate (cell w) y
  have ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := RationalPolynomialCell.cell_coordinate w.a w.b hab y hy
  have habr : (w.a : ℝ)<w.b := by exact_mod_cast hab
  have hcoord : (w.a : ℝ)+((w.b : ℝ)-w.a)*t=y := by
    dsimp [t,ordinate,cell]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr habr)]
    ring
  have hloc : location w t=y := by simpa only [location,Rat.cast_sub] using hcoord
  obtain ⟨hs,hL,hN,hE,hP⟩ := hconditions t ht
  have hnPos : 0<realEvaluator y (ofList d.N) := by
    rw [← HornerArithmetic.real_evaluation]
    simpa only [hloc] using hN
  have hePos : 0<realEvaluator y (ofList d.E) := by
    rw [← HornerArithmetic.real_evaluation]
    simpa only [hloc] using hE
  have hP' : evaluate w.L t*((evaluate w.s t+(evaluate w.s t)^2)*realEvaluator y (ofList d.U)+
      (evaluate w.s t+1)*realEvaluator y (ofList d.V))≤
      evaluate w.s t*realEvaluator y (ofList d.J) := by
    simpa only [hloc,HornerArithmetic.real_evaluation] using hP
  have hy0 : 0<y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast ha) hy.1
  have h := GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.actual_log_lower x y hy0 p q
    d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E hpath hpoly
    (evaluate w.s t) (evaluate w.L t) hs hnPos hePos hP'
    w.c w.R w.k w.n hc hL hl G u hd
  obtain ⟨hpayment,_⟩ := of_decide_eq_true (payment_checked w hb)
  change realEvaluator t (ofList (cell w).pay)≤_
  rw [hpayment,GeneralPathPolynomialPayments.payment_evaluation,
    ← HornerArithmetic.real_evaluation (cell w).L t]
  exact h

theorem actual_integral_lower (x : ℚ) (p q : ℕ) (d : Data)
    (hpath : GeneralPathPolynomials.accepts x p q d.a d.b d.c d.e=true)
    (hpoly : RationalMobiusPolynomials.accepts d.a d.b d.c d.e d.U d.V d.J d.N d.E=true)
    (w : Witness) (hcnd : Conditions d w) (hb : Budget w)
    (hl : RationalLog.accepts w.c w.R w.k w.n=true)
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : V) (hd : G.degree u=1) :
    (w.total : ℝ)≤∫ y : ℝ in (w.a : ℝ)..(w.b : ℝ),
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source G u p q)
        (CoreQuotient.fused G u p q) x y := by
  have ha : (0 : ℝ)≤w.a := by exact_mod_cast hcnd.1.le
  have habr : (w.a : ℝ)≤w.b := by exact_mod_cast hcnd.2.1.le
  have hf := TailIntegral.interval_integrable_of_Ioi
    (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable G u p q (x : ℝ)) ha habr
  exact le_trans (PolynomialPaymentCell.integral (cell w) hcnd.2.1
    (primitive_checked w) (payment_checked w hb))
    (intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on habr ((density_continuous (cell w)).intervalIntegrable _ _) hf
      (fun y hy => pointwise x p q d hpath hpoly w hcnd hb hl G u hd y hy))

#print axioms payment_checked
#print axioms primitive_checked
#print axioms pointwise
#print axioms actual_integral_lower
end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.SemanticPolynomialPaymentCell

/-!
# The exact small-order basis for RG assembly

Every tree of order two or three is a path. Together with the checked singleton
case, this proves both energy conclusions at every positive order below four.
The global conclusion at cutoff four therefore requires only strict fusion.
This does not establish strict fusion or finite coverage at a larger cutoff.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.SmallOrders

open SimpleGraph CoreQuotient TreeTerminal GlobalAssembly
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem tree_path_iso_below_four {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hn4 : n < 4)
    (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph n) := by
  let : Nontrivial (Fin n) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hn
  have hd : ∀ v, T.degree v ≤ 2 := by
    intro v
    have hv := T.degree_lt_card_verts v
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hv
    omega
  have hp := tree_path_iso_of_degree_le_two T hT hd
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hp
  exact hp

/-- Exhaustive coverage of the exact finite base range 2 <= n < 4. -/
theorem smallOrders_four : GlobalAssembly.SmallOrders 4 := by
  intro n hn hn4 T hT
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := tree_path_iso_below_four hn hn4 T hT
  exact conclusion_of_iso T f

theorem smallOrders_of_le_four {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≤ 4) : GlobalAssembly.SmallOrders N := by
  intro n hn hnN T hT
  exact smallOrders_four n hn (by omega) T hT

/-- At an arbitrary cutoff, the only remaining finite cases start at order four. -/
theorem smallOrders_iff_from_four (N : ℕ) :
    GlobalAssembly.SmallOrders N ↔
      ∀ n, 4 ≤ n → n < N → ∀ T : SimpleGraph (Fin n), T.IsTree → Conclusion T := by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn hnN T hT
    exact h n (by omega) hnN T hT
  · intro h n hn hnN T hT
    by_cases hn4 : n < 4
    · exact smallOrders_four n hn hn4 T hT
    · exact h n (by omega) hnN T hT

/-- Positive core root degree forces every admissible source to have order at least four. -/
theorem four_le_source_order {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m)
    (p q : ℕ) (hu : 1 ≤ C.degree u) :
    4 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m ⊕ Fin (p + 1) ⊕ Fin (q + 1)) := by
  have hm := C.degree_lt_card_verts u
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hm
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

/-- Strict decrease on every actual admissible source/fused pair, with no order cutoff. -/
def UniformStrictFusion : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
    (source C u p q).IsTree → 1 ≤ C.degree u →
      laplacianEnergy (fused C u p q) < laplacianEnergy (source C u p q)

theorem uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_four :
    UniformStrictFusion ↔ StrictFusionAbove 4 := by
  constructor
  · intro h m C u p q _ hT hu
    exact h m C u p q hT hu
  · intro h m C u p q hT hu
    exact h m C u p q (four_le_source_order C u p q hu) hT hu

/-- A conditional global reduction with strict fusion at the fixed cutoff four as its sole input. -/
theorem universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_four (hF : StrictFusionAbove 4)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Conclusion T :=
  SourcePresentation.universal_conclusion_of_inputs 4 smallOrders_four hF n hn T hT

theorem path_minimum_of_strictFusion_four (hF : StrictFusionAbove 4)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy T :=
  (universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_four hF n hn T hT).1

theorem path_equality_of_strictFusion_four (hF : StrictFusionAbove 4)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy T = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ↔ Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph n) :=
  (universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_four hF n hn T hT).2

theorem universal_conclusion_of_uniformStrictFusion (hF : UniformStrictFusion)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Conclusion T :=
  universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_four (uniformStrictFusion_iff_cutoff_four.mp hF) n hn T hT

#check @SimpleGraph.degree_lt_card_verts
#check @smallOrders_four
#check @smallOrders_iff_from_four
#check @universal_conclusion_of_strictFusion_four
#check @path_minimum_of_strictFusion_four
#check @path_equality_of_strictFusion_four

/-!
# Unconditional nonpath source presentation and two-input global assembly

Relabel the very residual and the two actual tail paths supplied by PendantFork.
The resulting source is isomorphic to the original graph, with the same root,
both attachment edges, and the physical arm lengths. This discharges the
`DecomposesAbove` predicate of the checked GlobalAssembly module for every cutoff.
Only finite coverage and strict fusion remain inputs to the global conclusions.
Sources: GlobalAssembly at 997d8d2931b45ea792aa12e812e2ae34153b086e and the
actual fork/residual at b546e3edbad3e45182649bc798182bf30a7457fe. The energy targets
follow PR #7399, statement commit 3654bf2bddc5217f904b7b85207b1091e833de49.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.SourcePresentation

open SimpleGraph NonpathFork ArmEmbedding CoreQuotient GlobalAssembly
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}

def coreEquiv (F : PendantFork G) : Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet) ≃ F.residualSet :=
  (Fintype.equivFin F.residualSet).symm

def core (F : PendantFork G) : SimpleGraph (Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet)) :=
  F.residual.comap (coreEquiv F)

def coreRoot (F : PendantFork G) : Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet) :=
  (coreEquiv F).symm F.residualRoot

theorem coreRoot_value (F : PendantFork G) : ((coreEquiv F) (coreRoot F)).val = F.root := by
  simp [coreRoot, PendantFork.residualRoot]

theorem core_value_eq_root_iff (F : PendantFork G) (c : Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet)) :
    ((coreEquiv F) c).val = F.root ↔ c = coreRoot F := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (coreEquiv F).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [coreRoot_value] using h
  · rintro rfl
    exact coreRoot_value F

theorem core_tree (F : PendantFork G) (hT : G.IsTree) : (core F).IsTree :=
  (Iso.comap (coreEquiv F) F.residual).isTree_iff.mpr (F.residual_tree hT)

theorem core_root_degree (F : PendantFork G) (hT : G.IsTree) : 1 ≤ (core F).degree (coreRoot F) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := F.residual_root_neighbor hT
  have hadj : (core F).Adj (coreRoot F) ((coreEquiv F).symm z) := by
    change F.residual.Adj ((coreEquiv F) ((coreEquiv F).symm F.residualRoot))
      ((coreEquiv F) ((coreEquiv F).symm z))
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hz
  exact Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hadj.degree_pos_left

theorem left_not_residual (F : PendantFork G) (i : Fin (F.left.tail.length + 1)) :
    armVertex F.left i ∉ F.residualSet := by
  rintro (h | h)
  · exact armVertex_ne_root F.left F.left_path F.left_positive i h
  · exact h.1 (armVertex_mem F.left F.left_path F.left_positive i)

theorem right_not_residual (F : PendantFork G) (i : Fin (F.right.tail.length + 1)) :
    armVertex F.right i ∉ F.residualSet := by
  rintro (h | h)
  · exact armVertex_ne_root F.right F.right_path F.right_positive i h
  · exact h.2 (armVertex_mem F.right F.right_path F.right_positive i)

theorem core_ne_left (F : PendantFork G) (c : Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet))
    (i : Fin (F.left.tail.length + 1)) : ((coreEquiv F) c).val ≠ armVertex F.left i := by
  intro h
  apply left_not_residual F i
  rw [← h]
  exact ((coreEquiv F) c).property

theorem core_ne_right (F : PendantFork G) (c : Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet))
    (i : Fin (F.right.tail.length + 1)) : ((coreEquiv F) c).val ≠ armVertex F.right i := by
  intro h
  apply right_not_residual F i
  rw [← h]
  exact ((coreEquiv F) c).property

theorem arms_ne (F : PendantFork G) (i : Fin (F.left.tail.length + 1))
    (j : Fin (F.right.tail.length + 1)) : armVertex F.left i ≠ armVertex F.right j := by
  intro h
  have hr : armVertex F.left i ∈ F.right.support := by
    rw [h]
    exact armVertex_mem F.right F.right_path F.right_positive j
  exact armVertex_ne_root F.left F.left_path F.left_positive i
    (F.intersection _ (armVertex_mem F.left F.left_path F.left_positive i) hr)

def vertexMap (F : PendantFork G) :
    Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet) ⊕ Fin (F.left.tail.length + 1) ⊕
      Fin (F.right.tail.length + 1) → V
  | .inl c => ((coreEquiv F) c).val
  | .inr (.inl i) => armVertex F.left i
  | .inr (.inr j) => armVertex F.right j

theorem vertexMap_injective (F : PendantFork G) : Function.Injective (vertexMap F) := by
  intro x y h
  rcases x with c | (i | j) <;> rcases y with d | (k | l) <;> dsimp [vertexMap] at h
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl ((coreEquiv F).injective (Subtype.ext h))
  · exact (core_ne_left F c k h).elim
  · exact (core_ne_right F c l h).elim
  · exact (core_ne_left F d i h.symm).elim
  · exact congrArg (fun a => Sum.inr (Sum.inl a)) (armVertex_injective F.left F.left_path h)
  · exact (arms_ne F i l h).elim
  · exact (core_ne_right F d j h.symm).elim
  · exact (arms_ne F k j h.symm).elim
  · exact congrArg (fun a => Sum.inr (Sum.inr a)) (armVertex_injective F.right F.right_path h)

theorem vertexMap_surjective (F : PendantFork G) : Function.Surjective (vertexMap F) := by
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ F.residualSet
  · refine ⟨.inl ((coreEquiv F).symm ⟨x, hx⟩), ?_⟩
    simp [vertexMap]
  · have hxu : x ≠ F.root := fun h => hx (Or.inl h)
    by_cases hl : x ∈ F.left.support
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := armVertex_range F.left F.left_path F.left_positive hl hxu
      exact ⟨.inr (.inl i), hi⟩
    · have hr : x ∈ F.right.support := by
        by_contra hr
        exact hx (Or.inr ⟨hl, hr⟩)
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := armVertex_range F.right F.right_path F.right_positive hr hxu
      exact ⟨.inr (.inr j), hj⟩

def vertexEquiv (F : PendantFork G) :
    (Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet) ⊕ Fin (F.left.tail.length + 1) ⊕
      Fin (F.right.tail.length + 1)) ≃ V :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (vertexMap F) ⟨vertexMap_injective F, vertexMap_surjective F⟩

theorem core_arm_adj_iff (F : PendantFork G) (hT : G.IsTree) {v : V}
    (p : G.Walk F.root v) (hp : p.IsPath) (hpos : 0 < p.length)
    (hnot : ∀ i, armVertex p i ∉ F.residualSet)
    (c : Fin (Fintype.card F.residualSet)) (i : Fin (p.tail.length + 1)) :
    G.Adj ((coreEquiv F) c).val (armVertex p i) ↔ c = coreRoot F ∧ i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he : ((coreEquiv F) c).val = F.root :=
      F.residual_boundary (hnot i) ((coreEquiv F) c).property h.symm
    refine ⟨(core_value_eq_root_iff F c).mp he, ?_⟩
    exact (root_arm_adj_iff hT.isAcyclic p hp hpos i).mp (by simpa only [he] using h)
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [coreRoot_value]
    exact (root_arm_adj_iff hT.isAcyclic p hp hpos 0).mpr rfl

theorem no_cross_arm_adj (F : PendantFork G) (i : Fin (F.left.tail.length + 1))
    (j : Fin (F.right.tail.length + 1)) : ¬G.Adj (armVertex F.left i) (armVertex F.right j) := by
  intro h
  have hr := F.left_closed (armVertex_mem F.left F.left_path F.left_positive i)
    (armVertex_ne_root F.left F.left_path F.left_positive i) h
  exact armVertex_ne_root F.right F.right_path F.right_positive j
    (F.intersection _ hr (armVertex_mem F.right F.right_path F.right_positive j))

/-- The source uses the same residual, root and physical arms, including single-edge arms. -/
def sourceIso (F : PendantFork G) (hT : G.IsTree) :
    source (core F) (coreRoot F) F.left.tail.length F.right.tail.length ≃g G where
  toEquiv := vertexEquiv F
  map_rel_iff' := by
    intro x y
    change G.Adj (vertexMap F x) (vertexMap F y) ↔ _
    rcases x with c | (i | j) <;> rcases y with d | (k | l)
    · simp [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap, core, PendantFork.residual]
    · simpa [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap] using
        core_arm_adj_iff F hT F.left F.left_path F.left_positive (left_not_residual F) c k
    · simpa [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap] using
        core_arm_adj_iff F hT F.right F.right_path F.right_positive (right_not_residual F) c l
    · simpa [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap, adj_comm] using
        core_arm_adj_iff F hT F.left F.left_path F.left_positive (left_not_residual F) d i
    · simpa [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap] using
        armVertex_adj_iff hT.isAcyclic F.left F.left_path i k
    · simp [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap, no_cross_arm_adj]
    · simpa [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap, adj_comm] using
        core_arm_adj_iff F hT F.right F.right_path F.right_positive (right_not_residual F) d j
    · simp [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap, adj_comm, no_cross_arm_adj]
    · simpa [source, joinTwo, SimpleGraph.sum, edge_adj, vertexMap] using
        armVertex_adj_iff hT.isAcyclic F.right F.right_path j l

theorem physical_arm_lengths (F : PendantFork G) :
    F.left.tail.length + 1 = F.left.length ∧ F.right.tail.length + 1 = F.right.length :=
  ⟨Walk.length_tail_add_one (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr F.left_positive),
    Walk.length_tail_add_one (Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr F.right_positive)⟩

/-- Every finite nontrivial nonpath tree has an admissible actual source presentation. -/
theorem nonpath_source [Nontrivial V] (hT : G.IsTree)
    (hpath : ¬Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card V))) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ),
      C.IsTree ∧ 1 ≤ C.degree u ∧ Nonempty (G ≃g source C u p q) := by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := nonpath_has_pendant_fork hT hpath
  exact ⟨Fintype.card F.residualSet, core F, coreRoot F, F.left.tail.length,
    F.right.tail.length, core_tree F hT, core_root_degree F hT, ⟨(sourceIso F hT).symm⟩⟩

/-- The decomposition input is discharged for every natural order cutoff. -/
theorem decomposesAbove (N : ℕ) : DecomposesAbove N := by
  intro n _ T hT hpath
  by_cases hn : 2 ≤ n
  · let : Nontrivial (Fin n) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hn
    have hp : ¬Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card (Fin n))) := by
      rw [Fintype.card_fin]
      exact hpath
    obtain ⟨m, C, u, p, q, _, hd, hf⟩ := nonpath_source hT hp
    exact ⟨m, C, u, p, q, hd, hf⟩
  · have hpos : 0 < n := by
      obtain ⟨v⟩ := hT.connected.nonempty
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le v.val) v.isLt
    have hn1 : n = 1 := by omega
    subst n
    have heq : T = pathGraph 1 := by
      ext u v
      have he : v = u := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst v
      simp
    exact (hpath (by rw [heq]; exact ⟨Iso.refl⟩)).elim

/-- Finite coverage and strict fusion are the only remaining inputs to the global target. -/
theorem universal_conclusion_of_inputs (N : ℕ) (hsmall : SmallOrders N)
    (hF : StrictFusionAbove N) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) : Conclusion T :=
  universal_conclusion N hsmall (decomposesAbove N) hF n hn T hT

theorem path_minimum_of_inputs (N : ℕ) (hsmall : SmallOrders N)
    (hF : StrictFusionAbove N) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy T :=
  (universal_conclusion_of_inputs N hsmall hF n hn T hT).1

theorem path_equality_of_inputs (N : ℕ) (hsmall : SmallOrders N)
    (hF : StrictFusionAbove N) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hT : T.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy T = laplacianEnergy (pathGraph n) ↔ Nonempty (T ≃g pathGraph n) :=
  (universal_conclusion_of_inputs N hsmall hF n hn T hT).2

import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Spectrum
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.LapMatrix
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.DegreeSum
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Hasse
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman

open Finset

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

noncomputable def stopLoss (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, max (eigenvalue i - t) 0

noncomputable def centredEnergy (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, |eigenvalue i - t|

theorem abs_eq_two_positivePart_sub (x : ℝ) : |x| = 2 * max x 0 - x := by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx, max_eq_left hx]
    ring
  · have hx' : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hx', max_eq_right hx']
    ring

/-- The exact finite spectral identity; no integral representation is assumed. -/
theorem energy_eq_two_stopLoss_sub_trace (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    centredEnergy eigenvalue t = 2 * stopLoss eigenvalue t -
      ((∑ i, eigenvalue i) - (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * t) := by
  unfold centredEnergy stopLoss
  simp_rw [abs_eq_two_positivePart_sub]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sum, sum_sub_distrib]
  simp

theorem energy_eq_two_stopLoss (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (htrace : ∑ i, eigenvalue i = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * t) :
    centredEnergy eigenvalue t = 2 * stopLoss eigenvalue t := by
  rw [energy_eq_two_stopLoss_sub_trace, htrace]
  ring

theorem stopLoss_lipschitz (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (s t : ℝ) :
    |stopLoss eigenvalue s - stopLoss eigenvalue t| ≤
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * |s - t| := by
  unfold stopLoss
  rw [← sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    |∑ i, (max (eigenvalue i - s) 0 - max (eigenvalue i - t) 0)| ≤
        ∑ i, |max (eigenvalue i - s) 0 - max (eigenvalue i - t) 0| :=
      abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _ : ι, |s - t| := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hi := abs_max_sub_max_le_abs (eigenvalue i - s) (eigenvalue i - t) 0
      have heq : eigenvalue i - s - (eigenvalue i - t) = -(s - t) := by ring
      simpa only [heq, abs_neg] using hi
    _ = _ := by simp

/-- The strict spectral counting function, as a real-valued finite sum. -/
noncomputable def aboveCount (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, if t < eigenvalue i then 1 else 0

theorem positivePart_right_derivative (a t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun x : ℝ => max (a - x) 0)
      (if t < a then -1 else 0) (Set.Ici t) t := by
  split_ifs with h
  · have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => a - x) (-1) t := by
      simpa using! (hasDerivAt_const t a).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)
    have heq : (fun x : ℝ => max (a - x) 0) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun x => a - x) := by
      filter_upwards [gt_mem_nhds h] with x hx
      exact max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.le)
    exact (hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).hasDerivWithinAt
  · apply (hasDerivWithinAt_const t (Set.Ici t) (0 : ℝ)).congr
    · intro x hx
      exact max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr ((le_of_not_gt h).trans hx))
    · exact max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr (le_of_not_gt h))

theorem stopLoss_right_derivative (eigenvalue : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (stopLoss eigenvalue) (-aboveCount eigenvalue t) (Set.Ici t) t := by
  classical
  have h := HasDerivWithinAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => positivePart_right_derivative (eigenvalue i) t)
  have heq : (∑ i, if t < eigenvalue i then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      -aboveCount eigenvalue t := by
    unfold aboveCount
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

/-- A one-unit count gap gives the dimension-free transport estimate. -/
theorem stopLoss_difference_lipschitz (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hcount : ∀ x, |aboveCount a x - aboveCount b x| ≤ 1) (s t : ℝ) :
    |(stopLoss a s - stopLoss b s) - (stopLoss a t - stopLoss b t)| ≤ |s - t| := by
  wlog hst : s ≤ t generalizing s t
  · have h := this t s (le_of_not_ge hst)
    simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using h
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x => stopLoss a x - stopLoss b x) (Set.Icc s t) := by
    unfold stopLoss
    fun_prop
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico s t,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun y => stopLoss a y - stopLoss b y)
        (-aboveCount a x - -aboveCount b x) (Set.Ici x) x := by
    intro x _
    exact (stopLoss_right_derivative a x).sub (stopLoss_right_derivative b x)
  have hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico s t, ‖-aboveCount a x - -aboveCount b x‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro x _
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, neg_sub_neg, abs_sub_comm] using hcount x
  have hm := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_right_le_segment hc hd hb t ⟨hst, le_rfl⟩
  calc
    _ = |(stopLoss a t - stopLoss b t) - (stopLoss a s - stopLoss b s)| :=
      abs_sub_comm _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, abs_sub_comm s t,
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)] using hm

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
variable (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

noncomputable def meanDegree : ℝ :=
  (2 * G.edgeFinset.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V

noncomputable def laplacianSpectrum : V → ℝ :=
  (G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ).eigenvalues

noncomputable def laplacianEnergy : ℝ :=
  centredEnergy (laplacianSpectrum G) (meanDegree G)

theorem laplacian_trace : (G.lapMatrix ℝ).trace = (2 * G.edgeFinset.card : ℝ) := by
  have hs := G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  have hsR := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) hs
  push_cast at hsR
  simpa [Matrix.trace, SimpleGraph.lapMatrix, SimpleGraph.degMatrix,
    SimpleGraph.adjMatrix] using hsR

theorem spectrum_sum : ∑ v, laplacianSpectrum G v = (2 * G.edgeFinset.card : ℝ) := by
  simpa [laplacianSpectrum] using
    ((G.isHermitian_lapMatrix ℝ).trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues).symm.trans (laplacian_trace G)

theorem spectrum_mean [Nonempty V] :
    ∑ v, laplacianSpectrum G v = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * meanDegree G := by
  rw [spectrum_sum]
  unfold meanDegree
  have hn : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

/-- Equation (2.1) of the RG manuscript, now attached to the actual Laplacian. -/
theorem laplacianEnergy_eq_stopLoss [Nonempty V] :
    laplacianEnergy G = 2 * stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) (meanDegree G) := by
  exact energy_eq_two_stopLoss _ _ (spectrum_mean G)

theorem laplacianEnergy_nonneg : 0 ≤ laplacianEnergy G := by
  exact sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)

variable (H : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel H.Adj]

/-- Equal edge counts give the exact comparison at a common mean degree. -/
theorem energy_difference_eq_twice_stopLoss_difference [Nonempty V]
    (hedges : G.edgeFinset.card = H.edgeFinset.card) :
    laplacianEnergy G - laplacianEnergy H =
      2 * (stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) (meanDegree G) -
           stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) (meanDegree G)) := by
  rw [laplacianEnergy_eq_stopLoss, laplacianEnergy_eq_stopLoss]
  have hm : meanDegree H = meanDegree G := by simp [meanDegree, hedges]
  rw [hm]
  ring

theorem strict_comparison_iff [Nonempty V]
    (hedges : G.edgeFinset.card = H.edgeFinset.card) :
    laplacianEnergy H < laplacianEnergy G ↔
      stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum H) (meanDegree G) <
      stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) (meanDegree G) := by
  have h := energy_difference_eq_twice_stopLoss_difference G H hedges
  constructor <;> intro hlt <;> linarith

omit [DecidableEq V] in
/-- The common mean degree of any nonempty finite tree. -/
theorem tree_meanDegree (hG : G.IsTree) :
    meanDegree G = 2 - 2 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by
  have hn := hG.connected.nonempty
  have hp : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have he : (G.edgeFinset.card : ℝ) + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
    exact_mod_cast hG.card_edgeFinset
  unfold meanDegree
  field_simp
  nlinarith

/-- In particular the manuscript's centering is exactly the tree centering. -/
theorem tree_energy_identity (hG : G.IsTree) :
    laplacianEnergy G =
      2 * stopLoss (laplacianSpectrum G) (2 - 2 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) := by
  have hn := hG.connected.nonempty
  rw [laplacianEnergy_eq_stopLoss, tree_meanDegree G hG]

/-- The path-minimum target itself, with no proof supplied or assumed. -/
noncomputable def PathMinimum : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ∀ (n : ℕ) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)),
    T.IsTree → laplacianEnergy (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) ≤ laplacianEnergy T
