/-!
# Exact original tail integral and its payments

Source: revised universal manuscript, equations (other-17)--(other-20).
The same t(y) and J(y) as in the original degree-46 certificate are used.
The graph-to-tail polynomial inequalities remain separate obligations.
-/
namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.TailIntegral
open Real Set Filter MeasureTheory LargeDegreeReserve
open scoped Topology Classical
noncomputable section

def positiveTail (y : ℝ) : ℝ := log (1 + (tailParameter y)^2)/2
def phi (y : ℝ) : ℝ := -positiveTail y

theorem positive_tail_nonneg (y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ positiveTail y := by
  unfold positiveTail
  apply div_nonneg
  · exact Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tailParameter y)])
  · norm_num

def primitiveInParameter (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -((t - 1/t)*log (1+t^2)-2*t+4*arctan t)/2

theorem parameter_derivative (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    HasDerivAt primitiveInParameter (-(1+1/t^2)*log (1+t^2)/2) t := by
  have hi := (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).div (hasDerivAt_id t) ht.ne'
  have hl := (((hasDerivAt_id t).pow 2).const_add 1).log
    (show 1+t^2 ≠ 0 by positivity)
  have h := (((((hasDerivAt_id t).sub hi).mul hl).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul 2)).add ((hasDerivAt_arctan t).const_mul 4)).neg.div_const 2
  simp only [id_eq, Pi.pow_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.div_apply] at h
  convert h using 1 <;> first
    | rfl
    | (field_simp [ht.ne', show 1+t^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]; ring)

theorem tail_parameter_derivative (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt tailParameter (-tailParameter y / sqrt (y^2+4)) y := by
  have hs : 0 < sqrt (y^2+4) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have h := (((((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 2).add_const 4).sqrt
    (by change y^2+4 ≠ 0; positivity)).sub
    (hasDerivAt_id y)).div_const 2
  simp only [id_eq, Pi.pow_apply] at h
  convert h using 1 <;> first
    | rfl
    | (dsimp [tailParameter]; field_simp [hs.ne']; ring)

theorem primitive_derivative (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    HasDerivAt tailPrimitive (positiveTail y) y := by
  let t := tailParameter y
  have ht : 0 < t := (tail_parameter_properties y hy).1
  have hq : t^2+y*t=1 := (tail_parameter_properties y hy).2.2
  have hs : 0 < sqrt (y^2+4) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have he : sqrt (y^2+4)=2*t+y := by dsimp [t,tailParameter]; ring
  have hts : t*sqrt (y^2+4)=1+t^2 := by rw [he]; nlinarith [hq]
  have hm : (1+1/t^2)*t/sqrt (y^2+4)=1 := by
    calc
      _ = (1+t^2)/(t*sqrt (y^2+4)) := by field_simp [ht.ne',hs.ne']; ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hts]; exact div_self (by positivity)
  have h := (parameter_derivative t ht).comp y (tail_parameter_derivative y)
  have hd : (-(1+1/t^2)*log (1+t^2)/2)*(-t/sqrt (y^2+4)) = positiveTail y := by
    change _ = log (1+t^2)/2
    calc
      _ = (log (1+t^2)/2)*((1+1/t^2)*t/sqrt (y^2+4)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hm,mul_one]
  rw [hd] at h
  exact h

theorem primitive_nonpos (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) : tailPrimitive y ≤ 0 := by
  let t := tailParameter y
  obtain ⟨ht,ht1,_⟩ := tail_parameter_properties y hy
  have hc : 0 ≤ 1/t-t := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    apply (le_div_iff₀ ht).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hl : log (1+t^2) ≤ t^2 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1+t^2 by positivity)
    linarith
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hc
  have ha := atan_lower t ht.le
  have he : (1/t-t)*t^2 = t-t^3 := by field_simp [ht.ne']
  rw [he] at hm
  have h3 : t^3 ≤ t := by
    have hsq : t^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq ht.le
    nlinarith
  change -((t-1/t)*log (1+t^2)-2*t+4*arctan t)/2 ≤ 0
  dsimp [atanLower] at ha
  nlinarith only [hm,ha,h3,ht]

theorem parameter_tendsto : Tendsto tailParameter atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hb : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, tailParameter y ≤ 1/y := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    have hq := (tail_parameter_properties y hy.le).2.2
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hy).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tailParameter y)]
  have hn : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, 0 ≤ tailParameter y := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    exact (tail_parameter_properties y hy).1.le
  exact squeeze_zero' hn hb (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_id)

theorem primitive_tendsto : Tendsto tailPrimitive atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hn : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, 0 ≤ -tailPrimitive y := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    exact neg_nonneg.mpr (primitive_nonpos y hy)
  have hb : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, -tailPrimitive y ≤ tailParameter y := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy
    linarith [tail_lower y hy]
  have h := (squeeze_zero' hn hb parameter_tendsto).neg
  simpa using h

theorem positive_tail_integrable (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    IntegrableOn positiveTail (Ioi Y) :=
  integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg
    (primitive_derivative Y hY.le).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    (fun y hy => primitive_derivative y (lt_trans hY hy).le)
    (fun y _ => positive_tail_nonneg y) primitive_tendsto

theorem positive_tail_integral (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, positiveTail y) = -tailPrimitive Y := by
  have h := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg
    (primitive_derivative Y hY.le).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    (fun y hy => primitive_derivative y (lt_trans hY hy).le)
    (fun y _ => positive_tail_nonneg y) primitive_tendsto
  simpa using h

theorem phi_integrable (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : IntegrableOn phi (Ioi Y) :=
  (positive_tail_integrable Y hY).neg

/-- Exact equality with the original improper tail integral. -/
theorem phi_integral (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, phi y) = tailPrimitive Y := by
  simp only [phi, integral_neg, positive_tail_integral Y hY, neg_neg]

theorem inv_square_integrable_integral (k Y : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => k/y^2) (Ioi Y) ∧
      (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi Y, k/y^2) = k/Y := by
  have hd (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
      HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => -k/z) (k/y^2) y := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const y (-k)).div (hasDerivAt_id y) hy.ne'
    simp only [id_eq] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | ring
  have ht : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => -k/y) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_id
  refine ⟨integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg (hd Y hY).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    (fun y hy => hd y (lt_trans hY hy)) (fun y _ => by positivity) ht, ?_⟩
  have h := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg (hd Y hY).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    (fun y hy => hd y (lt_trans hY hy)) (fun y _ => by positivity) ht
  simpa only [zero_sub,neg_div,neg_neg] using h

theorem positive_tail_upper (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) : positiveTail y ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)/y^2 := by
  have ht := (tail_parameter_properties y hy.le).1
  have hq := (tail_parameter_properties y hy.le).2.2
  have hb : tailParameter y ≤ 1/y := (le_div_iff₀ hy).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tailParameter y)])
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht.le hb 2
  have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1+(tailParameter y)^2 by positivity)
  unfold positiveTail
  have he : (1/y)^2 = 1/y^2 := by ring
  rw [he] at hs
  have hb' : log (1+(tailParameter y)^2) ≤ 1/y^2 := by linarith only [hl,hs]
  calc
    _ ≤ (1/y^2)/2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb' (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem tail_cost (Y : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) : -(1/(2*Y)) ≤ tailPrimitive Y := by
  have h := integral_mono_ae (positive_tail_integrable Y hY)
    (inv_square_integrable_integral (1/2) Y (by norm_num) hY).1
    (by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
      exact positive_tail_upper y (lt_trans hY hy))
  rw [positive_tail_integral Y hY,
    (inv_square_integrable_integral (1/2) Y (by norm_num) hY).2] at h
  have he : -((1/2 : ℝ)/Y) = -(1/(2*Y)) := by ring
  have hh := neg_le_neg h
  rw [neg_neg,he] at hh
  exact hh

theorem positive_tail_lower (y : ℝ) (hy : 4 ≤ y) :
    (2/5 : ℝ)/y^2 ≤ positiveTail y := by
  let t := tailParameter y
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ht,_,hq⟩ := tail_parameter_properties y hy0.le
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy ht.le
  have hb : t ≤ (1/4 : ℝ) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have hs : t^2 ≤ (1/16 : ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have he : y*t=1-t^2 := by linarith [hq]
  have he2 := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z^2) he
  have hf : (4/5 : ℝ)/y^2 ≤ t^2/(1+t^2) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hy0) (by positivity : 0 < 1+t^2)).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t^2)]
  have hl := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (show 0 < 1+t^2 by positivity)
  have hr : 1-(1+t^2)⁻¹=t^2/(1+t^2) := by
    field_simp [show 1+t^2 ≠ 0 by positivity]; ring
  rw [hr] at hl
  change (2/5 : ℝ)/y^2 ≤ log (1+t^2)/2
  calc
    _ = ((4/5 : ℝ)/y^2)/2 := by ring
    _ ≤ (t^2/(1+t^2))/2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hf (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hl (by norm_num)

theorem tail_gain (Y : ℝ) (hY : 4 ≤ Y) : (2/(5*Y) : ℝ) ≤ -tailPrimitive Y := by
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have h := integral_mono_ae
    (inv_square_integrable_integral (2/5) Y (by norm_num) hY0).1
    (positive_tail_integrable Y hY0)
    (by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
      exact positive_tail_lower y (le_trans hY hy.le))
  rw [positive_tail_integral Y hY0,
    (inv_square_integrable_integral (2/5) Y (by norm_num) hY0).2] at h
  have he : (2/5 : ℝ)/Y = 2/(5*Y) := by ring
  simpa only [he] using h

theorem escape_start_gain (d : ℝ) (hd : 46 ≤ d) :
    (2/(5*(653/2000 : ℝ)))/d ≤ -tailPrimitive ((653/2000)*d) := by
  have h := tail_gain ((653/2000)*d) (by linarith)
  convert h using 1
  ring

theorem tail_cost_1024 : -(1/2048 : ℝ) ≤ tailPrimitive 1024 := by
  convert tail_cost 1024 (by norm_num) using 1
  norm_num

def escapeDensity (d y : ℝ) : ℝ := (21/25 : ℝ)/(d*(1+(y/d)^2))

/-- Exact payment for the original scaled escape region. -/
theorem escape_integral (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in ((653/2000)*d)..(10*d), escapeDensity d y) =
      (21/25 : ℝ)*(arctan 10 - arctan (653/2000)) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => (21/25 : ℝ)*arctan (y/d)
  have hf (y : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (escapeDensity d y) y := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id y).div_const d).arctan.const_mul (21/25 : ℝ)
    convert h using 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (dsimp [escapeDensity]; field_simp [hd.ne',show 1+(y/d)^2 ≠ 0 by positivity])
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => d*(1+(y/d)^2)) := by fun_prop
  have hg : Continuous (escapeDensity d) :=
    continuous_const.div hc (fun y => by positivity)
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun y _ => hf y)
    (hg.intervalIntegrable ((653/2000)*d) (10*d))
  have h10 : (10*d)/d=(10 : ℝ) := by field_simp [hd.ne']
  have hlo : ((653/2000 : ℝ)*d)/d=653/2000 := by field_simp [hd.ne']
  simpa only [F,h10,hlo,mul_sub] using h

theorem phi_interval_integral (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ y : ℝ in a..b, phi y) = tailPrimitive a - tailPrimitive b := by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi (phi_integrable a ha) hab
  rw [phi_integral a ha, phi_integral b (lt_of_lt_of_le ha hab)] at h
  exact h.symm

theorem interval_integrable_of_Ioi {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0))
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b := by
  apply (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hab).mpr
  exact hf.mono_set (by intro y hy; exact lt_of_le_of_lt ha hy.1)

theorem escape_continuous (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) : Continuous (escapeDensity d) := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => d*(1+(y/d)^2)) := by fun_prop
  exact continuous_const.div hc (fun y => by positivity)

/-- Assemble the four original, gap-free regions. The graph bounds are inputs;
all scalar integration and the original tail gain are discharged here. -/
theorem four_region_lower (f : ℝ → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 46 ≤ d)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0))
    (hlow : (-(8/3 : ℝ)*log 2-2*log 3)/d-log 2/2 ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..(1/2), f y)
    (hmiddle : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) ((653/2000)*d), phi y ≤ f y)
    (hescape : ∀ y ∈ Icc ((653/2000 : ℝ)*d) (10*d), escapeDensity d y ≤ f y)
    (htail : ∀ y ∈ Ioi (10*d), phi y ≤ f y) :
    reserveAt d ≤ ∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, f y := by
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 := by norm_num
  have hab : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ (653/2000)*d := by linarith
  have hbc : (653/2000 : ℝ)*d ≤ 10*d := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ (653/2000 : ℝ)*d := by positivity
  have hc0 : 0 < 10*d := by positivity
  have hfa := hf.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi ha)
  have hfb := hf.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hb0)
  have hfc := hf.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hc0.le)
  have hpab : IntervalIntegrable phi volume (1/2) ((653/2000)*d) := by
    apply (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hab).mpr
    exact (phi_integrable (1/2) (by norm_num)).mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
  have hm := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab hpab
    (interval_integrable_of_Ioi hf ha hab) hmiddle
  rw [phi_interval_integral (1/2) _ (by norm_num) hab] at hm
  have he := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hbc
    ((escape_continuous d hd0).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    (interval_integrable_of_Ioi hf hb0 hbc) hescape
  rw [escape_integral d hd0] at he
  have ht := integral_mono_ae (phi_integrable (10*d) hc0) hfc (by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
    exact htail y hy)
  rw [phi_integral (10*d) hc0] at ht
  have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi hf ha
  have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi hfa hab
  have h3 := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi hfb hbc
  have hg := escape_start_gain d hd
  unfold reserveAt coefficient
  rw [add_div]
  linarith only [hlow,hm,he,ht,h1,h2,h3,hg]

/-- Conditional actual-graph endpoint. The remaining premises are the original
low-strip bound and three pointwise graph-to-envelope comparisons. -/
theorem strict_fusion_of_four_regions {m : ℕ} (C : SimpleGraph (Fin m))
    (u : Fin m) (p q : ℕ) (hT : (CoreQuotient.source C u p q).IsTree)
    (hd : 46 ≤ C.degree u)
    (hlow : (-(8/3 : ℝ)*log 2-2*log 3)/(C.degree u : ℝ)-log 2/2 ≤
      ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..(1/2),
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source C u p q) (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) 2 y)
    (hmiddle : ∀ y ∈ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) ((653/2000)*(C.degree u : ℝ)), phi y ≤
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source C u p q) (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) 2 y)
    (hescape : ∀ y ∈ Icc ((653/2000 : ℝ)*(C.degree u : ℝ)) (10*(C.degree u : ℝ)),
      escapeDensity (C.degree u) y ≤
        MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source C u p q) (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) 2 y)
    (htail : ∀ y ∈ Ioi (10*(C.degree u : ℝ)), phi y ≤
      MixedGraphIntegral.logarithm (CoreQuotient.source C u p q) (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) 2 y) :
    laplacianEnergy (CoreQuotient.fused C u p q) <
      laplacianEnergy (CoreQuotient.source C u p q) := by
  classical
  apply strict_fusion_of_original_integral_bound C u p q hT hd
  have h := four_region_lower _ (C.degree u) (by exact_mod_cast hd)
    (ActualFusionIntegral.logarithm_integrable C u p q 2) hlow hmiddle hescape htail
  change reserveAt (C.degree u) / Real.pi ≤ (1/Real.pi)*_
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm,one_mul,mul_one] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (show 0 ≤ 1/Real.pi by positivity)

import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.TensorPolynomial
open Finset
open scoped Classical

abbrev Exponent (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℕ
abbrev Term (n : ℕ) := ℤ × Exponent n
abbrev Poly (n : ℕ) := List (Term n)

noncomputable def monomial {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (e : Exponent n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, x i ^ e i

noncomputable def evaluate {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Poly n → ℝ
  | [] => 0
  | t :: p => t.1 * monomial x t.2 + evaluate x p

def bounded {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Prop :=
  ∀ t ∈ p, ∀ i, t.2 i ≤ d i

instance {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Decidable (bounded d p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ t ∈ p, ∀ i, t.2 i ≤ d i))

def factor {n : ℕ} (d e j : Exponent n) : ℤ :=
  ∏ i, if e i ≤ j i then (Nat.choose (d i - e i) (j i - e i) : ℤ) else 0

def coefficient {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) : Poly n → ℤ
  | [] => 0
  | t :: p => t.1 * factor d t.2 j + coefficient d j p

noncomputable def weight {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, x i ^ j i * (1 - x i) ^ (d i - j i)

theorem weight_nonneg {n : ℕ} (d j : Exponent n) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ weight d j x := by
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hx i).1 _) (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hx i).2) _))

private theorem univariate_expansion (n j : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n) (t : ℝ) :
    t ^ j = (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
      else 0) := by
  -- Step 1: t^j = t^j * (t + (1-t))^(n-j)
  have h1 : t + (1 - t) = (1 : ℝ) := by ring
  have hstart : t ^ j = t ^ j * (t + (1 - t)) ^ (n - j) := by
    rw [h1, one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [hstart]
  -- Step 2: expand (t + (1-t))^(n-j) via binomial theorem
  rw [add_pow t (1 - t) (n - j)]
  -- Goal: t^j * Σ_m C(n-j,m) * t^m * (1-t)^(n-j-m) = Σ_k if j≤k then ...
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  -- Step 3: reindex the sum. LHS sums over m ∈ range(n-j+1), RHS over k ∈ range(n+1)
  -- Let k = m + j, so m = k - j
  -- We split the RHS: terms with k < j are 0, terms with j ≤ k contribute
  -- First simplify: the RHS sum over k < j gives 0
  have hsplit : (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
      else 0) =
    (Finset.range (n - j + 1)).sum (fun m =>
      (Nat.choose (n - j) m : ℝ) * t ^ (m + j) * (1 - t) ^ (n - j - m)) := by
    -- Reindex: k = m + j
    rw [show n + 1 = j + (n + 1 - j) from by omega]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
    -- The first part (k < j) sums to 0
    have hfirst : (Finset.range j).sum (fun k =>
        if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
        else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      simp only [show ¬(j ≤ k) from by omega, ite_false]
    rw [hfirst, zero_add]
    -- Second part: ∑ m in range(n+1-j), f(m+j)
    -- f(m+j) = if j ≤ m+j then C(n-j, m+j-j) * t^(m+j) * (1-t)^(n-(m+j)) else 0
    --        = C(n-j, m) * t^(m+j) * (1-t)^(n-j-m)
    rw [show n + 1 - j = n - j + 1 from by omega]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
    have hjle : j ≤ j + m := Nat.le_add_right j m
    rw [if_pos hjle]
    have h1 : j + m - j = m := by omega
    have h2 : n - (j + m) = n - j - m := by omega
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  -- Now both sides sum over m ∈ range(n-j+1)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
  -- LHS: t^j * (t^m * (1-t)^(n-j-m) * C(n-j,m))
  -- RHS: C(n-j,m) * t^(m+j) * (1-t)^(n-j-m)
  rw [pow_add t m j]
  ring


theorem monomial_expansion {n : ℕ} (d e : Exponent n) (he : ∀ i, e i ≤ d i)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    monomial x e = ∑ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      (factor d e (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) : ℝ) *
        weight d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) x := by
  have hi (i : Fin n) : x i ^ e i = ∑ j : Fin (d i + 1),
      ((if e i ≤ (j : ℕ) then
        (Nat.choose (d i - e i) ((j : ℕ) - e i) : ℤ) else 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
        (x i ^ (j : ℕ) * (1 - x i) ^ (d i - (j : ℕ))) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j : ℕ =>
      ((if e i ≤ j then (Nat.choose (d i - e i) (j - e i) : ℤ) else 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
        (x i ^ j * (1 - x i) ^ (d i - j))) (d i + 1)]
    simpa only [Int.cast_ite, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_zero, mul_assoc,
      ite_mul, zero_mul] using
      univariate_expansion (d i) (e i) (he i) (x i)
  unfold monomial
  simp_rw [hi]
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [factor, weight, Int.cast_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib

theorem representation {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) (hp : bounded d p)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    evaluate x p = ∑ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      (coefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p : ℝ) *
        weight d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) x := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [evaluate, coefficient]
  | cons t p ih =>
    have ht : ∀ i, t.2 i ≤ d i := hp t (by simp)
    have hrest : bounded d p := fun u hu => hp u (by simp [hu])
    simp only [evaluate, coefficient, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← ih hrest]
    rw [monomial_expansion d t.2 ht x, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring

def accepts {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n) : Bool :=
  decide (bounded d p ∧ ∀ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
    0 ≤ coefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p)

theorem accepts_sound {n : ℕ} (d : Exponent n) (p : Poly n)
    (hc : accepts d p = true) (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 ≤ evaluate x p := by
  have h : bounded d p ∧ ∀ j : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)),
      0 ≤ coefficient d (fun i => (j i : ℕ)) p := of_decide_eq_true hc
  rw [representation d p h.1 x]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  exact mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast h.2 j) (weight_nonneg d _ x hx)

theorem power_expansion (n j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) (t : ℝ) :
    t ^ j = (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
      else 0) := univariate_expansion n j hj t

#print axioms monomial_expansion
#print axioms representation
#print axioms accepts_sound
#print axioms power_expansion
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.TensorPolynomial

import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Hasse

/-!
# The terminal trees for RG leaf descent

For a finite nontrivial tree, the leaf count is two plus the total degree excess.
Its leaf count is two precisely when it is isomorphic to the path of the same order.
The singleton tree is excluded from the leaf-count characterization.
-/

namespace Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.TreeTerminal

open SimpleGraph RewireTopology
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V]

/-- The total branching excess, with natural subtraction at each vertex. -/
def branchingExcess (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ := ∑ v, (G.degree v - 2)

theorem leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hT : G.IsTree) : leafCount G = 2 + branchingExcess G := by
  have hlocal : ∀ v, G.degree v + (if G.degree v = 1 then 1 else 0) =
      2 + (G.degree v - 2) := by
    intro v
    have hp := hT.connected.preconnected.degree_pos_of_nontrivial v
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have hs : (∑ v : V, (G.degree v + (if G.degree v = 1 then 1 else 0))) =
      ∑ v : V, (2 + (G.degree v - 2)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => hlocal v)
  have he := hT.card_edgeFinset
  have hd := G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_boole] at hs
  change (∑ v, G.degree v) + leafCount G =
    Fintype.card V * 2 + branchingExcess G at hs
  omega

theorem branching_excess_eq_zero_iff (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    branchingExcess G = 0 ↔ ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2 := by
  simp [branchingExcess, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff, Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le]

theorem leaf_count_eq_two_iff_degree_le_two [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hT : G.IsTree) : leafCount G = 2 ↔ ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2 := by
  rw [leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess G hT]
  simpa using branching_excess_eq_zero_iff G

theorem path_graph_degree_le_two (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (pathGraph n).degree i ≤ 2 := by
  let f : (pathGraph n).neighborSet i → Fin 2 := fun j =>
    if j.val.val < i.val then 0 else 1
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    have ha := pathGraph_adj.mp a.property
    have hb := pathGraph_adj.mp b.property
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [f] at hab
    split_ifs at hab <;> simp at hab <;> omega
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  simpa only [card_neighborSet_eq_degree, Fintype.card_fin] using hc

/-- A path between two leaves exhausts a connected graph of maximum degree two. -/
theorem leaf_path_spanning (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected)
    (hd : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2) {u v : V} (huv : u ≠ v)
    (hu : G.degree u = 1) (hv : G.degree v = 1)
    (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath) : p.toSubgraph.IsSpanning := by
  have hnil : ¬p.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne huv
  have hn : ∀ x ∈ p.support, p.toSubgraph.neighborSet x = G.neighborSet x := by
    intro x hx
    apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le (p.toSubgraph.neighborSet_subset x)
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← G.neighborFinset_def, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    by_cases hxu : x = u
    · subst x
      rw [hp.neighborSet_toSubgraph_startpoint hnil, Set.ncard_singleton, hu]
    · by_cases hxv : x = v
      · subst x
        rw [hp.neighborSet_toSubgraph_endpoint hnil, Set.ncard_singleton, hv]
      · obtain ⟨i, hi, hil⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp hx
        have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          subst i
          exact hxu (by simpa using hi.symm)
        have hilt : i < p.length := by
          by_contra h
          have heq : i = p.length := by omega
          subst i
          exact hxv (by simpa using hi.symm)
        rw [← hi, hp.ncard_neighborSet_toSubgraph_internal_eq_two hi0 hilt]
        exact hd _
  have hclosed : ∀ x y, x ∈ p.support → G.Adj x y → y ∈ p.support := by
    intro x y hx hxy
    apply p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mp
    exact p.toSubgraph.neighborSet_subset_verts x ((hn x hx).symm ▸ hxy)
  have hwalk : ∀ {a b} (q : G.Walk a b), b ∈ p.support → a ∈ p.support := by
    intro a b q
    induction q with
    | nil => exact id
    | cons hab q ih =>
      intro hb
      exact hclosed _ _ (ih hb) hab.symm
  intro x
  obtain ⟨q⟩ := hG x u
  exact p.mem_verts_toSubgraph.mpr (hwalk q p.start_mem_support)

/-- Every finite nontrivial tree of maximum degree two is the path of its order. -/
theorem tree_path_iso_of_degree_le_two [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hT : G.IsTree) (hd : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2) :
    Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card V)) := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu, hv⟩ := hT.exists_ne_and_degree_eq_one
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hT.connected.exists_isPath u v
  have hs := leaf_path_spanning G hT.connected hd huv hu hv p hp
  let e := p.toSubgraph.spanningCoeEquivCoeOfSpanning hs
  have hc : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.Connected :=
    e.connected_iff.mpr p.toSubgraph_connected
  have heq : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe = G :=
    le_antisymm p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe_le
      ((isTree_iff_minimal_connected.mp hT).2 hc p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe_le)
  have f : pathGraph (p.length + 1) ≃g G := by
    simpa only [heq] using hp.pathGraphIsoToSubgraph.trans e.symm
  have hcard : p.length + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_congr f.toEquiv
  exact ⟨(hcard ▸ f).symm⟩

theorem tree_two_leaves_iff_path [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hT : G.IsTree) :
    leafCount G = 2 ↔ Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card V)) := by
  rw [leaf_count_eq_two_iff_degree_le_two G hT]
  refine ⟨tree_path_iso_of_degree_le_two G hT, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨f⟩ v
  rw [← f.degree_eq v]
  exact path_graph_degree_le_two _ _

theorem nonpath_has_three_leaves [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hT : G.IsTree)
    (hpath : ¬Nonempty (G ≃g pathGraph (Fintype.card V))) : 3 ≤ leafCount G := by
  have hl := leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess G hT
  have hn := (tree_two_leaves_iff_path G hT).not.mpr hpath
  omega

#print axioms leaf_count_eq_two_add_excess
#print axioms branching_excess_eq_zero_iff
#print axioms leaf_count_eq_two_iff_degree_le_two
#print axioms path_graph_degree_le_two
#print axioms leaf_path_spanning
#print axioms tree_path_iso_of_degree_le_two
#print axioms tree_two_leaves_iff_path
#print axioms nonpath_has_three_leaves

end
end Gebendorfer.RadenkovicGutman.TreeTerminal
